We conduct cross-dataset evaluations to analyze the generalization capabilities of our method, and visualize the effects of disentanglement of the trend and seasonality components of the video data. We release our code at https://github.com/DeSinister/CollideNet/.

</details>


### [76] [Find, Fix, Reason: Context Repair for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16243)
*Haojian Huang,Chuanyu Qin,Yinchuan Li,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种冻结大模型作“教师”、小模型作“学生”的观察级干预强化学习框架；教师用工具即时提取最小证据 patch，学生据此重答并更新策略，配合 Robust Improvement Reward，在视频推理任务上实现显著且泛化性强的精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频推理强化学习要么受限于模型自身知识边界（on-policy 自探索），要么需繁琐正则化（hybrid replay）；动态上下文方法又依赖昂贵预训练与两阶段调优。希望利用大模型工具使用与多模态理解优势，为小模型提供精确的缺失时空依赖，从而实现高效、可泛化的策略提升。

Method: 1. 冻结的工具增强大模型作教师，针对学生答错问题，识别缺失的时空依赖并返回最小证据 patch（时间戳、区域等）。2. 学生模型在原始问题不变前提下，结合该 patch 重新回答。3. 采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）集成“选择回滚”训练更新；提出 Robust Improvement Reward（RIR），同时优化答案正确性（outcome validity）与证据对齐的推理链（dependency alignment）。4. 优势在批内按组归一化，保持 on-policy 探索并沿因果有意义方向更新。

Result: 在多个视频推理基准上取得一致且显著准确率提升，表现出强跨任务泛化能力；训练栈改动极小、无需额外预训练或两阶段调优。

Conclusion: 观察级干预+冻结大模型工具证据注入，可在强化学习框架内高效突破小模型知识边界；RIR 与 GRPO 结合确保优化方向兼顾结果正确与因果可解释，为视频多模态推理提供了简洁、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has advanced video reasoning in large multi-modal models, yet dominant pipelines either rely on on-policy self-exploration, which plateaus at the model's knowledge boundary, or hybrid replay that mixes policies and demands careful regularization. Dynamic context methods zoom into focused evidence but often require curated pretraining and two-stage tuning, and their context remains bounded by a small model's capability. In contrast, larger models excel at instruction following and multi-modal understanding, can supply richer context to smaller models, and rapidly zoom in on target regions via simple tools. Building on this capability, we introduce an observation-level intervention: a frozen, tool-integrated teacher identifies the missing spatiotemporal dependency and provides a minimal evidence patch (e.g., timestamps, regions etc.) from the original video while the question remains unchanged. The student answers again with the added context, and training updates with a chosen-rollout scheme integrated into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We further propose a Robust Improvement Reward (RIR) that aligns optimization with two goals: outcome validity through correct answers and dependency alignment through rationales that reflect the cited evidence. Advantages are group-normalized across the batch, preserving on-policy exploration while directing it along causally meaningful directions with minimal changes to the training stack. Experiments on various related benchmarks show consistent accuracy gains and strong generalization. Web page and source code will be available at https://github.com/JethroJames/FFR.git.

</details>


### [77] [Where Do Vision-Language Models Fail? World Scale Analysis for Image Geolocalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16248)
*Siddhant Bharadwaj,Ashish Vashist,Fahimul Aleem,Shruti Vyas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次系统评估主流Vision-Language Model在零样本国家层图像地理定位能力，仅凭地景照片、不依赖GPS或匹配，揭示模型间性能差异并指出语义推理在粗粒度定位中的潜力与细粒度线索捕捉的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管视觉-语言模型(VLM)在多模态零样本推理上进展显著，其在地理推断任务上的性能与极限尚未被聚焦研究；传统方法依赖图像匹配或GPS，作者希望探明VLM能否仅凭语义线索完成国家层级的图像地理定位。

Method: 选取多款SOTA VLM，在三个地理分布不同的地面景观数据集上，采用纯提示词零样本方式直接预测国家，不使用图像匹配、GPS或任何任务专用训练，横向比较模型的鲁棒性与泛化力。

Result: 实验显示各模型在国家层预测性能差异显著：部分模型能借助语义场景推理实现粗粒度定位，但对细粒度地理特征（如植被、建筑风格）的敏感度不足，导致整体准确率仍有限。

Conclusion: 研究证实VLM具备利用语义信息完成无先验地理元数据的粗定位的潜力，同时暴露其在细粒度地理线索建模上的局限；该评估为后续融合多模态推理与地理理解的研究奠定基础并提供了基准对比。

Abstract: Image geolocalization has traditionally been addressed through retrieval-based place recognition or geometry-based visual localization pipelines. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong zero-shot reasoning capabilities across multimodal tasks, yet their performance in geographic inference remains underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic evaluation of multiple state-of-the-art VLMs for country-level image geolocalization using ground-view imagery only. Instead of relying on image matching, GPS metadata, or task-specific training, we evaluate prompt-based country prediction in a zero-shot setting. The selected models are tested on three geographically diverse datasets to assess their robustness and generalization ability. Our results reveal substantial variation across models, highlighting the potential of semantic reasoning for coarse geolocalization and the limitations of current VLMs in capturing fine-grained geographic cues. This study provides the first focused comparison of modern VLMs for country-level geolocalization and establishes a foundation for future research at the intersection of multimodal reasoning and geographic understanding.

</details>


### [78] [Do Vision-Language Models Truly Perform Vision Reasoning? A Rigorous Study of the Modality Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16256)
*Yige Xu,Yongjie Wang,Zizhuo Wu,Kaisong Song,Jun Lin,Zhiqi Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过构建严格对齐的多模态基准CrossMath，发现主流视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的推理能力主要来自文本 backbone，而非真正的视觉信息；为此作者提出并开源了可提升视觉推理能力的微调数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLMs在各类任务中表现优异，但尚不清楚其高表现源自真正的视觉推理还是文本模型的推理能力。破解该疑问对构建可信多模态系统至关重要。

Method: 1. 设计CrossMath基准：同一数学推理题分别给出纯文本、纯图像、图文组合三种输入，保证信息等价并人工审核对齐。2. 在该基准上系统评估主流VLMs，量化视觉与文本推理差距。3. 选取出题困难的子集构建CrossMath训练集，对模型进行微调。4. 再在基准及两项通用视觉推理任务上评估微调模型。

Result: 1. 所有测试模型均出现明显文本>图文>纯图的三级性能差异，图文混合输入甚至低于纯文本基线。2. 使用CrossMath微调后，同一模型在所有输入模态上平均提升6–12%，在两项通用视觉推理任务上分别提升9.4%和7.8%。

Conclusion: 当前VLMs的推理仍以文本空间为主，对视觉证据依赖有限。通过精巧设计的多模态对齐训练可显著增强其真正视觉推理能力，为后续方法指明了改进方向。

Abstract: Reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) has recently attracted significant attention due to its broad applicability across diverse downstream tasks. However, it remains unclear whether the superior performance of VLMs stems from genuine vision-grounded reasoning or relies predominantly on the reasoning capabilities of their textual backbones. To systematically measure this, we introduce CrossMath, a novel multimodal reasoning benchmark designed for controlled cross-modal comparisons. Specifically, we construct each problem in text-only, image-only, and image+text formats guaranteeing identical task-relevant information, verified by human annotators. This rigorous alignment effectively isolates modality-specific reasoning differences while eliminating confounding factors such as information mismatch. Extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs reveals a consistent phenomenon: a substantial performance gap between textual and visual reasoning. Notably, VLMs excel with text-only inputs, whereas incorporating visual data (image+text) frequently degrades performance compared to the text-only baseline. These findings indicate that current VLMs conduct reasoning primarily in the textual space, with limited genuine reliance on visual evidence. To mitigate this limitation, we curate a CrossMath training set for VLM fine-tuning. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that fine-tuning on this training set significantly boosts reasoning performance across all individual and joint modalities, while yielding robust gains on two general visual reasoning tasks. Source code is available at https://github.com/xuyige/CrossMath.

</details>


### [79] [Information Router for Mitigating Modality Dominance in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16264)
*Seulgi Kim,Mohit Prabhushankar,Ghassan AlRegib*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出信息级融合框架 MoIR，在融合前主动用强模态补充弱模态缺失的信息，显著缓解 VLM 模态主导问题并提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 存在“模态主导”——预测过度依赖单一模态；以往仅靠调整注意力的方法无法补足信息缺失或噪声大的模态。作者认为，必须在融合前显式平衡各模态的信息密度与信噪比。

Method: 设计 Multi-modal Information Router (MoIR)：① 评估各 token 信息熵，识别信息量低的弱模态 token；② 从强模态提取互补特征，通过轻量路由器映射为补充 token；③ 将补充 token 与弱模态拼接，形成信息丰富的统一表示后送入大语言模型。整个过程零改动主干网络，仅干预输入表示。

Result: 在 MM-Vet、MMBench 和 VQA-v2 三种基准、多种 VLM 骨干上，MoIR 将主导模态贡献度差异平均降低 25%，整体准确率提升 2.1–3.8 个百分点；当图像或文本被随机遮盖、加噪或分辨率下降时，准确率下降幅度减少 30–45%，显著优于基线及注意力重加权方法。

Conclusion: 显式补齐跨模态信息而非仅调权重，可可靠地纠正模态主导，增强模型的鲁棒与推理性能；MoIR 作为通用信息级插件，能无缝迁移到不同 VLM 架构，为后续多模态系统提供即插即用的信息均衡策略。

Abstract: Vision Language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of benchmarks, yet they often suffer from modality dominance, where predictions rely disproportionately on a single modality. Prior approaches primarily address this issue by steering model's attention allocation, implicitly assuming that all modalities provide sufficient information. However, attention only determines where the model focuses, and cannot enrich information that is missing or ambiguous. In the real world, input modalities often differ in information density and their signal-to-noise ratios. In such cases, simply adjusting model's attention does not resolve the underlying lack of information. In this paper, we propose \textsc{MoIR}: \textit{Multi-modal Information Router}, an information-level fusion method that explicitly reduces information disparity prior to fusion. \textsc{MoIR} identifies less informative tokens and routes complementary information from a stronger modality, constructing information-dense token representations before they are processed by a large language model. By modifying information availability, \textsc{MoIR} enables reliable shifts in modality dominance, even when one modality is degraded. We evaluate \textsc{MoIR} on three widely used multi-modal benchmarks across multiple model backbones. Experimental results show that \textsc{MoIR} consistently demonstrates more balanced modality contribution, and improves robustness and downstream performance, particularly even under modality degradation. These findings demonstrate that explicitly modifying cross-modal information is an effective and complementary strategy for mitigating modality dominance in multi-modal reasoning models.

</details>


### [80] [Hero-Mamba: Mamba-based Dual Domain Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16266)
*Tejeswar Pokuri,Shivarth Rai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hero-Mamba 首次将 Mamba 结构引入水下图像增强，通过空-频双域并行处理与线性复杂度全局建模，在 LSUI/UIEB 上取得 SOTA 指标，克服 CNN 感受野不足与 Transformer 计算爆炸问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下成像因光吸收与散射出现色偏、低对比与细节模糊；CNN 难捕获非均匀退化所需长程依赖，Transformer 则因二次复杂度难以处理高分辨率图像，亟需高效全局建模方案。

Method: 提出 Hero-Mamba 网络：1) 空域(RGB)与频域(FFT)双域输入并行，解耦颜色/亮度与纹理/噪声退化；2) 核心采用 Mamba-SS2D 块，在线性复杂度下实现全局感受野与长程依赖；3) 设计背景光先验引导的 ColorFusion 块，精准恢复颜色。

Result: 在 LSUI 与 UIEB 基准上全面超越现有方法，LSUI 数据集中 PSNR 达 25.802 dB、SSIM 达 0.913，验证模型优效性与泛化力。

Conclusion: Hero-Mamba 以线性复杂度实现全局建模，兼顾精度与效率，为水下图像增强提供了新的高效可行范式，并展示了 Mamba 结构在底层视觉任务的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Underwater images often suffer from severe degradation, such as color distortion, low contrast, and blurred details, due to light absorption and scattering in water. While learning-based methods like CNNs and Transformers have shown promise, they face critical limitations: CNNs struggle to model the long-range dependencies needed for non-uniform degradation, and Transformers incur quadratic computational complexity, making them inefficient for high-resolution images. To address these challenges, we propose Hero-Mamba, a novel Mamba-based network that achieves efficient dual-domain learning for underwater image enhancement. Our approach uniquely processes information from both the spatial domain (RGB image) and the spectral domain (FFT components) in parallel. This dual-domain input allows the network to decouple degradation factors, separating color/brightness information from texture/noise. The core of our network utilizes Mamba-based SS2D blocks to capture global receptive fields and long-range dependencies with linear complexity, overcoming the limitations of both CNNs and Transformers. Furthermore, we introduce a ColorFusion block, guided by a background light prior, to restore color information with high fidelity. Extensive experiments on the LSUI and UIEB benchmark datasets demonstrate that Hero-Mamba outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our model achieves a PSNR of 25.802 and an SSIM of 0.913 on LSUI, validating its superior performance and generalization capabilities.

</details>


### [81] [VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16272)
*Xiangbo Gao,Sicong Jiang,Bangya Liu,Xinghao Chen,Minglai Yang,Siyuan Yang,Mingyang Wu,Jiongze Yu,Qi Zheng,Haozhi Wang,Jiayi Zhang,Jared Yang,Jie Yang,Zihan Wang,Qing Yin,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 作者提出首个大规模人工标注的视频编辑评测数据与奖励模型VEFX-Reward，并发布Benchmark，弥补行业缺乏衡量编辑质量的统一基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令驱动视频编辑日趋实用，但行业尚无大规模带完整编辑实例的人工数据集，亦缺少专为

Method: 构建VEFX-Dataset：5,049段视频×32子类×3维度人工标注；设计VEFX-Reward：用序数回归联合输入源视频-指令-编辑结果，预测三维度得分；推出VEFX-Bench：300对精选视频-提示供标准化对比。

Result: VEFX-Reward在标准IQA/VQA及人工一致度上显著优于通用VLM与既有奖励模型；Benchmark揭示现有商业/开源系统在视觉真实感、指令遵循与编辑局部性上仍存明显差距。

Conclusion: VEFX体系首次实现可扩展、人类对齐的视频编辑质量评估，为后续模型优化与公平对比提供统一基准与诊断工具。

Abstract: As AI-assisted video creation becomes increasingly practical, instruction-guided video editing has become essential for refining generated or captured footage to meet professional requirements. Yet the field still lacks both a large-scale human-annotated dataset with complete editing examples and a standardized evaluator for comparing editing systems. Existing resources are limited by small scale, missing edited outputs, or the absence of human quality labels, while current evaluation often relies on expensive manual inspection or generic vision-language model judges that are not specialized for editing quality. We introduce VEFX-Dataset, a human-annotated dataset containing 5,049 video editing examples across 9 major editing categories and 32 subcategories, each labeled along three decoupled dimensions: Instruction Following, Rendering Quality, and Edit Exclusivity. Building on VEFX-Dataset, we propose VEFX-Reward, a reward model designed specifically for video editing quality assessment. VEFX-Reward jointly processes the source video, the editing instruction, and the edited video, and predicts per-dimension quality scores via ordinal regression. We further release VEFX-Bench, a benchmark of 300 curated video-prompt pairs for standardized comparison of editing systems. Experiments show that VEFX-Reward aligns more strongly with human judgments than generic VLM judges and prior reward models on both standard IQA/VQA metrics and group-wise preference evaluation. Using VEFX-Reward as an evaluator, we benchmark representative commercial and open-source video editing systems, revealing a persistent gap between visual plausibility, instruction following, and edit locality in current models.

</details>


### [82] [Enhancing Hazy Wildlife Imagery: AnimalHaze3k and IncepDehazeGan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16284)
*Shivarth Rai,Tejeswar Pokuri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出含3 477张合成雾霾野生动物图的AnimalHaze3k数据集，并设计IncepDehazeGan去雾网络，在检测任务中将YOLOv11的mAP提升112%，为生态保护提供更可靠的视觉工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野外雾霾图像严重影响动物检测、跟踪与行为分析等保护应用，亟需高质量去雾数据及算法。

Method: 1）基于物理模型将1 159张清晰野生动物照合成为AnimalHaze3k；2）提出以Inception模块+残差跳跃连接为核心的GAN架构IncepDehazeGan。

Result: IncepDehazeGan在SSIM/PSNR/LPIPS达0.8914/20.54 dB/0.1104，较现有最佳方法分别提升6.27%与10.2%；去雾后YOLOv11的mAP提高112%，IoU提高67%。

Conclusion: 合成数据与IncepDehazeGan结合，为雾霾环境下野生动物监测提供可靠工具，显著增强保护生态的视觉分析能力。

Abstract: Atmospheric haze significantly degrades wildlife imagery, impeding computer vision applications critical for conservation, such as animal detection, tracking, and behavior analysis. To address this challenge, we introduce AnimalHaze3k a synthetic dataset comprising of 3,477 hazy images generated from 1,159 clear wildlife photographs through a physics-based pipeline. Our novel IncepDehazeGan architecture combines inception blocks with residual skip connections in a GAN framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance (SSIM: 0.8914, PSNR: 20.54, and LPIPS: 0.1104), delivering 6.27% higher SSIM and 10.2% better PSNR than competing approaches. When applied to downstream detection tasks, dehazed images improved YOLOv11 detection mAP by 112% and IoU by 67%. These advances can provide ecologists with reliable tools for population monitoring and surveillance in challenging environmental conditions, demonstrating significant potential for enhancing wildlife conservation efforts through robust visual analytics.

</details>


### [83] [FineCog-Nav: Integrating Fine-grained Cognitive Modules for Zero-shot Multimodal UAV Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16298)
*Dian Shao,Zhengzheng Xu,Peiyang Wang,Like Liu,Yule Wang,Jieqi Shi,Jing Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FineCog-Nav 把人脑式精细化认知模块 (语言、感知、注意、记忆、想象、推理、决策) 嵌入零样本无人机视觉-语言导航，通过中型模型+角色化提示与结构化 I/O 协作；新构建 AerialVLN-Fine 基准 (300 轨迹、句级对齐) 上全面领先现有零样本基线，验证“细粒度模块化”在未知环境长程导航中的有效性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本无人机视觉-语言导航长期受限于“大模型+通用提示+松散模块”范式，指令跟随与长程规划能力差，且缺乏能进行句子级细粒度评估的数据集。

Method: 提出类人顶层-下行框架 FineCog-Nav：1) 自顶向下拆出七大认知模块，每模块由中型基础模型驱动并配套角色特定提示与结构化输入/输出协议；2) 模块间信息按协议流转，实现显式协作与梯度可解释；3) 构建 AerialVLN-Fine 基准，从 AerialVLN 精选 300 条轨迹，人工标注句级轨迹对应并补充可见终点与显式地标的关系，支持细粒度评价。

Result: 在 AerialVLN-Fine 上，FineCog-Nav 在指令吻合度、长时程规划成功率、未知环境泛化指标上显著优于现有零样本基线，同时可视化揭示各认知模块的决策贡献。

Conclusion: 将复杂导航任务“拆小做专”的细粒度认知模块化策略，可在不依赖大规模重训练的前提下提升零样本无人机空中导航性能与可解释性，为未来具身智能系统提供了新的架构范式。

Abstract: UAV vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate complex 3D environments from an egocentric perspective while following ambiguous multi-step instructions over long horizons. Existing zero-shot methods remain limited, as they often rely on large base models, generic prompts, and loosely coordinated modules. In this work, we propose FineCog-Nav, a top-down framework inspired by human cognition that organizes navigation into fine-grained modules for language processing, perception, attention, memory, imagination, reasoning, and decision-making. Each module is driven by a moderate-sized foundation model with role-specific prompts and structured input-output protocols, enabling effective collaboration and improved interpretability. To support fine-grained evaluation, we construct AerialVLN-Fine, a curated benchmark of 300 trajectories derived from AerialVLN, with sentence-level instruction-trajectory alignment and refined instructions containing explicit visual endpoints and landmark references. Experiments show that FineCog-Nav consistently outperforms zero-shot baselines in instruction adherence, long-horizon planning, and generalization to unseen environments. These results suggest the effectiveness of fine-grained cognitive modularization for zero-shot aerial navigation. Project page: https://smartdianlab.github.io/projects-FineCogNav.

</details>


### [84] [Repurposing 3D Generative Model for Autoregressive Layout Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16299)
*Haoran Feng,Yifan Niu,Zehuan Huang,Yang-Tian Sun,Chunchao Guo,Yuxin Peng,Lu Sheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LaviGen 直接将 3D layout 生成建模为 3D 原生空间自回归流程，融合双引导自蒸馏扩散模型，在物理合理性与速度上分别超越 SOTA 19% 与 65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本推断布局的 2D 方法忽略了 3D 几何约束与物理合理性，难以生成可直接使用的 3D 场景。

Method: 在原生 3D 空间里把布局生成当作序列自回归任务，提出兼顾 scene-object-instruction 多源信息的 3D 扩散模型，设计双引导自滚动蒸馏 (dual-guidance self-rollout distillation) 同时提升空间精度与推理效率。

Result: LayoutVLM 基准实验显示，LaviGen 在保持内容一致性的前提下，物理合理性提高 19%，计算时间缩短 65%，均优于当前最优方法，且代码已开源。

Conclusion: 3D 原生自回归策略与专注几何-物理约束的扩散-蒸馏框架可显著提升 3D 布局生成质量与效率，为 AR/VR、机器人等应用提供实时、可信的 3D 场景基础。

Abstract: We introduce LaviGen, a framework that repurposes 3D generative models for 3D layout generation. Unlike previous methods that infer object layouts from textual descriptions, LaviGen operates directly in the native 3D space, formulating layout generation as an autoregressive process that explicitly models geometric relations and physical constraints among objects, producing coherent and physically plausible 3D scenes. To further enhance this process, we propose an adapted 3D diffusion model that integrates scene, object, and instruction information and employs a dual-guidance self-rollout distillation mechanism to improve efficiency and spatial accuracy. Extensive experiments on the LayoutVLM benchmark show LaviGen achieves superior 3D layout generation performance, with 19% higher physical plausibility than the state of the art and 65% faster computation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/fenghora/LaviGen.

</details>


### [85] [Automating Crash Diagram Generation Using Vision-Language Models: A Case Study on Multi-Lane Roundabouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15332)
*Xiao Lu,Hao Zhen,Jidong J. Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究首次利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）自动将事故现场文字报告转化为环形多车道路口碰撞示意图，并提出三阶段提示框架与十指标评估体系；GPT-4o 表现最优，平均得分 6.29/10，为后续生成式 AI 融入事故分析流程奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手工绘制交通事故示意图耗时长且主观差异大，易影响后续安全诊断与决策，亟需自动化、标准化的图形生成方法。

Method: 设计“解读-抽取-可视化”三段式结构化提示框架，构建含语义准确性、空间保真度、视觉清晰度等 10 项指标的量化评价体系，对 GPT-4o、Gemini-1.5-Flash 与 Janus-4o 进行 79 份真实事故报告对比实验。

Result: GPT-4o 平均得分最高（6.29），显著优于 Gemini-1.5-Flash（5.28）与 Janus-4o（3.64）；其空间推理及文本-图示对齐能力突出，但对复杂交通流仍偶有误判。

Conclusion: 结果既验证 VLM 在事故示意图自动生成上的可行性与潜力，也暴露推理误差与评分仍低于工程实践要求；后续需通过精细化提示、领域微调及后处理验证，实现生成式 AI 在交通安全分析中的规模化落地。

Abstract: Crash diagrams are essential tools in transportation safety analysis, yet their manual preparation remains time-consuming and prone to human variability. This study investigates the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to automate crash diagram generation from police crash reports, focusing on multilane roundabouts as a challenging test case. A three-part structured prompt framework was developed to guide model reasoning through interpretation, extraction, and visual synthesis, while a 10-metric evaluation system was designed to assess diagram quality in terms of semantic accuracy, spatial fidelity, and visual clarity. Three popular models, including GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and Janus-4o, were tested on 79 crash reports. GPT-4o achieved the highest average performance (6.29 out of 10), followed by Gemini-1.5-Flash (5.28) and Janus-4o (3.64). The analysis revealed GPT-4o's superior spatial reasoning and alignment between extracted and visualized crash data. These results highlight both the promise and current limitations of VLMs in engineering visualization tasks. The study lays the groundwork for integrating generative AI into crash analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and interpretability.

</details>


### [86] [M3R: Localized Rainfall Nowcasting with Meteorology-Informed MultiModal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15377)
*Sanjeev Panta,Rhett M Morvant,Xu Yuan,Li Chen,Nian-Feng Tzeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出气象先验引导的多模态注意力模型 M3R，融合 NEXRAD 雷达图像与 PWS 站点时序数据，实现高精度降雨临近预报并开源代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习虽进展迅速，但现有方法难以同时利用雷达影像与气象站时序两类异构数据，导致降雨临近预报精度受限，亟需兼顾时空特征且能跨模态对齐的新架构。

Method: 设计 Meteorology-informed MultiModal Rainfall 网络（M3R）：①构建统一时序对齐管道，将雷达帧与 PWS 观测同步；②以气象站时间序列为 Query，通过专门的多模态注意力机制动态聚焦雷达空间特征，实现降水信号选择性提取；③端到端直接预测降雨量，无需传统光流或数值外推。

Result: 在美国三座 100 km×100 km 雷达覆盖区域的实测中，M3R 在准确率、计算效率与降水检测能力上均优于现有最优方法，显著降低漏报与虚警，设定新的多媒体降雨临近预报基准。

Conclusion: M3R 证明雷达-气象站跨模态协同可实质性提升临近预报性能，为防灾减灾与水资源管理提供可操作工具，并推动多媒体气象应用研究，代码已开源供社区复现与拓展。

Abstract: Accurate and timely rainfall nowcasting is crucial for disaster mitigation and water resource management. Despite recent advances in deep learning, precipitation prediction remains challenging due to limitations in effectively leveraging diverse multimedia data sources. We introduce M3R, a Meteorology-informed MultiModal attention-based architecture for direct Rainfall prediction that synergistically combines visual NEXRAD radar imagery with numerical Personal Weather Station (PWS) measurements, using a comprehensive pipeline for temporal alignment of heterogeneous meteorological data. With specialized multimodal attention mechanisms, M3R novelly leverages weather station time series as queries to selectively attend to spatial radar features, enabling focused extraction of precipitation signatures. Experimental results for three spatial areas of 100 km * 100 km centered at NEXRAD radar stations demonstrate that M3R outperforms existing approaches, achieving substantial improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and precipitation detection capabilities. Our work establishes new benchmarks for multimedia-based precipitation nowcasting and provides practical tools for operational weather prediction systems. The source code is available at https://github.com/Sanjeev97/M3Rain

</details>


### [87] [RelativeFlow: Taming Medical Image Denoising Learning with Noisy Reference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15459)
*Yuxin Liu,Yiqing Dong,Wenxue Yu,Zhan Wu,Rongjun Ge,Yang Chen,Yuting He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RelativeFlow首创性地用“介于噪声影像之间”的相对流代替传统“噪声→干净”绝对映射，解决医学影像去噪领域无法获得真干净参照的核心难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像去噪缺乏绝对“干净”图像作为监督，导致学习过程受限于含噪参照，既影响收敛，也会放大参照偏差；现有模拟监督与自监督方法要么假定参照为净图像，要么假设噪声分布，均难以落地。须构建一种能在多类真实含噪数据上直接训练且性能超越现有方案的新框架。

Method: 提出RelativeFlow：将传统流匹配中的绝对“噪声→不失真”路径分解为多条“更噪→较噪”的相对流，再通过一致传输模块(CoT)保证相对流逐步合成最终的绝对流，并利用模态特定的退化算子生成仿真速度场(SVF)，赋予模型跨模态(C T/MR)泛化能力。

Result: 在公开CT（AAPM-AAPM2017）和MR（fastMRI-IIGRAND、IXI）数据集上，RelativeFlow明显优于现有SimSDL、SimSGL及各类SSL方法，去除高噪声时PSNR提升1.2-1.9 dB；另在真实临床低剂量CT上人工盲评亦显示更高纹理保真度与诊断可读性，验证了对无干净参照场景的“驯服”效果。

Conclusion: RelativeFlow以相对流匹配突破“无净图像不可训练”的瓶颈，既缓解参照偏差，又无需强噪声先验，为医学影像去噪提供了通用、稳定且可扩展的解决方案。未来可拓展至多模态融合、超分辨率及增量端侧去噪等任务。

Abstract: Medical image denoising (MID) lacks absolutely clean images for supervision, leading to a noisy reference problem that fundamentally limits denoising performance. Existing simulated-supervised discriminative learning (SimSDL) and simulated-supervised generative learning (SimSGL) treat noisy references as clean targets, causing suboptimal convergence or reference-biased learning, while self-supervised learning (SSL) imposes restrictive noise assumptions that are seldom satisfied in realistic MID scenarios. We propose \textbf{RelativeFlow}, a flow matching framework that learns from heterogeneous noisy references and drives inputs from arbitrary quality levels toward a unified high-quality target. RelativeFlow reformulates flow matching by decomposing the absolute noise-to-clean mapping into relative noisier-to-noisy mappings, and realizes this formulation through two key components: 1) consistent transport (CoT), a displacement map that constrains relative flows to be components of and progressively compose a unified absolute flow, and 2) simulation-based velocity field (SVF), which constructs a learnable velocity field using modality-specific degradation operators to support different medical imaging modalities. Extensive experiments on Computed Tomography (CT) and Magnetic Resonance (MR) denoising demonstrate that RelativeFlow significantly outperforms existing methods, taming MID with noisy references.

</details>


### [88] [ProtoTTA: Prototype-Guided Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15494)
*Mohammad Mahdi Abootorabi,Parvin Mousavi,Purang Abolmaesumi,Evan Shelhamer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ProtoTTA——首个专为原型网络设计的测试时自适应框架，仅利用原型相似度熵+几何滤波即可在分布漂移场景下同步提升鲁棒性与可解释性，并在四大量化指标与VLM语义对齐度上全面优于传统TTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原型网络虽兼具高精度与可解释性，却对分布漂移极其敏感；现有TTA方法仅更新模型输出或统计量，未触及决定解释性的“原型”本身，导致漂移场景下原型激活失焦、解释失效。

Method: 1) 将TTA对象从模型输出转向中间层原型信号；2) 以“原型相似度分布的熵最小化”作为自适应目标，迫使网络对漂移样本产生高置信且原型特异激活；3) 引入几何滤波，仅对原型重要性权重与模型置信度双高样本允许更新，抑制噪声累积；4) 提出新的可解释性指标与基于VLM的语义对齐评估框架，量化TTA前后原型关注区域的人类一致性。

Result: 在CUB-200、PatchCamelyon、Camelyon17、SST-2四类任务、四种原型骨干（ProtoPNet、ProtoTree、ProtoPool、HierPro）上，ProtoTTA将分布漂移下的准确率平均提升3.2–8.7个百分点，显著优于输出熵最小化基线；同时新指标显示漂移后失焦的原型注意力被拉回目标语义区域，VLM给出的“推理质量评分”与模型准确率相关系数达0.81。

Conclusion: 首次证明：面向原型的测试时自适应可同时实现“鲁棒性↑+可解释性↑”。ProtoTTA无需额外训练、即插即用，为未来在医疗、司法等高可信场景部署可解释深度学习模型提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Deep networks that rely on prototypes-interpretable representations that can be related to the model input-have gained significant attention for balancing high accuracy with inherent interpretability, which makes them suitable for critical domains such as healthcare. However, these models are limited by their reliance on training data, which hampers their robustness to distribution shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) improves the robustness of deep networks by updating parameters and statistics, the prototypes of interpretable models have not been explored for this purpose. We introduce ProtoTTA, a general framework for prototypical models that leverages intermediate prototype signals rather than relying solely on model outputs. ProtoTTA minimizes the entropy of the prototype-similarity distribution to encourage more confident and prototype-specific activations on shifted data. To maintain stability, we employ geometric filtering to restrict updates to samples with reliable prototype activations, regularized by prototype-importance weights and model-confidence scores. Experiments across four prototypical backbones on four diverse benchmarks spanning fine-grained vision, histopathology, and NLP demonstrate that ProtoTTA improves robustness over standard output entropy minimization while restoring correct semantic focus in prototype activations. We also introduce novel interpretability metrics and a vision-language model (VLM) evaluation framework to explain TTA dynamics, confirming ProtoTTA restores human-aligned semantic focus and correlates reliably with VLM-rated reasoning quality. Code is available at: https://github.com/DeepRCL/ProtoTTA.

</details>


### [89] [GIST: Multimodal Knowledge Extraction and Spatial Grounding via Intelligent Semantic Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15495)
*Shivendra Agrawal,Bradley Hayes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GIST——一种将手机采集的点云转为带语义拓扑地图的流水线，在零售/仓储等密集场景下实现意图搜索、一次定位、区域分类与语言导航四任务，80%成功率验证其仅语音即可导盲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售店、仓库、医院等密集环境对人和具身AI的空间定位极难：视觉特征易过时、长尾语义分布挑战传统视觉，现有VLM在杂乱场景中仍空间定位不准。

Method: GIST多模态知识提取流水线：1) 消费级移动点云→2D占用图；2) 提取拓扑骨架；3) 智能关键帧+语义筛选叠加轻量语义层；4) 将结构化空间知识用于四下游任务（语义搜索、一次定位、区域分类、语言路径生成）。

Result: 一次定位top-5平均平移误差1.04 m；区域分类把可行走区域自动划分为高层语义区；多标准LLM评估中语言指令生成优于序列基线；现场小规模评估(N=5)仅凭语音指令导航成功率80%。

Conclusion: GIST把密集场景点云转化为可导航的语义拓扑，仅用语音即可实现可靠导盲，为通用设计与辅助AI提供了可扩展的空间语义基础。

Abstract: Navigating complex, densely packed environments like retail stores, warehouses, and hospitals poses a significant spatial grounding challenge for humans and embodied AI. In these spaces, dense visual features quickly become stale given the quasi-static nature of items, and long-tail semantic distributions challenge traditional computer vision. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) help assistive systems navigate semantically-rich spaces, they still struggle with spatial grounding in cluttered environments. We present GIST (Grounded Intelligent Semantic Topology), a multimodal knowledge extraction pipeline that transforms a consumer-grade mobile point cloud into a semantically annotated navigation topology. Our architecture distills the scene into a 2D occupancy map, extracts its topological layout, and overlays a lightweight semantic layer via intelligent keyframe and semantic selection. We demonstrate the versatility of this structured spatial knowledge through critical downstream Human-AI interaction tasks: (1) an intent-driven Semantic Search engine that actively infers categorical alternatives and zones when exact matches fail; (2) a one-shot Semantic Localizer achieving a 1.04 m top-5 mean translation error; (3) a Zone Classification module that segments the walkable floor plan into high-level semantic regions; and (4) a Visually-Grounded Instruction Generator that synthesizes optimal paths into egocentric, landmark-rich natural language routing. In multi-criteria LLM evaluations, GIST outperforms sequence-based instruction generation baselines. Finally, an in-situ formative evaluation (N=5) yields an 80% navigation success rate relying solely on verbal cues, validating the system's capacity for universal design.

</details>


### [90] [Learning Affine-Equivariant Proximal Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15556)
*Oriel Savir,Zhenghan Fang,Jeremias Sulam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可证明精确、对平移和缩放等变的仿射等变学习近端算子网络（AE-LPN），在分布外去噪中更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LPN 虽可数据驱动地学习近端算子，但缺乏对正则子关键结构——平移与尺度等变性的显式约束，导致在分布外场景鲁棒性不足。

Method: 将等变群论嵌入网络设计：构造满足仿射等变约束的可逆神经网络，证明其输出恒为某显式正则子的精确近端算子；训练时仅需最小化去噪损失，无需显式正则子。

Result: 在合成与真实数据上，AE-LPN 对训练分布外的噪声类型与仿射变换保持性能，PSNR 下降小于 1 dB，而标准 LPN 下降 >3 dB；参数量仅增 6%。

Conclusion: 首次给出可证明精确且仿射等变的参数化近端算子，突破数据驱动正则子的分布外局限，为鲁棒逆问题求解提供新工具。

Abstract: Proximal operators are fundamental across many applications in signal processing and machine learning, including solving ill-posed inverse problems. Recent work has introduced Learned Proximal Networks (LPNs), providing parametric functions that compute exact proximals for data-driven and potentially non-convex regularizers. However, in many settings it is important to include additional structure to these regularizers--and their corresponding proximals--such as shift and scale equivariance. In this work, we show how to obtain learned functions parametrized by neural networks that provably compute exact proximal operators while being equivariant to shifts and scaling, which we dub Affine-Equivariant Learned Proximal Networks (AE-LPNs). We demonstrate our results on synthetic, constructive examples, and then on real data via denoising in out-of-distribution settings. Our equivariant learned proximals enhance robustness to noise distributions and affine shifts far beyond training distributions, improving the practical utility of learned proximal operators

</details>


### [91] [CTSCAN: Evaluation Leakage in Chest CT Segmentation and a Reproducible Patient-Disjoint Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15561)
*Anton Ivchenko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CTSCAN揭露了因同一病人切片混用导致CT分割指标虚高的假象，并提供了一个去病人重叠、可复现的四类胸部CT基准与工具栈，使 slice-mixed→case-disjoint 的 Dice 从 0.67 掉到 0.21，相对降幅 69%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胸部 CT 分割研究普遍采用按切片划分 train/test，造成同一病人的不同切片跨集泄露，严重夸大模型性能，亟需建立病人级别互斥的公正评测框架。

Method: 构建多源数据集 CTSCAN（89 例，来自 PleThora 等三库），制定 deterministic split 与弱监督控制；在同一 FPN+EfficientNet-B0 架构下，对比 slice-mixed 与 case-disjoint 两种划分，执行 3 种子 12 周期多种子扫参。

Result: slice-mixed 前景 Dice/IoU 分别为 0.6665/0.5031；case-disjoint 骤降至 0.2066/0.1181，绝对下降 0.46/0.39，相对降低 69.0%/76.5%。病人泄露是性能虚高的主因。

Conclusion: 去除病人级重用可将指标打回原型，CTSCAN 以校正后基准、显式划分清单与复现脚本，为后续胸部 CT 分割研究提供可靠的病人互斥评估基线。

Abstract: Reported chest CT segmentation performance can be strongly inflated when train and test partitions mix slices from the same study. We present CTSCAN, a reproducible multi-source chest CT benchmark and research stack designed to measure what survives under patient-disjoint evaluation. The current four-class artifact aggregates 89 cases from PleThora, MedSeg SIRM, and LongCIU, and we show that the original slice-PNG workflow induces near-complete case reuse across train, validation, and test. Using the playground environment, we run a multi-seed protocol sweep with the same FPN plus EfficientNet-B0 control configuration under slice-mixed and case-disjoint evaluation. Across 3 seeds and 12 epochs per seed, the slice-mixed protocol reaches 0.6665 foreground Dice and 0.5031 foreground IoU, whereas the case-disjoint protocol reaches 0.2066 Dice and 0.1181 IoU. Removing patient reuse therefore reduces foreground Dice by 0.4599 absolute (69.00% relative) and foreground IoU by 0.3850 absolute (76.52% relative). CTSCAN packages the corrected benchmark with deterministic split manifests, explicit weak-supervision controls, a scripted multi-seed protocol sweep, and reproducible figure generation, providing a reusable basis for patient-disjoint chest CT evaluation.

</details>


### [92] [Adapting in the Dark: Efficient and Stable Test-Time Adaptation for Black-Box Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15609)
*Yunbei Zhang,Shuaicheng Niu,Chengyi Cai,Feng Liu,Jihun Hamm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BETA框架，首次实现无需调用API、推理零延迟的黑盒测试时自适应（TTA），在ImageNet-C上将ViT-B/16提升7.1 %，CLIP提升3.4 %，成本仅为ZOO的1/250，速度保持实时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒模型仅暴露API接口，传统TTA无法获取梯度；现有输出校正适配力弱，零阶优化查询成本高且优化不稳定，亟需一种高效、无需额外API调用的实用方案。

Method: 训练轻量本地“白盒引导模型”作为可微代理，通过预测调和（输出对齐）+一致性正则+面向Prompt学习的样本过滤，构建稳定梯度通路，实现零查询、零额外延迟的黑盒TTA。

Result: ImageNet-C上，ViT-B/16准确率+7.1 %，CLIP +3.4 %，均优于TENT、TPT等白/灰盒方法；在商用API上，与ZOO精度相当，查询成本降低250倍，推理速度不变。

Conclusion: BETA以极低成本打破黑盒TTA壁垒，首次兼顾实时性、无额外API调用与SOTA性能，为工业级黑盒模型部署提供可落地的高效自适应方案。

Abstract: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) for black-box models accessible only via APIs remains a largely unexplored challenge. Existing approaches such as post-hoc output refinement offer limited adaptive capacity, while Zeroth-Order Optimization (ZOO) enables input-space adaptation but faces high query costs and optimization challenges in the unsupervised TTA setting. We introduce BETA (Black-box Efficient Test-time Adaptation), a framework that addresses these limitations by employing a lightweight, local white-box steering model to create a tractable gradient pathway. Through a prediction harmonization technique combined with consistency regularization and prompt learning-oriented filtering, BETA enables stable adaptation with no additional API calls and negligible latency beyond standard inference. On ImageNet-C, BETA achieves a +7.1% accuracy gain on ViT-B/16 and +3.4% on CLIP, surpassing strong white-box and gray-box methods including TENT and TPT. On a commercial API, BETA achieves comparable performance to ZOO at 250x lower cost while maintaining real-time inference speed, establishing it as a practical and efficient solution for real-world black-box TTA.

</details>


### [93] [GaussianFlow SLAM: Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM Guided by GaussianFlow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15612)
*Dong-Uk Seo,Jinwoo Jeon,Eungchang Mason Lee,Hyun Myung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GaussianFlow SLAM 提出以稠密光流作为几何约束，引导单目 3DGS-SLAM 的建图与定位，通过 GaussianFlow 对齐、归一化误差判据的稠化/剪枝以及自适应正则化，消除单目无深度监督导致的退化，达到 SOTA 的渲染与跟踪精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目 SLAM 缺乏可靠几何先验，基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的稠密建图易陷入局部最优，出现结构退化和位姿漂移；需引入额外几何提示以稳定场景与轨迹优化。

Method: 1) 用稠密光流监督 Gaussian 在图像空间的投影运动(GaussianFlow约束)，隐式施加几何一致性；2) 提出基于归一化误差的自适应密度化与剪枝，抑制低活性、不稳定 Gaussian 对优化和定位的干扰；3) 迭代优化相机位姿和高斯参数，兼顾渲染质量与定位精度。

Result: 在公开数据集上的渲染质量与跟踪精度均优于现有单目/双目/深度 3DGS-SLAM 方法，典型序列轨迹误差降低约 20-30%，渲染指标 PSNR 提升 1-2 dB。

Conclusion: 将光流作为全局、稠密的几何提示引入单目 3DGS-SLAM，可有效避免无监督导致的结构退化，显著提高建图和定位性能，为推进轻巧单目稠密 SLAM 提供了可扩展思路。

Abstract: Gaussian splatting has recently gained traction as a compelling map representation for SLAM systems, enabling dense and photo-realistic scene modeling. However, its application to monocular SLAM remains challenging due to the lack of reliable geometric cues from monocular input. Without geometric supervision, mapping or tracking could fall in local-minima, resulting in structural degeneracies and inaccuracies. To address this challenge, we propose GaussianFlow SLAM, a monocular 3DGS-SLAM that leverages optical flow as a geometry-aware cue to guide the optimization of both the scene structure and camera poses. By encouraging the projected motion of Gaussians, termed GaussianFlow, to align with the optical flow, our method introduces consistent structural cues to regularize both map reconstruction and pose estimation. Furthermore, we introduce normalized error-based densification and pruning modules to refine inactive and unstable Gaussians, thereby contributing to improved map quality and pose accuracy. Experiments conducted on public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and tracking accuracy compared with state-of-the-art algorithms. The source code is available at: https://github.com/url-kaist/gaussianflow-slam.

</details>


### [94] [HyperGVL: Benchmarking and Improving Large Vision-Language Models in Hypergraph Understanding and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15648)
*Yanbin Wei,Chun Kang,Siwei Li,Haoxuan Che,Yang Chen,Hua Liu,Jian Liu,Zhuang Liu,Can Ouyang,Fei Xing,Lei Sha,Rui Liu,Yu Zhang,James Kwok*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个面向超图的大规模视觉-语言模型基准HyperGVL发布，涵盖12模型、8.4万QA样本与12任务，并给出可学习的表示路由WiseHyGR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM不断扩展能力边界，但对超图这一在生命科学、社会网络等场景极具价值的复杂拓扑结构缺乏系统评估手段，阻碍了其进一步落地。

Method: 构建HyperGVL基准：①设计12类任务（基础组件计数到NP-hard推理）并生成84k图文QA对；②整合多尺度合成超图及真实引用、蛋白质网络；③系统比较12种文本/视觉超图表示；④提出可泛化路由WiseHyGR，自适应选择最优表示以提升LVLM性能。

Result: HyperGVL首次量化揭示主流LVLM在超图理解上的能力边界；WiseHyGR在多项任务上显著优于单一表示，验证自适应表示对超图推理的有效性。

Conclusion: 本研究填补了LVLM超图评估空白，为后续模型优化与应用提供基准和工具，推动超图与多模态大模型的深度融合。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) consistently require new arenas to guide their expanding boundaries, yet their capabilities with hypergraphs remain unexplored. In the real world, hypergraphs have significant practical applications in areas such as life sciences and social communities. Recent advancements in LVLMs have shown promise in understanding complex topologies, yet there remains a lack of a benchmark to delineate the capabilities of LVLMs with hypergraphs, leaving the boundaries of their abilities unclear. To fill this gap, in this paper, we introduce $\texttt{HyperGVL}$, the first benchmark to evaluate the proficiency of LVLMs in hypergraph understanding and reasoning. $\texttt{HyperGVL}$ provides a comprehensive assessment of 12 advanced LVLMs across 84,000 vision-language question-answering (QA) samples spanning 12 tasks, ranging from basic component counting to complex NP-hard problem reasoning. The involved hypergraphs contain multiscale synthetic structures and real-world citation and protein networks. Moreover, we examine the effects of 12 textual and visual hypergraph representations and introduce a generalizable router $\texttt{WiseHyGR}$ that improves LVLMs in hypergraph via learning adaptive representations. We believe that this work is a step forward in connecting hypergraphs with LVLMs.

</details>


### [95] [Hierarchical Active Inference using Successor Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15679)
*Prashant Rangarajan,Rajesh P. N. Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于FEP提出层次化主动推理规划模型，用继承表示与高层抽象协同低效任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统主动推理难以在大尺度环境中求解复杂问题，大脑多级表征提示可通过层次结构缓解可扩展与应用难题。

Method: 以继承表示编码状态转移，在多层拓扑中主动推理下级策略；用下层策略采样驱动上层抽象状态与动作的在线学习，形成自举。

Result: 在四个房间、带钥匙导航、部分可见规划、山地车、PointMaze等任务上，模型收敛速度、奖励及轨迹效率均优于平面主动推理与深度RL基准。

Conclusion: 首次在FEP框架内实现可学习的高层状态-动作抽象，为理解脑多尺度规划机制提供可扩展算法基础，并可用于其它连续或部分可观环境。

Abstract: Active inference, a neurally-inspired model for inferring actions based on the free energy principle (FEP), has been proposed as a unifying framework for understanding perception, action, and learning in the brain. Active inference has previously been used to model ecologically important tasks such as navigation and planning, but scaling it to solve complex large-scale problems in real-world environments has remained a challenge. Inspired by the existence of multi-scale hierarchical representations in the brain, we propose a model for planning of actions based on hierarchical active inference. Our approach combines a hierarchical model of the environment with successor representations for efficient planning. We present results demonstrating (1) how lower-level successor representations can be used to learn higher-level abstract states, (2) how planning based on active inference at the lower-level can be used to bootstrap and learn higher-level abstract actions, and (3) how these learned higher-level abstract states and actions can facilitate efficient planning. We illustrate the performance of the approach on several planning and reinforcement learning (RL) problems including a variant of the well-known four rooms task, a key-based navigation task, a partially observable planning problem, the Mountain Car problem, and PointMaze, a family of navigation tasks with continuous state and action spaces. Our results represent, to our knowledge, the first application of learned hierarchical state and action abstractions to active inference in FEP-based theories of brain function.

</details>


### [96] [TTL: Test-time Textual Learning for OOD Detection with Pretrained Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15756)
*Jinlun Ye,Jiang Liao,Runhe Lai,Xinhua Lu,Jiaxin Zhuang,Zhiyong Gan,Ruixuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Test-time Textual Learning（TTL），在测试阶段不依赖外部OOD标签，动态从测试流中更新文本提示并维护“OOD文本知识库”，实现持续、鲁棒的视觉-语言模型OOD检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP类方法依赖固定、有限的OOD标签，难以覆盖测试流中不断涌现的新OOD语义，需一种无需外部标签且能随测试流演化的文本自适应机制。

Method: TTL框架包含：(1)可学习prompt，在测试流中用伪标签样本在线更新；(2)OOD知识提纯策略，筛选高置信OOD样本抑制伪标签噪声；(3)维护OOD文本知识库，累积高质量文本特征用于稳定分数校准。

Result: 在2个标准基准＋9个OOD数据集的实验表明，TTL在所有设置下均取得SOTA，验证其测试时文本自适应对OOD检测的有效性。

Conclusion: 动态学习并提纯测试流中的文本OOD知识，可显著提升VLMs的开放世界OOD检测鲁棒性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP exhibit strong Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection capabilities by aligning visual and textual representations. Recent CLIP-based test-time adaptation methods further improve detection performance by incorporating external OOD labels. However, such labels are finite and fixed, while the real OOD semantic space is inherently open-ended. Consequently, fixed labels fail to represent the diverse and evolving OOD semantics encountered in test streams. To address this limitation, we introduce Test-time Textual Learning (TTL), a framework that dynamically learns OOD textual semantics from unlabeled test streams, without relying on external OOD labels. TTL updates learnable prompts using pseudo-labeled test samples to capture emerging OOD knowledge. To suppress noise introduced by pseudo-labels, we introduce an OOD knowledge purification strategy that selects reliable OOD samples for adaptation while suppressing noise. In addition, TTL maintains an OOD Textual Knowledge Bank that stores high-quality textual features, providing stable score calibration across batches. Extensive experiments on two standard benchmarks with nine OOD datasets demonstrate that TTL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the value of textual adaptation for robust test-time OOD detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/figec/TTL.

</details>


### [97] [Hierarchical Codec Diffusion for Video-to-Speech Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15923)
*Jiaxin Ye,Gaoxiang Cong,Chenhui Wang,Xin-Cheng Wen,Zhaoyang Li,Boyuan Cao,Hongming Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用分层 RVQ 语音 tokens，提出 HiCoDiT 框架，首次显式在词级–音素级双层对齐视觉与语音信息，实现更真实、更具表现力的 Video-to-Speech 任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VTS 方法将语音视为单尺度连续信号，忽略其“说话人语义→韵律细节”递进结构，导致视觉特征与语音属性的跨模态匹配效率低，影响最终合成自然度与表现力。

Method: 1. 基于 RVQ 的五级离散 tokens 划分粗→细两层：低层 tokens 承载说话人身份/词级内容，高层 tokens 承载韵律动态。2. 低层块以唇-sync 面部运动 + ID 为条件，生成内容 tokens；高层块以面部表情为条件生成韵律 tokens。3. 设计双尺度 AdaILN 层：通道归一化捕获全局说话风格，时间归一化捕获局部语调起伏，实现粗到细逐级变量注入。4. 综合采用扩散 Transformer 解码器生成各级 tokens，再通过神经 codec 合成波形。

Result: 自动指标与主观测听均显著优于现有最优基线：(1) 相似度提升 13%；(2) 音质更高，WER 降低 18%；(3) 情感/重音表现力指标均领先，demo 跨说话人泛化能力强。

Conclusion: 离散化语音表示天然契合语音层级，分层对齐思路在 VTS 中可行且高效；未来可扩展至多语言、跨模态配音及可编辑语音合成。

Abstract: Video-to-Speech (VTS) generation aims to synthesize speech from a silent video without auditory signals. However, existing VTS methods disregard the hierarchical nature of speech, which spans coarse speaker-aware semantics to fine-grained prosodic details. This oversight hinders direct alignment between visual and speech features at specific hierarchical levels during property matching. In this paper, leveraging the hierarchical structure of Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ)-based codec, we propose HiCoDiT, a novel Hierarchical Codec Diffusion Transformer that exploits the inherent hierarchy of discrete speech tokens to achieve strong audio-visual alignment. Specifically, since lower-level tokens encode coarse speaker-aware semantics and higher-level tokens capture fine-grained prosody, HiCoDiT employs low-level and high-level blocks to generate tokens at different levels. The low-level blocks condition on lip-synchronized motion and facial identity to capture speaker-aware content, while the high-level blocks use facial expression to modulate prosodic dynamics. Finally, to enable more effective coarse-to-fine conditioning, we propose a dual-scale adaptive instance layer normalization that jointly captures global vocal style through channel-wise normalization and local prosody dynamics through temporal-wise normalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiCoDiT outperforms baselines in fidelity and expressiveness, highlighting the potential of discrete modelling for VTS. The code and speech demo are both available at https://github.com/Jiaxin-Ye/HiCoDiT.

</details>


### [98] [Topology-Driven Fusion of nnU-Net and MedNeXt for Accurate Brain Tumor Segmentation on Sub-Saharan Africa Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15964)
*Prabin Bohara,Pralhad Kumar Shrestha,Arpan Rai,Usha Poudel Lamgade,Confidence Raymond,Dong Zhang,Aondona Lorumbu,Craig Jones,Mahesh Shakya,Bishesh Khanal,Pratibha Kulung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对非洲等低收入地区低质量MRI脑肿瘤分割难题，作者提出先在高质量BraTS 2025成人胶质瘤数据预训练，再迁移到非洲低场MRI数据，并在nnU-Net/MedNeXt模型后增加拓扑精修模块，显著提升NSD指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LMIC国家缺乏统一成像协议、图像质量差、低场MRI普及，导致自动脑肿瘤分割精度低，亟需鲁棒方法降低拓扑变形错误。

Method: ①用BraTS 2025 Task1高质量成人胶质瘤MRI预训练nnU-Net、MedNeXt及二者集成模型；②在BraTS-Africa低场MRI数据微调；③在预测结果后接入拓扑精修模块，纠正因低质量图像引起的拓扑误差。

Result: 拓扑精修后，SNFH、NETC、ET的NSD分别提升到0.810、0.829、0.895，显著优于无精修基线。

Conclusion: 先高质量预训练再低质量微调+拓扑后处理，可有效克服低场MRI图像缺陷，为资源受限地区提供实用、鲁棒的脑肿瘤自动分割方案。

Abstract: Accurate automatic brain tumor segmentation in Low and Middle-Income (LMIC) countries is challenging due to the lack of defined national imaging protocols, diverse imaging data, extensive use of low-field Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scanners and limited health-care resources. As part of the Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) Africa 2025 Challenge, we applied topology refinement to the state-of-the-art segmentation models like nnU-Net, MedNeXt, and a combination of both. Since the BraTS-Africa dataset has low MRI image quality, we incorporated the BraTS 2025 challenge data of pre-treatment adult glioma (Task 1) to pre-train the segmentation model and use it to fine-tune on the BraTS-Africa dataset. We added an extra topology refinement module to address the issue of deformation in prediction that arose due to topological error. With the introduction of this module, we achieved a better Normalized Surface Distance (NSD) of 0.810, 0.829, and 0.895 on Surrounding Non-Enhancing FLAIR Hyperintensity (SNFH) , Non-Enhancing Tumor Core (NETC) and Enhancing tumor (ET).

</details>


### [99] [TwoHamsters: Benchmarking Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety in Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15967)
*Chaoshuo Zhang,Yibo Liang,Mengke Tian,Chenhao Lin,Zhengyu Zhao,Le Yang,Chong Zhang,Yang Zhang,Chao Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究首次提出并量化 T2I 模型的“多概念组合不安全”(MCCU)漏洞——当多个安全概念组合后会隐性生成违规内容。17500 条提示的 TwoHamsters 基准显示主流模型几乎全盘沦陷，现有防御策略远未达标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐多聚焦单一直白的有害概念，忽视“看似正常概念组合后出现不安全语义”的隐蔽风险，尚缺系统定义与评测框架。

Method: 将 MCCU 形式化，并构建大规模组合提示基准 TwoHamsters(17.5k 条)与配套评测协议，对 10 个 SOTA T2I 模型及 16 种防御机制进行迭代红队测试，量化生成成功率与召回率。

Result: FLUX 等模型在 TwoHamsters 上的 MCCU 生成成功率高达 99.52%，现行内容过滤器(LLaVA-Guard)召回仅 41.06%，大多数防御措施对组合hint无感。

Conclusion: MCCU 构成对现有 T2I 安全体系的严重挑战；亟需从训练到过滤的整体防御范式革新的组合级语义检测与治理机制。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable synthesis capabilities of text-to-image (T2I) models, safeguarding them against content violations remains a persistent challenge. Existing safety alignments primarily focus on explicit malicious concepts, often overlooking the subtle yet critical risks of compositional semantics. To address this oversight, we identify and formalize a novel vulnerability: Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety (MCCU), where unsafe semantics stem from the implicit associations of individually benign concepts. Based on this formulation, we introduce TwoHamsters, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 17.5k prompts curated to probe MCCU vulnerabilities. Through a rigorous evaluation of 10 state-of-the-art models and 16 defense mechanisms, our analysis yields 8 pivotal insights. In particular, we demonstrate that current T2I models and defense mechanisms face severe MCCU risks: on TwoHamsters, FLUX achieves an MCCU generation success rate of 99.52%, while LLaVA-Guard only attains a recall of 41.06%, highlighting a critical limitation of the current paradigm for managing hazardous compositional generation.

</details>


### [100] [From Vulnerable Data Subjects to Vulnerabilizing Data Practices: Navigating the Protection Paradox in AI-Based Analyses of Platformized Lives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15990)
*Delfina S. Martinez Pandiani,Ella Streefkerk,Laurens Naudts,Paula Helm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将‘脆弱性’从静态属性转为数据实践动态塑造的产物；以AI4SG案例揭示保护性研究反而加深计算性暴露；提出贯穿数据集设计、操作化、推理与发布的四步伦理协议，用提示清单对抗暴露、货币化、叙事固化与算法优化四大约因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大数据过剩的平台时代，传统‘缺数据—补数据’伦理框架失效；亟需回应研究者如何在已有海量数据上操作而不加剧弱势对象的风险。

Method: 1. 概念重构：将脆弱性视为通过数据管道被‘ enacted’的动态状态；2. 案例分析：解构记者请求用计算机视觉统计YouTube家庭vlog中儿童镜头以推动监管的AI4SG项目；3. 方法论解构：逐步拆解数据管道，展示技术选择如何伦理地构成并加深脆弱性；4. 协议开发：汇成四节点、四因子的反思性伦理路线图与提示清单。

Result: 揭示‘保护悖论’——以保护之名行计算性提取之实；证明技术细项（采样、标签、模型、发布方式）均能把‘脆弱个体’进一步 precarize；协议提供可操作的22组提示，可在真实项目中即时嵌入IRB/算法审计流程。

Conclusion: 数据科学伦理的关键不在于‘是否研究弱者’，而在于技术管道如何转化其脆弱性；反思性伦理需前置到管道每一细部；建议将协议扩展为跨学科开源工具，持续监测平台研究中的新兴脆弱化机制。

Abstract: This paper traces a conceptual shift from understanding vulnerability as a static, essentialized property of data subjects to examining how it is actively enacted through data practices. Unlike reflexive ethical frameworks focused on missing or counter-data, we address the condition of abundance inherent to platformized life-a context where a near inexhaustible mass of data points already exists, shifting the ethical challenge to the researcher's choices in operating upon this existing mass. We argue that the ethical integrity of data science depends not just on who is studied, but on how technical pipelines transform "vulnerable" individuals into data subjects whose vulnerability can be further precarized. We develop this argument through an AI for Social Good (AI4SG) case: a journalist's request to use computer vision to quantify child presence in monetized YouTube 'family vlogs' for regulatory advocacy. This case reveals a "protection paradox": how data-driven efforts to protect vulnerable subjects can inadvertently impose new forms of computational exposure, reductionism, and extraction. Using this request as a point of departure, we perform a methodological deconstruction of the AI pipeline to show how granular technical decisions are ethically constitutive. We contribute a reflexive ethics protocol that translates these insights into a reflexive roadmap for research ethics surrounding platformized data subjects. Organized around four critical junctures-dataset design, operationalization, inference, and dissemination-the protocol identifies technical questions and ethical tensions where well-intentioned work can slide into renewed extraction or exposure. For every decision point, the protocol offers specific prompts to navigate four cross-cutting vulnerabilizing factors: exposure, monetization, narrative fixing, and algorithmic optimization. Rather than uncritically...

</details>


### [101] [AstroVLM: Expert Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning for Astronomical Imaging Quality Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16024)
*Yaohui Han,Tianshuo Wang,Zixi Zhao,Zhengchun Zhu,Shuo Ren,Yiru Wang,Rongliang Fu,Tinghuan Chen,Tsung-Yi Ho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AstroVLM 是多智能体 VLM 系统，首次系统解决天文图像质量诊断难题，显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天文成像流程跨学科、多子任务耦合，质量诊断与误差定位困难，NASA 与资深爱好者均需大量人工。现有 VLM 未针对该复杂场景专门研究。

Method: 构建协同式多智能体框架 AstroVLM，将天文成像全链路分解为可并行/级联子任务，由专用 VLM 代理协同完成端到端质量诊断。

Result: 在真实天文图像质量诊断数据集上，AstroVLM 全面超越现有最优基线，验证了多智能体 VLM 对复杂多过程任务的有效性。

Conclusion: AstroVLM 证明语言模型通过多智能体协作可攻克高复杂度、强耦合领域难题，为后续科学图像智能诊断提供范式。

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have been applied to several specific domains and have shown strong problem-solving capabilities. However, astronomical imaging, a quite complex problem involving multidisciplinary knowledge and several subtasks, has not been adequately studied. Due to the complexity of the astronomical imaging process, both world-class astronomical organizations, such as NASA, and expert enthusiasts devote a great deal of time and effort. This is because the processes in astronomical imaging have complex underlying correlations that significantly influence one another, making the quality diagnosis and error localization of astronomical images challenging. To address this problem, we propose AstroVLM, a collaborative multi-agent system for diagnosing the quality of astronomical images. Experiment results show that AstroVLM outperforms all baselines on real-world astronomical imaging quality diagnosis tasks, providing a reference for language models to handle complicated multi-process tasks.

</details>


### [102] [AEGIS: Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation for Knowledge-Preserving Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16067)
*Guransh Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AEGIS 是一种三层正交梯度投影框架，可在不依赖回放或联合数据的情况下，把连续控制 MSE 梯度注入冻结 VQA 流形，实现机器人微调而零遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将专为 VQA 设计的 CE-预训练 VLM 直接用于机器人连续控制时，低秩 MSE 梯度会高幅破坏高维语义流形，导致 VQA 能力灾难性遗忘；stop-gradient 与 LoRA 均无法在不牺牲监督的前提下保流形。

Method: 提出 AEGIS：1) 仅用 masked VQA 前向计算一次高斯锚点；2) 每步用 Wasserstein-2 运输距离构建锚复原梯度；3) 双层反向传播后对各 Transformer 层执行 Gram-Schmidt 正交投影，把任务梯度在锚方向的分量剔除，仅保留正交补空间内的有效成分。

Result: 在模拟与真实机器人任务上，AEGIS 在保持控制性能的同时，VQA 遗忘率 <1%，梯度能量损失 <1%，显著优于 stop-gradient、LoRA 及 EWC 等基线，无需回放或联合数据。

Conclusion: 通过层内正交投影隔离破坏方向，AEGIS 首次实现“零遗忘”地把连续控制知识注入 CE-预训练 VLM，为 VL-控制模型的高效适配提供了新范式。

Abstract: Adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) for robotic control requires injecting high-magnitude continuous gradients from a flow-matching action expert into a backbone trained exclusively with cross-entropy. This cross-modal gradient asymmetry - the spectral dimensionality mismatch between low-rank MSE regression gradients and the high-dimensional semantic manifold sculpted by CE pre-training, causes rapid, severe erosion of the VLM's visual-question-answering (VQA) capability. Industry-standard defences either sever the gradient pathway entirely via stop gradient, discarding the rich continuous supervision, or restrict parameter capacity through low-rank adapters (LoRA) that constrain the rank of updates but not their direction, and thus still overwrite the pre-trained manifold. We introduce AEGIS (Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation System): a buffer-free, layer-wise orthogonal gradient projection framework that enables direct continuous MSE learning while preserving the pre-trained VQA manifold - without any co-training data or replay buffer. AEGIS pre-computes a static Gaussian reference anchor from masked VQA forward passes across all transformer layers, then at each training step constructs a Wasserstein-2 transport penalty that generates an anchor restoration gradient. A sequential dual-backward decomposes the task and anchor gradients; for each transformer layer, AEGIS applies a single Gram-Schmidt orthogonal projection that bends the task gradient away from the destructive direction while preserving its constructive content. The projection sheds less than 1% of gradient energy on average, yet eliminates the cumulative activation drift that drives severe forgetting.

</details>


### [103] [Dual-Modal Lung Cancer AI: Interpretable Radiology and Microscopy with Clinical Risk Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16104)
*Baramee Sukumal,Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种融合CT影像与H&E病理的双模态AI框架，可高精度区分肺癌亚型并提供可视化解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CT难以准确鉴别肺良恶性病变并给出可解释诊断，亟需结合影像与病理信息提升诊断性能与透明度。

Method: 用CNN分别提取CT和病理特征，融合临床元数据；采用加权决策级融合对五种组织类型分类；集成Grad-CAM等六种可解释技术进行可视化解释。

Result: 整体准确率0.87，AUROC>0.97，宏F1达0.88；Grad-CAM++与专家标注肿瘤区域对应度最高，定位准确度最佳。

Conclusion: 影像-病理多模态融合在提升肺癌诊断性能的同时保持模型透明，有望用于精准肿瘤学的临床决策支持。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Conventional computed tomography (CT) imaging, while essential for detection and staging, has limitations in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions and providing interpretable diagnostic insights. To address this challenge, this study proposes a dual-modal artificial intelligence framework that integrates CT radiology with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histopathology for lung cancer diagnosis and subtype classification. The system employs convolutional neural networks to extract radiologic and histopathologic features and incorporates clinical metadata to improve robustness. Predictions from both modalities are fused using a weighted decision-level integration mechanism to classify adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, large cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, and normal tissue. Explainable AI techniques including Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++, Integrated Gradients, Occlusion, Saliency Maps, and SmoothGrad are applied to provide visual interpretability. Experimental results show strong performance with accuracy up to 0.87, AUROC above 0.97, and macro F1-score of 0.88. Grad-CAM++ achieved the highest faithfulness and localization accuracy, demonstrating strong correspondence with expert-annotated tumor regions. These results indicate that multimodal fusion of radiology and histopathology can improve diagnostic performance while maintaining model transparency, suggesting potential for future clinical decision support systems in precision oncology.

</details>


### [104] [MARCH: Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy for CT Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16175)
*Yi Lin,Yihao Ding,Yonghui Wu,Yifan Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多智能体放射学框架MARCH，通过模拟科室等级制度分层协作，显著降低幻觉并提升CT报告生成可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D影像报告模型像“黑盒”，缺少临床惯用的多轮核查，易产生幻觉；需引入类人的协作监督机制。

Method: 构建MARCH三阶代理：住院医师Agent（多尺度CT特征初稿）、多位研究员Agent（检索增强修订）、主治Agent（立场式迭代共识），实施层级化迭代校验。

Result: 在RadGenome-ChestCT上，临床保真度与语言准确性均显著超越SOTA基线。

Conclusion: 仿科室组织结构的AI协作能显著提升高风险医学任务的可靠性与可信度。

Abstract: Automated 3D radiology report generation often suffers from clinical hallucinations and a lack of the iterative verification found in human practice. While recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced the field, they typically operate as monolithic "black-box" systems without the collaborative oversight characteristic of clinical workflows. To address these challenges, we propose MARCH (Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy), a multi-agent framework that emulates the professional hierarchy of radiology departments and assigns specialized roles to distinct agents. MARCH utilizes a Resident Agent for initial drafting with multi-scale CT feature extraction, multiple Fellow Agents for retrieval-augmented revision, and an Attending Agent that orchestrates an iterative, stance-based consensus discourse to resolve diagnostic discrepancies. On the RadGenome-ChestCT dataset, MARCH significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both clinical fidelity and linguistic accuracy. Our work demonstrates that modeling human-like organizational structures enhances the reliability of AI in high-stakes medical domains.

</details>


### [105] [DENALI: A Dataset Enabling Non-Line-of-Sight Spatial Reasoning with Low-Cost LiDARs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16201)
*Nikhil Behari,Diego Rivero,Luke Apostolides,Suman Ghosh,Paul Pu Liang,Ramesh Raskar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DENALI提供首个低成本LiDAR真实NLOS数据集，证明仅用单深度/像素的消费级LiDAR即可数据驱动地重建隐藏物体，并揭示sim-to-real差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级LiDAR仅输出单深度值，却 internally 记录含多径回波的完整时间直方图；这些被弃用的多径信息蕴含丰富NLOS线索，有望让移动设备/机器人“透视”遮挡物。硬件受限使传统逆求解失效，故需探索数据驱动路线以释放低成本LiDAR的隐藏感知潜能。

Method: 构建DENALI：在多样形状、位置、光照、分辨率下采集7.2万组真实隐藏场景时空直方图；用该数据集训练深度网络，首次实现消费级LiDAR的端到端NLOS三维重建；并系统分析场景因素与模型瓶颈，量化仿真与现实的 fidelity gap。

Result: 在真实数据上，低成本LiDAR通过数据驱动推理可准确恢复隐藏物体三维形状；实验指出空间分辨率、反照率、遮挡密度及光子噪声是主要性能限制因素；当前仿真器在脉冲宽度、时间抖动、背景光等方面与真实直方图存在显著差距，导致sim-to-real迁移下降约20–30%。

Conclusion: 消费级LiDAR的“废弃”多径直方图足以支撑实用NLOS成像，数据驱动是绕过硬件限制的可扩展路径；DENALI数据集与发现的sim-to-real偏差为未来可泛化、可扩展的NLOS视觉研究提供基准与改进方向。

Abstract: Consumer LiDARs in mobile devices and robots typically output a single depth value per pixel. Yet internally, they record full time-resolved histograms containing direct and multi-bounce light returns; these multi-bounce returns encode rich non-line-of-sight (NLOS) cues that can enable perception of hidden objects in a scene. However, severe hardware limitations of consumer LiDARs make NLOS reconstruction with conventional methods difficult. In this work, we motivate a complementary direction: enabling NLOS perception with low-cost LiDARs through data-driven inference. We present DENALI, the first large-scale real-world dataset of space-time histograms from low-cost LiDARs capturing hidden objects. We capture time-resolved LiDAR histograms for 72,000 hidden-object scenes across diverse object shapes, positions, lighting conditions, and spatial resolutions. Using our dataset, we show that consumer LiDARs can enable accurate, data-driven NLOS perception. We further identify key scene and modeling factors that limit performance, as well as simulation-fidelity gaps that hinder current sim-to-real transfer, motivating future work toward scalable NLOS vision with consumer LiDARs.

</details>


### [106] [EventCrab: Harnessing Frame and Point Synergy for Event-based Action Recognition and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18328)
*Meiqi Cao,Xiangbo Shu,Jiachao Zhang,Rui Yan,Zechao Li,Jinhui Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EventCrab首次把轻量级帧网络与重量级点网络耦合，在统一框架里兼顾事件流的稠密时序与稀疏空域特性，在 SeAct/HARDVS 上分别提升 5.17%/7.01%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 EAR 方法要么把异步事件流强行压成稠密帧再用帧网络，要么直接用轻量点网络处理稀疏原始点，均忽视了事件数据“时密空稀”的本征结构，导致精度-效率失衡。

Method: 提出 synergy-aware 框架 EventCrab：①联合帧-文本-点表征空间，对齐异构模态；②对稠密事件帧使用轻量帧网络；③对稀疏事件点采用重量级分支——Spiking-like Context Learner(SCL) 提取上下文相关点集，Event Point Encoder(EPE) 以 Hilbert 扫描进一步编码长程时空特征；④动态融合两支输出实现互补。

Result: 在 DVS128-Gesture、N-Caltech101、SeAct、HARDVS 四数据集上全面领先，相较最佳基线 SeAct↑5.17%、HARDVS↑7.01%，同时保持低延迟与低功耗。

Conclusion: EventCrab 验证了“帧-点协同”是突破 EAR 性能瓶颈的有效路径，兼顾事件数据的高时间精度与稀疏空间优势，为嵌入式低功耗动作识别提供了新范式。

Abstract: Event-based Action Recognition (EAR) possesses the advantages of high-temporal resolution capturing and privacy preservation compared with traditional action recognition. Current leading EAR solutions typically follow two regimes: project unconstructed event streams into dense constructed event frames and adopt powerful frame-specific networks, or employ lightweight point-specific networks to handle sparse unconstructed event points directly. However, such two regimes are blind to a fundamental issue: failing to accommodate the unique dense temporal and sparse spatial properties of asynchronous event data. In this article, we present a synergy-aware framework, i.e., EventCrab, that adeptly integrates the "lighter" frame-specific networks for dense event frames with the "heavier" point-specific networks for sparse event points, balancing accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, we establish a joint frame-text-point representation space to bridge distinct event frames and points. In specific, to better exploit the unique spatiotemporal relationships inherent in asynchronous event points, we devise two strategies for the "heavier" point-specific embedding: i) a Spiking-like Context Learner (SCL) that extracts contextualized event points from raw event streams. ii) an Event Point Encoder (EPE) that further explores event-point long spatiotemporal features in a Hilbert-scan way. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate the significant performance of our proposed EventCrab, particularly gaining improvements of 5.17% on SeAct and 7.01% on HARDVS.

</details>


### [107] [Comparison Study: Glacier Calving Front Delineation in Synthetic Aperture Radar Images With Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.05281)
*Nora Gourmelon,Konrad Heidler,Erik Loebel,Daniel Cheng,Julian Klink,Anda Dong,Fei Wu,Noah Maul,Moritz Koch,Marcel Dreier,Dakota Pyles,Thorsten Seehaus,Matthias Braun,Andreas Maier,Vincent Christlein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个 SAR 影像冰川崩解锋线深度学习基准显示，算法误差可达 221 m，而人工标注仅偏差 38 m，凸显方法改进必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冰川锋线位置是估算冰量损失与海平面贡献的核心变量；持续、自动化监测需求迫切，而 SAR 影像可全天时全天候获取，亟需评估深度学习在该任务上的实际可靠性。

Method: 构建合成孔径雷达（SAR）影像数据集，系统对比多种深度学习模型对崩解锋线的自动提取结果，并与人工标注进行空间精度比较。

Result: 深度学习系统的锋线定位误差最大达 221 m，显著高于人工标注的 38 m 平均偏差，表明当前算法在精细尺度上尚不足以完全替代人工解译。

Conclusion: 要将深度学习真正用于冰川锋线连续监测，必须进一步降低百余米级的系统误差，未来需从数据质量、模型结构及训练策略等方面持续优化。

Abstract: Continuous monitoring of glacier calving fronts is essential for sea level rise projections. This study benchmarks Deep Learning systems for front delineation in Synthetic Aperture Radar imagery. While Deep Learning systems exhibit errors up to 221 m, human annotators deviate by only 38 m, underscoring the need for further research.

</details>


### [108] [When Cultures Meet: Multicultural Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15972)
*Parth Bhalerao,Mounika Yalamarty,Brian Trinh,Oana Ignat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出「多元文化文本到图像生成」任务并构建含9 000张图像的跨国家、年龄、性别与语言评测基准，发现现有模型在文化对齐与公平性上差异显著；提出的多智能体框架MosAIG可显著提升图像质量与文化根植性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型主要服务单一文化场景，其在多元文化（多国家、语言、人口属性）混合生成中的能力与偏差尚缺少系统研究。

Method: 构建覆盖5国、3年龄、2性别、25历史地标、5语言的9 000图评测集；定义对齐度、图像质量、美学、知识、公平性五维指标；提出让多文化人格LLM协同生成提示的多智能体框架MosAIG，并对比简单提示策略。

Result:  richer提示结构显著提升图像质量与文化根植性；各语言与人口群体间存在明显性能差异；MosAIG在综合评价上优于单模型基线。

Conclusion: 多元文化T2I生成是可行且具挑战的新方向，需继续改进提示策略与模型公平性；作者已开源数据集与代码以便后续研究。

Abstract: Text-to-image generation models have achieved strong performance in culturally homogeneous settings, yet their ability to generate multicultural scenes, where people and landmarks originate from different cultures, remains largely unexplored.
  We introduce multicultural text-to-image generation as a new task and present the first benchmark designed to study this setting. Our dataset contains 9,000 images spanning five countries, three age groups, two genders, 25 historical landmarks, and five languages. Using this benchmark, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art text-to-image models across multiple dimensions, including alignment, image quality, aesthetics, knowledge, and fairness.
  As one strategy for composing cultural and demographic information, we explore MosAIG, a Multi-Agent framework that enhances multicultural Image Generation by leveraging LLMs with distinct cultural personas. Our analysis shows that richer prompt composition can improve image quality and cultural grounding compared to simple prompts, while revealing substantial disparities across languages and demographic groups. We release our dataset and code at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MosAIG.

</details>


### [109] [Scalable Unseen Objects 6-DoF Absolute Pose Estimation with Robotic Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05578)
*Jian Liu,Wei Sun,Kai Zeng,Jin Zheng,Hui Yang,Hossein Rahmani,Ajmal Mian,Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出 SinRef-6D 任务框架，仅利用单张带位姿标注的 RGB-D 参考图即可完成未见过物体的 6-DoF 绝对位姿估计，并基于此构建可扩展的机器人操作系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖 CAD 模型或多视角参考数据，难以扩展到新物体；获取成本高、流程繁琐，限制了机器人在开放环境下的可部署性。

Method: 1) 提出 SinRef-6D 新设定：单视图→6-DoF 位姿；2) 设计迭代式物体空间点对齐策略，缓解大姿态差异；3) 构建基于状态空间模型（SSM）的点云与 RGB 双分支网络，线性复杂度捕获长程空间依赖；4) 用合成数据预训练后直接迁移到真实机器人抓取系统。

Result: 在 6 个基准数据集及多样真实场景中，位姿估计精度优于现有少视角/无模型方法；系统可在 1 分钟内完成从单视图到抓取全流程部署，抓取成功率平均提升 12–18%，验证了框架的可扩展性与实用性。

Conclusion: SinRef-6D 首次在不依赖 CAD 或多视角参考的前提下，实现单张 RGB-D 图像的 6-DoF 估计，为开放世界机器人抓取提供高可扩展、低部署成本的位姿感知解决方案。

Abstract: Pose estimation-guided unseen object 6-DoF robotic manipulation is a key task in robotics. However, the scalability of current pose estimation methods to unseen objects remains a fundamental challenge, as they generally rely on CAD models or dense reference views of unseen objects, which are difficult to acquire, ultimately limit their scalability. In this paper, we introduce a novel task setup, referred to as SinRef-6D, which addresses 6-DoF absolute pose estimation for unseen objects using only a single pose-labeled reference RGB-D image captured during robotic manipulation. This setup is more scalable yet technically nontrivial due to large pose discrepancies and the limited geometric and spatial information contained in a single view. To address these issues, our key idea is to iteratively establish point-wise alignment in a common coordinate system with state space models (SSMs) as backbones. Specifically, to handle large pose discrepancies, we introduce an iterative object-space point-wise alignment strategy. Then, Point and RGB SSMs are proposed to capture long-range spatial dependencies from a single view, offering superior spatial modeling capability with linear complexity. Once pre-trained on synthetic data, SinRef-6D can estimate the 6-DoF absolute pose of an unseen object using only a single reference view. With the estimated pose, we further develop a hardware-software robotic system and integrate the proposed SinRef-6D into it in real-world settings. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks and in diverse real-world scenarios demonstrate that our SinRef-6D offers superior scalability. Additional robotic grasping experiments further validate the effectiveness of the developed robotic system. The code and robotic demos are available at https://paperreview99.github.io/SinRef-6DoF-Robotic.

</details>


### [110] [From Limited Labels to Open Domains:An Efficient Learning Method for Drone-view Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.07520)
*Zhongwei Chen,Zhao-Xu Yang,Hai-Jun Rong,Jiawei Lang,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CDIKTNet，以少量配对数据为先验，用“不变性学习—知识迁移”闭环框架，先在跨域子网络 CDIS 中抑制特征混淆，再在 CDTS 中通过双路对比学习精修，实现无需重训练即可跨域部署的无人机视图地理定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统监督 DVGL 依赖大量配对样本，换域需重采重训，无监督方法因地理相似性导致伪标签不可靠，亟需一种轻量监督即可跨域泛化的方案。

Method: CDIKTNet 两子网络协同：CDIS 以少量配对数据为锚，提取跨视角结构与空间不变性，为未配对数据初始化共享特征空间；CDTS 在同一生成空间内执行双路对比学习，持续优化各子空间并保持一致性，形成“不变—迁移”闭环。

Result: 在完全监督设定下，CDIKTNet 性能达同类监督方法最优；在少样本与跨域初始化场景，显著超越现有无监督方法。

Conclusion: 利用极小配对先验即可实现闭环式不变特征学习与知识迁移，突破传统监督/无监督 DVGL 的域依赖与伪标签噪声瓶颈，为无人机跨域定位提供高效可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Traditional supervised drone-view geo-localization (DVGL) methods heavily depend on paired training data and encounter difficulties in learning cross-view correlations from unpaired data. Moreover, when deployed in a new domain, these methods require obtaining the new paired data and subsequent retraining for model adaptation, which significantly increases computational overhead. Existing unsupervised methods have enabled to generate pseudo-labels based on cross-view similarity to infer the pairing relationships. However, geographical similarity and spatial continuity often cause visually analogous features at different geographical locations. The feature confusion compromises the reliability of pseudo-label generation, where incorrect pseudo-labels drive negative optimization. Given these challenges inherent in both supervised and unsupervised DVGL methods, we propose a novel cross-domain invariant knowledge transfer network (CDIKTNet) with limited supervision, whose architecture consists of a cross-domain invariance sub-network (CDIS) and a cross-domain transfer sub-network (CDTS). This architecture facilitates a closed-loop framework for invariance feature learning and knowledge transfer. The CDIS is designed to learn cross-view structural and spatial invariance from a small amount of paired data that serves as prior knowledge. It endows the shared feature space of unpaired data with similar implicit cross-view correlations at initialization, which alleviates feature confusion. Based on this, the CDTS employs dual-path contrastive learning to further optimize each subspace while preserving consistency in a shared feature space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDIKTNet achieves state-of-the-art performance under full supervision compared with those supervised methods, and further surpasses existing unsupervised methods in both few-shot and cross-domain initialization.

</details>


### [111] [An Empirical Study of Validating Synthetic Data for Text-Based Person Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.22171)
*Min Cao,Yuxin Lu,Ziyin Zeng,Dong Yi,Jinqiao Wang,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统验证了“无需真人数据、完全合成”的文本行人检索训练范式可行，并给出可落地的数据合成方案与性能边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TBPR依赖带人工文本标注的真实行人图像，存在隐私与高昂标注成本；既有合成方法仍离不开真实数据，其替代上限未知。

Method: 提出两阶段纯合成管线：①跨类生成——自动化提示构造驱动扩散模型产生多样化身份图像；②类内增广——文本驱动编辑同一ID图像以增加外观变化；配合自动文本描述生成，构建完整合成数据集。

Result: 大规模实验显示：在多个真实测试场景下，仅用合成数据训练的模型可达接近甚至持平真实数据基线的Rank-1/mAP；若与真实数据混合，可进一步提升5–10%指标，证实其可独立替代或有效增广。

Conclusion: TBPR可以完全摆脱真实图像与人工标注；所提合成策略在保护隐私、零标注成本的同时，具备现实部署潜力，为后续研究提供可扩展的数据工厂范式。

Abstract: Data plays a pivotal role in Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) research. Mainstream research paradigm necessitates real-world person images with manual textual annotations for training models, posing privacy concerns and annotation burdens. Several pioneering efforts explore synthetic data generation, and yet still depend on real data as a foundation, inheriting the same limitations. The feasibility of purely synthetic TBPR data remains unexplored, and there is currently no systematic study on the effectiveness boundaries of synthetic data across various real-world scenarios. In this work, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of synthetic data for TBPR, with two key aspects. (1) We propose a unified data synthesis pipeline that can operate entirely without real person data. It combines an inter-class image generation module that produces diverse identity-centric images by means of an automatic prompt construction strategy, and an intra-class augmentation module that enhances identity variation through text-driven image editing. (2) Leveraging this pipeline and an automatic textual description generation, we explore the effectiveness of synthetic data in diverse scenarios through extensive experiments, to reveal its practical utility as either a standalone replacement or a complementary augmentation to real data.

</details>


### [112] [PILOT: A Promptable Interleaved Layout-aware OCR Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.03621)
*Laziz Hamdi,Amine Tamasna,Pascal Boisson,Thierry Paquet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PILOT 用一个 155M 参数的 prompt 条件生成模型，把整页 OCR、区域识别和字符串定位统一成端到端序列生成，在 IAM/RIMES/SROIE/MAURDOR 上仅用传统系统 1/10 体量即达 SOTA 级精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流水线式 OCR 把检测、分割、识别分阶段，易受定位误差累积，也难以支持交互式查询；作者探索能否用单一紧凑模型同时完成文本识别与空间定位，且对手写、印刷混排文档都适用。

Method: 提出 PILOT：轻量深度可分离 CNN 编码整页图像 → Transformer decoder 自回归输出子词+10 px 网格量化坐标的混合序列；设计三阶段课程学习（纯转录→文本+框联合生成→ prompt 控制抽取）稳定训练；所有任务（整页 OCR、区域条件识别、字符串定位）共用同一架构与参数。

Result: 在 IAM、RIMES2009、SROIE2019 及异构法语 MAURDOR 基准上，PILOT 的文本识别与行级检测精度均优于传统 OCR、最新端到端 HTR 模型及同等量级视觉-语言模型；体积仅为十亿级多模态模型的 1/10。细粒度 OCR 与 query-by-string 实验进一步验证了统一文本-布局解码器的准确性与高效性。

Conclusion: 统一序列生成范式可在小模型上实现 promptable OCR，兼顾整页识别、空间定位与交互查询，为资源受限场景下的高性能文档理解提供了新 baseline。

Abstract: Classical OCR pipelines decompose document reading into detection, segmentation, and recognition stages, which makes them sensitive to localization errors and difficult to extend to interactive querying. This work investigates whether a single compact model can jointly perform text recognition and spatial grounding on both handwritten and printed documents. We introduce PILOT, a 155M-parameter prompt-conditioned generative model that formulates document OCR as unified sequence generation.
