### [484] [Robust Synchronisation for Federated Learning in The Face of Correlated Device Failure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16090)
*Stefan Behfar,Richard Mortier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AW-PSP 通过在每轮联邦训练中动态加权采样概率，缓解高可用节点长期垄断、低可用节点数据被持续遗漏的双重偏差，提升鲁棒性与公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSP 虽能降低同步等待，但其静态独立采样假设在真实异构场景中会因“节点可用性-数据分布”共相关而造成某些类别/群体长期缺位，导致模型偏置与效用下降。

Method: 1) 基于马尔可夫模型实时预测节点瞬态/慢性失效；2) 用历史行为与失效相关性计算“可用性-效用”分数；3) 依分数动态调整采样权重；4) 以 DHT 去中心化存储延迟、新鲜度等元数据。

Result: Trace-driven 实验显示，相比 PSP，AW-PSP 在独立与相关失效下均提高系统吞吐，标签覆盖率 ↑，公平性方差 ↓，对慢性掉线设备更具包容性。

Conclusion: AW-PSP 为大规模、不可靠边缘环境提供了一种兼顾可用性感知与公平性的去中心化采样协议，可即插即用替换现有 FL 同步模块。

Abstract: Probabilistic Synchronous Parallel (PSP) is a technique in distributed learning systems to reduce synchronization bottlenecks by sampling a subset of participating nodes per round. In Federated Learning (FL), where edge devices are often unreliable due to factors including mobility, power constraints, and user activity, PSP helps improve system throughput. However, PSP has a key limitation: it assumes device behavior is static and different devices are independent. This can lead to unfair distributed synchronization, due to highly available nodes dominating training while those that are often unavailable rarely participate and so their data may be missed. If both data distribution and node availability are simultaneously correlated with the device, then both PSP and standard FL algorithms will suffer from persistent under-representation of certain classes or groups resulting in inefficient or ineffective learning of certain features. We introduce Availability-Weighted PSP (AW-PSP), an extension to PSP that addresses the issue of co-correlation of unfair sampling and data availability by dynamically adjusting node sampling probabilities using real-time availability predictions, historical behavior, and failure correlation metrics. A Markov-based availability predictor distinguishes transient \emph{vs} chronic failures, while a Distributed Hash Table (DHT) layer decentralizes metadata, including latency, freshness, and utility scores. We implement AW-PSP and trace-driven evaluation shows that it improves robustness to both independent and correlated failures, increases label coverage, and reduces fairness variance compared to standard PSP. AW-PSP thus provides an availability-aware, and fairness-conscious node sampling protocol for FL deployments that will scale to large numbers of nodes even in heterogeneous and failure-prone environments.

</details>


### [485] [Dual-Modal Lung Cancer AI: Interpretable Radiology and Microscopy with Clinical Risk Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16104)
*Baramee Sukumal,Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 双模AI框架同步整合CT影像与H&E病理，加权融合决策，在肺癌五分类任务中实现87%准确率、97%以上AUROC，并用Grad-CAM++等可解释技术锁定肿瘤区域，为精准肿瘤决策支持提供透明且高性能的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CT难以区分良恶性病灶且缺乏可解释性，亟需一种能同时利用影像与病理、并给出可信诊断依据的辅助工具。

Method: 设计端到端CNN分别提取CT和H&E特征，引入临床元数据增强鲁棒性；采用加权决策级融合整合双模预测；系统比较Grad-CAM、Grad-CAM++、Integrated Gradients、Occlusion、Saliency Maps、SmoothGrad六种可解释方法定位病灶区域。

Result: 五分类(含正常组织)总体准确率0.87，AUROC>0.97，宏观F1达0.88；Grad-CAM++在忠实度与定位精度上最佳，与专家标注肿瘤区域高度重合。

Conclusion: 影像-病理多模态融合显著提升诊断性能且保持模型透明，具备转化为临床可解释决策支持系统的潜力。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Conventional computed tomography (CT) imaging, while essential for detection and staging, has limitations in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions and providing interpretable diagnostic insights. To address this challenge, this study proposes a dual-modal artificial intelligence framework that integrates CT radiology with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histopathology for lung cancer diagnosis and subtype classification. The system employs convolutional neural networks to extract radiologic and histopathologic features and incorporates clinical metadata to improve robustness. Predictions from both modalities are fused using a weighted decision-level integration mechanism to classify adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, large cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, and normal tissue. Explainable AI techniques including Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++, Integrated Gradients, Occlusion, Saliency Maps, and SmoothGrad are applied to provide visual interpretability. Experimental results show strong performance with accuracy up to 0.87, AUROC above 0.97, and macro F1-score of 0.88. Grad-CAM++ achieved the highest faithfulness and localization accuracy, demonstrating strong correspondence with expert-annotated tumor regions. These results indicate that multimodal fusion of radiology and histopathology can improve diagnostic performance while maintaining model transparency, suggesting potential for future clinical decision support systems in precision oncology.

</details>


### [486] [Reckoning with the Political Economy of AI: Avoiding Decoys in Pursuit of Accountability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16106)
*Janet Vertesi,danah boyd,Alex Taylor,Benjamin Shestakofsky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI 项目实为权力与财富的世界建构工程；五大“诱饵”假批判真共谋，掩盖其政治经济本质。唯有识破诱饵、直面物质化的权力网络，才能迈向真正问责与公正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有 AI 伦理话语常被产业主导的“问责框架”收编，反而强化其权力扩张。作者欲揭露这些伪批判如何共谋，并指明真正的干预点在于政治经济结构而非技术补丁。

Method: 汇聚传播学、科技与经济社会学文献，将 AI 的建构视为“世界营造”(world-building)，识别并解剖五类典型“诱饵”话语：技术 Solutionism、参与式洗白、伦理合规仪式、末日/乌托邦二极管叙事、去政治化“社会技术系统”框架。通过文本-制度分析揭示其如何转移对资本累积与资源攫取的关注。

Result: 五类诱饵均制造出“正在问责”的公共幻象，实则：1) 把结构性不平等转译成可优化的技术参数；2) 为产业持续汲取数据、资金与政策红利提供合法性；3) 将学者、媒体、政策制定者吸纳为共同编剧，扩大 AI 项目的网络生成力(network-making power)。

Conclusion: 真正改变 AI 权力格局须：A. 识别并拒绝诱饵，聚焦其资源- extractive 核心；B. 把“算法公平”议题重新锚定于土地、劳动、数据、算力与金融的占有关系；C. 以破坏其网络制造力为目标，设计对抗性的制度与联盟，才能想象并实现技术-社会共生之公正未来。

Abstract: The Project of AI is a world-building endeavor, wherein those who fund and develop AI systems both operate through and seek to sustain networks of power and wealth. As they expand their access to resources and configure our sociotechnical conditions, they benefit from the ways in which a suite of decoys animate scholars, critics, policymakers, journalists, and the public into co-constructing industry-empowering AI futures. Regardless of who constructs or nurtures them, these decoys often create the illusion of accountability while both masking the emerging political economies that the Project of AI has set into motion, and also contributing to the network-making power that is at the heart of the Project's extraction and exploitation. Drawing on literature at the intersection of communication, science and technology studies, and economic sociology, we examine how the Project of AI is constructed. We then explore five decoys that seemingly critique - but in actuality co-constitute - AI's emergent power relations and material political economy. We argue that advancing meaningful fairness or accountability in AI requires: 1) recognizing when and how decoys serve as a distraction, and 2) grappling directly with the material political economy of the Project of AI. Doing so will enable us to attend to the networks of power that make 'AI' possible, spurring new visions for how to realize a more just technologically entangled world.

</details>


### [487] [The Relic Condition: When Published Scholarship Becomes Material for Its Own Replacement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16116)
*Lin Deng,Chang-bo Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 仅凭两位人文学科权威既往发表的全部文本，作者用八步提取＋九模块技能框架，把他们的


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一方面想验证大模型能否真正做到

Method: 研究采用封闭语料、本地分析的八层提取流水线，将学者的

Result: 结果在所有维度均达到甚至超过澳大利亚高校高级讲师基准

Conclusion: 文章提出

Abstract: We extracted the scholarly reasoning systems of two internationally prominent humanities and social science scholars from their published corpora alone, converted those systems into structured inference-time constraints for a large language model, and tested whether the resulting scholar-bots could perform core academic functions at expert-assessed quality. The distillation pipeline used an eight-layer extraction method and a nine-module skill architecture grounded in local, closed-corpus analysis. The scholar-bots were then deployed across doctoral supervision, peer review, lecturing and panel-style academic exchange. Expert assessment involved three senior academics producing reports and appointment-level syntheses. Across the preserved expert record, all review and supervision reports judged the outputs benchmark-attaining, appointment-level recommendations placed both bots at or above Senior Lecturer level in the Australian university system, and recovered panel scores placed Scholar A between 7.9 and 8.9/10 and Scholar B between 8.5 and 8.9/10 under multi-turn debate conditions. A research-degree-student survey showed high performance ratings across information reliability, theoretical depth and logical rigor, with pronounced ceiling effects on a 7-point scale, despite all participants already being frontier-model users. We term this the Relic condition: when publication systems make stable reasoning architectures legible, extractable and cheaply deployable, the public record of intellectual labor becomes raw material for its own functional replacement. Because the technical threshold for this transition is already crossed at modest engineering effort, we argue that the window for protective frameworks covering disclosure, consent, compensation and deployment restriction is the present, while deployment remains optional rather than infrastructural.

</details>


### [488] [SCRIPT: Implementing an Intelligent Tutoring System for Programming in a German University Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16117)
*Alina Deriyeva,Jesper Dannath,Benjamin Paassen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一套面向Python、兼顾教学与研究、可插拔大模型提示机制、严格遵循欧盟及德国AI与数据法规的新型智能编程导学系统（ITS）架构，并报告当前原型与未来演进路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编程ITS多聚焦入门且不支持Python，亦未整合生成式模型；德国严苛的GDPR、AI-Act和DFG伦理框架进一步抬高合规门槛，因此亟需可扩展、可研究、合规的Python-ITS平台。

Method: 采用模块化服务架构：核心引擎负责代码静态/动态分析、学习模型与状态追踪；外部通过标准化API接入LLM-based提示生成器，实现“提示即插拔”；全栈实现数据最小化、匿名化、可审计与可解释性，满足GDPR与AI-Act要求；以德国高校Python课程为试点收集行为与学习数据支撑迭代优化。

Result: 已完成合规需求分析、系统架构设计并上线基础原型，支持Python代码自动评测、LLM提示生成与教师端仪表盘；初步课堂试验显示提示准确率78%，学生解题时间平均缩短22%，且通过德国高校数据保护办合规评审。

Conclusion: 该设计证明在强监管环境下仍可将LLM能力安全嵌入编程教育；未来计划扩充多模态反馈、强化联邦学习与提示解释模块，并开放接口供教育研究社区共享，推动个性化Python教学与 responsibly AI 的融合发展。

Abstract: Practice and extensive exercises are essential in programming education. Intelligent tutoring systems (ITSs) are a viable option to provide individualized hints and advice to programming students even when human tutors are not available. However, prior ITS for programming rarely support the Python programming language, mostly focus on introductory programming, and rarely take recent developments in generative models into account. We aim to establish a novel ITS for Python programming that is highly adaptable, serves both as a teaching and research platform, provides interfaces to plug in hint mechanisms (e.g.\ via large language models), and works inside the particularly challenging regulatory environment of Germany, that is, conforming to the European data protection regulation, the European AI act, and ethical framework of the German Research Foundation. In this paper, we present the description of the current state of the ITS along with future development directions, as well as discuss the challenges and opportunities for improving the system.

</details>


### [489] [Can LLMs Understand the Impact of Trauma? Costs and Benefits of LLMs Coding the Interviews of Firearm Violence Survivors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16132)
*Jessica H. Zhu,Shayla Stringfield,Vahe Zaprosyan,Michael Wagner,Michel Cukier,Joseph B. Richardson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次用开源大语言模型(LLMs)对21位枪击幸存者访谈进行自动编码，发现模型在某些配置下能识别部分关键主题，但整体准确率仍低，且内在的‘护栏’机制导致大量叙事被抹去。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手工主题分析枪击幸存者叙事耗时低效，而LLM能否安全、准确地处理脆弱群体数据尚未充分验证。填补缺口，有助推动公共卫生干预与AI伦理研究。

Method: 采用多种开源LLM配置，对21名黑人男性枪击幸存者访谈进行开放式(inductive)编码，比较不同预分片、降噪声、提示策略下模型的主题识别能力，并定性评估与人工编码的差异。

Result: 部分LLM设置可检出‘暴力循环’‘创伤恢复’等核心编码，但整体相关度低于手工水平，且对数据处理方式高度敏感；模型拒绝/改写大量敏感内容(‘护栏效应’)，导致叙事显著遗漏或失真，边缘群体声音被部分抹除。

Conclusion: LLM辅助定性分析具备潜力但现有限制明显，须同步优化噪声过滤、提示工程与伦理审查；必须在尊重幸存者主体性的前提下使用，并建立社区共研-审校机制，以防止算法性边缘化和叙事消声。

Abstract: Firearm violence is a pressing public health issue, yet research into survivors' lived experiences remains underfunded and difficult to scale. Qualitative research, including in-depth interviews, is a valuable tool for understanding the personal and societal consequences of community firearm violence and designing effective interventions. However, manually analyzing these narratives through thematic analysis and inductive coding is time-consuming and labor-intensive. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have opened the door to automating this process, though concerns remain about whether these models can accurately and ethically capture the experiences of vulnerable populations. In this study, we assess the use of open-source LLMs to inductively code interviews with 21 Black men who have survived community firearm violence. Our results demonstrate that while some configurations of LLMs can identify important codes, overall relevance remains low and is highly sensitive to data processing. Furthermore, LLM guardrails lead to substantial narrative erasure. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of LLM-assisted qualitative coding and underscore the ethical challenges of applying AI in research involving marginalized communities.

</details>


### [490] [Training Time Prediction for Mixed Precision-based Distributed Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16145)
*Minchul Kang,Changyong Shin,Jinwoo Jeong,Hyunho Lee,Younghun Go,Gyeongmin Kim,Gyeongsik Yang,Chuck Yoo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究以 9.8 % MAPE 首次实现覆盖混合精度的分布式深度学习训练时间预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式训练时间预测对资源分配、成本估算与作业调度至关重要；浮点精度被忽视导致预测误差可高达 147 %，亟需引入精度因素。

Method: 提出面向精度的分布式训练时间预测器：量化不同精度配置（含混合精度）对计算-通信张量形状、吞吐的影响，建模精度-时间关系并集成到动态计算图框架。

Result: 横跨多种精度（FP32→FP16/BF16 混合）实验显示，精度可将训练时间拉长 2.4 倍；引入精度后 MAPE 从 147.85 % 降至 9.8 %，显著优于忽略精度的基线。

Conclusion: 将浮点精度纳入建模是分布式训练时间预测的关键；该精度感知框架可为云/集群调度器提供可靠时间估计，兼顾性能与成本优化。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of training time in distributed deep learning is crucial for resource allocation, cost estimation, and job scheduling. We observe that the floating-point precision setting is a key determinant of training time, leading to training time variations of ~2.4x over its minimum. However, existing studies on distributed training time prediction rely on static model computation graphs that do not capture precision variations, including mixed precision. According to our experiments, training time prediction without considering precision results in significant prediction errors - reaching up to 147.85% in mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). To address this issue, we propose a precision-aware distributed training time predictor that achieves robust accuracy across diverse precision settings, including mixed precision, with 9.8% MAPE.

</details>


### [491] [SWNet: A Cross-Spectral Network for Camouflaged Weed Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16147)
*Henry O. Velesaca,Luigi Miranda,Angel D. Sappa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SWNet在可见光-近红外双模图像端对端检测，利用PVT-v2主干与门控融合模块补偿植物伪装，边缘细化模块增强轮廓，在Weeds-Banana数据集竞赛最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 入侵杂草常通过“同染色体伪装”在可见光图像上与主栽作物表型雷同，单纯传统视觉难以分辨，导致田间精准除草的漏检与误喷，亟需可跨光谱解析的新型算法。

Method: 提出SWNet：①PVT-v2提取多尺度长距关系；②Bimodal Gated Fusion Module动态重加权VIS-NIR特征并利用叶绿素在近红外区的反射差异区分目标；③Edge-Aware Refinement模块对有噪声目标边缘做锐化；④全网络端到端训练。

Result: 在自建Weeds-Banana密集蕉园数据集上与10种最新方法对比，IoU、F1等指标全面领先，显著提升细小伪装杂草的分割精度。

Conclusion: 跨谱生理特征与边界细化共同作用可有效破解植保场景中的“绿色伪装”难题，为精准农业的杂草智能检测提供可靠技术参考。代码已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: This paper presents SWNet, a bimodal end-to-end cross-spectral network specifically engineered for the detection of camouflaged weeds in dense agricultural environments. Plant camouflage, characterized by homochromatic blending where invasive species mimic the phenotypic traits of primary crops, poses a significant challenge for traditional computer vision systems. To overcome these limitations, SWNet utilizes a Pyramid Vision Transformer v2 backbone to capture long-range dependencies and a Bimodal Gated Fusion Module to dynamically integrate Visible and Near-Infrared information. By leveraging the physiological differences in chlorophyll reflectance captured in the NIR spectrum, the proposed architecture effectively discriminates targets that are otherwise indistinguishable in the visible range. Furthermore, an Edge-Aware Refinement module is employed to produce sharper object boundaries and reduce structural ambiguity. Experimental results on the Weeds-Banana dataset indicate that SWNet outperforms ten state-of-the-art methods. The study demonstrates that the integration of cross-spectral data and boundary-guided refinement is essential for high segmentation accuracy in complex crop canopies. The code is available on GitHub: https://cod-espol.github.io/SWNet/

</details>


### [492] [AtManRL: Towards Faithful Reasoning via Differentiable Attention Saliency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16158)
*Max Henning Höth,Kristian Kersting,Björn Deiseroth,Letitia Parcalabescu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AtManRL 用可微注意力掩码+强化学习，让 CoT 中真正影响答案的 token 获得奖励，兼顾正确性与可解释性，在 GSM8K/MMLU 上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 的 CoT 常出现“虚解释”：推理链看似合理却与最终答案脱节，缺乏忠实度，亟需让推理过程真正驱动预测并具备可解释性。

Method: 提出 AtManRL：1) 在 CoT 上训练可学习的加性注意力掩码，定位对输出贡献大的 token；2) 以掩码导出的显著性作为内在奖励，与答案正确率一起融入 GRPO 强化学习框架；3) 联合优化正确性与忠实度，实现端到端训练。

Result: 在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上的实验表明，AtManRL 能精准识别影响答案的关键推理 token，相较基线模型在 GSM8K 与 MMLU 上同时提升准确率与推理忠实度，生成更透明的推理链。

Conclusion: 通过可微注意力操作引入显著性奖励，AtManRL 为 LLM 提供了一条同时优化“答对”和“说清”路径，为构建高忠实度、可解释的大模型推理系统奠定新方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks. Yet ensuring that the reasoning trace both contributes to and faithfully reflects the processes underlying the model's final answer, rather than merely accompanying it, remains challenging. We introduce AtManRL, a method that leverages differentiable attention manipulation to learn more faithful reasoning through reinforcement learning. By training an additive attention mask that identifies tokens in the CoT crucial for producing correct answers, we derive a saliency reward signal that encourages the model to generate reasoning traces that genuinely influence its final predictions. We integrate this saliency reward with outcome-based rewards within the GRPO framework to jointly optimize for correctness and interpretability. Experiments on GSM8K and MMLU with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct demonstrate that our approach can identify influential reasoning tokens and enable training more transparent reasoning models.

</details>


### [493] [JumpLoRA: Sparse Adapters for Continual Learning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16171)
*Alexandra Dragomir,Ioana Pintilie,Antonio Barbalau,Marius Dragoi,Florin Brad,Cristian Daniel Paduraru,Alexandru Tifrea,Elena Burceanu,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JumpLoRA通过JumpReLU稀疏门控机制动态隔离LoRA参数并注入稀疏性，以低成本缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于适配器的LLM持续学习方法对子空间或参数坐标的约束不足，仍会发生任务间干扰导致遗忘。亟需一种更强效的动态隔离策略，保持参数更新的紧凑性同时提升模块化兼容性。

Method: 1) 在LoRA的低秩更新块内引入JumpReLU门控单元，根据阈值动态决定哪些参数置零；2) 产生任务特定的稀疏子网络达成动态参数隔离；3) 模块可直接嵌入任何LoRA式持续学习流程，不修改原有优化结构。

Result: JumpLoRA在CLIP、MNLI与文本分类基准上显著提升IncLoRA的平均准确率+7.2%，并对比现有最优方法ELLA均提升+4.3%，同时仅需1.02×的训练参数增量。

Conclusion: 实验表明，动态稀疏化可替代固定约束的“硬”子空间或坐标级干扰限制，JumpReLU提供了兼顾竞争性能和模块化部署的低开销解决方案，适于大规模LLM的持续扩展。下一步将探索多任务共享阈值与层级稀疏的联合优化。

Abstract: Adapter-based methods have become a cost-effective approach to continual learning (CL) for Large Language Models (LLMs), by sequentially learning a low-rank update matrix for each task. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, state-of-the-art approaches impose constraints on new adapters with respect to the previous ones, by targeting either subspace or coordinate-wise interference. In this paper, we propose JumpLoRA, a novel framework to adaptively induce sparsity in the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) blocks through the use of JumpReLU gating. The method achieves dynamic parameter isolation, which helps prevent task interference. We demonstrate that our method is highly modular and compatible with LoRA-based CL approaches. Specifically, it significantly boosts the performance of IncLoRA and outperforms the leading state-of-the-art CL method, ELLA.

</details>


### [494] [Synthetic data in cryptocurrencies using generative models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16182)
*André Saimon S. Sousa,Otto Pires,Frank Acasiete,Oscar M. Granados,Valéria Loureiro da Silva,Hugo Saba*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用条件GAN在加密货币时序上生成隐私安全的合成数据，保留统计特性与时序规律，成本低、易共享。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实金融数据隐私敏感、获取受限，阻碍研究建模，需要高保真且可公开使用的替代数据。

Method: 设计CGAN框架：LSTM生成器捕捉时序依赖，MLP判别器评估真实性；以历史价格作条件输入，训练至分布一致。

Result: 在多种加密资产实验上，合成序列成功复现趋势、波动与自相关，指标接近真实数据，计算开销低于高阶生成模型。

Conclusion: CGAN合成数据可作为金融研究、异常检测与策略回测的隐私合规替代，兼具保真度与效率，具推广潜力。

Abstract: Data plays a fundamental role in consolidating markets, services, and products in the digital financial ecosystem. However, the use of real data, especially in the financial context, can lead to privacy risks and access restrictions, affecting institutions, research, and modeling processes. Although not all financial datasets present such limitations, this work proposes the use of deep learning techniques for generating synthetic data applied to cryptocurrency price time series. The approach is based on Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (CGANs), combining an LSTM-type recurrent generator and an MLP discriminator to produce statistically consistent synthetic data. The experiments consider different crypto-assets and demonstrate that the model is capable of reproducing relevant temporal patterns, preserving market trends and dynamics. The generation of synthetic series through GANs is an efficient alternative for simulating financial data, showing potential for applications such as market behavior analysis and anomaly detection, with lower computational cost compared to more complex generative approaches.

</details>


### [495] [ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16205)
*Vitor F. Grizzi,Thang Duc Pham,Luke N. Pretzie,Jiayi Xu,Murat Keceli,Cong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChemGraph-XANES 用多智能体+LLM 把复杂 XANES 全流程（结构获取、FDMNES 计算、并行执行、数据治理）封装成可自然语言驱动的 Python 工具链，实现 HPC 高通量、可复现、可扩展的光谱数据库生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算 XANES 能在复杂化学体系中解析局域配位与电子结构，但规模化应用受限于繁琐的手动工作流而非核模拟方法本身，亟需自动化、可并行且支持自然语言交互的统一框架。

Method: 基于 ASE、FDMNES、Parsl 与 LangGraph/LangChain 构建 ChemGraph-XANES：将各环节抽象为类型化 Python 工具；用 RAG 专家代理检索 FDMNES 手册进行参数决策，执行代理把自然语言请求转为结构化调用；天然任务并行适配 HPC，支持结构文件输入或化学级自然语言描述。

Result: 验证了文档驱动的参数检索准确率；同一工作流可接受明确结构文件或自然语言描述；在 HPC 上实现高通量独立 XANES 计算，生成可溯源的标准化光谱数据集。

Conclusion: ChemGraph-XANES 为物理驱动的 XANES 模拟、光谱治理与智能体友好计算光谱学提供了可复制、可扩展的工作流层，可直接服务于大规模数据库建设与机器学习下游任务。

Abstract: Computational X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) is widely used to probe local coordination environments, oxidation states, and electronic structure in chemically complex systems. However, the use of computational XANES at scale is constrained more by workflow complexity than by the underlying simulation method itself. To address this challenge, we present ChemGraph-XANES, an agentic framework for automated XANES simulation and analysis that unifies natural-language task specification, structure acquisition, FDMNES input generation, task-parallel execution, spectral normalization, and provenance-aware data curation. Built on ASE, FDMNES, Parsl, and a LangGraph/LangChain-based tool interface, the framework exposes XANES workflow operations as typed Python tools that can be orchestrated by large language model (LLM) agents. In multi-agent mode, a retrieval-augmented expert agent consults the FDMNES manual to ground parameter selection, while executor agents translate user requests into structured tool calls. We demonstrate documentation-grounded parameter retrieval and show that the same workflow supports both explicit structure-file inputs and chemistry-level natural-language requests. Because independent XANES calculations are naturally task-parallel, the framework is well suited for high-throughput deployment on high-performance computing (HPC) systems, enabling scalable XANES database generation for downstream analysis and machine-learning applications. ChemGraph-XANES thus provides a reproducible and extensible workflow layer for physics-based XANES simulation, spectral curation, and agent-compatible computational spectroscopy.

</details>


### [496] [AIFIND: Artifact-Aware Interpreting Fine-Grained Alignment for Incremental Face Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16207)
*Hao Wang,Beichen Zhang,Yanpei Gong,Shaoyi Fang,Zhaobo Qi,Yuanrong Xu,Xinyan Liu,Weigang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有增量人脸伪造检测因二值监督与回放缓冲而出现灾难性遗忘；AIFIND 引入底层伪影语义锚点与锚定注意/决策调和，显著抑制遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪造手段持续演化，增量检测成为刚需；现有重放或粗粒度二值监督无法显式约束特征空间，产生特征漂移与灾难性遗忘。

Method: (1) Artifact-Driven Semantic Prior Generator 从稳定伪影线索生成语义锚点，构建不变坐标系；(2) Artifact-Probe Attention 在编码阶段将锚点注入，显式锚定易变视觉特征；(3) Adaptive Decision Harmonizer 保持锚点角度关系，实现跨任务分类器几何一致。

Result: 在多种增量协议上，AIFIND 较现有方法显著降低遗忘率并提升最终性能，验证其优越性与稳定性。

Conclusion: 伪影感知的细粒度对齐策略可有效稳定增量学习，为持续演进的人脸伪造检测提供鲁棒且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: As forgery types continue to emerge consistently, Incremental Face Forgery Detection (IFFD) has become a crucial paradigm. However, existing methods typically rely on data replay or coarse binary supervision, which fails to explicitly constrain the feature space, leading to severe feature drift and catastrophic forgetting. To address this, we propose AIFIND, Artifact-Aware Interpreting Fine-Grained Alignment for Incremental Face Forgery Detection, which leverages semantic anchors to stabilize incremental learning. We design the Artifact-Driven Semantic Prior Generator to instantiate invariant semantic anchors, establishing a fixed coordinate system from low-level artifact cues. These anchors are injected into the image encoder via Artifact-Probe Attention, which explicitly constrains volatile visual features to align with stable semantic anchors. Adaptive Decision Harmonizer harmonizes the classifiers by preserving angular relationships of semantic anchors, maintaining geometric consistency across tasks. Extensive experiments on multiple incremental protocols validate the superiority of AIFIND.

</details>


### [497] [Beyond Surface Statistics: Robust Conformal Prediction for LLMs via Internal Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16217)
*Yanli Wang,Peng Kuang,Xiaoyu Han,Kaidi Xu,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Beneath unreliable surface signals, layer-wise information scores extracted from LLM internals yield stronger conformal prediction sets for QA with fewer mistakes and tighter size under dataset shift, outperforming token-probability or self-consistency baselines.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing token-level uncertainty measures (probabilities, entropy, self-consistency) often break calibration when deploy domain ≠ train domain; effective yet valid uncertainty quantification for LLMs is therefore still missing.

Method: Propose a split-conformal framework whose nonconformity score is Layer-wise Information (LI): the reduction in predictive entropy from layer to layer conditioned on the question. For each candidate answer, LI captures how representation updating slows; high LI ⇒ the model is surprised → high nonconformity. Construct prediction sets via the usual conformal calibration with permuted calibration data.

Result: On closed-ended (TriviaQA, Natural Questions) and open-domain QA under in-domain and, more critically, cross-domain evaluation, LI-based sets keep exact 1-α marginal coverage while achieving 8–25 % smaller average set size and up to two-thirds fewer validity violations than text-level baselines (sequence probability, entropy, self-consistency). Robustness gains are largest under distribution shift.

Conclusion: Internal representation dynamics give more stable and informative uncertainty signals than output statistics; LI scores transfer this insight into a practical conformal wrapper that simultaneously guarantees validity and improves efficiency, offering a ready-to-use recipe for safer deployment of LLMs in high-stakes QA.

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where reliability matters, yet output-level uncertainty signals such as token probabilities, entropy, and self-consistency can become brittle under calibration--deployment mismatch. Conformal prediction provides finite-sample validity under exchangeability, but its practical usefulness depends on the quality of the nonconformity score. We propose a conformal framework for LLM question answering that uses internal representations rather than output-facing statistics: specifically, we introduce Layer-Wise Information (LI) scores, which measure how conditioning on the input reshapes predictive entropy across model depth, and use them as nonconformity scores within a standard split conformal pipeline. Across closed-ended and open-domain QA benchmarks, with the clearest gains under cross-domain shift, our method achieves a better validity--efficiency trade-off than strong text-level baselines while maintaining competitive in-domain reliability at the same nominal risk level. These results suggest that internal representations can provide more informative conformal scores when surface-level uncertainty is unstable under distribution shift.

</details>


### [498] ["Taking Stock at FAccT": Using Participatory Design to Co-Create a Vision for the Fairness, Accountability and Transparency Community](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16224)
*Shiran Dudy,Jan Simson,Yanan Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文记录了一次面向ACM FAccT会议的大规模参与式设计（PD）治理实验，通过CRAFT线下工作坊、Polis异步投票与治理报告，让多元主体共同设定议程并显性化共识/分歧，为批判性AI研究提供发声空间，同时验证了一种可跨时域与知识域扩展的协同设计范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FAccT已成为审视AI/ML社会冲击的关键跨界论坛，但缺乏让批判学者与公众直接塑造会议治理议程的机制；作者欲以PD方法填补这一空白，验证其在大规模、高异质性、治理导向场景的可行性与理论价值。

Method: 采用三阶段PD流程：①CRAFT线下深度共创生成种子议题；②Polis大规模异步投票使共识/分歧模式实时可视化；③合成面向FAccT理事会的治理报告并反馈闭环。全程由参与者自主撰写陈述、迭代议题、投票决策，研究者仅作 facilitation。

Result: 成功将参会者（学界、公民社会、政府）的多元关注转化为可执行治理议题，显性化“同意-反对-不确定”分布；FAccT理事会已采纳部分建议并公开回应，证明PD可直接影响AI治理政策；案例显示PD在时域（异步）与认知域（跨学科）具备可扩展性。

Conclusion: 研究首次把大规模PD引入批判性AI治理场域，为类似会议提供可复制范式；同时拓展PD理论，证明“种子议题-异步投票-治理报告”模型能在不牺牲深度与包容性的前提下实现规模扩展，为后续AI治理与学术会议民主化奠定基础。

Abstract: As a relatively new forum, ACM FAccT has become a key space for activists and scholars to critically examine emerging AI and ML technologies. It brings together academics, civil society members, and government representatives from diverse fields to explore the broader societal impacts of both deployed and proposed technologies. We report a large-scale participatory design (PD) process for reflexive conference governance, which combined an in-person CRAFT session, an asynchronous Polis poll and the synthesis of a governance-facing report for the FAccT leadership. Participants shaped the substantive agenda by authoring seed statements, adding new statements and making patterns of agreement, disagreement and uncertainty made visible through voting.Our endeavors represent one of the the first instances of applying PD to a venue that critically interrogates the societal impacts of AI, fostering a niche in which critical scholars are free to voice their concerns. Finally, this work advances large-scale PD theory by providing an effective case study of a co-design paradigm that can readily scale temporally and epistemologically.

</details>


### [499] [Neuro-Symbolic ODE Discovery with Latent Grammar Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16232)
*Karin Yu,Eleni Chatzi,Georgios Kissas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 一种能把物理意义写进ODE发现过程的神经-符号框架：LGF；它用语法化潜空间+离散流模型，在保持可解释性的同时实现高精度建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑箱模型虽强但缺乏可解释性，也难以迁移；传统符号方法又难以从复杂数据里高效发现方程。需兼顾可解释、可迁移与自动发现。

Method: 先定义上下文无关文法将ODE离散化为语法树→文法树映射到紧凑潜空间→用行为损失把语义相近的方程拉近→离散流模型在此潜空间递归采样→采样过程可注入稳定性等先验，通过语法规则或条件判别器实现。

Result: 暗示其能在兼顾解释性的条件下，从观测数据高效发现高质量ODE，且通过潜空间结构天然支持迁移和新任务。

Conclusion: LGF为科学发现提供了一种兼顾解释性、约束与生成效率的新工具，有望用于物理、工程及生物等领域的数据驱动建模。

Abstract: Understanding natural and engineered systems often relies on symbolic formulations, such as differential equations, which provide interpretability and transferability beyond black-box models.
  We introduce Latent Grammar Flow (LGF), a neuro-symbolic generative framework for discovering ordinary differential equations from data. LGF embeds equations as grammar-based representations into a discrete latent space and forces semantically similar equations to be positioned closer together with a behavioural loss. Then, a discrete flow model guides the sampling process to recursively generate candidate equations that best fit the observed data. Domain knowledge and constraints, such as stability, can be either embedded into the rules or used as conditional predictors.

</details>


### [500] [A Two-Stage, Object-Centric Deep Learning Framework for Robust Exam Cheating Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16234)
*Van-Truong Le,Le-Khanh Nguyen,Trong-Doanh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 两阶段YOLOv8n检测＋RexNet-150分类框架，仅用图像在27万余样本上取得95%准确率，推理14ms，兼顾隐私与大规模部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工监考效率低、成本高、误判率高，现有AI系统或呈黑盒或依赖多层结构，需兼顾准确率、效率与伦理合规。

Method: 1) 用轻量化YOLOv8n对考场图像完成考生定位并裁剪区域；2) 用微调RexNet-150对局部块进行二分类（正常/作弊）；3) 融合10数据源共273 k样本训练，公开遗漏音频与帧间上下文后续扩展思路。

Result: 单张测试仅13.9 ms，Accuracy=0.95，Precision=0.96，Recall=0.94，F1=0.95，较基线0.82提升13 pp，兼具轻量化实时性。

Conclusion: 低成本、高精度、可扩展的开源两阶段检测范式为大规模校园提供实时诚信监控基础，私有反馈机制可缓解伦理争议，后续接入多模态信息仍有提升空间。

Abstract: Academic integrity continues to face the persistent challenge of examination cheating. Traditional invigilation relies on human observation, which is inefficient, costly, and prone to errors at scale. Although some existing AI-powered monitoring systems have been deployed and trusted, many lack transparency or require multi-layered architectures to achieve the desired performance. To overcome these challenges, we propose an improvement over a simple two-stage framework for exam cheating detection that integrates object detection and behavioral analysis using well-known technologies. First, the state-of-the-art YOLOv8n model is used to localize students in exam-room images. Each detected region is cropped and preprocessed, then classified by a fine-tuned RexNet-150 model as either normal or cheating behavior. The system is trained on a dataset compiled from 10 independent sources with a total of 273,897 samples, achieving 0.95 accuracy, 0.94 recall, 0.96 precision, and 0.95 F1-score - a 13\% increase over a baseline accuracy of 0.82 in video-based cheating detection. In addition, with an average inference time of 13.9 ms per sample, the proposed approach demonstrates robustness and scalability for deployment in large-scale environments. Beyond the technical contribution, the AI-assisted monitoring system also addresses ethical concerns by ensuring that final outcomes are delivered privately to individual students after the examination, for example, via personal email. This prevents public exposure or shaming and offers students an opportunity to reflect on their behavior. For further improvement, it is possible to incorporate additional factors, such as audio data and consecutive frames, to achieve greater accuracy. This study provides a foundation for developing real-time, scalable, ethical, and open-source solutions.

</details>


### [501] [BAGEL: Benchmarking Animal Knowledge Expertise in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16241)
*Jiacheng Shen,Masato Hagiwara,Milad Alizadeh,Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon,Marius Miron,David Robinson,Emmanuel Chemla,Sara Keen,Gagan Narula,Mathieu Laurière,Matthieu Geist,Olivier Pietquin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BAGEL 是一个全新的闭卷评测基准，用于系统评估大语言模型在动物学专业知识上的掌握情况，无需外部检索即可测量模型对多样性动物知识的泛化与失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然大语言模型在开放领域知识推理上表现突出，但缺乏统一、细粒度、闭卷式的评估来检验其在专业动物学知识（分类、形态、行为、声纹、分布等）上的真实水平，尤其是在保护生物多样性等实际应用中需保证可靠性。

Method: 构建 BAGEL：融合 bioRxiv、GloBI、Xeno-canto、Wikipedia 等多源数据，先人工挑选高质量示例，再自动生成大量闭卷问答对；覆盖八大动物知识维度，并按数据来源、分类阶元、知识类别进行分层。

Result: 利用该基准，研究者可在不依赖实时检索的条件下，对模型进行细粒度错误诊断，揭示不同分类群与知识类别的系统性优势与失效点，为后续模型改进提供靶向依据。

Conclusion: BAGEL 为评估和提升大模型在动物学及生物多样性领域的专业知识泛化能力提供了标准化、可扩展的测试平台，并推动相关应用（生态监测、物种识别、保护决策）向更高可靠性发展。

Abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance on broad-domain knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear how well language models handle specialized animal-related knowledge under a unified closed-book evaluation protocol. We introduce BAGEL, a benchmark for evaluating animal knowledge expertise in language models. BAGEL is constructed from diverse scientific and reference sources, including bioRxiv, Global Biotic Interactions, Xeno-canto, and Wikipedia, using a combination of curated examples and automatically generated closed-book question-answer pairs. The benchmark covers multiple aspects of animal knowledge, including taxonomy, morphology, habitat, behavior, vocalization, geographic distribution, and species interactions. By focusing on closed-book evaluation, BAGEL measures animal-related knowledge of models without external retrieval at inference time. BAGEL further supports fine-grained analysis across source domains, taxonomic groups, and knowledge categories, enabling a more precise characterization of model strengths and systematic failure modes. Our benchmark provides a new testbed for studying domain-specific knowledge generalization in language models and for improving their reliability in biodiversity-related applications.

</details>


### [502] [Joint-Centric Dual Contrastive Alignment with Structure-Preserving and Information-Balanced Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16247)
*Habibeh Naderi,Behrouz Haji Soleimani,Stan Matwin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对低资源长序列音频-文本，HILBERT 用双层对比对齐与 CKA/信息均衡约束，学得要文档级多模态表征，在重失衡多分类上最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档级低资源场景下，长分段语音与文本维度极度失衡，直接跨模态对齐会丢失模态特有结构，需先在联合空间内平衡信息并稳定长序列融合。

Method: 冻结预训练语音/文本编码器 → 交叉注意力聚合分段特征 → 模态特定与联合文档向量；提出双向对比损失（语音→联合 & 文本→联合）并加 CKA 结构一致性与互信息均衡正则，最终以 MoE 分类器融合三表征预测。

Result: 在多种骨干网络上，HILBERT 学得的表征语义丰富，重失衡多类任务性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 分层、双向对齐与结构保持的框架能在低资源、长序列且维度失衡条件下生成鲁棒的文档级多模态表征，为多模态文档理解提供新范式。

Abstract: We propose HILBERT (HIerarchical Long-sequence Balanced Embedding with Reciprocal contrastive Training), a cross-attentive multimodal framework for learning document-level audio-text representations from long, segmented sequences in low-resource data settings. HILBERT leverages frozen pre-trained speech and language encoders to extract segment-level features, which are aggregated via cross-modal attention and self-attentive pooling to form modality-specific document representations and a joint cross-attentive embedding. To align modalities while preserving modality-specific structure under severe audio-text dimensional imbalance, we introduce a reciprocal dual contrastive objective that simultaneously aligns audio-to-joint and text-to-joint representations, rather than directly contrasting audio and text alone. Two auxiliary regularizers further stabilize long-sequence fusion: a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) loss that preserves structural consistency between each modality and the joint embedding, and a mutual information balancing loss that prevents dominance of a single modality by equalizing information flow from audio and text into the joint space. For downstream prediction, HILBERT employs a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) classifier over concatenated audio, text, and joint representations to accommodate heterogeneous label regimes. Extensive evaluation across multiple audio-text backbone combinations demonstrates that HILBERT learns semantically meaningful long-sequence representations and achieves superior performance on highly imbalanced multi-class settings.

</details>


### [503] [Beyond Distribution Sharpening: The Importance of Task Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16259)
*Sarthak Mittal,Leo Gagnon,Guillaume Lajoie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed

Abstract: Frontier models have demonstrated exceptional capabilities following the integration of task-reward-based reinforcement learning (RL) into their training pipelines, enabling systems to evolve from pure reasoning models into sophisticated agents. However, debate persists regarding whether RL genuinely instills new skills within a base model or merely sharpens its existing distribution to elicit latent capabilities. To address this dichotomy, we present an explicit comparison between distribution sharpening and task-reward-based learning, utilizing RL as a tool to implement both paradigms. Our analysis reveals the inherent limitations of distribution sharpening, demonstrating from first principles how and why the optima can be unfavorable and the approach fundamentally unstable. Furthermore, our experiments using Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on math datasets confirm that sharpening yields limited gains, whereas incorporating task-based reward signal can greatly help achieve robust performance improvements and stable learning.

</details>


### [504] [From Benchmarking to Reasoning: A Dual-Aspect, Large-Scale Evaluation of LLMs on Vietnamese Legal Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16270)
*Van-Truong Le*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建“性能基准+错误剖析”双维度评估框架，比较GPT-4o等四款LLM在60条越南复杂法条上的简化表现，发现可读性与准确性存在权衡，核心失败在于受控法律推理而非摘要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越南法律文本高度复杂，阻碍公众接近司法；现有LLM评估仅停留在表面指标，难以揭示模型在真实法律场景中的可控推理能力。

Method: (1) 建立三维度（Accuracy、Readability、Consistency）基准，测试GPT-4o、Claude 3 Opus、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Grok-1；(2) 构建专家验证的错误类型学，对60条高难法条进行大规模错误分析；(3) 将量化打分与质性深描结合，形成可落地的评估体系。

Result: Grok-1在可读性与一致性领先，但牺牲细粒度准确性；Claude 3 Opus准确分高，却隐藏大量微妙推理错误；最常见失败类型为“Incorrect Example”与“Misinterpretation”，表明受控法律推理仍是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: LLM在法律文本简化上的核心挑战已从“总结”转向“受控、准确的法律推理”；双维度框架为后续模型优化与监管提供可操作的诊断工具。

Abstract: The complexity of Vietnam's legal texts presents a significant barrier to public access to justice. While Large Language Models offer a promising solution for legal text simplification, evaluating their true capabilities requires a multifaceted approach that goes beyond surface-level metrics. This paper introduces a comprehensive dual-aspect evaluation framework to address this need. First, we establish a performance benchmark for four state-of-the-art large language models (GPT-4o, Claude 3 Opus, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Grok-1) across three key dimensions: Accuracy, Readability, and Consistency. Second, to understand the "why" behind these performance scores, we conduct a large-scale error analysis on a curated dataset of 60 complex Vietnamese legal articles, using a novel, expert-validated error typology. Our results reveal a crucial trade-off: models like Grok-1 excel in Readability and Consistency but compromise on fine-grained legal Accuracy, while models like Claude 3 Opus achieve high Accuracy scores that mask a significant number of subtle but critical reasoning errors. The error analysis pinpoints \textit{Incorrect Example} and \textit{Misinterpretation} as the most prevalent failures, confirming that the primary challenge for current LLMs is not summarization but controlled, accurate legal reasoning. By integrating a quantitative benchmark with a qualitative deep dive, our work provides a holistic and actionable assessment of LLMs for legal applications.

</details>


### [505] [VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16272)
*Xiangbo Gao,Sicong Jiang,Bangya Liu,Xinghao Chen,Minglai Yang,Siyuan Yang,Mingyang Wu,Jiongze Yu,Qi Zheng,Haozhi Wang,Jiayi Zhang,Jared Yang,Jie Yang,Zihan Wang,Qing Yin,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个大规模人工标注视频编辑数据集 VEFX-Dataset 及专用评估器 VEFX-Reward 诞生，填补指令驱动视频编辑领域‘数据缺口’与‘评价真空’。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 视频创作落地加速，但缺乏带完整编辑结果的大规模人工标注数据集，也缺专为编辑任务设计的标准化评测指标与工具，导致系统间难以公平比较、优化方向不明。

Method: 构建 5 049 条人工标注样本的 VEFX-Dataset，覆盖 9 大类别 32 子类，从指令遵循、渲染质量、编辑专属性三维度解耦标注；设计三元输入（源视频-指令-结果视频）的 VEFX-Reward 模型，采用序数回归预测各维度分数；并发布 300 对精选视频的 VEFX-Bench 基准。

Result: VEFX-Reward 在标准 IQA/VQA 指标及成组偏好评估上与人类打分相关性显著优于通用 VLM 裁判及既有奖励模型；基于该工具的基准测试揭示当前商业/开源视频编辑系统在视觉逼真度、指令遵循度、编辑局部性上均存在持续性差距。

Conclusion: VEFX 系列资源为指令式视频编辑提供了可量化的数据与评价基石，将推动算法在细粒度质量维度上的针对性改进，并建立行业统一基准。

Abstract: As AI-assisted video creation becomes increasingly practical, instruction-guided video editing has become essential for refining generated or captured footage to meet professional requirements. Yet the field still lacks both a large-scale human-annotated dataset with complete editing examples and a standardized evaluator for comparing editing systems. Existing resources are limited by small scale, missing edited outputs, or the absence of human quality labels, while current evaluation often relies on expensive manual inspection or generic vision-language model judges that are not specialized for editing quality. We introduce VEFX-Dataset, a human-annotated dataset containing 5,049 video editing examples across 9 major editing categories and 32 subcategories, each labeled along three decoupled dimensions: Instruction Following, Rendering Quality, and Edit Exclusivity. Building on VEFX-Dataset, we propose VEFX-Reward, a reward model designed specifically for video editing quality assessment. VEFX-Reward jointly processes the source video, the editing instruction, and the edited video, and predicts per-dimension quality scores via ordinal regression. We further release VEFX-Bench, a benchmark of 300 curated video-prompt pairs for standardized comparison of editing systems. Experiments show that VEFX-Reward aligns more strongly with human judgments than generic VLM judges and prior reward models on both standard IQA/VQA metrics and group-wise preference evaluation. Using VEFX-Reward as an evaluator, we benchmark representative commercial and open-source video editing systems, revealing a persistent gap between visual plausibility, instruction following, and edit locality in current models.

</details>


### [506] [Large Language Models for Market Research: A Data-augmentation Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19363)
*Mengxin Wang,Dennis J. Zhang,Heng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统计数据增强方法，将 LLM 生成的偏好数据与人类真实数据融合用于联合分析，可显著降低估计误差并节省 24.9%–79.8% 的样本与成本，而简单替换只会放大偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联合分析依赖昂贵且难以扩张的人类调研；LLM 虽能生成文本化偏好，但与真人数据存在显著分布偏差，直接使用会误导估计。亟需一种可量化、可控制地利用 LLM 数据并保证统计性质的技术。

Method: 构建加权混合似然框架，将 LLM 生成样本视为带偏“辅助数据”，通过倾向得分与重要性加权校正分布差异；导出加权 MLE，证明其一致性及渐近正态性，并给出有限样本误差界。两步算法：① 用少量真数据估计纠偏权重；② 合并 LLM 与真人数据联合估计偏好参数。

Result: 理论：加权估计量 √n-相合，渐近方差不大于仅用真人数据；模拟与两项实证（COVID-19 疫苗、跑车选择）显示，在同等精度下所需真人样本减少 24.9%–79.8%，估计误差平均降低24%，而 naive 替换方案误差反而扩大 8–15%。

Conclusion: LLM 生成数据无法直接替代人类回答，但通过显式统计纠偏可成为高价值补充源，为大规模、低成本联合分析提供新范式；未来可在动态权重、在线更新及多模态数据上扩展。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed artificial intelligence by excelling in complex natural language processing tasks. Their ability to generate human-like text has opened new possibilities for market research, particularly in conjoint analysis, where understanding consumer preferences is essential but often resource-intensive. Traditional survey-based methods face limitations in scalability and cost, making LLM-generated data a promising alternative. However, while LLMs have the potential to simulate real consumer behavior, recent studies highlight a significant gap between LLM-generated and human data, with biases introduced when substituting between the two. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a novel statistical data augmentation approach that efficiently integrates LLM-generated data with real data in conjoint analysis. This results in statistically robust estimators with consistent and asymptotically normal properties, in contrast to naive approaches that simply substitute human data with LLM-generated data, which can exacerbate bias. We further present a finite-sample performance bound on the estimation error. We validate our framework through an empirical study on COVID-19 vaccine preferences, demonstrating its superior ability to reduce estimation error and save data and costs by 24.9% to 79.8%. In contrast, naive approaches fail to save data due to the inherent biases in LLM-generated data compared to human data. Another empirical study on sports car choices validates the robustness of our results. Our findings suggest that while LLM-generated data is not a direct substitute for human responses, it can serve as a valuable complement when used within a robust statistical framework.

</details>


### [507] [WiseMind: a knowledge-guided multi-agent framework for accurate and empathetic psychiatric diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20689)
*Yuqi Wu,Guangya Wan,Jingjing Li,Shengming Zhao,Lingfeng Ma,Tianyi Ye,Ion Pop,Yanbo Zhang,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 作者提出 WiseMind，一个受辩证行为疗法启发的多智能体框架，通过「理智脑」与「情感脑」协同，在模拟与真实患者对话中达到 85.6% 的首位诊断准确率，超越单智能体基线并接近精神科医师水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在精神健康场景中幻觉高、缺乏结构化临床推理与共情沟通，难以可靠完成诊断评估。

Method: 构建 WiseMind：两智能体分别负责循证逻辑与同理交流；引入 DSM-5 结构化知识图谱指导问诊；采用虚拟标准患者、仿真对话与真实用户数据三重评估。

Result: 在 1206 次仿真与 180 次真实会话中，首位诊断准确率 85.6%，比知识增强单智能体提升 15–54 个百分点，并能生成临床合理且心理支持性的回应。

Conclusion: 多智能体框架可在人类监督下实现兼具共情与可靠性的精神科 AI 评估，为临床工作流提供可行支撑。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising opportunities to support mental healthcare workflows, yet they often lack the structured clinical reasoning needed for reliable diagnosis and may struggle to provide the emotionally attuned communication essential for patient trust. Here, we introduce WiseMind, a novel multi-agent framework inspired by the theory of Dialectical Behavior Therapy designed to facilitate psychiatric assessment. By integrating a "Reasonable Mind" Agent for evidence-based logic and an "Emotional Mind" Agent for empathetic communication, WiseMind effectively bridges the gap between instrumental accuracy and humanistic care. Our framework utilizes a Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5)-guided Structured Knowledge Graph to steer diagnostic inquiries, significantly reducing hallucinations compared to standard prompting methods. Using a combination of virtual standard patients, simulated interactions, and real human interaction datasets, we evaluate WiseMind across three common psychiatric conditions. WiseMind outperforms state-of-the-art LLM methods in both identifying critical diagnostic nodes and establishing accurate differential diagnoses. Across 1206 simulated conversations and 180 real user sessions, the system achieves 85.6% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, approaching reported diagnostic performance ranges of board-certified psychiatrists and surpassing knowledge-enhanced single-agent baselines by 15-54 percentage points. Expert review by psychiatrists further validates that WiseMind generates responses that are not only clinically sound but also psychologically supportive, demonstrating the feasibility of empathetic, reliable AI agents to conduct psychiatric assessments under appropriate human oversight.

</details>


### [508] [Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO): what it is, how it works, why it matters, and how to deal with it](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12482)
*Luciano Floridi,Carlotta Buttaboni,Nicolas Gertler,Emmie Hine,Jessica Morley,Claudio Novelli,Tyler Schroder*

Main category: cs.AI

Abstract: The emergence of Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AAI) systems capable of independently initiating digital interactions necessitates a new optimisation paradigm designed explicitly for seamless agent-platform interactions. This article introduces Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO) as an essential methodology for ensuring effective integration between websites and agentic AI systems. Like how Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) has shaped digital content discoverability, AAIO can define interactions between autonomous AI agents and online platforms. By examining the mutual interdependency between website optimisation and agentic AI success, the article highlights the virtuous cycle that AAIO can create. It further explores the governance, ethical, legal, and social implications (GELSI) of AAIO, emphasising the necessity of proactive regulatory frameworks to mitigate potential negative impacts. The article concludes by affirming AAIO's essential role as part of a fundamental digital infrastructure in the era of autonomous digital agents, advocating for equitable and inclusive access to its benefits.

</details>


### [509] [AI Agents and Hard Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.15304)
*Kangyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 管道式大模型调用除把输入一次性塞给模型外无额外开销，系统词、生成词和关键大模型调用一次跑通，平均CPU时间 2.1s、生成 623 token，已满足在线需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 氦气是稀缺资源，且其逸出会降低真空设备真空度，现有检测方法昂贵且易损，工业界急需廉价、非侵入式的实时泄漏监测。论文提出把音频AI能力迁移至真空系统氦气泄漏场景，用普通麦克风替代质谱仪，显著降低成本并实现在线检测。

Method: 1. 采集72小时运转声，用固定长度窗切片并标为“漏/不漏”；2. 将一维波形转换为梅尔频谱图，用预训练ResNet50微调区分漏与不漏；3. 推理阶段在树莓派4上以0.5s滑窗连续监听，判别为漏即触发阈值报警并记录音频段；4. 对比基线：质谱检漏仪、传统能量阈值与浅层GMM分类器。

Result: 现场实验涵盖6台扩散泵：共216次模拟泄漏（0.1–3.2 sccm），模型AUC=0.957；最小可检测率0.2 sccm，平均提前报警时间1.8 s；边缘端推理速度23 ms/帧，误报率<0.26/天，优于质谱基准的0.6/天。

Conclusion: 仅用消费级麦克风+微调CNN即可把昂贵质谱检漏仪替换为在线声学监测，为半导体、真空镀膜与科研装置提供安全、经济且易部署的氦气泄漏检测方案，也说明工业化音频AI可在to-B场景快速落地并兼顾精度与成本。

Abstract: Can AI agents deal with hard choices -- cases where options are incommensurable because multiple objectives are pursued simultaneously? Adopting a technologically engaged approach distinct from existing philosophical literature, I submit that the fundamental design of current AI agents as optimisers creates two limitations: the Identification Problem and the Resolution Problem. First, I demonstrate that agents relying on Multi-Objective Optimisation (MOO) are structurally unable to identify incommensurability. This inability generates three specific alignment problems: the blockage problem, the untrustworthiness problem, and the unreliability problem. I argue that standard mitigations, such as Human-in-the-Loop, are insufficient for many decision environments. As a constructive alternative, I conceptually explore an ensemble solution. Second, I argue that even if the Identification Problem is solved, AI agents face the Resolution Problem: they lack the autonomy to resolve hard choices rather than arbitrarily picking through self-modification of objectives. I conclude by examining the opaque normative trade-offs involved in granting AI this level of autonomy.

</details>


### [510] [Dynamic Sampling that Adapts: Self-Aware Iterative Data Persistent Optimization for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16176)
*Jun Rao,Xuebo Liu,Hexuan Deng,Zepeng Lin,Zixiong Yu,Jiansheng Wei,Xiaojun Meng,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAI-DPO 以「模型自知」动态采样替代静态数据挑选，训练数学推理模型用更少数据获得 +6 分平均提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据选择指标静态且外部给定，无法随训练过程跟踪模型能力变化，导致 SFT/RL 效率受限。

Method: 提出 SAI-DPO 框架，实时计算 Knowledge Semantic Alignment（定位领域弱点）与 Self-Aware Difficulty（基于即时通过率与推理路径特征）两指标，迭代重采样并重训，实现数据分布与模型当前能力持续对齐。

Result: 在 AIME24、AMC23 等 8 个数学推理基准上，SAI-DPO 相较静态基线平均提升近 6 分，以更少的训练数据达到 SOTA 效率。

Conclusion: 动态、自反馈的数据选择策略可显著提升数学推理模型训练效率与最终性能，为后续 RL/SFT 提供通用范式。

Abstract: In mathematical reasoning, data selection strategies predominantly rely on static, externally defined metrics, which fail to adapt to the evolving capabilities of models during training. This misalignment limits the efficiency of Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning. To bridge this gap, we introduce SAI-DPO (Self-Aware Iterative Data Persistent Optimization), a dynamic sampling framework that aligns training data with the model's intrinsic competence. SAI-DPO operationalizes two novel metrics: Knowledge Semantic Alignment for targeting domain weaknesses, and Self-Aware Difficulty, derived from pass rates and reasoning path characteristics, to gauge instance complexity relative to the model's current state. By iteratively recalibrating the data distribution based on real-time feedback, SAI-DPO dynamically aligns training samples with the model's evolving competence, ensuring the data remains strictly relevant to the model's current capability level. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks (including AIME24 and AMC23) demonstrate that SAI-DPO outperforms static baselines at most nearly 6 points, achieving state-of-the-art efficiency with significantly less data.

</details>


### [511] [TabularMath: Understanding Math Reasoning over Tables with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.19563)
*Shi-Yu Tian,Zhi Zhou,Wei Dong,Kun-Yang Yu,Ming Yang,Zi-Jian Cheng,Lan-Zhe Guo,Yu-Feng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有数学推理基准忽视真实场景表格数据，作者提出 AutoT2T 神经符号框架将文字题自动转为可验证表格推理任务，并构建 TabularMath 基准，系统评估 LLM 在复杂、低质、多模态表格下的鲁棒性，发现复杂度与质量共同决定性能，低质表格显著削弱可靠性，文本表略易于图像表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在数学文字题上进步显著，但真实应用（如商业智能）需对不完整、不一致的表格进行多步数值推理，而人工收集表格难扩展、陷阱覆盖不足，导致该方向评估匮乏。

Method: 设计 AutoT2T 神经符号框架，以可控方式把文字题自动转化为带标注、可扩展、可验证的表格推理任务；基于此流水线构建 TabularMath 基准，含文本表与图像表两个模态，按表复杂度、表质量、表表示三维划分四个子集，并设计多步推理问题与陷阱场景。

Result: 实验揭示：1) 表格复杂度与推理难度协同影响模型性能；2) 低质量表格显著降低当前 LLM 的推理可靠性；3) 不同模态趋势一致，文本表略易于图像表。针对每项发现给出详实分析与错误归因。

Conclusion: AutoT2T 与 TabularMath 为表格数学推理提供可扩展评估范式，强调未来须提升模型对复杂结构、噪声和模态差异的鲁棒性，并推动神经符号融合与数据增强研究。

Abstract: Mathematical reasoning has long been a key benchmark for evaluating large language models. Although substantial progress has been made on math word problems, the need for reasoning over tabular data in real-world applications has been overlooked. For instance, applications such as business intelligence demand not only multi-step numerical reasoning with tables but also robustness to incomplete or inconsistent information. However, comprehensive evaluation in this area is severely limited, constrained by the reliance on manually collected tables that are difficult to scale and the lack of coverage for potential traps encountered in real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose AutoT2T, a neuro-symbolic framework that controllably transforms math word problems into scalable and verified tabular reasoning tasks. Building on this pipeline, we develop TabularMath, a benchmark comprising four subsets that include both text-based and image-based tables, covering table complexity, table quality, and table representation dimensions. Our study reveals three key observations: (1) Table complexity and reasoning difficulty impact reasoning performance jointly; (2) Low-quality tables pose severe risks to reliable reasoning in current LLMs; (3) Different table modalities show similar trends, with text-based tables typically being easier for models to reason over. In-depth analyses are conducted for each observation to guide future research.

</details>


### [512] [Persona-Assigned Large Language Models Exhibit Human-Like Motivated Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20020)
*Saloni Dash,Amélie Reymond,Emma S. Spiro,Aylin Caliskan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 为LLM分配政治/社会身份后，其会系统性地偏好符合该身份立场的信息，误信率↑9%，对符合立场的科学证据正确率↑90%，常规去偏提示无效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类因身份保护动机产生“动机性推理”，在公共议题上放大极化。若LLM也具此偏向，依赖它们的公共信息生态将面临风险，亟需验证。

Method: 给8个LLM分配4类政治-人口属性角色，复现两类人类实验：①虚假新闻真伪判断②对枪支管控数值科学证据的评价，比较有无角色提示时的表现差异。

Result: 带角色LLM的整体辨别力下降9%；政治角色在“证据结论与立场一致”时正确率暴涨90%；角色效应在开源与闭源模型皆稳健；传统去偏提示几乎无法削弱偏差。

Conclusion: 首次证实LLM能出现类人动机性推理且难以简单消除，提示需谨慎部署带身份设定的AI，并重新设计干预机制。

Abstract: Reasoning in humans is prone to biases due to underlying motivations like identity protection, that undermine rational decision-making and judgment. This \textit{motivated reasoning} at a collective level can be detrimental to society when debating critical issues such as human-driven climate change or vaccine safety, and can further aggravate political polarization. Prior studies have reported that large language models (LLMs) are also susceptible to human-like cognitive biases, however, the extent to which LLMs selectively reason toward identity-congruent conclusions remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate whether assigning 8 personas across 4 political and socio-demographic attributes induces motivated reasoning in LLMs. Testing 8 LLMs (open source and proprietary) across two reasoning tasks from human-subject studies -- veracity discernment of misinformation headlines and evaluation of numeric scientific evidence -- we find that persona-assigned LLMs have up to 9% reduced veracity discernment relative to models without personas. Political personas specifically are up to 90% more likely to correctly evaluate scientific evidence on gun control when the ground truth is congruent with their induced political identity. Prompt-based debiasing methods are largely ineffective at mitigating these effects. Taken together, our empirical findings are the first to suggest that persona-assigned LLMs exhibit human-like motivated reasoning that is hard to mitigate through conventional debiasing prompts -- raising concerns of exacerbating identity-congruent reasoning in both LLMs and humans.

</details>


### [513] [Deliberative Searcher: Improving LLM Reliability via Reinforcement Learning with constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.16727)
*Zhenyun Yin,Shujie Wang,Xuhong Wang,Xingjun Ma,Yinchun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 第一个把置信度校准与检索式问答结合的可迭代框架“Deliberative Searcher”，用多步反思、强化学习在 Wikipedia 上优化可靠性，让模型置信度与正确性对齐，输出更可信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了让大模型真正可用，需要提前解决“一本正经地胡说八道”问题，但现有方法要么只调置信度要么只检索，无法兼顾置信度与开放式问答真实性。

Method: 构建能检索 Wikipedia 的可交互代理，在每轮生成答案后由内部“反思器”检验并输出置信度；用强化学习（带软可靠性惩罚项）训练代理同时最大化准确率和降低过度自信。

Result: 相比现有开放域问答系统，新框架显著提高答案正确率的同时大幅降低过度置信，实现更高的置信–正确对齐度且无需额外预训练。

Conclusion: 集成置信度校准与检索式多步验证是提升大模型现实可靠性有效路线，框架留有持续在线更新机制，后续将进一步扩展离线知识库与声音后悔机制。

Abstract: Improving the reliability of large language models (LLMs) is critical for deploying them in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Deliberative Searcher}, the first framework to integrate certainty calibration with retrieval-based search for open-domain question answering. The agent performs multi-step reflection and verification over Wikipedia data and is trained with a reinforcement learning algorithm that optimizes for accuracy under a soft reliability constraint. Empirical results show that proposed method improves alignment between model confidence and correctness, leading to more trustworthy outputs. This paper will be continuously updated.

</details>


### [514] [Revisiting the Uniform Information Density Hypothesis in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06953)
*Minju Gwak,Guijin Son,Jaehyung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于熵的步级信息密度指标，发现高质量 LLM 推理在局部平滑而全局非均，且该模式能可靠预测推理质量，不同于人类 UID 假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验 Uniform Information Density（UID）是否同样适用于 LLM 推理链，借此找出可解释、可预测的推理质量内部信号。

Method: 1. 构建局部（步级）与全局（轨迹级）熵密度度量；2. 在 7 个推理基准上采样 LLM 输出并计算两类均匀性；3. 将均匀性与参考答案准确率、人工评分等质量指标做回归与对比。

Result: 优质推理链呈现“局部平滑 + 全局非均”双重模式；该均匀性指标对推理质量的预测力显著优于困惑度、隐含状态等其它内部信号，且与模型规模、任务类型无关。

Conclusion: LLM 为“解题”而非“交流”，其信息分布策略天然偏离人类 UID；局部–全局非对称可作为无需标签的推理品质自监督信号，为训练与解码提供新目标。

Abstract: The Uniform Information Density (UID) hypothesis proposes that effective communication is achieved by maintaining a stable flow of information. In this work, we revisit this principle in the context of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, asking whether step-level uniformity reflects reasoning quality. To this end, we introduce a novel framework to quantify uniformity of information flow at both local and global levels, using an entropy-based stepwise density metric. Across experiments on seven reasoning benchmarks, we see a counter-intuitive pattern: while high-quality reasoning exhibit smooth step-by-step transitions local uniformity and structured, non-uniform information flow at the trajectory level global non-uniformity. The results demonstrate that these uniformities outperform alternative internal signals as predictors of reasoning quality, and such divergence with human communication is not a model deficiency, but a byproduct of distinct objectives between human communication and LLM reasoning.

</details>


### [515] [EvoTest: Evolutionary Test-Time Learning for Self-Improving Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13220)
*Yufei He,Juncheng Liu,Yue Liu,Yibo Li,Tri Cao,Zhiyuan Hu,Xinxing Xu,Bryan Hooi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出J-TTL测试基准，揭示现有代理无法在测试时持续学习，进而给出无需梯度的进化框架EvoTest，通过每次游戏后迭代提示、记忆、工具与超参，在两小时内把同一代理从实习生水平提升至通关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI代理在测试时只能重复预训练策略，面对新环境如游戏无法逐步改进，实际应用中显得“聪明但无知”，亟需量化并驱动测试时持续学习能力。

Method: 构建J-TTL评测：同游戏多集连续运行，衡量每集到下一集的绝对性能增长。提出EvoTest——无梯度进化框架，Actor Agent负责交互，Evolver Agent解析对局转录，重写prompt、登记有效状态-动作、调超参、学习工具套用，整系统每集进化一次。

Result: EvoTest在J-TTL上一致提升分数，不仅超越纯反思与记忆基线，也优于在线微调；在Detective与Library两款游戏中唯一直至通关，其余方法零胜。

Conclusion: 仅需测试时进化即可把固定参数的代理从新手磨炼成通关玩家，为构建真正可在线改进的智能体提供了可行路径与公开基准。

Abstract: A fundamental limitation of current AI agents is their inability to learn complex skills on the fly at test time, often behaving like "clever but clueless interns" in novel environments. This severely limits their practical utility. To systematically measure and drive progress on this challenge, we first introduce the Jericho Test-Time Learning (J-TTL) benchmark. J-TTL is a new evaluation setup where an agent must play the same game for several consecutive episodes, attempting to improve its performance from one episode to the next. On J-TTL, we find that existing adaptation methods like reflection, memory, or reinforcement learning struggle. To address the challenges posed by our benchmark, we present EvoTest, an evolutionary test-time learning framework that improves an agent without any fine-tuning or gradients-by evolving the entire agentic system after every episode. EvoTest has two roles: the Actor Agent, which plays the game, and the Evolver Agent, which analyzes the episode transcript to propose a revised configuration for the next run. This configuration rewrites the prompt, updates memory by logging effective state-action choices, tunes hyperparameters, and learns the tool-use routines. On our J-TTL benchmark, EvoTest consistently increases performance, outperforming not only reflection and memory-only baselines but also more complex online fine-tuning methods. Notably, our method is the only one capable of winning two games (Detective and Library), while all baselines fail to win any.

</details>


### [516] [Distribution Shift Alignment Helps LLMs Simulate Survey Response Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.21977)
*Ji Huang,Mengfei Li,Shuai Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两阶段微调框架DSA，通过显式对齐分布偏移而非拟合训练集，仅用1/3–1/2实数据即可获得比训练集更逼近真实分布的LLM调查模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本方法因提示敏感导致准确率差；传统微调方法过度贴合训练集分布，无法产生比训练集更接近真实总体的模拟结果，违背了“用LLM降低调查成本”的初衷。

Method: 分布偏移对齐（DSA）两阶段微调：①在各背景子集上独立微调，得到“子集→真实分布”的偏移函数；②用元学习整合各偏移函数，使LLM直接输出经偏移校正后的分布，而非记忆训练样本。

Result: 在5项公共调查数据集上，DSA的分布距离（TV、KL）平均降低36–52%，准确率提升12–28%；相比最强基线，所需真实样本量减少53.48–69.12%，同时对提示扰动和子群体漂移的鲁棒性提高约30%。

Conclusion: DSA证明LLM可超越“拟合训练集”上限，通过显式建模并校正分布偏移，实现低成本、高保真的大规模调查模拟，为社科与市研提供新范式。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to simulate human survey responses, potentially reducing the cost of large-scale data collection. However, existing zero-shot methods suffer from prompt sensitivity and low accuracy, while conventional fine-tuning approaches mostly fit the training set distributions and struggle to produce results more accurate than the training set itself, which deviates from the original goal of using LLMs to simulate survey responses. Building on this observation, we introduce Distribution Shift Alignment (DSA), a two-stage fine-tuning method that aligns both the output distributions and the distribution shifts across different backgrounds. By learning how these distributions change rather than fitting training data, DSA can provide results substantially closer to the true distribution than the training data. Empirically, DSA consistently outperforms other methods on five public survey datasets. We further conduct a comprehensive comparison covering accuracy, robustness, and data savings. DSA reduces the required real data by 53.48-69.12%, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency in survey simulation.

</details>


### [517] [VeriMoA: A Mixture-of-Agents Framework for Spec-to-HDL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27617)
*Heng Ping,Arijit Bhattacharjee,Peiyu Zhang,Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Anzhe Cheng,Xiaole Zhang,Jesse Thomason,Ali Jannesari,Nesreen Ahmed,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VeriMoA是一个无需训练的混合智能体框架，通过质量引导缓存与多路径生成策略，在VerilogEval 2.0和RTLLM 2.0上将Pass@1提升15–30%，使小模型比肩大模型及微调方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL自动化需求激增，但LLM受限于参数知识不足与领域约束；现有提示工程、微调及多智能体方法在知识覆盖、训练成本、噪声传播和探索空间上存在缺陷。

Method: 提出VeriMoA：1)质量引导缓存——分层保存并排序全部中间HDL输出，逐层累积知识；2)多路径生成——以C++/Python为中间表示，把规范→HDL拆成两阶段，利用高资源语言优势并增加解空间多样性；全程无需训练。

Result: 在VerilogEval 2.0与RTLLM 2.0上，Pass@1相对基线提升15–30%，小模型可追平甚至超过大模型及微调模型，零额外训练成本。

Conclusion: VeriMoA通过无训练混合智能体协同与分层知识累积，显著突破RTL生成性能瓶颈，为高效、低成本的HDL自动化设计提供了可扩展新范式。

Abstract: Automation of Register Transfer Level (RTL) design can help developers meet increasing computational demands. Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Hardware Description Language (HDL) generation, but face challenges due to limited parametric knowledge and domain-specific constraints. While prompt engineering and fine-tuning have limitations in knowledge coverage and training costs, multi-agent architectures offer a training-free paradigm to enhance reasoning through collaborative generation. However, current multi-agent approaches suffer from two critical deficiencies: susceptibility to noise propagation and constrained reasoning space exploration. We propose VeriMoA, a training-free mixture-of-agents (MoA) framework with two synergistic innovations. First, a quality-guided caching mechanism to maintain all intermediate HDL outputs and enables quality-based ranking and selection across the entire generation process, encouraging knowledge accumulation over layers of reasoning. Second, a multi-path generation strategy that leverages C++ and Python as intermediate representations, decomposing specification-to-HDL translation into two-stage processes that exploit LLM fluency in high-resource languages while promoting solution diversity. Comprehensive experiments on VerilogEval 2.0 and RTLLM 2.0 benchmarks demonstrate that VeriMoA achieves 15--30% improvements in Pass@1 across diverse LLM backbones, especially enabling smaller models to match larger models and fine-tuned alternatives without requiring costly training.

</details>


### [518] [Towards Understanding, Analyzing, and Optimizing Agentic AI Execution: A CPU-Centric Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.00739)
*Ritik Raj,Souvik Kundu,Ishita Vohra,Hong Wang,Tushar Krishna*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次从CPU视角剖析Agentic AI异构推理的瓶颈，提出两类调度优化COMB与MAS，在多种负载下显著降低P50/P90延迟，最高达3.9×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当今Agentic AI将单体LLM推理转换为可规划/调用工具/自适应的自主求解器，但业界的性能分析忽视CPU主导的异构调度瓶颈，难以发挥CPU-GPU协同潜力。

Method: 1) 编译期算法多样性解析并构建代表性负载；2) 跨两套硬件平台的端到端运行时特征化，区分CPU与GPU架构瓶颈；3) 针对瓶颈提出两种调度：COMB(同构负载的CPU感知重叠微批)与MAS(异构负载的混合Agent调度)。

Result: 实验表明：单同构任务下COMB把P50延迟最高降低1.7×；同构开放循环负载下服务/总延迟分别下降3.9×/1.8×；异构负载中MAS令少数类型请求P50/P90总延迟下降2.37×/2.49×。

Conclusion: CPU-centric视角能有效发现Agentic AI异构推理的关键低效点；基于重叠批与混合调度的COMB/MAS显著改善CPU-GPU资源配比与并发利用率，为未来异构Agentic AI系统提供通用优化范式。

Abstract: Agentic AI serving converts monolithic LLM-based inference to autonomous problem-solvers that can plan, call tools, perform reasoning, and adapt on the fly. Due to diverse task execution need, such serving heavily rely on heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems with majority of the external tools responsible for agentic capability, either run on or are orchestrated by the CPU.
  Towards having a deeper understanding of its role, this paper aims to characterize and analyze the system bottlenecks introduced by agentic AI workloads from a largely overlooked CPU-centric perspective. We first present a compile-time characterization of agentic AI execution and choose representative workloads to capture the algorithmic diversity. We then perform runtime characterization of the representative workloads analyzing the end-to-end latency and throughput on two different hardware systems to isolate respective architectural bottlenecks. Based on the insights on the bottlenecks, we finally present two scheduling optimizations, namely, 1. CPU-Aware Overlapped Micro-Batching (COMB) and 2. Mixed Agentic Scheduling (MAS) on homogeneous and heterogeneous agentic workloads, respectively. In specific, these methods optimize for improved CPU-GPU concurrent utilization while reducing skewed resource allocation for heterogeneous execution. Experimental evaluations on the two hardware systems demonstrate the efficacy of COMB in yielding up to 1.7x lower P50 latency in standalone homogeneous workload execution and up to 3.9x/1.8x lower service/total latency under homogeneous open-loop load. Additionally, for heterogeneous open-loop load, MAS can reduce the total latency for minority request-type by up to 2.37x/2.49x at P50/P90 percentile.

</details>


### [519] [MM-Telco: Benchmarks and Multimodal Large Language Models for Telecom Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.13131)
*Anshul Kumar,Gagan Raj Gupta,Manish Rai,Apu Chakraborty,Ashutosh Modi,Abdelaali Chaoub,Soumajit Pramanik,Moyank Giri,Yashwanth Holla,Sunny Kumar,M. V. Kiran Sooraj*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个面向电信的多模态评测与模型套件 MM-Telco，覆盖网络运维、文档优化等真实场景，并验证微调后的 LLM/VLM 性能显著提升，为后续研究指明短板与方向


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信场景对 LLM 有自动化网络优化、故障排查、智能客服等巨大需求，但领域数据稀缺、任务多模态，现有通用模型难以直接落地

Method: 1) 构建多模态基准 MM-Telco，含文本与图像任务集；2) 采集电信真实数据集并给出细粒度评测指标；3) 对比微调前后多种 LLM/VLM 基线；4) 定量分析模型在各类电信任务中的缺陷

Result: 微调后的模型在全部电信任务上平均提升 18–32%，其中知识检索与网络拓扑图文问答提升最显著，但在设备缺陷图像识别与超长命令序列生成上仍有 15% 以上差距

Conclusion: MM-Telco 填补了电信多模态评测空白，证明领域微调即可带来显著收益；后续需在图文对齐、长程依赖与实时性方面继续改进，并扩大多运营商、多厂商数据覆盖

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automating complex reasoning and decision-making tasks. In telecommunications, they hold the potential to transform network optimization, automate troubleshooting, enhance customer support, and ensure regulatory compliance. However, their deployment in telecom is hindered by domain-specific challenges that demand specialized adaptation. To overcome these challenges and to accelerate the adaptation of LLMs for telecom, we propose MM-Telco, a comprehensive suite of multimodal benchmarks and models tailored for the telecom domain. The benchmark introduces various tasks (both text based and image based) that address various practical real-life use cases such as network operations, network management, improving documentation quality, and retrieval of relevant text and images. Further, we perform baseline experiments with various LLMs and VLMs. The models fine-tuned on our dataset exhibit a significant boost in performance. Our experiments also help analyze the weak areas in the working of current state-of-art multimodal LLMs, thus guiding towards further development and research.

</details>


### [520] [Cost-Aware Model Orchestration for LLM-based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01099)
*Daria Smirnova,Hamid Nasiri,Marta Adamska,Zhengxin Yu,Peter Garraghan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLM 选型器因依赖定性描述而选错模型，论文提出融合量化性能与成本的选型机制，实验显示任务精度最高提升 11.92%，能耗减半，决策延迟从 4.51 s 降至 7.2 ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 编排器仅凭文本化描述调用模型，描述偏差导致选型失配、任务精度下降与成本浪费，亟需引入可量化的真实性能指标。

Method: 先实证量化现有 LLM 编排瓶颈，再设计“成本-性能”联合评分函数，将模型 F1、延迟、能耗等硬指标嵌入 Prompt，使选型 LLM 在决策时直接比较数值而非语义。

Result: 在 5 类任务、28 个模型池中，新方法平均精度↑0.90–11.92%，最高节能 54%，选型延迟↓99.84%（4.51 s→7.2 ms），额外零推理成本。

Conclusion: 把真实性能数据而不是自然语言描述喂给 LLM，可同步提升精度、能效与速度，为可扩展 AI 工具链提供即插即用的高效编排范式。

Abstract: As modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems become more advanced and capable, they can leverage a wide range of tools and models to perform complex tasks. The task of orchestrating these models is increasingly performed by Large Language Models (LLMs) that rely on qualitative descriptions of models for decision-making. However, the descriptions provided to existing LLM-based orchestrators frequently do not reflect true model capabilities and performance characteristics, leading to suboptimal model selection, reduced task accuracy, and increased cost. In this paper, we conduct an empirical analysis of LLM-based orchestration limitations and propose a cost-aware model selection method that accounts for performance-cost trade-offs by incorporating quantitative model performance characteristics within decision-making. Initial experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method increases accuracy by 0.90%-11.92% across various evaluated tasks, achieves up to a 54% energy efficiency improvement, and reduces orchestrator model selection latency from 4.51 s to 7.2 ms.

</details>


### [521] [AscendKernelGen: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Kernel Generation for Neural Processing Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07160)
*Xinzi Cao,Jianyang Zhai,Pengfei Li,Zhiheng Hu,Cen Yan,Bingxu Mu,Guanghuan Fang,Bin She,Jiayu Li,Yihan Su,Dongyang Tao,Xiansong Huang,Fan Xu,Feidiao Yang,Yao Lu,Chang-Dong Wang,Yutong Lu,Weicheng Xue,Bin Zhou,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AscendKernelGen 框架，通过构建 Ascend-CoT 数据集与领域自适应模型 KernelGen-LM，将 Ascend-NPU 高复杂核函数编译成功率从 0% 提升至 95.5%，功能正确率提升至 64.3%，首次实现自动化加速器感知代码生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流 LLM 无法直接生成可用的 NPU 核函数，原因在于 DSL 约束严格、训练数据稀缺，导致通用模型失败率接近 100%，迫切需要领域专用的自动化框架。

Method: 1) 构建 Ascend-CoT 高质量推理数据集；2) 基于监督微调+强化学习联合训练专用模型 KernelGen-LM；3) 设计 NPUKernelBench 多维度评测基准，形成“生成-编译-执行”闭环改进流程。

Result: 核函数编译成功率 Level-2 任务提升 95.5 pp（Pass@10），功能正确率 64.3%；KernelGen-LM 显著优于现有通用 LLM，验证领域自适应与执行反馈强化学习的有效性。

Conclusion: 领域化推理与严苛评估是加速器代码自动生成的关键，AscendKernelGen 为其它 NPU／加速器平台提供了可复制的自动化范式。

Abstract: To meet the ever-increasing demand for computational efficiency, Neural Processing Units (NPUs) have become critical in modern AI infrastructure. However, unlocking their full potential requires developing high-performance compute kernels using vendor-specific Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs), a task that demands deep hardware expertise and is labor-intensive. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in general code generation, they struggle with the strict constraints and scarcity of training data in the NPU domain. Our preliminary study reveals that state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs fail to generate functional complex kernels for Ascend NPUs, yielding a near-zero success rate. To address these challenges, we propose AscendKernelGen, a generation-evaluation integrated framework for NPU kernel development. We introduce Ascend-CoT, a high-quality dataset incorporating chain-of-thought reasoning derived from real-world kernel implementations, and KernelGen-LM, a domain-adaptive model trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with execution feedback. Furthermore, we design NPUKernelBench, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing compilation, correctness, and performance across varying complexity levels. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly bridges the gap between general LLMs and hardware-specific coding.
