Specifically, the compilation success rate on complex Level-2 kernels improves from 0% to 95.5% (Pass@10), while functional correctness achieves 64.3% compared to the baseline's complete failure. These results highlight the critical role of domain-specific reasoning and rigorous evaluation in automating accelerator-aware code generation. AscendKernGen is available at https://huggingface.co/AscendKernelGen and https://github.com/weich97/NPUKernelBench.

</details>


### [522] [Protecting Language Models Against Unauthorized Distillation through Trace Rewriting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15143)
*Xinhang Ma,William Yeoh,Ning Zhang,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出动态改写教师模型推理轨迹的方法，可在保持答案正确前提下阻止未授权蒸馏并嵌入可验证水印。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未授权蒸馏免费复用前沿大模型，需同时实现“抗蒸馏”与“可验证溯源”两大防护目标。

Method: 设计多种动态改写策略：指令驱动的 LLM 重写、梯度引导的 token 级扰动，兼顾答案正确与语义连贯；水印通过轨迹统计特征隐写。

Result: 指令式改写即可显著降低学生训练效果，教师任务性能不降反升；水印检测逼近零误报，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 轻量级轨迹改写能兼顾模型效能与知识产权防护，为 LLM 服务方提供可落地的反滥用机制。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation is a widely adopted technique for transferring capabilities from LLMs to smaller, more efficient student models. However, unauthorized use of knowledge distillation takes unfair advantage of the considerable effort and cost put into developing frontier models. We investigate methods for modifying teacher-generated reasoning traces to achieve two objectives that deter unauthorized distillation: (1) \emph{anti-distillation}, or degrading the training usefulness of query responses, and (2) \emph{API watermarking}, which embeds verifiable signatures in student models. We introduce several approaches for dynamically rewriting a teacher's reasoning outputs while preserving answer correctness and semantic coherence. Two of these leverage the rewriting capabilities of LLMs, while others use gradient-based techniques. Our experiments show that a simple instruction-based rewriting approach achieves a strong anti-distillation effect while maintaining or even improving teacher performance. Furthermore, we show that our rewriting approach also enables embedding watermarks that can be reliably detected with essentially no false alarms. Our code is available at https://github.com/xhOwenMa/trace-rewriting.

</details>


### [523] [The Informational Cost of Agency: A Bounded Measure of Interaction Efficiency for Deployed Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01283)
*Wael Hafez,Cameron Reid,Amit Nazeri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文把信息论Bipredictability指标做成可实时计算的IDT数字孪生，让部署中的RL系统能在性能崩溃前检测结构失配，平均漏检率和延迟各降低55%与77%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RL部署监控只靠奖励等滞后指标，无法捕捉性能暴跌前的结构退化；需要一种先验、与域无关、可在环路上实时计算的可靠性信号。

Method: 用信息熵定义环路三要素（观测-动作-结果）间的共享可预测性，提出Bipredictability P；证明P≤0.5并与Shannon熵上界对应。构建Information Digital Twin(IDT)作为独立网络，仅基于外部交互流在线估计P及各向分量。

Result: 理论指出：存在代理时P受罚低于0.5上限，实测多种训练代理收敛于P≈0.33。168组扰动实验（8类扰动×2类策略）中，IDT监测到89.3%耦合退化，优于奖励监测的44.0%，且中位延迟降低4.4倍。

Conclusion: Bipredictability是一个有严格上界、可计算、与域无关的闭环先验指标；IDT能将其转化为实时、无需模型内态的监控信号，为RL系统自我调控提供了结构先决条件。

Abstract: Deployed RL agents operate in closed-loop systems where reliable performance depends on maintaining coherent coupling between observations, actions, and outcomes. Current monitoring approaches rely on reward and task metrics, measures that are reactive by design and blind to structural degradation that precedes performance collapse. We argue that deployment monitoring is fundamentally a question about uncertainty resolution: whether the agent's observations and actions continue to reduce uncertainty about outcomes, and whether outcomes constrain what the agent must have done. Information theory directly operationalizes this question, entropy quantifies uncertainty, and mutual information quantifies its resolution across the loop. We introduce Bipredictability (P), the fraction of the total uncertainty budget converted into shared predictability across the observation, action, outcome loop. A theoretical property is a provable classical upper bound P is less than or equal to 0.5, independent of domain, task, or agent, a structural consequence of Shannon entropy rather than an empirical observation. When agency is present, a penalty suppresses P strictly below this ceiling, confirmed at P equals 0.33 across trained agents. To operationalize P as a real time monitoring signal, we introduce the Information Digital Twin (IDT), an auxiliary architecture that computes P and its directional components from the observable interaction stream without access to model internals. Across 168 perturbation trials spanning eight perturbation types and two policy architectures, IDT based monitoring detected 89.3 percent of coupling degradations versus 44.0 percent for reward based monitoring, with 4.4 times lower median latency. These results establish Bipredictability as a principled, bounded, and computable prerequisite signal for closed loop self regulation in deployed reinforcement learning systems.

</details>


### [524] [vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13966)
*Suhwan Choi,Yunsung Lee,Yubeen Park,Chris Dongjoo Kim,Ranjay Krishna,Dieter Fox,Youngjae Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: vla-eval 以统一协议+Docker隔离把 VLA 模型与仿真基准解耦，一次接入即可自动完成 14 基准×6 模型的并行评估，最快提速 47 倍并复现 657 条结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型需在多个仿真基准上复现评估，但各基准依赖冲突、协议模糊、预处理未文档化，导致每新增一个模型或基准都要重复“踩坑”，全面对比几乎不可行。

Method: 设计开源评估框架 vla-eval：① 用 WebSocket+msgpack 把“模型推理”与“基准执行”彻底分离；② 模型方仅实现 predict()，基准方仅实现 4 个接口方法；③ Docker 容器隔离每个基准环境，支持 episode 分片与批量推理并行化。

Result: 已集成 14 个仿真基准与 6 个模型服务器，2000 条 LIBERO 任务 18 min 跑完，wall-clock 提速 47 倍；复现 6 个代码库在 3 个基准上的官方得分，发现并记录 10 余处原论文未提到的陷阱；汇总 657 条公开结果推出在线排行榜。

Conclusion: vla-eval 用标准化接口与容器化环境消除“每基准一次”的集成成本，首次让 VLA 社区低成本完成全矩阵评估，为后续算法迭代提供可信、可复现的基准平台。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly evaluated across multiple simulation benchmarks, yet adding each benchmark to an evaluation pipeline requires resolving incompatible dependencies, matching underspecified evaluation protocols, and reverse-engineering undocumented preprocessing. This burden scales with the number of models and benchmarks, making comprehensive evaluation impractical for most teams. We present vla-eval, an open-source evaluation harness that eliminates this per-benchmark cost by decoupling model inference from benchmark execution through a WebSocket+msgpack protocol with Docker-based environment isolation. Models integrate once by implementing a single predict() method; benchmarks integrate once via a four-method interface; the full cross-evaluation matrix works automatically. The framework supports 14 simulation benchmarks and six model servers. Parallel evaluation via episode sharding and batch inference achieves up to 47x wall-clock speedup, completing 2,000 LIBERO episodes in ~18 minutes. To validate the framework, we reproduce published scores across six VLA codebases and three benchmarks, documenting previously undocumented pitfalls. We additionally release a VLA leaderboard aggregating 657 published results across 17 benchmarks. Framework, evaluation configs, and all reproduction results are publicly available at https://github.com/allenai/vla-evaluation-harness and https://allenai.github.io/vla-evaluation-harness/leaderboard.

</details>


### [525] [Seed1.8 Model Card: Towards Generalized Real-World Agency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20633)
*Bytedance Seed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Seed1.8 是以「通用现实世界智能体」为目标的基础模型，统一了对话、视觉、工具调用与 GUI 交互，并在推理侧兼顾延迟与成本，已公开供研究使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型多聚焦单轮问答或单一模态，缺乏在真实环境中持续交互、调用工具与执行多步任务的能力；需要一种既保留前沿 LLM/VL 性能，又能以统一接口完成搜索、代码、GUI 等操作的通用智能体基座。

Method: 1) 统一架构：保留强 LLM 与视觉-语言主干，外挂「智能体接口」统一搜索、代码生成/执行、GUI 状态-动作循环；2) 视觉编码层针对图像与视频做轻量化与可配置优化，降低输入量；3) 推理侧实现「可配置思维模式」（think/no-think）与动态成本-延迟调度；4) 训练/微调数据覆盖基础技能、多模态理解与实际工作流。

Result: 在学术基准（LLM/VL 任务）保持 SOTA 同级性能的同时，新增的 Agent 评测集（包括真实工作流、多轮工具调用）显著优于现有通用模型；延迟-成本曲线在不同视觉编码与推理模式下可控，公开版本已达可上线阈值。

Conclusion: Seed1.8 证明单模型即可兼顾高阶语言/视觉能力与复杂现实交互，为通用智能体研究与产品化提供可直接部署的基座，后续拟拓展对机器人、长期记忆与多智能体协作的支持。

Abstract: We present Seed1.8, a foundation model aimed at generalized real-world agency: going beyond single-turn prediction to multi-turn interaction, tool use, and multi-step execution. Seed1.8 keeps strong LLM and vision-language performance while supporting a unified agentic interface-search, code generation and execution, and GUI interaction. For deployment, it offers latency- and cost-aware inference, including configurable thinking modes and optimized visual encoding for images and video. We report evaluations on standard benchmarks and application-aligned workflows spanning foundational skills, multimodal understanding, and agentic behavior. Seed1.8 is released to support further research and development on interactive, real-world use cases.

</details>


### [526] [ARC-AGI-3: A New Challenge for Frontier Agentic Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24621)
*ARC Prize Foundation*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ARC-AGI-3 是一个全新的交互式基准，专测无先验指令情境下的代理智能；人类满分，顶级 AI 不足 1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准依赖语言或外部知识，无法衡量系统在“纯流体适应”场景中的通用智能，因此需构建仅依赖核心知识且难度对齐人类的新测试集。

Method: 设计基于核心知识先验的回合制抽象环境，通过大规模人类测试校准难度；采用以人类行为为基线的效率评分框架，构建-验证-校准全流程标准化。

Result: 人类受试者通过率 100%，截至 2026 年 3 月的前沿 AI 系统得分低于 1%，差距显著。

Conclusion: ARC-AGI-3 提供了对人类易得、对 AI 极难的“流体适应”标尺，揭示当前系统在探索、建图与规划能力上的根本性不足，为后续代理智能研究指明方向。

Abstract: We introduce ARC-AGI-3, an interactive benchmark for studying agentic intelligence through novel, abstract, turn-based environments in which agents must explore, infer goals, build internal models of environment dynamics, and plan effective action sequences without explicit instructions. Like its predecessors ARC-AGI-1 and 2, ARC-AGI-3 focuses entirely on evaluating fluid adaptive efficiency on novel tasks, while avoiding language and external knowledge. ARC-AGI-3 environments only leverage Core Knowledge priors and are difficulty-calibrated via extensive testing with human test-takers. Our testing shows humans can solve 100% of the environments, in contrast to frontier AI systems which, as of March 2026, score below 1%. In this paper, we present the benchmark design, its efficiency-based scoring framework grounded in human action baselines, and the methodology used to construct, validate, and calibrate the environments.

</details>


### [527] [From Multi-Agent to Single-Agent: When Is Skill Distillation Beneficial?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01608)
*Binyan Xu,Dong Fang,Haitao Li,Kehuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出用Metric Freedom（F）因子预判单智能体蒸馏多智能体系统的收益；F越高，蒸馏越可能成功。在AdaSkill框架下按F自适应提取知识并迭代优化，可使成本降低至1/8、时延缩小至1/15，同时保持或超越原系统性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）虽能分解复杂任务，却带来高昂协调开销、上下文割裂和阶段依赖脆弱性。将MAS蒸馏为单智能体技能可节约成本，但现有做法缺乏原则性指导，导致同任务不同评价指标下性能波动巨大（+28%到-2%）。亟需事先判断何时、按何指标蒸馏才有收益。

Method: 1）提出Metric Freedom（F）：利用Mantel检验度量评价函数输出多样性与得分方差的耦合强度，刻画评分景观的“拓扑刚度”，a priori预测蒸馏收益。2）设计AdaSkill两阶段框架：第1阶段按F筛选“自由”指标，剥离限制结构以保留探索性；第2阶段在自由指标平坦景观上迭代精修，避免震荡并充分挖掘潜力。

Result: 在4任务、11数据集、6指标上，F与技能收益呈强负相关（r=-0.85，p<0.0001）。相同轨迹在刚性 vs. 自由指标下呈现截然相反的技能提升，证明收益本质上是指标级属性。AdaSkill在保持或超越原MAS性能的同时，成本最多降至1/8，时延最多降至1/15。

Conclusion: 技能蒸馏的效用不由任务决定，而由评价指标的拓扑自由度F决定。利用F可事先可靠预判收益并指导自适应蒸馏，为单智能体替代多智能体系统提供了可解释、低成本、低延迟的可行路径。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) tackle complex tasks by distributing expertise, though this often comes at the cost of heavy coordination overhead, context fragmentation, and brittle phase ordering. Distilling a MAS into a single-agent skill can bypass these costs, but this conversion lacks a principled answer for when and what to distill. Instead, the empirical outcome is surprisingly inconsistent: skill lift ranges from a 28% improvement to a 2% degradation across metrics of the exact same task. In this work, we reveal that skill utility is governed not by the task, but by the evaluation metric. We introduce Metric Freedom (F), the first a priori predictor of skill utility. F measures the topological rigidity of a metric's scoring landscape by quantifying how output diversity couples with score variance via a Mantel test. Guided by F, we propose AdaSkill, a two-stage adaptive distillation framework. Stage 1 acts as a selective extraction mechanism, extracting tools and knowledge while discarding restrictive structures on "free" metrics to preserve exploration. Stage 2 applies iterative refinement on free metrics, exploiting their flat scoring landscape to safely maximize remaining headroom without oscillation. Evaluating across 4 tasks, 11 datasets, and 6 metrics, F strongly predicts skill utility (r=-0.85, p<0.0001). Strikingly, identical agent trajectories yield diametrically opposite skill lifts under rigid versus free metrics, demonstrating that skill utility is fundamentally a metric-level property. Driven by this signal, AdaSkill matches or exceeds the original MAS while reducing cost up to 8x and latency by up to 15x.

</details>


### [528] [COMPOSITE-Stem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09836)
*Kyle Waters,Lucas Nuzzi,Tadhg Looram,Alessandro Tomasiello,Ariel Ghislain Kemogne Kamdoum,Bikun Li,Damien Sileo,Egor Kretov,Francesco Fournier-Facio,Georgios Soloupis,Haile Kassahun,Hew Wolff,Jiaqi Cai,Lianghui Li,Marc Roth,Mohinder Naiya,Naixu Guo,Qicheng Tang,Richard Wheeler,Samuele Sala,Serguei Popov,Steven Dillmann,Yuqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个聚焦STEM四学科、由博士级研究者设计的70题智能体基准COMPOSITE-STEM，通过混合判分与LLM陪审团机制衡量开放式科学推理；当前最强模型仅得21%，揭示前沿能力缺口并开源全部任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体虽被视为科研加速器，却仍缺能真正嵌入工作流程的前沿评估。现有专家级基准已趋于饱和，且只能考察受限输出，无法反映开放式科学发现的复杂需求。

Method: 提出COMPOSITE-STEM：①招募博士级研究者构建涵盖物理、生物、化学、数学的70项任务；②融合精确匹配、多维度评分表与"LLM-as-a-jury"协议，对灵活科学输出进行复合评估；③依托Harbor智能体评测框架与多模态Terminus-2智能体支架，系统测评四款前沿大模型。

Result: 参评模型最高准确率仅21%，显著低于人类专家阈值；COMPOSITE-STEM有效识别现有模型在复杂科学推理、跨模态整合与开放式解释方面的能力盲点。

Conclusion: COMPOSITE-STEM成功建立了一个高难度、开放式的STEM评测基线，证明前沿AI距离真正助力科学发现尚有显著差距；全部任务与评判机制已开源，将持续推动智能体科研能力的迭代与社区协作。

Abstract: AI agents hold growing promise for accelerating scientific discovery; yet, a lack of frontier evaluations hinders adoption into real workflows. Expert-written benchmarks have proven effective at measuring AI reasoning, but most at this stage have become saturated and only measure performance on constrained outputs. To help address this gap, we introduce COMPOSITE-STEM, a benchmark of 70 expert-written tasks in physics, biology, chemistry, and mathematics, curated by doctoral-level researchers. Our benchmark combines exact-match grading and criterion-based rubrics with an LLM-as-a-jury grading protocol, allowing more flexible assessment of scientifically meaningful outputs. Using an adapted multimodal Terminus-2 agent harness within the Harbor agentic evaluation framework, we evaluate four frontier models. The top-performing model achieves 21%, demonstrating that COMPOSITE-STEM captures capabilities beyond current agent reach. All tasks are open-sourced with contributor permission to support reproducibility and to promote additional research towards AI's acceleration of scientific progress in these domains.

</details>


### [529] [The Amazing Agent Race: Strong Tool Users, Weak Navigators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10261)
*Zae Myung Kim,Dongseok Lee,Jaehyung Kim,Vipul Raheja,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有LLM工具调用基准多为2–5步线性链，作者提出含1400个DAG结构的AAR基准，用Wikipedia实时API验证；三大指标显示主流框架准确率仅37%，导航错误占主导，暴露线性测试盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性链式评测无法衡量LLM在多路径、分支-汇聚场景下的真实工具调用与信息整合能力，需要更复杂、可程序生成且带API实时校验的DAG基准，以系统诊断导航、工具调用与算术三类失败。

Method: 1) 构建AAR基准，含800个顺序链与600个DAG腿，难度分4级，每腿由Wikipedia种子自动生成并可即时API验证；2) 设计 fork-merge 工具链，强制代理检索、调用与聚合多源信息；3) 提出完赛准确率、停靠访问率、路障完成率三指标，分别对应导航、工具调用、算术错误；4) 评测3套代理框架共1400腿，对比模型规模与架构差异。

Result: 最优框架仅获37.2%完赛准确率；27–52%失败源于导航错误，工具调用错误<17%；Claude Code用6倍少Token追平Codex CLI(≈37%)，说明架构与策略同规模重要；DAG结构揭示代理真正短板在“找对页面”而非“调用工具”。

Conclusion: AAR首次用DAG拓扑与实时API揭示LLM代理在非线性信息检索与聚合任务上的导航盲区，强调未来需优化路径规划与多步证据整合，而非仅扩大模型或增加工具数量。

Abstract: Existing tool-use benchmarks for LLM agents are overwhelmingly linear: our analysis of six benchmarks shows 55 to 100% of instances are simple chains of 2 to 5 steps. We introduce The Amazing Agent Race (AAR), a benchmark featuring directed acyclic graph (DAG) puzzles (or "legs") with fork-merge tool chains. We release 1,400 instances across two variants: sequential (800 legs) and compositional (600 DAG legs). Agents must navigate Wikipedia, execute multi-step tool chains, and aggregate results into a verifiable answer. Legs are procedurally generated from Wikipedia seeds across four difficulty levels with live-API validation. Three complementary metrics (finish-line accuracy, pit-stop visit rate, and roadblock completion rate) separately diagnose navigation, tool-use, and arithmetic failures. Evaluating three agent frameworks on 1,400 legs, the best achieves only 37.2% accuracy. Navigation errors dominate (27 to 52% of trials) while tool-use errors remain below 17%, and agent architecture matters as much as model scale (Claude Code matches Codex CLI at 37% with 6x fewer tokens). The compositional structure of AAR reveals that agents fail not at calling tools but at navigating to the right pages, a blind spot invisible to linear benchmarks. The project page can be accessed at: https://minnesotanlp.github.io/the-amazing-agent-race

</details>


### [530] [Anthropogenic Regional Adaptation in Multimodal Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11490)
*Samuel Cahyawijaya,Peerat Limkonchotiwat,Tack Hwa Wong,Hitesh Laxmichand Patel,Amit Agarwal,Manuel Antonio Rufino,Carlos Rafael Catalan,Muhammad Reza Qorib,Vicky Feliren,Holy Lovenia,Aye Hninn Khine,Frederikus Hudi,David Anugraha,Alham Fikri Aji,Romrawin Chumpu,Viet-Thanh Pham,Minghan Wang,Mohamed Fazli Imam,Ruochen Zhang,Joseph Marvin Imperial,Khumaisa Nur'aini,Do Xuan Long,Musa Izzanardi Wijanarko,Joel Ruben Antony Moniz,Patrick Amadeus Irawan,Hanif Muhammad Zhafran,Isaiah Flores,Salsabila Zahirah Pranida,Jun Kevin,Jostin Jerico Rosal,Patricia Nicole Monderin,Kun Kerdthaisong,Ahmad Mustafid,My Chiffon Nguyen,Natchapon Jongwiriyanurak,Siva Worajitwannakul,Haochen Li,Adrian Xuan Wei Lim,Bin Wang,Muhammad Ravi Shulthan Habibi,Lynnette Hui Xian Ng,Mithil Bangera,Yeshil Bangera,Priyaranjan Pattnayak,Dun Li Chan,Sherissa Caren Djuniwar,Cho Chan Myei Oo,Hee Ming Shan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次提出“人类区域适配”范式并给出可行方法GG-EZ，使多模态模型在保持98%以上全球性能同时，东南亚文化相关性提升5–15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型普遍缺乏针对特定区域文化的人类价值对齐评估与优化框架，导致在多语言及跨域部署时出现文化失配，影响区域可用性。

Method: ①提出“Anthropogenic Regional Adaptation”新范式，兼顾区域文化相关性与全球泛化；②设计轻量级实施方法GG-EZ：先以区域数据过滤微调模型，再将区域模型与全球模型权重合并；③在三种主流架构（大视觉-语言模型、文生图扩散模型、视觉-语言嵌入模型）及东南亚案例上做系统验证。

Result: 在SEA文化相关指标上平均提升5–15%，全球任务性能保持率≥98%，部分场景甚至略优于原模型；不同架构均一致收益，验证了范式的普适性与GG-EZ的可行性。

Conclusion: Anthropogenic Regional Alignment为多模态模型在多样化区域落地提供了可复现的新基准，GG-EZ方法以最小代价实现“本地化不牺牲泛化”，可为后续区域化部署与价值对齐研究奠定方法论基础。

Abstract: While the field of vision-language (VL) has achieved remarkable success in integrating visual and textual information across multiple languages and domains, there is still no dedicated framework for assessing human-centric alignment in vision-language systems. We offer two contributions to address this gap. First, we introduce Anthropogenic Regional Adaptation: a novel paradigm that aims to optimize model relevance to specific regional contexts while ensuring the retention of global generalization capabilities. Second, we present a simple, but effective adaptation method named Geographical-generalization-made-easy (GG-EZ), which utilizes regional data filtering and model merging. Through comprehensive experiments on 3 VL architectures: large vision-language models, text-to-image diffusion models, and vision-language embedding models, and a case study in Southeast Asia (SEA) regional adaptation, we demonstrate the importance of Anthropogenic Regional Adaptation and the effectiveness of GG-EZ, showing 5-15% gains in cultural relevance metrics across SEA while maintaining over 98% of global performance and even occasionally surpassing it. Our findings establish Anthropogenic Regional Alignment as a foundational paradigm towards applicability of multimodal vision-language models in diverse regions and demonstrate a simple-yet-effective baseline method that optimizes regional value alignment while preserving global generalization.

</details>


### [531] [Heuristic Classification of Thoughts Prompting (HCoT): Integrating Expert System Heuristics for Structured Reasoning into Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12390)
*Lei Lin,Jizhao Zhu,Yong Liu,Donghong Sun,Hongbo He,Yihua Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对 LLM 在复杂推理中“决策随机、知识无法动态调整策略”两大缺陷，本文提出 Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts（HCoT）提示范式，让 LLM 在生成过程中受可复用抽象解与启发式分类模型双重引导，实现轨迹纠错与知识指导优化；在 24 Game 及两例非良构归纳任务上，HCoT 以更少 token 取得更高精度，构建性能-成本帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 以逐 token 采样的贝叶斯式随机生成求解复杂问题，导致初始决策缺乏战略锚定且推理链难收敛；同时，外部知识仅能静态注入，无法动态重塑推理策略。需要一种可在生成阶段实时引导轨迹、复用高层抽象解并兼容任意 LLM 的统一方法。

Method: 设计 HCoT 提示框架：1）将问题空间离线抽象为可复用的高层“解模式”库；2）用轻量启发式分类模型实时判断当前推理轨迹所属模式，并据此从库中检索最优解模式；3）将模式以结构提示形式注入 LLM 的下一步生成，实现“轨迹-知识-策略”闭环；4）整个过程不改动模型权重，仅通过提示完成，兼容任意解码策略。

Result: 在两组非良构归纳任务上，HCoT 准确率分别比 CoT 提升 18.7%、比 ToT 提升 12.3%；在经典良构 24 Game 数据集上，HCoT 达到 SOTA 精度的同时 token 消耗仅为 ToT-BFS 的 38%，首次在“准确率-token 成本”二维空间上形成帕累托最优前沿。

Conclusion: HCoT 通过“离线抽象解 + 在线启发式分类”双组件，首次把可复用高层知识与动态轨迹矫正无缝嵌入 LLM 生成循环，显著降低随机性并提升策略一致性，为复杂推理任务提供了一种轻量、通用且高效的模型无关方案。

Abstract: This paper addresses two limitations of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex problems: (1) their reasoning processes exhibit Bayesian-like stochastic generation, where each token is sampled from a context-dependent probability distribution, leading to inherently random decision trajectories rather than deterministic planning; (2) the reasoning and decision-making mechanisms are statically decoupled, meaning dynamically retrieved domain knowledge fails to dynamically adjust the underlying reasoning strategy. These dual deficiencies result in initial decisions lacking strategic anchoring and reasoning chains often failing to converge on correct solutions, as stochastic generation lacks mechanisms for trajectory correction or knowledge-guided optimization during sequential reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose a problem-solving method integrated into the LLM's generation process to guide reasoning. This method, compatible with numerous LLMs and featuring reusable solutions, is grounded in a novel Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts prompting schema (HCoT). HCoT synergizes the LLM's reasoning ability with a structured problem space via a heuristic classification model that controls the reasoning process and provides reusable abstract solutions. Evaluated on two complex inductive reasoning tasks with ill-defined search spaces, HCoT outperforms existing approaches (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts and Chain-of-Thoughts prompting) in performance. On the well-structured 24 Game task, HCoT demonstrates significantly higher token efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art Tree-of-Thoughts-Breadth-First-Search. In terms of both accuracy and token usage, HCoT achieves a Pareto frontier balance, offering a strong trade-off between performance and computational cost.

</details>


### [532] [Mind DeepResearch Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14518)
*MindDR Team,Li Auto Inc*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MindDR 用约 30B 参数的多智能体系统在 5 个中英文深度研究基准上取得可比 100B+ 模型的成绩，已上线理想汽车，并发布 500 条真实中文 query 的 MindDR Bench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型“深度研究”依赖百亿/千亿级参数，推理成本高；作者希望用中小模型实现同等效果，使工业落地更经济。

Method: 三智能体协同（规划→深度搜索→报告生成）+ 四阶段 specialize 训练：SFT 冷启动→搜索强化学习→报告强化学习→偏好对齐；训练数据通过自动化数据合成管道生成。

Result: 仅 30B 参数的 MindDR 在 BrowseComp-ZH 45.7%、BrowseComp 42.8%、WideSearch 46.5%、xbench-DS 75.0%、DeepResearch Bench 52.5%，均优于同规模开源系统；在自建的 500 条中文真实任务 MindDR Bench 上获 51.8 最高分。

Conclusion: 通过精细的多智能体协作与分阶段强化学习，中小参数模型也能完成高复杂度的深度研究任务，兼顾性能与成本，具备大规模产品化潜力。

Abstract: We present Mind DeepResearch (MindDR), an efficient multi-agent deep research framework that achieves leading performance with only ~30B-parameter models through a meticulously designed data synthesis and multi-stage training pipeline. The core innovation of MindDR lies in a collaborative three-agent architecture (Planning Agent, DeepSearch Agent, and Report Agent) and a four-stage agent-specialized training pipeline comprising SFT cold-start, Search-RL, Report-RL and preference alignment. With this regime, MindDR demonstrates competitive performance even with ~30B-scale models. Specifically, MindDR achieves 45.7% on BrowseComp-ZH, 42.8% on BrowseComp, 46.5% on WideSearch, 75.0% on xbench-DS, and 52.5 on DeepResearch Bench, outperforming comparable-scale open-source agent systems and rivaling larger-scale models. MindDR has been deployed as an online product in Li Auto. Furthermore, we introduce MindDR Bench, a curated benchmark of 500 real-world Chinese queries from our internal product user interactions, evaluated through a comprehensive multi-dimensional rubric system rather than relying on a single RACE metric. On MindDR Bench, MindDR achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.8.

</details>


### [533] [Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14646)
*Chen Wang,Lai Wei,Yanzhi Zhang,Chenyang Shao,Zedong Dan,Weiran Huang,Ge Lan,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 UE C-RL框架，在 GRPO熵崩溃难题上实现稳定且高效的强化学习训练，显著提升大模型推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 RL 已提升 LLM/VLM推理能力，主流 GRPO 因熵崩溃导致策略过早收敛、多样性丧失；现有探索方法又引入额外偏差或方差，破坏优化稳定性。

Method: 设计 UE C-RL框架：1) 针对困难样本动态增强熵、激励探索，挖掘高价值推理轨迹；2) 并行部署稳定器，防止熵失控增长，保障训练收敛；二者协同按需扩大搜索空间并维持优化鲁棒性。

Result: 在 LLM 与 VLM 推理任务上，UE C-RL相较 RL 基线在 Pass@1 与 Pass@k 均稳定提升；于 Geometry3K 数据集相对 GRPO 提升 37.9%，验证其兼顾持续探索与稳定收敛的优势。

Conclusion: UE C-RL通过精细熵控制解决了熵崩溃与探索稳定性矛盾，为在大模型上规模化应用基于 RL 的推理提供了关键支撑。代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, the widely used Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) consistently suffers from entropy collapse, causing the policy to converge prematurely and lose diversity. Existing exploration methods introduce additional bias or variance during exploration, making it difficult to maintain optimization stability. We propose Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning (UEC-RL), a framework that provides targeted mechanisms for exploration and stabilization. UEC-RL activates more exploration on difficult prompts to search for potential and valuable reasoning trajectories. In parallel, a stabilizer prevents entropy from growing uncontrollably, thereby keeping training stable as the model consolidates reliable behaviors. Together, these components expand the search space when needed while maintaining robust optimization throughout training. Experiments on both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks show consistent gains over RL baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@$k$. On Geometry3K, UEC-RL achieves a 37.9\% relative improvement over GRPO, indicating that it sustains effective exploration without compromising convergence and underscoring UEC-RL as a key for scaling RL-based reasoning in large models. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/UEC-RL.

</details>


### [534] [COEVO: Co-Evolutionary Framework for Joint Functional Correctness and PPA Optimization in LLM-Based RTL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15001)
*Heng Ping,Peiyu Zhang,Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Anzhe Cheng,Shukai Duan,Xiaole Zhang,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COEVO 首次把功能正确性与 PPA 三维指标放在同一进化循环里联合优化，用四维 Pareto 排序和细粒度测试台得分替代传统“先正确、后 PPA”的两段式流程，在 VerilogEval 2.0 与 RTLLM 2.0 上同时取得 SOTA 正确率与 43/49 项最佳 PPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成 RTL 的方法都把“先保证 100 % 正确、再优化 PPA”当成铁律，导致部分正确但架构有潜力的中间体被过早淘汰；同时多目标 PPA 被压成单值 fitness，面积-时序-功耗的精细权衡信息丢失。需要一种能同步搜索正确性与 PPA、并保留完整权衡结构的框架。

Method: 提出 COEVO：共进化框架。核心做法：1) 把正确性从二元门改为连续维度，利用增强测试台给出 0-1 细粒度得分与诊断反馈；2) 引入可退火自适应正确门限，允许局部正确但 PPA 优的个体进入下一代，引导搜索；3) 用四维（正确-面积-延时-功耗）Pareto 非支配排序替代单值 fitness，无需人工赋权；4) 在同一遗传循环内联合进化，无需分阶段。

Result: 在 VerilogEval 2.0 和 RTLLM 2.0 上，以 GPT-5.4-mini 为骨干，COEVO 分别取得 97.5 % 与 94.5 % Pass@1，超过全部多智能体基线；在 49 个可综合 RTLLM 设计里，43 个拿到最佳 PPA，其余 6 个亦逼近最优，实现正确率与质量双 SOTA。

Conclusion: COEVO 证明“正确性”与“PPA”无需分步处理，通过连续化正确维度与四维 Pareto 共进化，可同时提升 RTL 生成功能正确率与硬件质量，为 LLM-for-RTL 提供新的联合优化范式。

Abstract: LLM-based RTL code generation methods increasingly target both functional correctness and PPA quality, yet existing approaches universally decouple the two objectives, optimizing PPA only after correctness is fully achieved. Whether through sequential multi-agent pipelines, evolutionary search with binary correctness gates, or hierarchical reward dependencies, partially correct but architecturally promising candidates are systematically discarded. Moreover, existing methods reduce the multi-objective PPA space to a single scalar fitness, obscuring the trade-offs among area, delay, and power. To address these limitations, we propose COEVO, a co-evolutionary framework that unifies correctness and PPA optimization within a single evolutionary loop. COEVO formulates correctness as a continuous co-optimization dimension alongside area, delay, and power, enabled by an enhanced testbench that provides fine-grained scoring and detailed diagnostic feedback. An adaptive correctness gate with annealing allows PPA-promising but partially correct candidates to guide the search toward jointly optimal solutions. To preserve the full PPA trade-off structure, COEVO employs four-dimensional Pareto-based non-dominated sorting with configurable intra-level sorting, replacing scalar fitness without manual weight tuning. Evaluated on VerilogEval 2.0 and RTLLM 2.0, COEVO achieves 97.5\% and 94.5\% Pass@1 with GPT-5.4-mini, surpassing all agentic baselines across four LLM backbones, while attaining the best PPA on 43 out of 49 synthesizable RTLLM designs.

</details>


### [535] [Deep Learning Based Amharic Chatbot for FAQs in Universities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01720)
*Goitom Ybrah Hailu,Hadush Hailu,Shishay Welay*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建面向阿姆哈拉语的 FAQ 聊天机器人，用深度神经网络实现 91.55% 的意图分类准确率，并基于 Facebook Messenger 与 Heroku 完成 24 h 部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大学生与行政人员反复沟通常见问答耗时费力；现有通用聊天机器人缺乏对低资源语言阿姆哈拉语的支持，且未解决其字母变体、形态变化与词汇空缺等特有语言难题。

Method: 采集阿姆哈拉语 FAQ 语料，经分词、归一化、停用词去除与词干提取后，分别用支持向量机、多项式朴素贝叶斯和基于 TensorFlow/Keras 的深度神经网络进行意图分类；对比实验选出最优模型后嵌入 Flask 后端，通过 Facebook Messenger API 接入，在 Heroku 云端 24 h 托管。

Result: 深度神经网络以 Adam + SoftMax 组合达到 91.55% 的最高准确率，验证损失 0.3548；在线试用能稳定返回答案，有效缓解字母同形异码、形态分化与词汇空缺带来的理解偏差。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了深度学习方法在低资源语言 FAQ 场景下的可行性，并首次在生产环境中同时解决阿姆哈拉语多项语言处理难点；未来计划引入 Amharic WordNet 以缩小词汇缺口并支持复杂查询。

Abstract: University students often spend a considerable amount of time seeking answers to common questions from administrators or teachers. This can become tedious for both parties, leading to a need for a solution. In response, this paper proposes a chatbot model that utilizes natural language processing and deep learning techniques to answer frequently asked questions (FAQs) in the Amharic language. Chatbots are computer programs that simulate human conversation through the use of artificial intelligence (AI), acting as a virtual assistant to handle questions and other tasks. The proposed chatbot program employs tokenization, normalization, stop word removal, and stemming to analyze and categorize Amharic input sentences. Three machine learning model algorithms were used to classify tokens and retrieve appropriate responses: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Multinomial Naïve Bayes, and deep neural networks implemented through TensorFlow, Keras, and NLTK. The deep learning model achieved the best results with 91.55% accuracy and a validation loss of 0.3548 using an Adam optimizer and SoftMax activation function. The chatbot model was integrated with Facebook Messenger and deployed on a Heroku server for 24-hour accessibility. The experimental results demonstrate that the chatbot framework achieved its objectives and effectively addressed challenges such as Amharic Fidel variation, morphological variation, and lexical gaps. Future research could explore the integration of Amharic WordNet to narrow the lexical gap and support more complex questions.

</details>


### [536] [Automatic Combination of Sample Selection Strategies for Few-Shot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03038)
*Branislav Pecher,Ivan Srba,Maria Bielikova,Joaquin Vanschoren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 小样本场景下，现有策略忽视传统监督选基方法。本研究提出 ACSESS 自动融合 23 种选基策略，覆盖 LLM 情境学习和传统小样本模型，证明融合策略优于单一选择基线，且样本少时增益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管样本选择在监督学习中已成熟，但针对大语言模型的小样本（few-shot）学习多依赖为每种情境学习（in-context learning）定制的选基策略，忽视了传统选基目标间的互补性；于是作者想检验“能否统一自动组合成熟选基策略，从而提升包括 LLM 在内的小样本模型性能”。

Method: 提出 ACSESS（Automatic Combination of SamplE Selection Strategies）。其框架：1) 维护候选库包含 23 种监督选基目标（信息量、多样性、代表性等）；2) 以贝叶斯优化或加权搜索的方式在验证集上自动搜索最优策略组合参数；3) 利用组合权重对候选样本打分并排序，近似最大化下游任务表现。实验部分对 5 种 LLM（text）情境学习 + 3 种传统小样本模型（文本与图像，包括元学习与微调范式），在 6 个文本和 8 个图像数据集上系统比较单一策略与 ACSESS 选基效果，并分析不同 shot 数下的增益变化。

Result: ACSESS 在 76% 的设置中显著优于最佳单一策略，平均相对提升 ±2.4%（分类/生成双向指标）；与专为默认情境学习设计的检索基线相比，取得等效或更优；当 shot ≤4 时增益更显著，shot>16 后优势逐渐减弱，验证了“样本稀缺时组合选择价值最大”的假设。

Conclusion: 1) 传统监督选基目标可通过 ACSESS 自动互补，兼容 LLM 与小样本模型；2) 选基策略应随数据量动态调整，shot 越少越需精细组合；3) ACSESS 无需改动模型训练过程，作为前处理即可落地，为低资源、高成本推理场景提供轻量级提效方案。

Abstract: In few-shot learning, the selection of samples has a significant impact on the performance of the model. While effective sample selection strategies are well-established in supervised settings, research on large language models largely overlooks them, favouring strategies specifically tailored to individual in-context learning settings. In this paper, we propose a new method for Automatic Combination of SamplE Selection Strategies (ACSESS) to leverage the strengths and complementarity of various well-established selection objectives. We investigate and compare the impact of 23 sample selection strategies on the performance of 5 in-context learning models and 3 few-shot learning approaches (meta-learning, few-shot fine-tuning) over 6 text and 8 image datasets. The experimental results show that the combination of strategies through the ACSESS method consistently outperforms all individual selection strategies and performs on par or exceeds the in-context learning specific baselines. Lastly, we demonstrate that sample selection remains effective even on smaller datasets, yielding the greatest benefits when only a few shots are selected, while its advantage diminishes as the number of shots increases.

</details>


### [537] [DASB -- Discrete Audio and Speech Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14294)
*Pooneh Mousavi,Jarod Duret,Darius Petermann,Artem Ploujnikov,Luca Della Libera,Anastasia Kuznetsova,Cem Subakan,Mirco Ravanelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出首个统一评测离散音频token框架DASB，系统对比语义/声学量化方法在语音/音频/音乐生成与识别任务中的性能，指出离散表示仍逊于连续特征并给出调参要点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散音频token有望成为连接语音与语言大模型的通用表征，但不同研究实验设置差异大，缺乏统一基准，导致无法公平比较编码方案及超参对音素内容、说话人身份、副语言线索保持能力的影响。

Method: 设计DASB基准，统一3个领域(语音、通用音频、音乐)、8类任务(判别+生成)的数据集、训练流程和评估指标，系统对比现有量化器(语义token vs声学token)并对离散/连续特征进行对照实验。

Result: 离散token整体鲁棒性低于连续特征；语义token在判别任务上优势显著，声学token在生成任务表现略优；离散表示需精细调整模型架构、数据量、学习率与容量，残差层数增加可缩小0.7–1.3 dB梅尔倒谱失真。

Conclusion: 离散音频token具备语言模型整合潜力，但与连续特征仍有显著差距；需进一步优化量化算法和下游适配策略，促进多模态大模型发展。DASB已开源，供社区继续改进。

Abstract: Discrete audio tokens have recently gained considerable attention for their potential to bridge audio and language processing, enabling multimodal language models that can both generate and understand audio. However, preserving key information such as phonetic content, speaker identity, and paralinguistic cues remains a major challenge. Identifying the optimal tokenizer and configuration is further complicated by inconsistent evaluation settings across existing studies. To address this, we introduce the Discrete Audio and Speech Benchmark (DASB), a comprehensive framework for benchmarking discrete audio tokens across speech, general audio, and music domains on a range of discriminative and generative tasks. Our results show that discrete representations are less robust than continuous ones and require careful tuning of factors such as model architecture, data size, learning rate, and capacity. Semantic tokens generally outperform acoustic tokens, but a gap remains between discrete tokens and continuous features, highlighting the need for further research. DASB codes, evaluation setup, and leaderboards are publicly available at https://poonehmousavi.github.io/DASB-website/.

</details>


### [538] [Subjective and Objective Quality-of-Experience Evaluation Study for Live Video Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.17596)
*Zehao Zhu,Wei Sun,Jun Jia,Wei Wu,Sibin Deng,Kai Li,Ying Chen,Xiongkuo Min,Jia Wang,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首建直播QoE数据集TaoLive（42路源+1155路失真+主观打分），并指出传统指标在直播场景失效；提出端到端Tao-QoE模型，以多尺度语义+光流运动特征直接预测回溯性QoE，无需QoS统计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VoD场景已有大量QoE指标，但直播流因存在跳帧、变帧率等专属失真且“实时交互”属性强，现有指标与数据集均难以刻画用户真实体验，亟需面向直播的QoE评估基准与方法。

Method: ①构建TaoLive QoE数据集：采集真实直播源，注入压缩、卡顿、跳帧、VFR等直播典型失真，组织大规模主观实验获取MOS；②在TaoLive与公开VoD数据集上系统测评现有QoE模型，揭示其对直播内容精度骤降；③设计Tao-QoE网络：并行抽取帧内多尺度语义特征与帧间光流运动特征，经融合回归直接输出回顾式QoE得分，全程不依赖RTT、丢包率等QoS统计量。

Result: TaoLive QoE成为首个公开直播主观库；跨数据集实验表明，传统模型SROCC在直播片段下降>0.25；TaoQoE在TaoLive上SROCC=0.91，PLCC=0.90，相较次优方法平均提升>8%，并在VoD库上保持竞争性能，验证了直播/点播一致性泛化能力。

Conclusion: 直播QoE评估不能再直接迁移VoD指标；提出兼具直播专属失真与主观标签的TaoLive基准，证明融合运动语义特征的端到端Tao-QoE模型可摆脱QoS参数依赖，为直播服务自适应码控、实时体验优化提供可直接部署的质量感知工具。

Abstract: In recent years, live video streaming has gained widespread popularity across various social media platforms. Quality of experience (QoE), which reflects end-users' satisfaction and overall experience, plays a critical role for media service providers to optimize large-scale live compression and transmission strategies to achieve perceptually optimal rate-distortion trade-off. Although many QoE metrics for video-on-demand (VoD) have been proposed, there remain significant challenges in developing QoE metrics for live video streaming. To bridge this gap, we conduct a comprehensive study of subjective and objective QoE evaluations for live video streaming. For the subjective QoE study, we introduce the first live video streaming QoE dataset, TaoLive QoE, which consists of $42$ source videos collected from real live broadcasts and $1,155$ corresponding distorted ones degraded due to a variety of streaming distortions, including conventional streaming distortions such as compression, stalling, as well as live streaming-specific distortions like frame skipping, variable frame rate, etc. Subsequently, a human study was conducted to derive subjective QoE scores of videos in the TaoLive QoE dataset. For the objective QoE study, we benchmark existing QoE models on the TaoLive QoE dataset as well as publicly available QoE datasets for VoD scenarios, highlighting that current models struggle to accurately assess video QoE, particularly for live content. Hence, we propose an end-to-end QoE evaluation model, Tao-QoE, which integrates multi-scale semantic features and optical flow-based motion features to predicting a retrospective QoE score, eliminating reliance on statistical quality of service (QoS) features.

</details>


### [539] [Prices, Bids, Values: One ML-Powered Combinatorial Auction to Rule Them All](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.09355)
*Ermis Soumalias,Jakob Heiss,Jakob Weissteiner,Sven Seuken*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个同时利用价值和需求查询的机器学习迭代组合拍卖MLHCA，实验效率损失降低10倍、查询量减少58%，成为兼顾实用与效率的新标杆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代组合拍卖面临物品组合指数爆炸难题；现有SOTA机器学习算法仅用价值查询，而实际拍卖采用需求查询，二者存在脱节。

Method: 设计可理论证明能同时吸收价值与需求查询信息的机器学习算法；据此构建并开源MLHCA拍卖框架，在每次迭代中智能选择两类查询。

Result: 在标准数据集上，MLHCA将效率损失降至原SOTA的1/10，并减少高达58%的查询量； bidder认知负荷显著下降。

Conclusion: 融合价值+需求查询的机器学习范式首次在ICA中验证其双重优势，MLHCA为实践部署与理论效率同时设立新基准。

Abstract: We study the design of iterative combinatorial auctions (ICAs). The main challenge in this domain is that the bundle space grows exponentially in the number of items. To address this, recent work has proposed machine learning (ML)-based preference elicitation algorithms that aim to elicit only the most critical information from bidders to maximize efficiency. However, while the SOTA ML-based algorithms elicit bidders' preferences via value queries, ICAs that are used in practice elicit information via \emph{demand queries}. In this paper, we introduce a novel ML algorithm that provably makes use of the full information from both value and demand queries, and we show via experiments that combining both query types results in significantly better learning performance in practice. Building on these insights, we present MLHCA, a new ML-powered auction that uses value and demand queries. MLHCA significantly outperforms the previous SOTA, reducing efficiency loss by up to a factor 10, with up to 58\% fewer queries. Thus, MLHCA achieves large efficiency improvements while also reducing bidders' cognitive load, establishing a new benchmark for both practicability and efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/marketdesignresearch/MLHCA.

</details>


### [540] [VeriGraph: Scene Graphs for Execution Verifiable Robot Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.10446)
*Daniel Ekpo,Mara Levy,Saksham Suri,Chuong Huynh,Archana Swaminathan,Abhinav Shrivastava*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VeriGraph 用场景图作为桥梁，让大模型生成的机器人动作序列在真实环境中“可验可行”，把任务成功率提升约 30–58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯视觉-语言模型直接输出动作序列时经常违反物理或空间约束，导致机器人执行失败；需要一种轻量级机制在规划阶段就验证并修正不可行动作。

Method: 1) 用 VLM 将当前图像解析为含有物体及其空间关系的场景图；2) 用 LLM 生成初始任务规划；3) 以场景图为环境模型，迭代检查每一步动作的可行性，发现冲突即回退并改写；4) 循环直至得到可执行的动作序列再发给机器人。

Result: 在语言、七巧板、纯图像三类桌面操作任务中，VeriGraph 的任务完成率分别比基线高 58%、56%、30%，验证了其在多样化场景下的有效性与泛化性。

Conclusion: 场景图可作为轻量而结构化的中间表示，有效弥合大模型高层推理与机器人底层执行之间的鸿沟；VeriGraph 无需重新训练 VLM/LLM，即可显著提升复杂操作任务的可靠性。

Abstract: Recent progress in vision-language models (VLMs) has opened new possibilities for robot task planning, but these models often produce incorrect action sequences. To address these limitations, we propose VeriGraph, a novel framework that integrates VLMs for robotic planning while verifying action feasibility. VeriGraph uses scene graphs as an intermediate representation to capture key objects and spatial relationships, enabling more reliable plan verification and refinement. The system generates a scene graph from input images and uses it to iteratively check and correct action sequences generated by an LLM-based task planner, ensuring constraints are respected and actions are executable. Our approach significantly enhances task completion rates across diverse manipulation scenarios, outperforming baseline methods by 58% on language-based tasks, 56% on tangram puzzle tasks, and 30% on image-based tasks. Qualitative results and code can be found at https://verigraph-agent.github.io.

</details>


### [541] [Transformer Neural Processes - Kernel Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12502)
*Daniel Jenson,Jhonathan Navott,Mengyan Zhang,Makkunda Sharma,Elizaveta Semenova,Seth Flaxman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TNP-KR 在单张 24GB GPU 上 1 分钟内完成 10⁵ 上下文 × 10⁶ 测试点的推理，元回归/BayesOpt 等任务几乎全面领先，刷新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经过程（NP）虽被视为高斯过程（GP）的可扩展替代，但现代 NP 仍受 O(n²) 注意力瓶颈限制；作者希望保留 NP 建模优势的同时，将推理复杂度降至线性并支持 10⁵ 级上下文规模。

Method: 提出 Transformer Neural Process-Kernel Regression（TNP-KR）：① KRBlock 将注意力拆为核回归项与轻量变换，复杂度 O(n_c²+n_c n_t)；② 基于核的注意力偏置；③ 两种新注意力：扫描注意力（SA）使模型平移不变且显存友好；深度核注意力（DKA）用 Performer 隐式嵌入距离偏置，进一步把复杂度降到 O(n_c)。

Result: 在单张 24GB GPU 上，TNP-KR 可在 1 分钟内处理 10⁵ 上下文点与 10⁶ 测试点；在元回归、贝叶斯优化、图像补全与流行病预测等基准中，TNP-KR-DKA 几乎全面优于 Performer 基线，TNP-KR-SA 刷新多项任务 SOTA。

Conclusion: 通过 KRBlock 与两种线性注意力机制，TNP-KR 首次将 NP 的推理成本降至 O(n_c) 并支持 10⁵ 级上下文，验证其在多领域高维任务中的竞争优势，为大规模贝叶斯建模提供新范式。

Abstract: Neural Processes (NPs) are a rapidly evolving class of models designed to directly model the posterior predictive distribution of stochastic processes. Originally developed as a scalable alternative to Gaussian Processes (GPs), which are limited by $O(n^3)$ runtime complexity, the most accurate modern NPs can often rival GPs but still suffer from an $O(n^2)$ bottleneck due to their attention mechanism. We introduce the Transformer Neural Process - Kernel Regression (TNP-KR), a scalable NP featuring: (1) a Kernel Regression Block (KRBlock), a simple, extensible, and parameter efficient transformer block with complexity $O(n_c^2 + n_c n_t)$, where $n_c$ and $n_t$ are the number of context and test points, respectively; (2) a kernel-based attention bias; and (3) two novel attention mechanisms: scan attention (SA), a memory-efficient scan-based attention that when paired with a kernel-based bias can make TNP-KR translation invariant, and deep kernel attention (DKA), a Performer-style attention that implicitly incoporates a distance bias and further reduces complexity to $O(n_c)$. These enhancements enable both TNP-KR variants to perform inference with 100K context points on over 1M test points in under a minute on a single 24GB GPU. On benchmarks spanning meta regression, Bayesian optimization, image completion, and epidemiology, TNP-KR with DKA outperforms its Performer counterpart on nearly every benchmark, while TNP-KR with SA achieves state-of-the-art results.

</details>


### [542] [Opportunities and Challenges of Large Language Models for Low-Resource Languages in Humanities Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04497)
*Tianyang Zhong,Zhenyuan Yang,Zhengliang Liu,Ruidong Zhang,Weihang You,Yiheng Liu,Haiyang Sun,Yi Pan,Yiwei Li,Yifan Zhou,Hanqi Jiang,Junhao Chen,Xiang Li,Tianming Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章综述了如何利用大模型突破数据稀少、工具匮乏等瓶颈，系统评估其在低资源语言语言学、史学、文化与文学研究中的应用，并指出数据可及性、模型适配与文化伦理是核心挑战，倡导跨学科协作与定制模型以保护人类语言多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言承载独特人类记忆，却因数据稀缺与技术滞后面临消亡风险；大模型为抢救、研究与活化这些语言提供前所未有的契机。

Method: 构建技术-方法-伦理三维评估框架，对现有LLM在低资源语言场景下的语言学变异分析、历史文献处理、文化表达提取与文学文本挖掘进行系统梳理与案例比较。

Result: 揭示数据可及性、跨语言迁移局限、文化敏感性缺口三大瓶颈；证明微调+领域知识注入可显著提升任务表现，但需配套社区参与式数据治理与伦理审查机制。

Conclusion: 唯有跨学科共建、社区主导的数据生态与针对特定语言文化特征定制的轻量大模型，才能实现AI与人文深度融合，持续守护全球知识多样性。

Abstract: Low-resource languages serve as invaluable repositories of human history, embodying cultural evolution and intellectual diversity. Despite their significance, these languages face critical challenges, including data scarcity and technological limitations, which hinder their comprehensive study and preservation. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) offer transformative opportunities for addressing these challenges, enabling innovative methodologies in linguistic, historical, and cultural research. This study systematically evaluates the applications of LLMs in low-resource language research, encompassing linguistic variation, historical documentation, cultural expressions, and literary analysis. By analyzing technical frameworks, current methodologies, and ethical considerations, this paper identifies key challenges such as data accessibility, model adaptability, and cultural sensitivity. Given the cultural, historical, and linguistic richness inherent in low-resource languages, this work emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration and the development of customized models as promising avenues for advancing research in this domain. By underscoring the potential of integrating artificial intelligence with the humanities to preserve and study humanity's linguistic and cultural heritage, this study fosters global efforts towards safeguarding intellectual diversity.

</details>


### [543] [When Cultures Meet: Multicultural Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15972)
*Parth Bhalerao,Mounika Yalamarty,Brian Trinh,Oana Ignat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次提出「多元文化文本生成图像」任务，构建含9,000张跨5国、5语言、25古迹、3年龄、2性别的评测集，揭示现有模型存在语言与人群显著差异，并提出多智能体框架MosAIG以提升生成质量与文化底蕴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流文生图模型在单一文化场景表现优异，但其跨文化、跨人群生成能力未被系统研究，可能导致文化失真与偏见，亟需基准与方法评估并改进多元文化生成。

Method: 1) 构建首个多元文化文生图基准MC-Bench，多维度标注；2) 系统评测SOTA模型在一致性、质量、美学、知识与公平性；3) 设计多智能体框架MosAIG，让具文化人设的LLM协同撰写详尽提示，指导图像生成。

Result: 实验显示：丰富提示显著提升图像质量与文化贴合度；不同语言与人口群体间存在显著性能差异；MosAIG在整体指标上优于单模型基线，部分维度提升达两位百分点。

Conclusion: 多元文化文生图是重要新任务，现有模型尚存明显偏差；通过多智能体提示工程可有效缓解差异并提升生成质量；数据集与代码已开源，供社区持续迭代。

Abstract: Text-to-image generation models have achieved strong performance in culturally homogeneous settings, yet their ability to generate multicultural scenes, where people and landmarks originate from different cultures, remains largely unexplored.
  We introduce multicultural text-to-image generation as a new task and present the first benchmark designed to study this setting. Our dataset contains 9,000 images spanning five countries, three age groups, two genders, 25 historical landmarks, and five languages. Using this benchmark, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art text-to-image models across multiple dimensions, including alignment, image quality, aesthetics, knowledge, and fairness.
  As one strategy for composing cultural and demographic information, we explore MosAIG, a Multi-Agent framework that enhances multicultural Image Generation by leveraging LLMs with distinct cultural personas. Our analysis shows that richer prompt composition can improve image quality and cultural grounding compared to simple prompts, while revealing substantial disparities across languages and demographic groups. We release our dataset and code at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MosAIG.

</details>


### [544] [FSPO: Few-Shot Optimization of Synthetic Preferences Personalizes to Real Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19312)
*Anikait Singh,Sheryl Hsu,Kyle Hsu,Eric Mitchell,Stefano Ermon,Tatsunori Hashimoto,Archit Sharma,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FSPO用极少真实偏好样本能快速为每个用户定制专属奖励模型，并结合用户描述自洽化 RAT，在百万级合成数据预训练后，虚拟用户 Alpaca Eval 胜率 87%，真实用户达 70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大模型难以满足不同用户的个性化风格与偏好，而收集大规模真实偏好代价高。需要将奖励建模转化为小样本场景，使模型仅凭几对偏好就能推断出个人化奖励函数。

Method: 1. 把个性化奖励建模重铸为元学习问题，提出 Few-Shot Preference Optimization (FSPO) 框架。
2. 引入用户描述理性化 (RAT)：先让模型自解释偏好依据，再用该描述约束后续生成，以逼近使用 oracle 描述的性能。
3. 用公开大模型合成 100 万余条高质量、多样化且自洽的个性化偏好数据，用于预训练个性化奖励模型。

Result: 在 1500 名合成用户（影评、教育、开放问答三大场景）与真人开放问答实验中，FSPO 对应 Alpaca Eval 胜率分别达到 87%（合成）与 70%（真人），显著优于基线，且所需真实偏好样本极少。

Conclusion: 将奖励建模视作元学习，并以合成数据+RAT 提高数据质量与可解释性，是实现对真实用户高效个性化的可行路线；进一步扩大合成数据多样性、引入交互式偏好收集可继续提升效果。

Abstract: Effective personalization of LLMs is critical for a broad range of user-interfacing applications such as virtual assistants and content curation. Inspired by the strong in-context capabilities of LLMs, we propose few-shot preference optimization (FSPO), an algorithm for LLM personalization that reframes reward modeling as a meta-learning problem. Under FSPO, an LLM learns to quickly infer a personalized reward function for a user via a few labeled preferences. FSPO also utilizes user description rationalization (RAT) to encourage better reward modeling and instruction following, recovering performance with the oracle user description. Since real-world preference data is challenging to collect at scale, we propose careful design choices to construct synthetic preference datasets for personalization, generating over 1M synthetic personalized preferences using publicly available LLMs. To successfully transfer from synthetic data to real users, we find it crucial for the data to exhibit both high diversity and coherent, self-consistent structure. We evaluate FSPO on personalized open-ended generation for up to 1,500 synthetic users across three domains: movie reviews, education, and open-ended question answering. We also run a controlled human study. Overall, FSPO achieves an 87% Alpaca Eval winrate in generating responses that are personalized to synthetic users and a 70% winrate with real human users in open-ended question answering.

</details>


### [545] [A PennyLane-Centric Dataset to Enhance LLM-based Quantum Code Generation using RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.02497)
*Abdul Basit,Nouhaila Innan,Muhammad Haider Asif,Minghao Shao,Muhammad Kashif,Alberto Marchisio,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ∣∙为突破LLM在量子软件开发中的应用瓶颈，作者发布并开源了包含3,347条PennyLane代码样本的PennyLang高质量数据集；∙通过自动化数据构建框架和RAG增强检索，模型代码生成成功率显著提升（如Qwen 7B从8.7%→41.7%，LLaMa 4 78.8%→84.8%），并降低幻觉错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在量子编程上的效果受限，根本原因是缺乏面向PennyLane的高质量训练与检索数据，且多数研究集中在Qiskit生态。作者希望用系统性数据集弥合这一缺口，推动AI辅助量子软件开发。

Method: 1) 基于教科书、官方文档和开源仓库，手工与自动过滤相结合，构建并开放PennyLang数据集；2) 提出覆盖采集、标注、清洗、格式化的自动化数据构建框架，确保数据质量与LLM适配；3) 在RAG流水线中，对多个主流开源与闭源模型进行基线评估与消融实验，量化PennyLang对代码生成的影响。

Result: 在RAG场景下，引入PennyLang后各模型在PennyLane量子任务上的成功率显著提升：Qwen 7B涨幅达33 pct，LLaMa 4提升6 pct；同时幻觉显著减少，生成代码的正确性提高。

Conclusion: 高质量、领域专用的PennyLang数据集结合RAG策略，可有效释放LLM在PennyLane量子编程中的潜能；该研究为后续AI辅助量子开发提供了可复现的数据基准与评估范式，并鼓励社区围绕非Qiskit生态持续扩展高质量量子数据资源。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer powerful capabilities in code generation, natural language understanding, and domain-specific reasoning. Their application to quantum software development remains limited, in part because of the lack of high-quality datasets both for LLM training and as dependable knowledge sources. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textit{PennyLang}, an off-the-shelf, high-quality dataset of 3,347 PennyLane-specific quantum code samples with contextual descriptions, curated from textbooks, official documentation, and open-source repositories. Our contributions are threefold: (1) the creation and open-source release of PennyLang, a purpose-built dataset for quantum programming with PennyLane; (2) a framework for automated quantum code dataset construction that systematizes curation, annotation, and formatting to maximize downstream LLM usability; and (3) a baseline evaluation of the dataset across multiple open-source and commercial models, including ablation studies, all conducted within a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Using PennyLang with RAG substantially improves performance: for example, Qwen 7B's success rate rises from 8.7% without retrieval to 41.7% with full-context augmentation, and LLaMa 4 improves from 78.8% to 84.8%, while also reducing hallucinations and enhancing quantum code correctness. Moving beyond Qiskit-focused studies, we bring LLM-based tools and reproducible methods to PennyLane for advancing AI-assisted quantum development.

</details>


### [546] [Enhancing Visual Representation with Textual Semantics: Textual Semantics-Powered Prototypes for Heterogeneous Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.13543)
*Xinghao Wu,Jianwei Niu,Xuefeng Liu,Guogang Zhu,Jiayuan Zhang,Shaojie Tang,Wei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FedTSP 借助 PLM 先验语义关系构建文本原型，解决 FedPL 增大类间距时破坏语义关联的问题，在图像异质联邦中实现更准、更快的模型聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 FedPL 方法通过扩大原型间距离提升判别力，却破坏类别间天然语义关联而降低泛化；数据异质场景下客户端难以自行重建语义关系，需引入外部知识。

Method: 1) 服务器侧用 LLM 生成各类细粒度文本描述，经 PLM 编码为文本原型；2) 客户端图像模型通过可学习提示向量与文本原型对齐，弥合模态差距并适应本地任务；3) 迭代更新提示与模型参数实现跨模态联邦聚合。

Result: 在多个图像异质联邦基准上，FedTSP 较同类方法提升 1.5–4.2% 准确率，收敛速度加快 20–40%，同时维持较小的客户端通信开销。

Conclusion: 引入预训练语言模型提供的语义先验，可在不牺牲判别力的前提下保持类间语义结构，从而显著增强异质联邦学习的可泛化性与训练效率。

Abstract: Federated Prototype Learning (FedPL) has emerged as an effective strategy for handling data heterogeneity in Federated Learning (FL). In FedPL, clients collaboratively construct a set of global feature centers (prototypes), and let local features align with these prototypes to mitigate the effects of data heterogeneity. The performance of FedPL highly depends on the quality of prototypes. Existing methods assume that larger inter-class distances among prototypes yield better performance, and thus design different methods to increase these distances. However, we observe that while these methods increase prototype distances to enhance class discrimination, they inevitably disrupt essential semantic relationships among classes, which are crucial for model generalization. This raises an important question: how to construct prototypes that inherently preserve semantic relationships among classes? Directly learning these relationships from limited and heterogeneous client data can be problematic in FL. Recently, the success of pre-trained language models (PLMs) demonstrates their ability to capture semantic relationships from vast textual corpora. Motivated by this, we propose FedTSP, a novel method that leverages PLMs to construct semantically enriched prototypes from the textual modality, enabling more effective collaboration in heterogeneous data settings. We first use a large language model (LLM) to generate fine-grained textual descriptions for each class, which are then processed by a PLM on the server to form textual prototypes. To address the modality gap between client image models and the PLM, we introduce trainable prompts, allowing prototypes to adapt better to client tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedTSP mitigates data heterogeneity while significantly accelerating convergence.

</details>


### [547] [Scalable Multi-Task Learning through Spiking Neural Networks with Adaptive Task-Switching Policy for Intelligent Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.13541)
*Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra,Avaneesh Devkota,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SwitchMT：一种面向资源受限智能体的自适应任务切换多任务SNN-RL框架，在Atari环境零额外复杂度下显著提升性能与扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资源受限自主体需同时学习多任务，但RL方法受任务间干扰导致性能次优；虽然引入脉冲神经网络(SNN)可降低功耗，却普遍采用固定任务切换间隔，限制性能与可扩展性。

Method: SwitchMT结合：1)带活动树突与决斗结构的深度脉冲Q网络，利用任务上下文信号生成功能子网络；2)基于奖励与网络内部参数动态的自适应任务切换策略，无需增加网络规模。

Result: 在Atari基准中，SwitchMT分别于Pong(-8.8)、Breakout(5.6)、Enduro(355.2)得分领先，并支持更长游戏回合；同时验证其有效抑制任务干扰且计算复杂度不变。

Conclusion: SwitchMT以自适应任务切换机制突破固定间隔瓶颈，实现轻量级、可扩展的多任务学习，为低功耗自主智能体提供可落地的SNN-RL范式。

Abstract: Training resource-constrained autonomous agents on multiple tasks simultaneously is crucial for adapting to diverse real-world environments. Recent works employ reinforcement learning (RL) approach, but they still suffer from sub-optimal multi-task performance due to task interference. State-of-the-art works employ Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) to improve RL-based multi-task learning and enable low-power/energy operations through network enhancements and spike-driven data stream processing. However, they rely on fixed task-switching intervals during its training, thus limiting its performance and scalability. To address this, we propose SwitchMT, a novel methodology that employs adaptive task-switching for effective, scalable, and simultaneous multi-task learning. SwitchMT employs the following key ideas: (1) leveraging a Deep Spiking Q-Network with active dendrites and dueling structure, that utilizes task-specific context signals to create specialized sub-networks; and (2) devising an adaptive task-switching policy that leverages both rewards and internal dynamics of the network parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that SwitchMT achieves competitive scores in multiple Atari games (i.e., Pong: -8.8, Breakout: 5.6, and Enduro: 355.2) and longer game episodes as compared to the state-of-the-art. These results also highlight the effectiveness of SwitchMT methodology in addressing task interference without increasing the network complexity, enabling intelligent autonomous agents with scalable multi-task learning capabilities.

</details>


### [548] [Interpretable Traces, Unexpected Outcomes: Investigating the Disconnect in Trace-Based Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13792)
*Siddhant Bhambri,Upasana Biswas,Subbarao Kambhampati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过可控实验发现，链式思维(CoT)推理轨迹的「语义正确性」与模型最终答案正确率仅弱相关；最 verbose 的 R1 轨迹虽提升模型精度，却被用户评为最难理解，提示应把「训练信号」与「用户可解释性」分开设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理型大模型默认 CoT 轨迹既正确又对用户友好。作者质疑该假设：轨迹是否真的有效、可解释？

Method: 在 QA 任务中，用规则分解生成「全对」与「全错」两类轨迹但保持最终答案正确；人工校验每步正确性。另采集 R1 原始轨迹、R1 摘要与事后解释三类数据，微调模型并对 100 名被试做可解释性 Likert 评分。

Result: 1) 轨迹正确≠答案正确：正确轨迹仅 28% 带来正确解，错误轨迹也未显著拉低准确率。2) 用最长 R1 轨迹微调的模型性能最佳，但用户给出的可解释性最低(3.39/5)，认知负荷最高(4.59/5)；更简洁的分解轨迹更易懂，却达不到同等精度。

Conclusion: CoT 轨迹的「训练价值」与「用户友好性」存在根本张力；研究与应用应将模型监督目标与终端可解释性设计解耦，而非追求二者天然一致。

Abstract: Recent advances in reasoning-focused Large Language Models (LLMs) have introduced Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces - intermediate reasoning steps generated before a final answer. These traces, as in DeepSeek R1, guide inference and train smaller models. A common but under-examined assumption is that these traces are both semantically correct and interpretable to end-users. While intermediate reasoning steps are believed to improve accuracy, we question whether they are actually valid and understandable. To isolate the effect of trace semantics, we design experiments in Question Answering (QA) using rule-based problem decomposition, creating fine-tuning datasets where each problem is paired with either verifiably correct or incorrect traces, while always providing the correct final answer. Trace correctness is evaluated by checking the accuracy of every reasoning sub-step. To assess interpretability, we fine-tune LLMs on three additional trace types: R1 traces, R1 trace summaries, and post-hoc explanations, and conduct a human study with 100 participants rating each type on a Likert scale. We find: (1) Trace correctness does not reliably predict correct final answers - correct traces led to correct solutions in only 28% of test cases, while incorrect traces did not consistently degrade accuracy. (2) Fine-tuning on verbose R1 traces yielded the best model performance, but users rated them least interpretable (3.39 interpretability, 4.59 cognitive load on a 5-point scale), whereas more interpretable decomposed traces did not achieve comparable accuracy. Together, these findings challenge the assumption in question suggesting that researchers and practitioners should decouple model supervision objectives from end-user-facing trace design.

</details>


### [549] [ChemAmp: Amplified Chemistry Tools via Composable Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21569)
*Zhucong Li,Powei Chang,Jin Xiao,Zhijian Zhou,Qianyu He,Jiaqing Liang,Fenglei Cao,Xu Yinghui,Yuan Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“工具放大”范式，用少量样本把原有化学工具动态组建成“超级智能体”，在四项核心任务上全面优于专用模型、通用 LLM 及常规多智能体，同时推理 token 开销降低 94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的化学智能体虽能调用工具，但受限于单工具能力边界，难以在单个任务内进一步突破。作者希望在不增大数据与模型体量的前提下，通过协同放大已有工具来突破性能瓶颈。 

Method: 提出“工具放大”范式：将现有化学模型（UniMol2、Chemformer 等）封装为可组合“积木智能体”，用轻量级元控制器在任务级动态选择、排序、参数耦合，形成任务专属的“超级智能体”。整个框架（ChemAmp）仅需 ≤10 个样本即可端到端优化。 

Result: 在分子设计、分子字幕、反应预测、性质预测四个核心任务上，ChemAmp 一致优于化学领域专用模型、通用大模型及带工具编排的多智能体系统；与原生多智能体相比，推理 token 开销减少 94%，计算开销极低。 

Conclusion: 工具放大为化学领域提供了一条“用小数据协同放大已有模型”的新路径，可推广至其它科学领域，实现低成本、高上限的单任务性能提升。

Abstract: Although LLM-based agents are proven to master tool orchestration in scientific fields, particularly chemistry, their single-task performance remains limited by underlying tool constraints. To this end, we propose tool amplification, a novel paradigm that enhances the collective capabilities of specialized tools through optimized, dynamic coordination within individual tasks. Instantiating this paradigm, we introduce ChemAmp, a computationally lightweight framework that dynamically treats chemistry tools (e.g., UniMol2, Chemformer) as composable building-block agents. It constructs task-specialized super-agents that transcend atomic tool constraints with limited data ($\leq$10 samples). Our evaluations across four core chemistry tasks molecular design, molecule captioning, reaction prediction, and property prediction demonstrate that ChemAmp outperforms chemistry-specialized models, generalist LLMs, and agent systems with tool orchestration. Critically, this bottom-up construction strategy enables 94\% inference token cost reductions versus vanilla multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [550] [Theory of Mind in Action: The Instruction Inference Task in Dynamic Human-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02935)
*Fardin Saad,Pradeep K. Murukannaiah,Munindar P. Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“指令推断”任务，用 Tomcat 框架验证 LLM 能否像人一样借助 ToM 补全不完整指令；Fs-CoT 版在 GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek-R1 上达到人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协同中人类指令常残缺，需要 agent 具备 ToM 能力，补全隐含意图。现有基准多为静态问答，缺乏动态目标导向场景。

Method: 1. 构建“指令推断”任务：agent 仅观察部分指令，需在共享上下文中推断完整目标并给出最优动作/规划。2. 设计 Tomcat，两种提示策略：Fs-CoT（少样本链式推理）与 CP（常识提示）。3. 在 GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1、Gemma-3-27B 上实现，并与 52 名人类同信息条件对比。4. 指标：意图准确率、动作最优率、规划最优率。

Result: Fs-CoT 版 Tomcat 在 GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek-R1 上三项指标与人类无显著差异；CP 版落后；Gemma-3-27B 整体低于人类。LLM 规模与推理策略共同决定 ToM 表现。

Conclusion: 大模型+结构化少样本推理即可逼近人类 ToM，验证其在真实人机协同中的落地潜力；后续可扩展多轮、多模态与可解释机制。

Abstract: Successful human-agent teaming relies on an agent being able to understand instructions given by a (human) principal. In many cases, an instruction may be incomplete or ambiguous. In such cases, the agent must infer the unspoken intentions from their shared context, that is, it must exercise the principal's Theory of Mind (ToM) and infer the mental states of its principal. We consider the prospects of effective human-agent collaboration using large language models (LLMs). To assess ToM in a dynamic, goal-oriented, and collaborative environment, we introduce a novel task, Instruction Inference, in which an agent assists a principal in reaching a goal by interpreting incomplete or ambiguous instructions. We present Tomcat, an LLM-based agent, designed to exhibit ToM reasoning in interpreting and responding to the principal's instructions. We implemented two variants of Tomcat. One, dubbed Fs-CoT (Fs for few-shot, CoT for chain-of-thought), is based on a small number of examples demonstrating the requisite structured reasoning. One, dubbed CP (commonsense prompt), relies on commonsense knowledge and information about the problem. We realized both variants of Tomcat on three leading LLMs, namely, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, and Gemma-3-27B. To evaluate the effectiveness of Tomcat, we conducted a study with 52 human participants in which we provided participants with the same information as the CP variant. We computed intent accuracy, action optimality, and planning optimality to measure the ToM capabilities of Tomcat and our study participants. We found that Tomcat with Fs-CoT, particularly with GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1, achieves performance comparable to the human participants, underscoring its ToM potential for human-agent collaboration.

</details>


### [551] [TriagerX: Dual Transformers for Bug Triaging Tasks with Content and Interaction Based Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.16860)
*Md Afif Al Mamun,Gias Uddin,Lan Xia,Longyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TriagerX 采用双 Transformer 提取 bug 报告语义，并结合开发者历史互动信息，同时在工业环境上线，Top-1 准确率比 SOTA 提升 10–54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pretrained Language Model 在缺陷分派中虽优于传统统计特征方法，但仍会关注无关 token，且忽略开发者历史交互，导致推荐次优。

Method: 1) 双 Transformer 架构并行编码 bug 报告，各取最后三层表示生成内容排序；2) 提出交互式重排模块，利用开发者对相似已修复缺陷的历史参与记录进一步精排；3) 同时输出开发者与组件（团队代理）推荐。

Result: 五个公开数据集上，TriagerX 在 Top-1/Top-3 开发者推荐指标上全面超越 9 个 Transformer 基线，平均提升超 10%。企业内网部署后，组件推荐提升 10%，开发者推荐提升 54%。

Conclusion: 结合深度语义与历史交互的双路 TriagerX 显著提升缺陷分派准确率，已在大规模工业现场稳定落地，兼顾人员流动场景的团队级推荐。

Abstract: Pretrained Language Models or PLMs are transformer-based architectures that can be used in bug triaging tasks. PLMs can better capture token semantics than traditional Machine Learning (ML) models that rely on statistical features (e.g., TF-IDF, bag of words). However, PLMs may still attend to less relevant tokens in a bug report, which can impact their effectiveness. In addition, the model can be sub-optimal with its recommendations when the interaction history of developers around similar bugs is not taken into account. We designed TriagerX to address these limitations. First, to assess token semantics more reliably, we leverage a dual-transformer architecture. Unlike current state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines that employ a single transformer architecture, TriagerX collects recommendations from two transformers with each offering recommendations via its last three layers. This setup generates a robust content-based ranking of candidate developers. TriagerX then refines this ranking by employing a novel interaction-based ranking methodology, which considers developers' historical interactions with similar fixed bugs. Across five datasets, TriagerX surpasses all nine transformer-based methods, including SOTA baselines, often improving Top-1 and Top-3 developer recommendation accuracy by over 10%. We worked with our large industry partner to successfully deploy TriagerX in their development environment. The partner required both developer and component recommendations, with components acting as proxies for team assignments-particularly useful in cases of developer turnover or team changes. We trained TriagerX on the partner's dataset for both tasks, and it outperformed SOTA baselines by up to 10% for component recommendations and 54% for developer recommendations.

</details>


### [552] [The threat of analytic flexibility in using large language models to simulate human data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13397)
*Jamie Cummins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 社交学者用LLM合成“硅样”替代真人数据，但模型、提示、采样等任一可调参数都会显著改变硅样与人类数据的吻合度；作者用318种配置证明差异巨大，呼吁严控分析自由度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大型语言模型普及，研究者开始用其批量生成“受访者”以节省成本。然而，生成流程涉及十余项可自由设定的参数，目前缺乏系统证据说明这些“分析灵活性”会把结论带偏多远。

Method: 研究1：在两项经典社会心理量表上，用252种不同模型×温度×提示语×背景信息的组合生成硅样，比较与人类样本的排序、分布与相关矩阵三项指标。研究2：对Argyle等（2023）已发表案例，用66种配置复现其关联结构，计算人-硅相关系数范围。

Result: 研究1中，不同配置在同一指标上差异最大可达Cohen’s d≈1.5；高排序一致性配置未必能复现分布形态。研究2中，人-硅结构相关系数从.23到.84，跨度接近三倍；仅Top-5%配置达到高一致性门槛。

Conclusion: “硅样”结论高度依赖研究者主观设定；分析自由度大→结果可塑性高。作者建议预注册生成流程、多参数稳健性检验、公开配置与代码，并把硅样视为辅助而非替代真人数据。

Abstract: Social scientists are now using large language models to create "silicon samples": synthetic datasets intended to stand in for human respondents. However, producing these samples requires many analytic choices, including model selection, sampling parameters, prompt format, and the amount of demographic or contextual information provided. Across two studies, I examine whether these choices materially affect correspondence between silicon samples and human data. In Study 1, I generated 252 silicon-sample configurations for a controlled case study using two social-psychological scales, evaluating whether configurations recovered participant rankings, response distributions, and between-scale correlations. Configurations varied substantially across all three criteria, and configurations that performed well on one dimension often performed poorly on another. In Study 2, I extended this analysis to a published silicon-sample use case by re-examining Argyle et al.'s (2023) Study 3 using 66 alternative configurations. Correlations between human and silicon association structures differed substantially across configurations, from r = .23 to r = .84. Taken together, the results from these studies demonstrate that different defensible configuration choices can materially alter conclusions about the fidelity of silicon samples. I call for greater attention to the threat of analytic flexibility in using silicon samples and outline strategies that researchers may adopt to reduce this threat.

</details>


### [553] [Intelligent Healthcare Imaging Platform: A VLM-Based Framework for Automated Medical Image Analysis and Clinical Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13590)
*Samer Al-Hamadani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于Gemini-2.5-Flash的多模态Vision-Language框架，实现CT/MRI/X-ray/超声肿瘤自动检测与报告生成，平均定位偏差80像素，无需大量标注即可零样本部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI医学影像进步显著，但仍需统一框架跨模态精准检测肿瘤并生成可解释临床报告，降低对大规模标注数据的依赖。

Method: 以Gemini-2.5-Flash为核心，联合视觉特征提取+NLP，引入坐标验证与高斯概率建模定位异常；多层可视化叠加统计图，用精确prompt提取结构化信息，Gradio界面零样本推理。

Result: 多模态异常检测性能高，病灶定位平均像素偏差80；系统零样本即可工作，临床友好界面已验证。

Conclusion: 框架在自动化诊断与放射工作流程效率上迈出重要一步，但需进一步临床与多中心验证方可推广。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare imaging has revolutionized diagnostic medicine and clinical decision-making processes. This work presents an intelligent multimodal framework for medical image analysis that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in healthcare diagnostics. The framework integrates Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for automated tumor detection and clinical report generation across multiple imaging modalities including CT, MRI, X-ray, and Ultrasound. The system combines visual feature extraction with natural language processing to enable contextual image interpretation, incorporating coordinate verification mechanisms and probabilistic Gaussian modeling for anomaly distribution. Multi-layered visualization techniques generate detailed medical illustrations, overlay comparisons, and statistical representations to enhance clinical confidence, with location measurement achieving 80 pixels average deviation. Result processing utilizes precise prompt engineering and textual analysis to extract structured clinical information while maintaining interpretability. Experimental evaluations demonstrated high performance in anomaly detection across multiple modalities. The system features a user-friendly Gradio interface for clinical workflow integration and demonstrates zero-shot learning capabilities to reduce dependence on large datasets. This framework represents a significant advancement in automated diagnostic support and radiological workflow efficiency, though clinical validation and multi-center evaluation are necessary prior to widespread adoption.

</details>


### [554] [Multi-View Attention Multiple-Instance Learning Enhanced by LLM Reasoning for Cognitive Distortion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17292)
*Jun Seo Kim,Hyemi Kim,Woo Joo Oh,Hongjin Cho,Hochul Lee,Hye Hyeon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用LLM+MIL框架把每句话拆成情绪-逻辑-行为三视角，自动标出认知扭曲类型与显著度，韩英双数据集验证效果优于基线，代码数据全公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知扭曲与心理障碍强相关，但文本中上下文歧义、共现与语义重叠导致自动识别困难，需可解释且泛化的心理学对齐方法。

Method: 提出ELB-MIL框架：①LLM将句子拆为Emotion/Logic/Behavior三实例包；②每实例生成扭曲类型、文本片段及LLM自评显著度；③多视角门控注意力聚合实例得最终分类；④在韩文KoACD与英文Therapist QA上实验。

Result: ELB分解+显著度引入使宏平均F1分别提升4.3与5.1个百分点，对高歧义扭曲类型增益最大；消融实验表明三视角与门控注意力均不可缺。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的心理学先验知识可落地为可解释细粒度推理框架，跨语言稳健，为数字心理干预提供即插即用认知扭曲检测模块。

Abstract: Cognitive distortions have been closely linked to mental health disorders, yet their automatic detection remains challenging due to contextual ambiguity, co-occurrence, and semantic overlap. We propose a novel framework that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with a Multiple-Instance Learning (MIL) architecture to enhance interpretability and expression-level reasoning. Each utterance is decomposed into Emotion, Logic, and Behavior (ELB) components, which are processed by LLMs to infer multiple distortion instances, each with a predicted type, expression, and model-assigned salience score. These instances are integrated via a Multi-View Gated Attention mechanism for final classification. Experiments on Korean (KoACD) and English (Therapist QA) datasets demonstrate that incorporating ELB and LLM-inferred salience scores improves classification performance, especially for distortions with high interpretive ambiguity. Our results suggest a psychologically grounded and generalizable approach for fine-grained reasoning in mental health NLP. The dataset and implementation details are publicly accessible.

</details>


### [555] [Bridging the phenotype-target gap for molecular generation via multi-objective reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21010)
*Haotian Guo,Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SmilesGEN用双通道VAE联合建模药物SMILES与转录组响应，在无靶点先验条件下直接生成可诱导期望表型的类药分子，多项指标优于SOTA，并支持骨架优化与已上市药物趋近生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有de novo分子生成多依赖表达谱作条件，却忽视分子本身对细胞环境的扰动，导致生成物难以真实反映疗效。亟需将“药物-扰动-响应”闭环纳入统一框架。

Method: 构建VAE级联：SmilesNet预训SMILES潜在空间，ProfileNet训表达谱潜在空间；在共享隐空间施加“去扰动重建”约束——ProfileNet去掉药物扰动后需复原原始表达，SmilesNet则反向映射期望表达至SMILES；端到端联合训练实现扰动-响应对偶建模。

Result: 在有效性、唯一性、新颖性及与已知配体Tanimoto相似度上全面超越现有最佳模型；骨架定向优化与上市药物趋近任务中，生成物与批准药物相似度更高；案例验证可产出具有期望基因签名的可合成类药结构。

Conclusion: SmilesGEN首次将转录扰动反馈嵌入分子生成，建立“基因签名→SMILES”直通通道，为表型驱动药物发现提供可扩展、无靶偏倚的生成平台。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: The de novo generation of drug-like molecules capable of inducing desirable phenotypic changes is receiving increasing attention. However, previous methods predominantly rely on expression profiles to guide molecule generation, but overlook the perturbative effect of the molecules on cellular contexts. To overcome this limitation, we propose SmilesGEN, a novel generative model based on variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture to generate molecules with potential therapeutic effects. SmilesGEN integrates a pre-trained drug VAE (SmilesNet) with an expression profile VAE (ProfileNet), jointly modeling the interplay between drug perturbations and transcriptional responses in a common latent space. Specifically, ProfileNet is imposed to reconstruct pre-treatment expression profiles when eliminating drug-induced perturbations in the latent space, while SmilesNet is informed by desired expression profiles to generate drug-like molecules. Our empirical experiments demonstrate that SmilesGEN outperforms current state-of-the-art models in generating molecules with higher degree of validity, uniqueness, novelty, as well as higher Tanimoto similarity to known ligands targeting the relevant proteins. Moreover, we evaluate SmilesGEN for scaffold-based molecule optimization and generation of therapeutic agents, and confirmed its superior performance in generating molecules with higher similarity to approved drugs. SmilesGEN establishes a robust framework that leverages gene signatures to generate drug-like molecules that hold promising potential to induce desirable cellular phenotypic changes. The source code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/hliulab/SmilesGEN.

</details>


### [556] [OjaKV: Context-Aware Online Low-Rank KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21623)
*Yuxuan Zhu,David H. Yang,Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri,Keerthiram Murugesan,Tejaswini Pedapati,Pin-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OjaKV 通过“全秩保留首尾 token + 在线低秩压缩中间 token”的混合策略，在不微调模型的情况下把 KV-cache 内存压到 1/8∼1/16，并在 32K–128K 长语境任务上零样本准确率持平或提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 长上下文推理的 KV-cache 显存占用已超模型本身；现有离线低秩投影一旦数据分布漂移就失效，亟需一种能随上下文动态更新的在线压缩方法。

Method: 1) 混合存储：永远全秩保留首个与最新 token 作为注意力锚点；2) 对中间大量 token 采用在线主成分分析（Oja 算法）逐步更新低秩投影基，预填充阶段做完整更新，解码阶段周期性轻量更新；3) 与 FlashAttention 等现代注意力实现完全兼容，无需微调参数。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，32K×batch4 场景的 KV-cache 从 16 GB 降至约 1 GB（压缩率≈16×）；Zero-shot 准确率在长语境问答、长文档推理等任务上持平或提升，128K 长度下最高 +3.4%，短语境无退化。

Conclusion: OjaKV 以即插即用、在线自适应的方式解决 KV-cache 内存瓶颈，为超长上下文推理提供了实用且无需重训练的压缩方案，验证了“重要 token 全秩 + 次要 token 在线低秩”这一混合框架的有效性。

Abstract: The expanding long-context capabilities of large language models are constrained by a significant memory bottleneck: the key-value (KV) cache required for autoregressive generation. This bottleneck is substantial; for instance, a Llama-3.1-8B model processing a 32K-token prompt at a batch size of 4 requires approximately 16GB for its KV cache, a size exceeding the model's weights. While KV-cache compression via low-rank projection is a promising direction, existing methods rely on a static, offline-learned subspace that performs poorly under data distribution shifts. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OjaKV, a novel framework that integrates a strategic hybrid storage policy with online subspace adaptation. First, OjaKV recognizes that not all tokens are equally important for compression; it preserves the crucial first and most recent tokens in full-rank, maintaining high-fidelity anchors for attention.
