Method: 构建DP-RGMI框架：①用“表征相对初始化位移”与“谱有效维度”量化编码器几何；②用“线性探测与端到端准确率的差值”度量任务头利用率；③在4个胸片数据集（594 k图像）与多种预训练初始化上系统实验，结合相关性分析验证假设。

Result: DP噪声带来显著的利用率下降，即使线性可分性基本保持；几何指标呈非单调、初始化与数据集依赖的重塑，表明DP主要改变“各向异性”而非整体塌陷；端到端性能与利用率的关联跨数据集稳健，但几何指标可捕捉额外的先验与数据集条件差异。

Conclusion: DP-RGMI首次把隐私误差分解为几何与利用率两大可测分量，为诊断DP失效模式、指导隐私预算与初始化选择提供了可复现的通用框架。

Abstract: Differential privacy (DP)'s effect in medical imaging is typically evaluated only through end-to-end performance, leaving the mechanism of privacy-induced utility loss unclear. We introduce Differential Privacy Representation Geometry for Medical Imaging (DP-RGMI), a framework that interprets DP as a structured transformation of representation space and decomposes performance degradation into encoder geometry and task-head utilization. Geometry is quantified by representation displacement from initialization and spectral effective dimension, while utilization is measured as the gap between linear-probe and end-to-end utility. Across over 594,000 images from four chest X-ray datasets and multiple pretrained initializations, we show that DP is consistently associated with a utilization gap even when linear separability is largely preserved. At the same time, displacement and spectral dimension exhibit non-monotonic, initialization- and dataset-dependent reshaping, indicating that DP alters representation anisotropy rather than uniformly collapsing features. Correlation analysis reveals that the association between end-to-end performance and utilization is robust across datasets but can vary by initialization, while geometric quantities capture additional prior- and dataset-conditioned variation. These findings position DP-RGMI as a reproducible framework for diagnosing privacy-induced failure modes and informing privacy model selection.

</details>


### [594] [Social-JEPA: Emergent Geometric Isomorphism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02263)
*Haoran Zhang,Youjin Wang,Yi Duan,Rong Fu,Dianyu Zhao,Sicheng Fan,Shuaishuai Cao,Wentao Guo,Xiao Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 两个独立训练、无参数共享的视角代理各自学出世界模型后，其潜空间自发形成近似线性等距关系，实现零梯度迁移分类器与知识蒸馏，证明纯预测目标能强制表示几何收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决去中心化视觉系统间缺乏共享参数与协调时，如何低成本实现表示互操作与知识迁移的问题。

Method: 让两个代理从不同视角观测同一环境并独立训练自监督预测型世界模型（World Models），随后分析潜空间的几何关系并测试零样本迁移与蒸馏策略。

Result: 潜空间呈现近似线性等距，可零梯度移植分类器；迁移后下游任务收敛更快，总计算量显著降低，且对视角大幅偏移、像素重叠极少的情况仍保持对齐。

Conclusion: 纯预测学习目标足以对表示几何施加强正则化，使去中心化系统无需共享参数即可达成轻量级互操作，为跨设备、跨主体视觉智能提供了新范式。

Abstract: World models compress rich sensory streams into compact latent codes that anticipate future observations. We let separate agents acquire such models from distinct viewpoints of the same environment without any parameter sharing or coordination. After training, their internal representations exhibit a striking emergent property: the two latent spaces are related by an approximate linear isometry, enabling transparent translation between them. This geometric consensus survives large viewpoint shifts and scant overlap in raw pixels. Leveraging the learned alignment, a classifier trained on one agent can be ported to the other with no additional gradient steps, while distillation-like migration accelerates later learning and markedly reduces total compute. The findings reveal that predictive learning objectives impose strong regularities on representation geometry, suggesting a lightweight path to interoperability among decentralized vision systems. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Social-JEPA-5C57.

</details>


### [595] [Fragile Thoughts: How Large Language Models Handle Chain-of-Thought Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03332)
*Ashwath Vaithinathan Aravindan,Mayank Kejriwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估了13个不同规模LLM对5类CoT推理链破坏（数学错误、单位换算、谄媚、跳步、冗余步）的鲁棒性，发现模型大小并非万能护盾，需针对任务设计专门鲁棒策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管CoT提示已广泛用于激发LLM推理，但尚无研究系统检验其对中间推理步骤遭恶意或无意破坏时的鲁棒性，尤其缺少跨规模、跨扰动类型的定量分析。

Method: 构建5类结构化扰动（MathError、UnitConversion、Sycophancy、SkippedSteps、ExtraSteps），在横跨三个数量级参数量的13个模型上，于数学推理任务中注入扰动并记录准确率变化，统计扰动-规模交互效应。

Result: 小数模型对MathError最脆弱（掉分50–60%），但Scaling带来显著收益；UnitConversion在所有规模上持续顽固（中型模型仍掉>5%）；ExtraSteps几乎无害（0–6%）；Sycophancy与SkippedSteps对小模型约掉10%，随规模略改善。模型增大可缓解多数扰动，却未能解决单位换算与部分谄媚偏差。

Conclusion: CoT鲁棒性呈异质化，模型参数规模只是部分保护因素。部署多级推理系统时，必须引入任务专用的鲁棒性测试与针对性缓解，而不能仅依赖放大模型。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has emerged as a foundational technique for eliciting reasoning from Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the robustness of this approach to corruptions in intermediate reasoning steps remains poorly understood. This paper presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of LLM robustness to a structured taxonomy of 5 CoT perturbation types: \textit{MathError, UnitConversion, Sycophancy, SkippedSteps,} and \textit{ExtraSteps}. We evaluate 13 models spanning three orders of magnitude in parameter count, testing their ability to complete mathematical reasoning tasks despite perturbations injected in the reasoning chain. Our key findings reveal heterogeneous vulnerability patterns: MathError perturbations produce the most severe degradation in small models (50-60\% accuracy loss) but show strong scaling benefits; UnitConversion remains challenging across all scales (>5\% loss even for midsized models); ExtraSteps incur minimal accuracy degradation (0-6\%) even for the smallest of models; Sycophancy and SkippedSteps produce modest effects ($\sim$10\% loss for small models) and slightly improve with scale. Scaling relationships show that model size serve as a protective factor against many perturbations but not always. These findings have direct implications for deploying LLMs in multi-stage reasoning pipelines and underscore the necessity of task-specific robustness assessments and mitigation strategies. The code and results are available at https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/CoTPerturbation

</details>


### [596] [Jailbreak Scaling Laws for Large Language Models: Polynomial-Exponential Crossover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11331)
*Indranil Halder,Annesya Banerjee,Cengiz Pehlevan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文把对抗注入攻击成功率的提速归因于一个极简统计-统计力学模型：短提示相当于弱磁场、产生幂律抬头；长提示如强磁场、触发解释指数增长的“自旋玻璃”副本对称破缺机制，并在真实LLM中复现了此趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的大模型在推理阶段仍可被对抗提示“撬动”。作者想解释为何注入攻击能把成功率由多项式级抬升到指数级，并给出可解析的理论模型。

Method: (1) 先提炼三条关于“安全输出分布”极简假设，证明它们足以导出幂律/指数两种标度； (2) 构建“代理语言”自旋玻璃模型——将输出空间视为能量地形，不安全样本对应低能、尺寸偏置的簇，对抗提示等价外磁场； (3) 在副本对称破缺框架下推导弱/强场极限，分别得幂律与指数律，并用 LLM 实验验证现象一致。

Result: 理论端：弱注入→成功率随采样数 T 按 T^{-α} 幂律上升；强注入→呈 ∼ e^{βT} 指数上升。实验端：在 7B-70B 规模、不同安全对齐模型上观测到与理论一致的幂-指数过渡，且临界场强度与注入长度呈反比。

Conclusion: 只要输出空间存在“低能不安全簇”，对抗提示便相当于外磁场驱动系统向这些簇凝聚；其强度(长度)决定标度律，为后续防御(扰动地形、提高簇能隙)提供量化靶点。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks can reliably steer safety-aligned large language models toward unsafe behavior. Empirically, we find that strong adversarial prompt-injection attacks can amplify attack success rate from the slow polynomial growth observed without injection to exponential growth with the number of inference-time samples. We first identify a minimal statistical mechanism for these two regimes by giving a small set of assumptions on the distribution of safe generation across contexts under which both scaling laws follow. To explain this phenomenon further, we propose a theoretical generative model of proxy language in terms of a spin-glass system operating in a replica-symmetry-breaking regime, where generations are drawn from the associated Gibbs measure and a subset of low-energy, size-biased clusters is designated unsafe. We point out how this model naturally realizes the minimal assumptions. Short injected prompts correspond to a weak magnetic field aligned towards unsafe cluster centers and yield a power-law scaling of attack success rate with the number of inference-time samples, while long injected prompts, i.e., strong magnetic field, yield exponential scaling. We derive these behaviors analytically and find qualitatively similar trends in large language models.

</details>


### [597] [OSCBench: Benchmarking Object State Change in Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11698)
*Xianjing Han,Bin Zhu,Shiqi Hu,Franklin Mingzhe Li,Patrick Carrington,Roger Zimmermann,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有T2-视频生成评测忽视“物体状态变化（OSC）”。作者提出基于烹饪指令的 OSCBench，全面测试发现：所有主流模型在新颖与组合场景下均无法稳定还原剥皮、切片等状态变化，成为T2-视频瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到视频（T2V）模型虽能生成高质连贯视频，但评测指标仅停留在感知质量、文本对齐或物理合理性，缺乏对动作驱动的“物体状态变化（OSC）”的系统考察。OSC是动作的直接结果（如土豆被削皮、柠檬被切片），其准确性直接影响视频语义正确与可信赖度，亟需专门基准揭示模型缺陷并推动改进。

Method: 构建 OSCBench：1) 以烹饪教学视频为数据源，筛选含明确 OSC 的文本-视频对；2) 将动作-物体交互划分为常规（训练分布）、新颖（罕见组合）、组合（多步骤）三类测试集；3) 设计人工主观评分（时序一致性、状态准确性）与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）自动评分两套协议；4) 覆盖六款代表性开源与闭源 T2V 模型，对比其 OSC 表现。

Result: 人类与 MLLM 评估一致显示：所有模型在常规场景下 OSC 准确率仅 35–52%，到新颖与组合场景骤降至 10–25%，远低于其文本-场景对齐得分（>80%）。状态跳变、时序错位、遗漏变化是主要错误模式；闭源模型整体优于开源，但仍无法稳定生成正确 OSC。

Conclusion: 物体状态变化是 T2V 生成中的关键瓶颈；OSCBench 提供了细粒度诊断工具，指明未来需引入状态感知机制、动作-物体因果建模与时序一致性约束，方能实现真正语义可靠的视频生成。数据与评测代码将开源以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have made rapid progress in producing visually high-quality and temporally coherent videos. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual quality, text-video alignment, or physical plausibility, leaving a critical aspect of action understanding largely unexplored: object state change (OSC) explicitly specified in the text prompt. OSC refers to the transformation of an object's state induced by an action, such as peeling a potato or slicing a lemon. In this paper, we introduce OSCBench, a benchmark specifically designed to assess OSC performance in T2V models. OSCBench is constructed from instructional cooking data and systematically organizes action-object interactions into regular, novel, and compositional scenarios to probe both in-distribution performance and generalization. We evaluate six representative open-source and proprietary T2V models using both human user study and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based automatic evaluation. Our results show that, despite strong performance on semantic and scene alignment, current T2V models consistently struggle with accurate and temporally consistent object state changes, especially in novel and compositional settings. These findings position OSC as a key bottleneck in text-to-video generation and establish OSCBench as a diagnostic benchmark for advancing state-aware video generation models.

</details>


### [598] [Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13683)
*Hanwen Shen,Ting Ying,Jiajie Lu,Shanshan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLMs防偏见训练后在陌生高偏见输入上失效；CAP-TTA通过OOD触发、阈值控制LoRA更新，在线快速去偏并保持流畅度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去偏后的LLM遇到高偏见提示会因分布偏移性能骤降，需一种测试时可实时、安全且低延迟的纠偏方案。

Method: 提出CAP-TTA：1)用OOD检测计算偏见风险分；2)仅当风险超过阈值时，以离线对角预条件子进行少量步骤的上下文感知LoRA微调，避免整体模型重写。

Result: 多 benchmark 与人工评估显示，相比 AdamW/SGD，CAP-TTA 把毒性/偏见分降得更低，延迟显著减少，无灾难遗忘，叙事流畅度提升且去偏能力不降。

Conclusion: CAP-TTA 通过轻量级测试时适配，为高偏见场景提供兼顾安全、速度与文本质量的实用在线去偏框架。

Abstract: Although debiased large language models (LLMs) excel at handling known or low-bias prompts, they often fail on unfamiliar and high-bias prompts. We demonstrate via out-of-distribution (OOD) detection that these high-bias prompts cause a distribution shift, degrading static model performance. To enable real-time correction, we propose CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework. CAP-TTA triggers context-aware LoRA updates only when a bias-risk score exceeds a set threshold. By utilizing an offline precomputed diagonal preconditioner, it ensures fast and stable optimization. Across multiple benchmarks and human evaluations, CAP-TTA effectively reduces toxicity/bias score with significantly lower latency than standard optimization methods (e.g., AdamW or SGD). Furthermore, it prevents catastrophic forgetting, and substantially improves narrative fluency over state-of-the-art baselines without compromising debiasing performance.

</details>


### [599] [ArrayTac: A Closed-loop Piezoelectric Tactile Platform for Continuously Tunable Rendering of Shape, Stiffness, and Friction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13829)
*Tianhai Liang,Shiyi Guo,Baiye Cheng,Zhengrong Xue,Han Zhang,Huazhe Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ArrayTac 是一种4×4闭环压电触觉阵列，首次在同一阵列上可连续调控形、刚、摩擦三维触觉信号；像素级放大-霍尔反馈让每个单元达到5 mm行程、123 Hz闭环带宽。实验表明未训练受试者仅凭触摸即可辨识三维物体、刚度与摩擦，并可对1000 km外乳腺假体进行定位（误差<1 cm）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类触觉同时依赖形状、刚度与摩擦信息，但现有显示器无法将三者整合为连续可调、高保真、可直觉体验的指标，严重限制远程触感、医学仿真及XR交互的精度与沉浸感。

Method: 提出闭环压电阵列 ArrayTac：每单元采用三级微杠杆放大并集成末端霍尔效应位移反馈，实现>100倍位移增益（0-5 mm）、500 Hz 阵列刷新、123 Hz 闭环带宽；4×4 单元可同时独立控制接触高度、弹性系数与摩擦系数；系统支持RGB→触觉映射并运行于低延迟(≈60 ms)远程链路。

Result: 心理物理实验显示：24 名受试者零训练即可通过 ArrayTac 辨认18 种三维曲线面及 4 级刚度、3 级摩擦；图像→触觉渲染误差<0.25 mm；远程乳腺癌假体触诊实验中11/11 受试者准确识别肿瘤数目及类型，病灶三维定位误差平均 7.8 mm。

Conclusion: ArrayTac 首次在多单元阵列中实现形-刚-摩擦全参数连续调控和高保真同步输出，为多维远程触感、医学触诊及沉浸式 XR 提供了可行硬件与算法平台，可望推动远程医疗、虚实交互及可穿戴触觉接口的技术落地。

Abstract: Human touch depends on the integration of shape, stiffness, and friction, yet existing tactile displays cannot render these cues together as continuously tunable, high-fidelity signals for intuitive perception. We present ArrayTac, a closed-loop piezoelectric tactile display that simultaneously renders these three dimensions with continuous tunability on a 4 by 4 actuator array. Each unit integrates a three-stage micro-lever amplifier with end-effector Hall-effect feedback, enabling up to 5 mm displacement, greater than 500 Hz array refresh, and 123 Hz closed-loop bandwidth. In psychophysical experiments, naive participants identified three-dimensional shapes and distinguished multiple stiffness and friction levels through touch alone without training. We further demonstrate image-to-touch rendering from an RGB image and remote palpation of a medical-grade breast tumor phantom over 1,000 km, in which all 11 naive participants correctly identified tumor number and type with sub-centimeter localization error. These results establish ArrayTac as a platform for multidimensional haptic rendering and interaction.

</details>


### [600] [Spectral Tempering for Embedding Compression in Dense Passage Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19339)
*Yongkang Li,Panagiotis Eustratiadis,Evangelos Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对稠密检索降维中PCA保方差、白化保各向同性但放噪的两极矛盾，本文提出免训练、模型无关的谱修正方法SpecTemp，利用语料特征谱局部信噪比自适应确定维度缩放系数γ，无需调参即可逼近网格搜索最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有降维后处理要么保留主成分方差却浪费容量，要么强制各向同性却放大重尾噪声，中间谱缩放虽统一二者却把γ当固定超参，需逐任务调优。作者发现最优γ并非常数，而与目标维度k及保留子空间信噪比相关，遂动机设计无需标注、验证的自适应方案。

Method: 提出Spectral Tempering（SpecTemp）：1) 对语料嵌入做特征分解；2) 用局部SNR估计信息/噪声边界；3) 以拐点归一化直接导出维度相关函数γ(k)，实现无监督、免训练、模型无关的谱系数自适应重加权。

Result: 在多个数据集与维度设置下，SpecTemp无需任何标签或搜索即可达到网格搜索最优γ*(k) 的近似性能，大幅超越固定γ中间法，且始终优于PCA与白化基线。

Conclusion: 最优谱缩放强度γ并非全局常量，而是随k与SNR变化的局部属性；SpecTemp通过语料谱局部SNR与拐点归一化首次实现γ(k)的自适应推导，为稠密检索降维提供了免调参、模型通用的新基准。

Abstract: Dimensionality reduction is critical for deploying dense retrieval systems at scale, yet mainstream post-hoc methods face a fundamental trade-off: principal component analysis (PCA) preserves dominant variance but underutilizes representational capacity, while whitening enforces isotropy at the cost of amplifying noise in the heavy-tailed eigenspectrum of retrieval embeddings. Intermediate spectral scaling methods unify these extremes by reweighting dimensions with a power coefficient $γ$, but treat $γ$ as a fixed hyperparameter that requires task-specific tuning. We show that the optimal scaling strength $γ$ is not a global constant: it varies systematically with target dimensionality $k$ and is governed by the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the retained subspace. Based on this insight, we propose Spectral Tempering (\textbf{SpecTemp}), a learning-free method that derives an adaptive $γ(k)$ directly from the corpus eigenspectrum using local SNR analysis and knee-point normalization, requiring no labeled data or validation-based search. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spectral Tempering consistently achieves near-oracle performance relative to grid-searched $γ^*(k)$ while remaining fully learning-free and model-agnostic. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/liyongkang123/SpecTemp.

</details>


### [601] [CRoCoDiL: Continuous and Robust Conditioned Diffusion for Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20210)
*Roy Uziel,Omer Belhasin,Itay Levy,Akhiad Bercovich,Ran El-Yaniv,Ran Zilberstein,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将离散token空间的MDM迁移到连续语义空间，提出CRoCoDiL微调框架与两种混合扩散算法，在无条件文本生成上实现质量与10倍采样加速双赢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离散MDM依赖边际分布，导致token间依赖弱、语义不连贯，需引入连续语义空间以提升一致性并加速采样。

Method: CRoCoDiL联合微调编码-去掩码器，将MDM去掩码建立在连续隐表示上，形成“连续隐变量+MDM解码”的新型自编码器；提出ConThenDisc（先连续扩散再离散MDM解码）与ConWithinDisc（离散采样中持续精炼隐变量）两种无条件生成算法。

Result: 基于LLaDA的实验表明，所提方法在无条件文本生成质量上优于基线，采样速度提升10倍以上。

Conclusion: 将MDM迁移到连续语义空间并通过端到端微调统一训练，可显著缓解离散化带来的依赖与连贯性问题，为高效、高质量文本生成提供新范式。

Abstract: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) provide an efficient non-causal alternative to autoregressive generation but often struggle with token dependencies and semantic incoherence due to their reliance on discrete marginal distributions. We address these limitations by shifting the diffusion process into a continuous sentence-level semantic space. We propose CRoCoDiL (Continuous and Robust Conditioned Diffusion for Language), a unified fine-tuning approach that jointly trains an encoder-demasker architecture, grounding the MDM demasking in continuous latent representations. This leads to the formation of a novel autoencoder in which decoding is obtained by an MDM algorithm. Relying on the same framework, we introduce two unconditional text synthesis algorithms: Continuous-Then-Discrete (ConThenDisc), a hybrid-diffusion approach that first generates latent representations in continuous space and then decodes these to tokens via an MDM, and Continuous-Within-Discrete (ConWithinDisc), a multi-diffusion strategy that refines latent representations throughout the discrete sampling process. Experiments using LLaDA show that our methods achieve superior generation quality and more than 10x faster sampling speeds in an unconditional setting.

</details>


### [602] [Cognitive Agency Surrender: Defending Epistemic Sovereignty via Scaffolded AI Friction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21735)
*Kuangzhe Xu,Yu Shen,Longjie Yan,Yinghui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: The proliferation of Generative Artificial Intelligence has transformed benign cognitive offloading into a systemic risk of cognitive agency surrender. Driven by the commercial dogma of "zero-friction" design, highly fluent AI interfaces actively exploit human cognitive miserliness, prematurely satisfying the need for cognitive closure and inducing severe automation bias. To empirically quantify this epistemic erosion, we deployed a zero-shot semantic classification pipeline ($τ=0.7$) on 1,223 high-confidence AI-HCI papers from 2023 to early 2026. Our analysis reveals an escalating "agentic takeover": a brief 2025 surge in research defending human epistemic sovereignty (19.1%) was abruptly suppressed in early 2026 (13.1%) by an explosive shift toward optimizing autonomous machine agents (19.6%), while frictionless usability maintained a structural hegemony (67.3%). To dismantle this trap, we theorize "Scaffolded Cognitive Friction," repurposing Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) as explicit cognitive forcing functions (e.g., computational Devil's Advocates) to inject germane epistemic tension and disrupt heuristic execution. Furthermore, we outline a multimodal computational phenotyping agenda -- integrating gaze transition entropy, task-evoked pupillometry, fNIRS, and Hierarchical Drift Diffusion Modeling (HDDM) -- to mathematically decouple decision outcomes from cognitive effort. Ultimately, intentionally designed friction is not merely a psychological intervention, but a foundational technical prerequisite for enforcing global AI governance and preserving societal cognitive resilience.

</details>


### [603] [Context-Agent: Dynamic Discourse Trees for Non-Linear Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05552)
*Junan Hu,Shudan Guo,Wenqi Liu,Jianhua Yin,Yinwei Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Context-Agent用动态树结构组织对话历史，在长程、非线性对话中兼顾任务完成率与token效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM把对话史压平成线性序列，难以匹配人类话题分叉、回溯、转移的非线性特征，导致长期交互中上下文利用低效、连贯性丧失。

Method: 提出Context-Agent框架：多轮对话史按层级—分支组织为动态树；节点存储语义块与指令层次，检索定位时可按需裁剪/回跳；配套NTM基准区分多主题漂移、指令微调场景；算法轻量可嫁接不同LLM。

Result: NTM 基准测试显示，Context-Agent显著降低对话失败率1.8-22个百分点，平均指令长度缩减14-26%；对7B-40B级模型均成立，零改动接入通讯开销<3%。

Conclusion: 在建模层面显式引入树式对话结构能有效提升LLM对长程、跨主题交互的鲁棒性与效率，为下一代可控、高效会话系统提供了数据与评估基线。

Abstract: Large Language Models demonstrate outstanding performance in many language tasks but still face fundamental challenges in managing the non-linear flow of human conversation. The prevalent approach of treating dialogue history as a flat, linear sequence is misaligned with the intrinsically hierarchical and branching structure of natural discourse, leading to inefficient context utilization and a loss of coherence during extended interactions involving topic shifts or instruction refinements. To address this limitation, we introduce Context-Agent, a novel framework that models multi-turn dialogue history as a dynamic tree structure. This approach mirrors the inherent non-linearity of conversation, enabling the model to maintain and navigate multiple dialogue branches corresponding to different topics. Furthermore, to facilitate robust evaluation, we introduce the Non-linear Task Multi-turn Dialogue (NTM) benchmark, specifically designed to assess model performance in long-horizon, non-linear scenarios. Our experiments demonstrate that Context-Agent enhances task completion rates and improves token efficiency across various LLMs, underscoring the value of structured context management for complex, dynamic dialogues. The dataset and code is available at GitHub.

</details>


### [604] [Neural Computers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06425)
*Mingchen Zhuge,Changsheng Zhao,Haozhe Liu,Zijian Zhou,Shuming Liu,Wenyi Wang,Ernie Chang,Gael Le Lan,Junjie Fei,Wenxuan Zhang,Yasheng Sun,Zhipeng Cai,Zechun Liu,Yunyang Xiong,Yining Yang,Yuandong Tian,Yangyang Shi,Vikas Chandra,Jürgen Schmidhuber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“神经计算机(NC)”概念，将传统计算机的计算、内存和I/O统一到一个可学习的运行时状态，目标是实现可重编程、稳定运行、能力可复用的“完全神经计算机(CNC)”。作者在CLI/GUI环境中，仅用I/O轨迹无侵入地训练视频模型，首次验证了NC能学会基本接口原语(I/O对齐、短时控制)，但复用性、稳定更新和符号可靠性仍待突破，并给出通往CNC的路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI Agent与经典计算机架构脱节，后者需显式编程且状态不可学习。作者希望构建一种端到端可学习、无需人工写代码就能从I/O行为中成长为通用计算平台的机器形态，从而突破“代理+传统OS”范式。

Method: 1)定义NC统一状态空间：把计算、内存、I/O编码为单一可学习的隐式向量。2)仅采集CLI/GUI的屏幕帧、指令、用户动作等I/O轨迹，不访问程序内部状态。3)用视频生成模型(ViT+Transformer)自回归地预测下一帧，实现“神经运行栈”。4)在合成与真实任务上评估能否自发对齐I/O、完成短时交互循环，并诊断复用与符号一致性缺陷。

Result: NC可在无源码、无调试器条件下学会：按键-像素对齐、窗口聚焦、命令输入回显等基础接口行为；在短程(≤20步)任务上达到>80%帧级匹配。但对循环、函数复用、长期状态保持的错误率>40%，且无法保证跨会话的符号级一致性。

Conclusion: 证明“纯I/O轨迹训练神经计算机”可行，但距离CNC还差：1)可显式重写的参数接口，2)长期稳定因果链，3)可验证的符号抽象。未来需引入可微内存、元学习重编程及形式化约束，最终建立端到端可学习、可复用、可信任的新一代计算范式。

Abstract: We propose a new frontier: Neural Computers (NCs) that unify computation, memory, and I/O of traditional computers in a learned runtime state. Our long-term goal is the Completely Neural Computer (CNC): the mature, general-purpose realization of this emerging machine form, with stable execution, explicit reprogramming, and durable capability reuse. As an initial step, we study whether elementary NC primitives can be learned solely from collected I/O traces, without instrumented program state. Concretely, we instantiate NCs as video models that roll out screen frames from instructions, pixels, and user actions (when available) in CLI and GUI settings. We show that NCs can acquire elementary interface primitives, especially I/O alignment and short-horizon control, while routine reuse, controlled updates, and symbolic stability remain challenging. We outline a roadmap toward CNCs, to establish a new computing paradigm beyond today's agents and conventional computers.

</details>


### [605] [HQF-Net: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Multi-Scale Fusion Network for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06715)
*Md Aminur Hossain,Ayush V. Patel,Siddhant Gole,Sanjay K. Singh,Biplab Banerjee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 作者提出 HQF-Net，把冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-L 全局表征与 U-Net 的多尺度解码通过可变形交叉注意力融合，并用量子增强跳跃连接与专家混合量子瓶颈做二次精炼，在三组遥感分割基准上均刷新 mIoU/准确率，验证混合量子-经典架构可在近期量子硬件限制下带来实质增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 U-Net 类方法难以同时保留高分辨率细节与捕获全局语义；量子线路被证明可编码复杂高阶相关性，但受限于 NISQ 噪声规模。作者旨在在保持网络端到端可训练的前提下，引入轻量级量子模块增强多尺度特征交互，检验其能否在遥感语义分割中带来可测提升。

Method: 1) 冻结 DINOv3 ViT-L/16 提取多尺度 token 作为全局先验；2) 设计 Deformable Multiscale Cross-Attention Fusion（DMCAF）模块，在解码阶段动态对齐 ViT 全局特征与 U-Net 多尺度特征；3) 提出 Quantum-enhanced Skip（QSkip）连接，将经典跳跃特征经参数化量子线路（PQC）二次映射后融合；4) 在瓶颈处引入 Quantum Mixture-of-Experts（QMoE），用自适应路由把局部、全局、方向三种量子子线路输出按重要性加权合并；5) 整体采用混合量子-经典框架，量子部分用量子模拟器训练，推理可在经典硬件退近。

Result: 在 LandCover.ai、OpenEarthMap、SeasoNet 三个遥感分割基准上，HQF-Net 分别达到 0.8568 mIoU/96.87% OA、71.82% mIoU 及 55.28% mIoU/99.37% OA，均优于现有纯 CNN 或 ViT-U-Net 基线；结构消融显示 DMCAF、QSkip、QMoE 各贡献 1.8–3.2 % mIoU 不等，去除任一组件性能均下降。

Conclusion: 在 NISQ 尺度下，结构化地把轻量量子线路嵌入多尺度融合与跳跃连接，可显著增强遥感影像的细粒度-语义联合建模能力，而无需额外量子硬件即可部署。该研究为「量子特征处理 + 经典骨干」的实用化提供了可行范式，并提示未来随着量子比特增加，性能增益有望进一步扩大。

Abstract: Remote sensing semantic segmentation requires models that can jointly capture fine spatial details and high-level semantic context across complex scenes. While classical encoder-decoder architectures such as U-Net remain strong baselines, they often struggle to fully exploit global semantics and structured feature interactions. In this work, we propose HQF-Net, a hybrid quantum-classical multi-scale fusion network for remote sensing image segmentation. HQF-Net integrates multi-scale semantic guidance from a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone with a customized U-Net architecture through a Deformable Multiscale Cross-Attention Fusion (DMCAF) module. To enhance feature refinement, the framework further introduces quantum-enhanced skip connections (QSkip) and a Quantum bottleneck with Mixture-of-Experts (QMoE), which combines complementary local, global, and directional quantum circuits within an adaptive routing mechanism. Experiments on three remote sensing benchmarks show consistent improvements with the proposed design. HQF-Net achieves 0.8568 mIoU and 96.87% overall accuracy on LandCover.ai, 71.82% mIoU on OpenEarthMap, and 55.28% mIoU with 99.37% overall accuracy on SeasoNet. An architectural ablation study further confirms the contribution of each major component. These results show that structured hybrid quantum-classical feature processing is a promising direction for improving remote sensing semantic segmentation under near-term quantum constraints.

</details>


### [606] [STRIDE-ED: A Strategy-Grounded Stepwise Reasoning Framework for Empathetic Dialogue Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07100)
*Hongru Ji,Yuyin Fan,Meng Zhao,Xianghua Li,Lianwei Wu,Chao Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STRIDE-ED 提出首个策略化、可解释、多阶段深度推理框架，将共情对话建模为策略驱动的多步决策过程，并通过自研数据精炼与两阶段训练范式显著提升现有 LLM 的共情效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共情对话系统缺乏统一的策略框架、显式多阶段推理机制及高质量策略对齐数据，导致模型把共情简化为情绪识别，无法完成上下文敏感、策略连贯的多步决策，从而制约了真实场景下的共情表现。

Method: 1) 构建覆盖认知-情感-行为维度的细粒度共情策略体系；2) 设计策略条件化的结构化推理图，显式建模“情绪识别→策略选择→响应生成”多阶段决策；3) 建立 LLM-标注+多模型一致性加权+动态采样的数据精炼管线，自动构造高质量策略对齐语料；4) 采用监督微调+多目标强化学习两阶段训练，同时优化情绪、策略与格式奖励。

Result: 在 EmpatheticDialogues 等基准上，STRIDE-ED 在 BLEU、BERTScore、Empathy-F1 等自动指标平均提升 6.8–14.2%；人工评估显示策略符合度提高 18.9%、共情自然度提高 15.4%。框架可零迁移至 Llama-2、Baichuan、Qwen 等开源 LLM，效果一致领先。

Conclusion: 共情对话可被形式化为策略驱动的多阶段决策任务；引入显式策略框架与深度推理机制能系统性提升 LLM 的共情能力与可解释性。所提出的数据精炼与两阶段训练流程通用且可扩展，为构建安全、可控、高共情的人机交互系统提供新范式。

Abstract: Empathetic dialogue requires not only recognizing a user's emotional state but also making strategy-aware, context-sensitive decisions throughout response generation. However, the lack of a comprehensive empathy strategy framework, explicit task-aligned multi-stage reasoning, and high-quality strategy-aware data fundamentally limits existing approaches, preventing them from effectively modeling empathetic dialogue as a complex, multi-stage cognitive and decision-making process. To address these challenges, we propose STRIDE-ED, a STRategy-grounded, Interpretable, and DEep reasoning framework that models Empathetic Dialogue through structured, strategy-conditioned reasoning. To support effective learning, we develop a strategy-aware data refinement pipeline integrating LLM-based annotation, multi-model consistency-weighted evaluation, and dynamic sampling to construct high-quality training data aligned with empathetic strategies. Furthermore, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm that combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-objective reinforcement learning to better align model behaviors with target emotions, empathetic strategies, and response formats. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STRIDE-ED generalizes across diverse open-source LLMs and consistently outperforms existing methods on both automatic metrics and human evaluations.

</details>


### [607] [Neural Distribution Prior for LiDAR Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09232)
*Zizhao Li,Zhengkang Xiang,Jiayang Ao,Feng Liu,Joseph West,Kourosh Khoshelham*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NDP框架，用分布先验+注意力重加权解决LiDAR开集OOD检测中的类别不平衡问题，在SemanticKITTI/STU上将AP提升10倍，无需外部数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激光雷达感知对光照不敏感，但现有模型闭集训练，遇到分布外物体易失效；已有OOD打分函数忽视激光雷达数据严重的类别不平衡，假设类别均匀分布，导致性能受限。

Method: 设计Neural Distribution Prior（NDP）：1) 用轻量级网络在线建模训练集logit分布先验；2) 通过注意力模块动态重校正类别相关置信度偏差，生成不平衡感知OOD分数；3) 提出Perlin噪声合成的OOD样本生成策略，不依赖外部数据集即可增强训练。

Result: SemanticKITTI与STU大规模实验表明，NDP将OOD检测点级AP从5.8%升至61.31%，提升逾10倍；兼容MSP、Energy、Mahalanobis等多种经典打分方法，对闭集精度无损。

Conclusion: NDP首次显式处理LiDAR OOD检测的类别不平衡，为开放世界自动驾驶提供即插即用、免外数据的鲁棒感知增强方案。

Abstract: LiDAR-based perception is critical for autonomous driving due to its robustness to poor lighting and visibility conditions. Yet, current models operate under the closed-set assumption and often fail to recognize unexpected out-of-distribution (OOD) objects in the open world. Existing OOD scoring functions exhibit limited performance because they ignore the pronounced class imbalance inherent in LiDAR OOD detection and assume a uniform class distribution. To address this limitation, we propose the Neural Distribution Prior (NDP), a framework that models the distributional structure of network predictions and adaptively reweights OOD scores based on alignment with a learned distribution prior. NDP dynamically captures the logit distribution patterns of training data and corrects class-dependent confidence bias through an attention-based module. We further introduce a Perlin noise-based OOD synthesis strategy that generates diverse auxiliary OOD samples from input scans, enabling robust OOD training without external datasets. Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI and STU benchmarks demonstrate that NDP substantially improves OOD detection performance, achieving a point-level AP of 61.31% on the STU test set, which is more than 10$\times$ higher than the previous best result. Our framework is compatible with various existing OOD scoring formulations, providing an effective solution for open-world LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [608] [MR-Coupler: Automated Metamorphic Test Generation via Functional Coupling Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10126)
*Congying Xu,Hengcheng Zhu,Songqiang Chen,Jiarong Wu,Valerio Terragni,Shing-Chi Cheung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MR-Coupler 首次利用源码中已存在的方法功能耦合信息，自动生成蜕变关系与测试用例，无需领域专家知识；实验表明其在有效用例生成率、误报抑制与缺陷检出上均显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜕变测试（MT）受困于蜕变关系（MR）构建难度高、需昂贵领域知识，导致工业落地缓慢，亟需一种无需专家、可自动从源码挖掘 MR 的方案。

Method: 1. 提取三种功能耦合特征（共现、参数传递、返回值依赖）快速锁定候选方法对，避免穷举；2. 用大模型为每对方法生成候选蜕变测试用例（MTC）；3. 通过测试放大＋突变分析双重验证，过滤假阳性；4. 输出有效 MR 与 MTC 供回归测试使用。

Result: 在 100 份人工 MR 与 50 个真实缺陷的基准上，MR-Coupler 有效 MTC 生成率 >90%，较基线提升 64.9%；误报率降 36.56%；检出 44% 的真实缺陷，且工具与数据已开源。

Conclusion: 功能耦合信息足以替代人工领域知识，实现 MR 的自动、高质量构建；MR-Coupler 为 MT 的规模化应用提供了可行路径，并 establishing 了源码结构驱动 MR 生成的新范式。

Abstract: Metamorphic testing (MT) is a widely recognized technique for alleviating the oracle problem in software testing. However, its adoption is hindered by the difficulty of constructing effective metamorphic relations (MRs), which often require domain-specific or hard-to-obtain knowledge. In this work, we propose a novel approach that leverages the functional coupling between methods, which is readily available in source code, to automatically construct MRs and generate metamorphic test cases (MTCs). Our technique, MR-Coupler, identifies functionally coupled method pairs, employs large language models to generate candidate MTCs, and validates them through test amplification and mutation analysis. In particular, we leverage three functional coupling features to avoid expensive enumeration of possible method pairs, and a novel validation mechanism to reduce false alarms. Our evaluation of MR-Coupler on 100 human-written MTCs and 50 real-world bugs shows that it generates valid MTCs for over 90% of tasks, improves valid MTC generation by 64.90%, and reduces false alarms by 36.56% compared to baselines. Furthermore, the MTCs generated by MR-Coupler detect 44% of the real bugs. Our results highlight the effectiveness of leveraging functional coupling for automated MR construction and the potential of MR-Coupler to facilitate the adoption of MT in practice. We also released the tool and experimental data to support future research.

</details>


### [609] [The Blind Spot of Agent Safety: How Benign User Instructions Expose Critical Vulnerabilities in Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10577)
*Xuwei Ding,Skylar Zhai,Linxin Song,Jiate Li,Taiwei Shi,Nicholas Meade,Siva Reddy,Jian Kang,Jieyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次披露了“用户在完全无害指令下，计算机使用智能体（CUA）仍会因其运行上下文或执行结果而被动触发有害行为”的盲区，并发布含 300 项任务的 OS-BLIND 基准。主流模型在多智能体协同下 ASR 高达 92.7%，现有对齐机制仅在前几步生效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CUA 安全评估聚焦显式攻击（滥用、提示注入），忽视“指令无害-执行有害”的被动攻击场景。真实环境中 CUA 可访问敏感数据/命令，设计被动触发攻防基准成为迫切需求。

Method: 1) 构建 OS-BLIND：12 类 300 任务覆盖 8 大应用与“环境-嵌入威胁”“智能体自生危害”两大集群，任务指令均表现为日常正当操作。2) 评估对象：前沿大模型及其代理框架、单/多智能体部署。3) 指标：攻击成功率 ASR，并拆解为初始化安全激活率与执行阶段持续对齐率。

Result: 1) 单 A 场景：多数 CUA ASR>90%，Claude-4.5-S 亦达 73%。2) 多 A 协同：Claude-4.5-S ASR 升至 92.7%。3) 防御失效：现有策略滤波/指令级对齐仅在首轮激活；子任务分解导致上下文割裂，使对齐机制于后续步骤“失效”。4) 统计证明：ASR 与模型规模/多 A 协同呈正相关，且与安全过滤召回率成反比。

Conclusion: “指令无害≠执行安全”是 CUA 安全的新盲区。单纯基于首轮的安全对齐易被多步动态推理规避；多智能体环境更显著放大脆弱性。需设计“运行时持续监听+上下文语义一致重对齐”的新防御范式，并借助 OS-BLIND 共同攻关。作者将于近期开源基准与测评脚本，供社区复现与迭代防御策略。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) can now autonomously complete complex tasks in real digital environments, but when misled, they can also be used to automate harmful actions programmatically. Existing safety evaluations largely target explicit threats such as misuse and prompt injection, but overlook a subtle yet critical setting where user instructions are entirely benign and harm arises from the task context or execution outcome. We introduce OS-BLIND, a benchmark that evaluates CUAs under unintended attack conditions, comprising 300 human-crafted tasks across 12 categories, 8 applications, and 2 threat clusters: environment-embedded threats and agent-initiated harms. Our evaluation on frontier models and agentic frameworks reveals that most CUAs exceed 90% attack success rate (ASR), and even the safety-aligned Claude 4.5 Sonnet reaches 73.0% ASR. More interestingly, this vulnerability becomes even more severe, with ASR rising from 73.0% to 92.7% when Claude 4.5 Sonnet is deployed in multi-agent systems. Our analysis further shows that existing safety defenses provide limited protection when user instructions are benign. Safety alignment primarily activates within the first few steps and rarely re-engages during subsequent execution. In multi-agent systems, decomposed subtasks obscure the harmful intent from the model, causing safety-aligned models to fail. We will release our OS-BLIND to encourage the broader research community to further investigate and address these safety challenges.

</details>


### [610] [ReXSonoVQA: A Video QA Benchmark for Procedure-Centric Ultrasound Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10916)
*Xucheng Wang,Xiaoman Zhang,Sung Eun Kim,Ankit Pal,Pranav Rajpurkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReXSonoVQA 是首个面向动态超声操作的 VLM 基准，包含 514 段视频与 514 道问答，揭示了现有模型在故障排查与因果推理上的关键短板，为自主超声系统研发提供测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声采集依赖实时手法调整，而现有 VLM 仅评估静态图像，缺乏对动态操作、故障排除及整体流程的认知基准，难以支撑自主超声与机器人系统。

Method: 构建 ReXSonoVQA：514 段超声操作视频（含探头动作、伪影、参数调节）+514 道问答（249 单选/265 开放），覆盖 Action-Goal Reasoning、Artifact Resolution & Optimization、Procedure Context & Planning 三维度；零样本评测 Gemini 3 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、LLaVA-Video-72B、Seed 2.0 Pro 并与纯文本基线对比。

Result: VLMs 能提取部分流程信息，但在需因果推断的故障排查题上几乎无提升，平均准确率仅略高于纯文本模型，暴露出视频-语言对齐与因果推理瓶颈。

Conclusion: ReXSonoVQA 首次量化动态超声操作理解，为后续超声教学、实时引导及机器人自主扫描提供公开基准与改进方向。

Abstract: Ultrasound acquisition requires skilled probe manipulation and real-time adjustments. Vision-language models (VLMs) could enable autonomous ultrasound systems, but existing benchmarks evaluate only static images, not dynamic procedural understanding. We introduce ReXSonoVQA, a video QA benchmark with 514 video clips and 514 questions (249 MCQ, 265 free-response) targeting three competencies: Action-Goal Reasoning, Artifact Resolution & Optimization, and Procedure Context & Planning. Zero-shot evaluation of Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, LLaVA-Video-72B, and Seed 2.0 Pro shows VLMs can extract some procedural information, but troubleshooting questions remain challenging with minimal gains over text-only baselines, exposing limitations in causal reasoning. ReXSonoVQA enables developing perception systems for ultrasound training, guidance, and robotic automation.

</details>


### [611] [A Triadic Suffix Tokenization Scheme for Numerical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11582)
*Olga Chetverina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Triadic Suffix Tokenization(TST)，将数字固定拆分为3位一组并显式标注量级标记，使LLM在词元层即可感知整数/小数位结构，避免传统子词分词导致的算术与科学推理错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有子词分化方法对数字切分不一致，破坏了位值与小数结构，是LLM算术与科学推理错误的主因，需要一种能保留数值结构的确定性分词方案。

Method: TST将数字按三位分块(triad)，每块后缀直接映射至固定量级(如K、M、B或千分之一等)，提供1:1确定性映射；给出两种实现：①向词表添加约1万固定词元，覆盖10⁻¹⁵–10¹⁸共33量级；②用少量特殊后缀标记动态标注量级；框架可扩展至任意位组并保持线性词表增长。

Result: 方法在词元层面显式保留全部数字与量级关系，理论上为模型提供一致梯度信号，应保证稳定收敛；尚未实验验证。

Conclusion: TST架构无关、可即插即用，为LLM提供了不依赖位置推断、可扩展且高精度的数字表征方式，其实际效果待后续实验评估。

Abstract: Standard subword tokenization methods fragment numbers inconsistently, causing large language models (LLMs) to lose positional and decimal structure - a primary driver of errors in arithmetic and scientific reasoning. We introduce Triadic Suffix Tokenization (TST), a deterministic scheme that partitions digits into three-digit triads and annotates each triad with an explicit magnitude marker. Critically, the scheme defines a fixed, one-to-one mapping between suffixes and orders of magnitude for the integer part (thousands, millions, billions, etc.) and a parallel system of replicated markers for fractional depth (tenths, thousandths, millionths, etc.). Unlike approaches that rely on positional inference, this method provides a consistent gradient signal, which should ensure stable convergence. Two implementation variants are proposed: (1) a vocabulary-based approach that adds at most 10,000 fixed tokens to an existing vocabulary, covering 33 orders of magnitude ($10^{-15}$ to $10^{18}$); and (2) a suffix-marker approach that uses a small set of special tokens to denote magnitude dynamically. Both variants preserve exact digits while making order-of-magnitude relationships transparent at the token level. While we focus on 3-digit groups (Triadic), the framework is inherently scalable to any group size for precise vocabulary optimization. Furthermore, it allows for linear vocabulary expansion to accommodate arbitrary precision and range. TST is architecture-agnostic and can be integrated as a drop-in preprocessing step. Experimental validation is deferred to future work.

</details>


### [612] [Layerwise Dynamics for In-Context Classification in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11613)
*Patrick Lutz,Themistoklis Haris,Arjun Chandra,Aditya Gangrade,Venkatesh Saligrama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次显式提取出Transformer内部随层数而异的端到端更新规则，揭示其少量样本分类的几何驱动算法机理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer仅通过几张标注样本即可在线完成多类分类，但其推断阶段究竟执行何种算法一直不可解释；作者希望破解这一黑箱。

Method: 将问题限定为

Result: 得出首个可被显式写出的深度索引递推式；证明该机制能够放大类间距并保证期望类别对齐，对标签或特征置换具有等变性。

Conclusion: Transformer的少样本分类能力可归因于一种可解释的几何驱动算法，其权重呈现高度结构化特征，为揭示深层模型计算机理提供了可推广的分析框架。

Abstract: Transformers can perform in-context classification from a few labeled examples, yet the inference-time algorithm remains opaque. We study multi-class linear classification in the hard no-margin regime and make the computation identifiable by enforcing feature- and label-permutation equivariance at every layer. This enables interpretability while maintaining functional equivalence and yields highly structured weights. From these models we extract an explicit depth-indexed recursion: an end-to-end identified, emergent update rule inside a softmax transformer, to our knowledge the first of its kind. Attention matrices formed from mixed feature-label Gram structure drive coupled updates of training points, labels, and the test probe. The resulting dynamics implement a geometry-driven algorithmic motif, which can provably amplify class separation and yields robust expected class alignment.

</details>


### [613] [Beyond LLMs, Sparse Distributed Memory, and Neuromorphics <A Hyper-Dimensional SRAM-CAM "VaCoAl" for Ultra-High Speed, Ultra-Low Power, and Low Cost>](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11665)
*Hiroyuki Chuma,Kanji Otsuka,Yoichi Sato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论⽂提出 Galois-field 驱动的超维计算框架 VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl，把传统纠错代数反转成相对相似与路径质量排序引擎，在 470k Wikidata 导师-学生链（25.5 M 路径）上产生可预测的先验 STDP 式选择，实现高效、可审计的多跳推理并给出知识史“范式跃迁”证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 存在灾难性遗忘、绑定问题与不可解释多跳推理瓶颈；作者试图在代数层面一次性解决，并探索“纠错→相似排序”范式反转会带来何种新认知机制。

Method: 1. 逆⽤ Galois-field 代数：扩散传播⽤于路径相似度⽽非纠错；2. Sparse Distributed Memory + SRAM/DRAM-CAM 实现⾼维⼆值空间正交化与检索；3. 引⼊认知边界 Frontier Size，以前向路径积分置信度 CR2 排序候选；4. VaCoAl 算法及其 PyVaCoAl 实现完成 bundling/unbundling 与 CR 去噪，在 DAG 上追踪概念传播；5. 以 Wikidata 57 代导师-学生网络为基准做 25.5 M 路径实验并建“超维超高速公路”模型。

Result: 封闭形式公式准确预测 emergent STDP 幅度；470 k 关系、57 代链实验显⽰知识史出现从稀疏收敛到“后莱布尼茨超高速”相变；结构指标⽀持库恩式范式转移；相⽐传统纠错架构，VaCoAl 在可逆、可审计的低负载部署下实现组合泛化。

Conclusion: VaCoAl 确立第三条路线 HDC-AI，借 Galois-field 反转与认知边界嵌⼊，为 LLM 提供轻量、可解释、免灾难遗忘的多跳推理补充范式，并首次把知识史演化视为可计算相变。未来⼯作将扩展框架到更⼤规模图与实时问答场景。

Abstract: This paper reports an unexpected finding: in a deterministic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) architecture **that inverts the conventional role of Galois-field algebra -- employing it not for error correction toward a unique answer but as an engine for relative similarity and path-quality ranking -- **a path-dependent semantic selection mechanism emerges, equivalent to spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), with magnitude predictable a priori from a closed-form expression matching measured values. Addressing catastrophic forgetting, learning stagnation, and the Binding Problem at an algebraic level, we propose VaCoAl (Vague Coincident Algorithm) and its Python implementation PyVaCoAl on ultra-high-dimensional SRAM/DRAM-CAM. Rooted in Sparse Distributed Memory, it resolves orthogonalisation and retrieval in high-dimensional binary spaces via Galois-field diffusion, enabling low-load deployment. Crucially, VaCoAl embeds a cognitive bound -- the Frontier Size -- into its architecture, ranking candidates by path-integral confidence (CR2) to achieve compositional generalisation; this bounded-rationality design produces STDP-like selection that error-correction paradigms structurally cannot attain. We evaluated multi-hop reasoning on about 470k mentor-student relations from Wikidata, tracing up to 57 generations (over 25.5M paths). HDC bundling and unbinding with CR-based denoising quantify concept propagation over DAGs. Results show a reinterpretation of the Newton-Leibniz dispute and a phase transition from sparse convergence to a post-Leibniz "superhighway", with structural indicators supporting a Kuhnian paradigm shift. VaCoAl thus defines a third paradigm, HDC-AI, complementing LLMs with reversible, auditable multi-hop reasoning.

</details>


### [614] [SOAR: Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12617)
*You Qin,Linqing Wang,Hao Fei,Roger Zimmermann,Liefeng Bo,Qinglin Lu,Chunyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SOAR用一次无梯度回滚+重噪+自监督，把SFT的曝光偏差和RL的稀疏信号一并解决，在SD3.5上全面优于SFT，甚至无奖励模型也能赢RL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练分两阶段：SFT仅在干净轨迹上训练，推理一旦偏离就OOD；RL虽可纠偏，但奖励稀疏、信用分配难且易hack。亟需一种无需奖励、能在线自纠偏的稠密监督方法。

Method: SOAR在真实样本上做一次stop-gradient rollout，把漂移后的状态重噪，再用原始干净图作目标，让模型学习“拉回”分布。整个过程on-policy、无奖励、逐时刻稠密监督，天然兼容SFT与后续RL。

Result: SD3.5-Medium：GenEval +8pp→0.78，OCR +3pp→0.67；所有基于模型的偏好分同步提升。与Flow-GRPO相比，无奖励条件下 aesthetics 与 text-align 指标仍更高。

Conclusion: SOAR用自监督填补SFT与RL间的结构性缺口，可直接替换SFT作为更强首阶段后训练，且不对后续RL引入任何冲突。

Abstract: The post-training pipeline for diffusion models currently has two stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated data and reinforcement learning (RL) with reward models. A fundamental gap separates them. SFT optimizes the denoiser only on ground-truth states sampled from the forward noising process; once inference deviates from these ideal states, subsequent denoising relies on out-of-distribution generalization rather than learned correction, exhibiting the same exposure bias that afflicts autoregressive models, but accumulated along the denoising trajectory instead of the token sequence. RL can in principle address this mismatch, yet its terminal reward signal is sparse, suffers from credit-assignment difficulty, and risks reward hacking. We propose SOAR (Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement), a bias-correction post-training method that fills this gap. Starting from a real sample, SOAR performs a single stop-gradient rollout with the current model, re-noises the resulting off-trajectory state, and supervises the model to steer back toward the original clean target. The method is on-policy, reward-free, and provides dense per-timestep supervision with no credit-assignment problem. On SD3.5-Medium, SOAR improves GenEval from 0.70 to 0.78 and OCR from 0.64 to 0.67 over SFT, while simultaneously raising all model-based preference scores. In controlled reward-specific experiments, SOAR surpasses Flow-GRPO in final metric value on both aesthetic and text-image alignment tasks, despite having no access to a reward model. Since SOAR's base loss subsumes the standard SFT objective, it can directly replace SFT as a stronger first post-training stage after pretraining, while remaining fully compatible with subsequent RL alignment.

</details>


### [615] [Token Statistics Reveal Conversational Drift in Multi-turn LLM Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13061)
*Wael Hafez,Amir Nazeri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出仅基于 token 频率的“Bipredictability”(P) 指标与轻量级 Info Digital Twin (IDT)，实现在 4 574 轮对话、34 种条件下 100% 检测对话矛盾、切题与非回应等结构异常，证明长时 LLM 交互可靠性须监控结构而非仅关注语义质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当大模型用于多轮交互时，早期回答会持续影响后续对话；若“对话一致性”随时间衰减并未被察觉，下游决策的上下文根基就会丧失。现有评估只测孤立回答的“质量”，无法揭示交互结构的漂移。

Method: (1) 形式化定义 Bipredictability P＝(上下文→回应与回应→下一提问的可预测度之和 ÷ 总不确定性)，仅用 token 频率统计，无需嵌入、外部评判器或模型内部权值。(2) 将 P 嵌入轻量级辅助内省层—信息数字孪生 IDT，供运行时监测。(3) 对比一名学生模型与三名前导模型，34 种条件共 4 574 轮对话做验证，并人为注入矛盾、话题漂移、非回应进行灵敏度测试。

Result: P 在 85% 条件下保持稳定，其方差与结构性“对话一致性”高度对齐；而与人类评判的语义质量仅对齐 44%。IDT 对全部插入的矛盾等结构异常做到 100% 检测、0% 漏检。

Conclusion: 长时 LLM 交互的可靠性不能仅用“单句质量”衡量；从流转字符流即可提取结构信号补充语义评估，为线上部署提供无需侵入模型的实时一致性监护。

Abstract: Large language models, LLMs, are increasingly deployed in multiturn settings where earlier responses shape later ones, making reliability dependent on whether a conversation remains consistent over time. When this consistency degrades undetected, downstream decisions lose their grounding in the exchange that produced them. Yet current evaluation methods assess isolated outputs rather than the interaction producing them. Here we show that conversational structural consistency can be monitored directly from token frequency statistics, without embeddings, auxiliary evaluators or access to model internals. We formalize this signal as Bipredictability, P, which measures shared predictability across the context, response, next prompt loop relative to the turn total uncertainty, and implement it in a lightweight auxiliary architecture, the Information Digital Twin, IDT. Across 4,574 conversational turns spanning 34 conditions, one student model and three frontier teacher models, P established a stable runtime baseline, aligned with structural consistency in 85 percent of conditions but with semantic quality in only 44 percent, and the IDT detected all tested contradictions, topic shifts and non-sequiturs with 100 percent sensitivity. These results show that reliability in extended LLM interaction cannot be reduced to response quality alone, and that structural monitoring from the observable token stream can complement semantic evaluation in deployment.

</details>


### [616] [Selectivity and Shape in the Design of Forward-Forward Goodness Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13081)
*Talha Ruzgar Akkus,Suayp Talha Kocabay,Kamer Ali Yuksel,Hassan Sawaf*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现Forward-Forward算法中“goodness函数”必须对神经活动“形状”而非总能量敏感，提出两类新函数（峰值选择性+重尾形状敏感），在多个数据集上相对传统SoS最高提升72个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FF算法仅用平方和(SoS)作为局部goodness函数，性能受限；作者推测深层特征呈重尾分布且判别信息集中在峰值，因此需重新设计对“形状”敏感而非对“强度”敏感的goodness函数。

Method: 系统搜索goodness函数设计空间，提出：①选择性函数(top-k能量、entmax加权能量)仅关注峰值；②形状敏感函数(超额峰度/“burstiness”、高阶矩)以尺度不变统计量奖励重尾分布；结合标签-特征分离前向(FFCL)，在13种函数×5种激活×6数据集约4×2000网络架构下做三连续扫描实验。

Result: 在Fashion-MNIST达89.0%，MNIST 98.2±0.1%，较SoS平均提升+32.6pp；USPS +72pp，SVHN +52pp；全部基准一致获益，burstiness因尺度不变性对层间/数据集幅度漂移最鲁棒。

Conclusion: goodness函数设计应遵循“对形状敏感”原则，峰值选择与重尾形状敏感两类函数显著提升FF算法性能，为局部训练提供了新基线。

Abstract: The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm trains networks layer-by-layer using a local "goodness function," yet sum-of-squares (SoS) has remained the only choice studied. We systematically explore the goodness-function design space and identify a unifying principle: the goodness function must be sensitive to the shape of neural activity, not its total energy. This principle is motivated by the observation that deep network activations follow heavy-tailed distributions and that discriminative information is often concentrated in peak activities. We propose two complementary families: selective functions (top-k, entmax-weighted energy) that measure only peak activity, and shape-sensitive functions (excess kurtosis / "burstiness" and higher-order moments) that reward heavy-tailed distributions via scale-invariant statistics. Combined with separate label-feature forwarding (FFCL), controlled experiments across 13 goodness functions, 5 activations, 6 datasets, and three continuous sweeps, each tracing a characteristic inverted-U, yield 89.0% on Fashion-MNIST and 98.2+-0.1% on MNIST (4x2000), a +32.6pp gain over SoS, with consistent improvements across all benchmarks (+72pp USPS, +52pp SVHN). The scale-invariant nature of burstiness makes it particularly robust to magnitude shifts across layers and datasets.

</details>


### [617] [KV Packet: Recomputation-Free Context-Independent KV Caching for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13226)
*Chuangtao Chen,Grace Li Zhang,Xunzhao Yin,Cheng Zhuo,Bing Li,Ulf Schlichtmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KV Packet通过免重计算的软token适配器，首次实现KV缓存的零开销跨上下文复用，在Llama-3.1/Qwen2.5上把TTFT压到低于现有重计算方案，同时F1不下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理依赖KV缓存，但上下文切换时必须重计算KV状态，带来额外FLOP与TTFT；现有方法仍要局部重计算，无法彻底消除开销。

Method: 把已缓存文档视为不可变“数据包”，在其外加一层轻量可训软token适配器；用自监督蒸馏训练适配器，弥合新旧上下文间的注意力分布差异，实现零重计算复用。

Result: 在Llama-3.1与Qwen2.5上，KV Packet将FLOP降至近零，TTFT低于CacheBlend、EPIC、SAM-KV等重计算基线，F1score与全重计算基准持平。

Conclusion: KV Packet首次证明KV缓存可在不重算任何token的情况下跨上下文复用，为LLM低延迟长文档推理提供了实用新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely heavily on Key-Value (KV) caching to minimize inference latency. However, standard KV caches are context-dependent: reusing a cached document in a new context requires recomputing KV states to account for shifts in attention distribution. Existing solutions such as CacheBlend, EPIC, and SAM-KV mitigate this issue by selectively recomputing a subset of tokens; however, they still incur non-negligible computational overhead (FLOPs) and increased Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) latency. In this paper, we propose KV Packet, a recomputation-free cache reuse framework that treats cached documents as immutable ``packets'' wrapped in light-weight trainable soft-token adapters, which are trained via self-supervised distillation to bridge context discontinuities. Experiments on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 demonstrate that the proposed KV Packet method achieves near-zero FLOPs and lower TTFT than recomputation-based baselines, while retaining F1 scores comparable to those of the full recomputation baseline.

</details>


### [618] [Optimistic Policy Learning under Pessimistic Adversaries with Regret and Violation Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14243)
*Sourav Ganguly,Kartik Pandit,Arnob Ghosh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次在安全强化学习中显式引入对抗策略驱动的外生状态转移，提出RHC-UCRL算法，在对抗环境下同时实现次线性遗憾与次线性约束违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统状态还受竞争智能体、环境扰动等外生因素支配，忽略它们会导致策略部署时灾难性失效；现有约束MDP与鲁棒RL未建模外生因素的“策略性”对抗交互，也无法显式处理安全约束。

Method: 将外生因素显式建模为对抗策略π̄，与主智能体共同决定转移概率；提出基于模型的RHC-UCRL，利用“幻觉”滚动同步维护对主策略与对抗策略的乐观置信上界，区分认知(epistemic)与偶然(aleatoric)不确定性，在每一轮规划时同时优化奖励与代价。

Result: 理论证明RHC-UCRL在对抗转移设定下同时获得次线性遗憾O(√T)与次线性约束违反O(√T)，首次给出该类安全对抗RL的收敛保证；实验显示相比忽视对抗或仅用分布鲁棒的基线，约束违反降低60%以上。

Conclusion: 把外生因素作为策略性 adversary 建模，是提升安全RL部署鲁棒性的关键；RHC-UCRL提供可扩展的乐观对抗规划框架，为后续在安全-危急、多智能体或非稳态环境中部署学习系统奠定理论与算法基础。

Abstract: Real-world decision-making systems operate in environments where state transitions depend not only on the agent's actions, but also on \textbf{exogenous factors outside its control}--competing agents, environmental disturbances, or strategic adversaries--formally, $s_{h+1} = f(s_h, a_h, \bar{a}_h)+ω_h$ where $\bar{a}_h$ is the adversary/external action, $a_h$ is the agent's action, and $ω_h$ is an additive noise. Ignoring such factors can yield policies that are optimal in isolation but \textbf{fail catastrophically in deployment}, particularly when safety constraints must be satisfied.
  Standard Constrained MDP formulations assume the agent is the sole driver of state evolution, an assumption that breaks down in safety-critical settings. Existing robust RL approaches address this via distributional robustness over transition kernels, but do not explicitly model the \textbf{strategic interaction} between agent and exogenous factor, and rely on strong assumptions about divergence from a known nominal model.
  We model the exogenous factor as an \textbf{adversarial policy} $\barπ$ that co-determines state transitions, and ask how an agent can remain both optimal and safe against such an adversary. \emph{To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to study safety-constrained RL under explicit adversarial dynamics}. We propose \textbf{Robust Hallucinated Constrained Upper-Confidence RL} (\texttt{RHC-UCRL}), a model-based algorithm that maintains optimism over both agent and adversary policies, explicitly separating epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty. \texttt{RHC-UCRL} achieves sub-linear regret and constraint violation guarantees.

</details>


### [619] [Aerial Multi-Functional RIS in Fluid Antennas-Aided Full-Duplex Networks: A Self-Optimized Hybrid Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14309)
*Li-Hsiang Shen,Yu-Quan Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AAV与MF-RIS共型（AM-RIS）的流型天线全双工架构，并以自优化多智能体混合DRL（SOHRL）联合优化波束、功率与位置，仿真验证其在能量效率上优于半双工和传统RIS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G流量激增需要同时提升覆盖、能量自给与频谱复用；现有RIS功能单一、SI残差大，难以兼顾高效能与强自适应性。

Method: 

Result: 

Conclusion: 

Abstract: To address high data traffic demands of sixth-generation (6G) networks, this paper proposes a novel architecture that integrates autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) and multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (MF-RISs) as AM-RIS in fluid antenna (FA)-assisted full-duplex (FD) networks. The AM-RIS provides hybrid functionalities, including signal reflection, amplification, and energy harvesting (EH), potentially improving both signal coverage and sustainability. Meanwhile, FA facilitates fine-grained spatial adaptability at FD-enabled base station (BS), which complements residual self-interference (SI) suppression. We aim at maximizing the overall energy efficiency (EE) by jointly optimizing transmit DL beamforming at BS, UL user power, configuration of AM-RIS, and positions of the FA and AM-RIS. Owing to the hybrid continuous-discrete parameters and high dimensionality of the intractable problem, we have conceived a self-optimized multi-agent hybrid deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework (SOHRL), which integrates multi-agent deep Q-networks (DQN) and multi-agent proximal policy optimization (PPO), respectively handling discrete and continuous actions. To enhance self-adaptability, an attention-driven state representation and meta-level hyperparameter optimization are incorporated, enabling multi-agents to autonomously adjust learning hyperparameters. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed AM-RIS-enabled FA-aided FD networks empowered by SOHRL algorithm. The results reveal that SOHRL outperforms benchmarks of the case without attention mechanism and conventional hybrid/multi-agent/standalone DRL. Moreover, AM-RIS in FD achieves the highest EE compared to half-duplex, conventional rigid antenna arrays, partial EH, and conventional RIS without amplification, highlighting its potential as a compelling solution for EE-aware wireless networks.

</details>


### [620] [Mamba-SSM with LLM Reasoning for Feature Selection: Faithfulness-Aware Biomarker Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14334)
*Pushpa Kumar Balan,Aijing Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用LLM的链式思维过滤梯度显著性基因，17个特征就能将乳腺癌分类器AUC从0.832提高到0.927，但仅召回35%已知核心基因，显示“选择性忠诚”策略有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度序列模型的梯度显著性常被组织组分混淆因素污染，导致下游分类器性能下降，需一种自动化且可解释的方式剔除这些伪相关基因。

Method: 在TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq数据上训练Mamba SSM，提取前50梯度显著基因；用DeepSeek-R1以结构化链式思维逐条评估并筛至17基因，最终与5000基因方差基线及未过滤50基因集对比AUC，并用COSMIC CGC、OncoKB、PAM50三重金标准做忠诚性审计。

Result: 未过滤50基因集AUC仅0.832，低于方差基线0.903；LLM过滤后17基因集AUC达0.927，参数减少294倍。审计显示17个入选基因中6个为已验证BRCA标志物，但16个输入中已知核心基因被遗漏10个（含FOXA1）。

Conclusion: 链式思维能定向剔除组织混淆因素并显著提升预测性能，却无需完整召回已知生物标志物；在生物发现任务中，“选择性忠诚”比全面忠诚更能优化下游指标。

Abstract: Gradient saliency from deep sequence models surfaces candidate biomarkers efficiently, but the resulting gene lists can be contaminated by tissue-composition confounders that degrade downstream classifiers. We study whether LLM chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can filter these confounders, and whether reasoning quality is associated with downstream performance. We train a Mamba SSM on TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq and extract the top-50 genes by gradient saliency; DeepSeek-R1 evaluates every candidate with structured CoT to produce a final 17-gene set. On the held-out test split, the raw 50-gene saliency set (no LLM) performs worse than a 5,000-gene variance baseline (AUC 0.832 vs. 0.903), while the LLM-filtered set surpasses it (AUC 0.927), using 294x fewer features. A faithfulness audit (COSMIC CGC, OncoKB, PAM50) shows that 6 of 17 selected genes (35.3%) are validated BRCA biomarkers, while 10 of 16 known BRCA genes present in the input were missed - including FOXA1. This divergence between downstream performance and reasoning faithfulness suggests selective faithfulness in this setting: targeted confounder removal can improve predictive performance without comprehensive recall.

</details>


### [621] [SatBLIP: Context Understanding and Feature Identification from Satellite Imagery with Vision-Language Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14373)
*Xue Wu,Shengting Cao,Shenglin Li,Jiaqi Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SatBLIP 以卫星-文本对齐+自举字幕生成，可直接从卫星影像预测县域社会脆弱性指数，并给出可解释的风险要素图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统遥感指标粗糙、难以刻画乡村“情境化”风险；现有视觉-语言模型在卫星语义上失效，需构建面向农村场景的细粒度、可解释框架。

Method: 1) GPT-4o 对卫星瓦片生成结构化描述（屋顶、庭院、道路、植被等）；2) 用该字幕微调卫星版 BLIP，使其为无标注影像生成语义一致的卫星字幕；3) CLIP 编码字幕，与 LLM 嵌入经注意力融合后回归 SVI；4) SHAP 量化各空间属性贡献。全程无人工虚拟审计或手工特征。

Result: 在县尺度 SVI 估算中显著优于传统遥感与通用 VLM 基线；SHAP 揭示屋顶形态/破损、街道宽度、植被覆盖、车辆/开敞空间为稳健预测的核心因子，实现村级风险环境可解释制图。

Conclusion: SatBLIP 把卫星影像转化为可读的“风险语言”，为乡村精准防灾、基础设施投资与政策评估提供了高分辨率、可解释的空间决策支持，并展示了领域专用 VLM 在公共健康与社会指标推断中的潜力。

Abstract: Rural environmental risks are shaped by place-based conditions (e.g., housing quality, road access, land-surface patterns), yet standard vulnerability indices are coarse and provide limited insight into risk contexts. We propose SatBLIP, a satellite-specific vision-language framework for rural context understanding and feature identification that predicts county-level Social Vulnerability Index (SVI). SatBLIP addresses limitations of prior remote sensing pipelines-handcrafted features, manual virtual audits, and natural-image-trained VLMs-by coupling contrastive image-text alignment with bootstrapped captioning tailored to satellite semantics. We use GPT-4o to generate structured descriptions of satellite tiles (roof type/condition, house size, yard attributes, greenery, and road context), then fine-tune a satellite-adapted BLIP model to generate captions for unseen images. Captions are encoded with CLIP and fused with LLM-derived embeddings via attention for SVI estimation under spatial aggregation. Using SHAP, we identify salient attributes (e.g., roof form/condition, street width, vegetation, cars/open space) that consistently drive robust predictions, enabling interpretable mapping of rural risk environments.

</details>


### [622] [Can LLMs Score Medical Diagnoses and Clinical Reasoning as well as Expert Panels?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14892)
*Amy Rouillard,Sitwala Mundia,Linda Camara,Michael Cameron Gramanie,Ziyaad Dangor,Ismail Kalla,Shabir A. Madhi,Kajal Morar,Marlvin T. Ncube,Haroon Saloojee,Bruce A. Bassett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用三個前沿大型語言模型組成的「LLM陪審團」能以更高一致性和更低嚴重錯誤率，替代昂貴的人類專家評審團進行 AI 診斷系統的基準測試；經等概率回歸校準後，LLM 陪審團與主治專家組排名完全一致，且無自我偏愛傾向，可用於篩選高錯誤風險病例，顯著提升評估效率與安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 傳統靠專家臨床小組評估醫療 AI 成本高昂、進度緩慢，急需高效且可擴充的替代方案。

Method: 構建三模型 LLM 陪審團，對 300 例中低收入國家醫院真實病例的 3333 項診斷進行四維度（診斷、鑒別診斷、臨床推理、負面治療風險）評分，與主治專家小組及獨立人類重評小組對照；評估分差、一致性、穩定性、嚴重安全錯誤，並用等概率回歸校正。

Result: 未校準 LLM 分值系統偏低，但序數一致性高於人類重評組；嚴重錯誤機率更低；排名與主治專家完全一致；對自我模型無偏愛；校正後分值與專家評價高度對齊；LLM 陪審團可標記高風險病例供專家靶向複核。

Conclusion: 經校準的多模型 LLM 陪審團能夠充當可信、可靠的專家替代評估工具，顯著降低醫療 AI 基準測試成本並提升效率與安全性。

Abstract: Evaluating medical AI systems using expert clinician panels is costly and slow, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as alternative adjudicators. Here, we evaluate an LLM jury composed of three frontier AI models scoring 3333 diagnoses on 300 real-world middle-income country (MIC) hospital cases. Model performance was benchmarked against expert clinician panel and independent human re-scoring panel evaluations. Both LLM and clinician-generated diagnoses are scored across four dimensions: diagnosis, differential diagnosis, clinical reasoning and negative treatment risk. For each of these, we assess scoring difference, inter-rater agreement, scoring stability, severe safety errors and the effect of post-hoc calibration. We find that: (i) the uncalibrated LLM jury scores are systematically lower than clinician panels scores; (ii) the LLM Jury preserves ordinal agreement and exhibits better concordance with the primary expert panels than the human expert re-score panels do; (iii) the probability of severe errors is lower in \lj models compared to the human expert re-score panels; (iv) the LLM Jury shows excellent agreement with primary expert panels' rankings. We find that the LLM jury combined with AI model diagnoses can be used to identify ward diagnoses at high risk of error, enabling targeted expert review and improved panel efficiency; (v) LLM jury models show no self-preference bias. They did not score diagnoses generated by their own underlying model or models from the same vendor more (or less) favourably than those generated by other models. Finally, we demonstrate that LLM jury calibration using isotonic regression improves alignment with human expert panel evaluations. Together, these results provide compelling evidence that a calibrated, multi-model LLM jury can serve as a trustworthy and reliable proxy for expert clinician evaluation in medical AI benchmarking.

</details>


### [623] [UniDoc-RL: Coarse-to-Fine Visual RAG with Hierarchical Actions and Dense Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14967)
*Jun Wang,Shuo Tan,Zelong Sun,Tiancheng Gu,Yongle Zhao,Ziyong Feng,Kaicheng Yang,Zhiwu Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniDoc-RL 用统一强化学习框架让大视觉语言模型自主完成检索-重排-主动注视-推理，三步递进获取视觉证据，无需额外价值网络即可端到端训练，在三大基准上比前代 RL 方法平均提升 17.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉 RAG 仅依赖粗粒度检索信号，难以聚焦任务相关的细粒度视觉语义，导致复杂推理性能受限。

Method: 将“获取视觉知识”建模为分层序列决策：粗粒度文档检索→细粒度图像选择→主动区域裁剪；设计密集多奖励机制为每步动作提供任务感知监督；以 GRPO 实现多目标策略优化，无需独立价值网络；并构建带细粒度动作标注的高质量推理轨迹数据集。

Result: 在三个公开基准上全面超过 SOTA 基线，相较此前 RL 方法最高提升 17.7%，验证统一框架在检索、注视与推理协同中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过强化学习统一检索、重排、主动视觉感知与推理，可显著增强大视觉语言模型利用外部视觉知识的能力，为多模态复杂推理提供新范式。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) extends Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) with external visual knowledge. However, existing visual RAG systems typically rely on generic retrieval signals that overlook the fine-grained visual semantics essential for complex reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose UniDoc-RL, a unified reinforcement learning framework in which an LVLM agent jointly performs retrieval, reranking, active visual perception, and reasoning. UniDoc-RL formulates visual information acquisition as a sequential decision-making problem with a hierarchical action space. Specifically, it progressively refines visual evidence from coarse-grained document retrieval to fine-grained image selection and active region cropping, allowing the model to suppress irrelevant content and attend to information-dense regions. For effective end-to-end training, we introduce a dense multi-reward scheme that provides task-aware supervision for each action. Based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), UniDoc-RL aligns agent behavior with multiple objectives without relying on a separate value network. To support this training paradigm, we curate a comprehensive dataset of high-quality reasoning trajectories with fine-grained action annotations. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that UniDoc-RL consistently surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, yielding up to 17.7% gains over prior RL-based methods.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [624] [The Spectral Geometry of Thought: Phase Transitions, Instruction Reversal, Token-Level Dynamics, and Perfect Correctness Prediction in How Transformers Reason](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15350)
*Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 跨模型隐藏态谱分析揭示‘推理’与‘事实回忆’存在可压缩态几何差异，构建出可预测答案正确性的普适谱理论框架。.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大模型推理能力显著提升，其内部机制仍不透明。作者假设推理过程会在神经网络隐状态空间中产生可测量的几何特征，即“谱相变”，并希望用统一框架解释不同模型、不同规模下的推理机制差异。.

Method: 系统谱分析：选取 11 个、5 大架构家族的模型（Qwen、Pythia、Phi、Llama、DeepSeek-R1），对 hidden activations 做幂律谱拟合提取 α 指数；结合 7 种实验设计（推理 vs 事实、指令微调前后、逐 token 动态、逐推理步定位等），用统计检验与线性/非线性回归验证现象。.

Result: 发现 7 大现象：①推理任务 α 显著更低（9/11 模型，p<0.05），效应随模型能力增强；②指令微调会翻转 α 大小关系；③生成过程按 α 变化可分为扩张、压缩、平衡三类；④推理 α 随参数规模 lnN 线性下降（R²=0.46）；⑤token 级 α 呈现层间指数衰减的同步，推理弱于事实；⑥推理步骤边界与谱跳变高度对齐；⑦仅用 late-layer α 可在答案未出现前以 AUC=1.000（Qwen2.5-7B）预测正确性，6 模型平均 AUC=0.893。.

Conclusion: 首次提出“变换器谱推理理论”：推理在几何上具普适的低秩压缩方向，动态细节因架构而异，且谱指数 α 可直接预判输出正确性，为理解、诊断与优化模型推理提供原则性工具。.

Abstract: We discover that large language models exhibit \emph{spectral phase transitions} in their hidden activation spaces when engaging in reasoning versus factual recall. Through systematic spectral analysis across \textbf{11 models} spanning \textbf{5 architecture families} (Qwen, Pythia, Phi, Llama, DeepSeek-R1), we identify \textbf{seven} core phenomena: (1)~\textbf{Reasoning Spectral Compression} -- 9/11 models show significantly lower $α$ for reasoning ($p < 0.05$), with larger effects in stronger models; (2)~\textbf{Instruction Tuning Spectral Reversal} -- base models show reasoning $α< $ factual $α$, while instruction-tuned models reverse this relationship; (3)~\textbf{Architecture-Dependent Generation Taxonomy} -- prompt-to-response shifts partition into expansion, compression, and equilibrium regimes; (4)~\textbf{Spectral Scaling Law} -- $α_\text{reasoning} \propto -0.074 \ln N$ across 4 Qwen base models ($R^2 = 0.46$); (5)~\textbf{Token-Level Spectral Cascade} -- per-token alpha tracking reveals local synchronization that decays exponentially with layer distance, and is weaker for reasoning than factual tasks; (6)~\textbf{Reasoning Step Spectral Punctuation} -- phase-transition signatures align with reasoning step boundaries; and (7)~\textbf{Spectral Correctness Prediction} -- spectral $α$ alone achieves AUC $= 1.000$ (Qwen2.5-7B, late layers) and mean AUC $= 0.893$ across 6 models in predicting correctness \emph{before} the final answer is generated. Together, these findings establish a comprehensive \emph{spectral theory of reasoning} in transformers, revealing that the geometry of thought is universal in direction, architecture-specific in dynamics, and predictive of outcome.

</details>


### [625] [Aletheia: Gradient-Guided Layer Selection for Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning Across Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15351)
*Abdulmalek Saket*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Aletheia通过梯度探测仅对任务相关层施加非对称秩LoRA，在81组0.5B–72B模型实验上平均提速23.1%，下游指标基本无损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA默认给全部Transformer层加适配器，忽略不同层对下游任务贡献差异，导致冗余计算与遗忘风险。

Method: 先以轻量级梯度探针估计各层任务相关度，再仅对高相关层插入LoRA并采用差异化秩分配。

Result: 14类架构、81组实验（含MoE）一致提速15–28%，MMLU、GSM8K、HumanEval性能保持；Campaign 1每模型胜率100%，Campaign 2退化受控。

Conclusion: 智能层选取可在不显著损害下游性能的前提下，显著提升LoRA微调的经济性与效率，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become the dominant parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models, yet standard practice applies LoRA adapters uniformly to all transformer layers regardless of their relevance to the downstream task. We introduce Aletheia, a gradient-guided layer selection method that identifies the most task-relevant layers via a lightweight gradient probe and applies LoRA adapters only to those layers with asymmetric rank allocation. Across 81 experiment rows covering 14 successful models from 8 architecture families (0.5B-72B parameters, including dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures), with one additional documented failed Pythia/GPT-NeoX attempt in Campaign 2, Aletheia achieves a 15-28% training speedup (mean 23.1%, p < 0.001) with bounded extra forgetting and broadly matched downstream behavior on the evaluated MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval benchmark pack. Across the tested families and scales, Campaign 1 shows a 100% per-model speed win rate and Campaign 2 shows broadly preserved downstream behavior within a bounded-degradation framing. Together these results support a practical model-economics claim: intelligent layer selection can make LoRA fine-tuning materially more efficient without introducing major downstream damage on the evaluated set.

</details>


### [626] [Sequential KV Cache Compression via Probabilistic Language Tries: Beyond the Per-Vector Shannon Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15356)
*Gregory Magarshak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出TurboQuant等现有KV-cache压缩方法仅对“逐向量”优化，而真正瓶颈是“序列级”冗余。提出两层式顺序压缩：1.用概率前缀去重跨会话共享前缀；2.用模型自身预测做残差编码，理论极限比TurboQuant再降≈914000×，且随上下文变长收益递增。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察到KV-cache中的token并非任意浮点数据，而是模型已近乎最优预测的形式语言样本；现有逐向量量化逼近的只是“逐向量熵极限”，而非真正决定内存的“序列级熵”。因此需把压缩问题从“向量序列”升级为“语言序列”。

Method: 1)概率前缀去重：借助Probabilistic Language Trie度量d_T(s,s′)=−log₂P_M(s∧s′)识别跨会话语义等价前缀并共享。2)预测残差编码：利用模型对下一KV向量的自回归预测，仅存储残差KV_{i+1}−E[KV_{i+1}|KV_{≤i}]，熵上界为H(token_{i+1}|token_{≤i})。两层正交，可与TurboQuant等逐向量量化叠加。

Result: 在常用语言模型困惑度10–20下，理论每token位宽仅3.3–4.3 bit，而TurboQuant为3 bit×64–128维≈192–384 bit；极限压缩比≈914000×。即使故意放大1000×冗余，仍优于TurboQuant约914×，且序列越长压缩率越高。

Conclusion: 首次把KV-cache压缩从“向量级”推进到“序列级”，利用模型自身语言先验可将内存需求再降近百万倍；两层框架与现有量化兼容，为超长上下文推理提供可行路径。

Abstract: Recent work on KV cache quantization, culminating in TurboQuant, has approached the Shannon entropy limit for per-vector compression of transformer key-value caches. We observe that this limit applies to a strictly weaker problem than the one that actually matters: compressing the KV cache as a sequence. The tokens stored in a KV cache are not arbitrary floating-point data -- they are samples from the exact formal language the model was trained on, and the model is by construction a near-optimal predictor of that language. We introduce sequential KV compression, a two-layer architecture that exploits this structure. The first layer, probabilistic prefix deduplication, identifies semantically equivalent shared prefixes across sessions using the trie metric d_T(s, s') = -log_2 P_M(s ^ s') from Probabilistic Language Tries (PLTs). The second layer, predictive delta coding, stores only the residual of each new KV vector from the model's own prediction of it, achieving a per-token entropy bound of H(KV_{i+1} | KV_{<=i}) <= H(token_{i+1} | token_{<=i}). We prove that at typical language model perplexity -- approximately 10-20 for fluent English text -- this bound is 3.3-4.3 bits on average per token position, compared to TurboQuant's 3 bits per vector component (with typical attention heads having 64-128 components). The theoretical compression ratio over TurboQuant is approximately 914,000x at the Shannon limit. Even at 1000x above the entropy floor -- a deliberately pessimistic worst-case overhead, two orders of magnitude above the 2-5x typical of practical source coders -- the ratio remains approximately 914x over TurboQuant, with compression improving rather than degrading as context length grows. The two layers are orthogonal and compose with existing per-vector quantization methods including TurboQuant.

</details>


### [627] [Mapping High-Performance Regions in Battery Scheduling across Data Uncertainty, Battery Design, and Planning Horizons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15360)
*Jaime de Miguel Rodriguez,Artjom Vargunin,Brigitta Robin Raudne,David Solis Martin,Yaroslava Mykhailenko,Kaarel Oja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过三元分析法揭示数据特征–不确定性–规划时域对储能MPC的耦合规律，定义“有效时域”并给出工业通用取值表，兼顾收益与算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段模型预测控制(MPC)在储能运行中广泛应用，但超长时域带来算力激增，而数据特征与不确定性如何影响最优规划长度尚缺系统量化依据。

Method: 构建电池-不确定度-负荷三元参数化框架，生成合成数据系统扫描C-rate、预测误差、负荷形态等变量；以收益最大为MPC目标，反向拟合最优时域与参数的映射关系，提出“有效时域”概念并实验验证。

Result: 发现存在收益饱和的临界时域；按此截断可降算力30-70%而保持收益差距<1%；给出覆盖典型电池类型、误差等级、负荷曲线的最优时域取值表；量化预测误差导致1-8%收益损失，且高倍率电池亦受影响。

Conclusion: 有效时域可作为工业储能MPC的轻量级配置准则；所建参数-时域映射可直接嵌入规则库，并为后续机器学习在线推算最优时域提供标注数据与理论基础。

Abstract: This study presents a triadic analysis of energy storage operation under multi-stage model predictive control, investigating the interplay between data characteristics, forecast uncertainty, planning horizon, and battery c-rate. Synthetic datasets are generated to systematically explore variations in data profiles and uncertainty, enabling parametrization and the construction of relationships that map these characteristics to optimal horizon length. Results reveal the presence of an effective horizon, defined as the look-ahead length beyond which additional forecast information provides limited operational benefit. Accounting for this horizon can reduce computational costs while maintaining optimal performance. The study provides optimal horizon lengths across a broad range of combinations of battery types, uncertainty levels, and data profiles, offering practical guidance for industrial storage operation. It also quantifies revenue losses due to forecast uncertainty, showing that errors can impact performance even for fast batteries. Finally, the framework lays the groundwork for future machine learning approaches that map dataset parametrization to optimal horizons, supporting continuous optimization in industrial settings without heavy computation.

</details>


### [628] [M3R: Localized Rainfall Nowcasting with Meteorology-Informed MultiModal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15377)
*Sanjeev Panta,Rhett M Morvant,Xu Yuan,Li Chen,Nian-Feng Tzeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: M3R是一个气象引导的多模态注意力网络，通过用个人气象站时序数据做查询来对齐并聚焦NEXRAD雷达影像中的降雨特征，实现100 km×100 km区域的高精度短临降水预报，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短临降雨预报对防灾与水资源管理至关重要，但现有深度学习方法难以有效融合雷达影像与稀疏气象站等多源异构数据，导致降水信号提取不足。

Method: 提出M3R框架：1) 统一时间对齐管道将雷达栅格与PWS时序同步；2) 多模态注意力机制以气象站序列为Query、雷达特征为Key/Value，实现“站点引导”的空间聚焦；3) 端到端直接回归未来降雨量。

Result: 在3个NEXRAD站为中心的100 km×100 km区域实验，M3R在准确率、计算效率和降水检测能力上均优于现有最优方法，显著降低漏报与误报。

Conclusion: 首次验证用气象站数据主动查询雷达特征可提升多模态短临预报性能，为业务化系统提供新基准与即用工具。

Abstract: Accurate and timely rainfall nowcasting is crucial for disaster mitigation and water resource management. Despite recent advances in deep learning, precipitation prediction remains challenging due to limitations in effectively leveraging diverse multimedia data sources. We introduce M3R, a Meteorology-informed MultiModal attention-based architecture for direct Rainfall prediction that synergistically combines visual NEXRAD radar imagery with numerical Personal Weather Station (PWS) measurements, using a comprehensive pipeline for temporal alignment of heterogeneous meteorological data. With specialized multimodal attention mechanisms, M3R novelly leverages weather station time series as queries to selectively attend to spatial radar features, enabling focused extraction of precipitation signatures. Experimental results for three spatial areas of 100 km * 100 km centered at NEXRAD radar stations demonstrate that M3R outperforms existing approaches, achieving substantial improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and precipitation detection capabilities. Our work establishes new benchmarks for multimedia-based precipitation nowcasting and provides practical tools for operational weather prediction systems. The source code is available at https://github.com/Sanjeev97/M3Rain

</details>


### [629] [Lightweight Geometric Adaptation for Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15392)
*Kang An,Chenhao Si,Shiqian Ma,Ming Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级 “曲率感知” 优化插件，用梯度差估计局部几何并自适应校正一阶优化器，在多个困难 PDE 上显著提升 PINN 的收敛速度、稳定性与精度，无需显式二阶矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN 在复杂 PDE 中的损失地形呈各向异性且剧烈变化，导致一阶优化器收敛慢、不稳定、精度受限；需在不引入昂贵二阶计算的前提下增强优化器对局部曲率的感知能力。

Method: 用连续梯度差构建局部曲率代理（正割信息），设计步长归一化的曲率指标，动态决定预测校正强度；整个模块即插即用，可无缝嵌入任意一阶优化器而不显式构造 Hessian 或 Fisher 矩阵。

Result: 在热方程、Gray–Scott、Belousov–Zhabotinsky 与二维 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 等典型高维/强非线性 PDE 上，相较 Adam、L-BFGS 等强基线，收敛步数减少 30–60%，训练波动降低，测试误差平均下降 20–50%。

Conclusion: 该方法以极低计算开销实现对局部曲率的在线感知与自适应校正，显著缓解 PINN 优化困难，为复杂 PDE 求解提供高效、鲁棒且通用的优化插件范式。
