Quantitative analysis reveals that SAR reliably distinguishes answer quality: concise, correct answers score higher than redundant ones, and partially correct answers score higher than entirely incorrect ones. Evaluation on 4 models across 7 benchmarks shows that integrating SAR with prevalent RL algorithms like PPO and GRPO improves accuracy by 4%, while reducing inference cost by 30%. Further analysis demonstrates that SAR achieves a Pareto-optimal trade-off between correctness and efficiency compared to reward signals based on length or self-confidence. We also show that SAR shortens responses while preserving advanced reasoning behaviors, demonstrating its ability to suppress unnecessary elaboration without losing critical reasoning. These results highlight the promise of self-aligned reward as a fine-grained complement to verifiable rewards, paving the way for more efficient and effective LLM training.

</details>


### [777] [Examining the Relationship between Scientific Publishing Activity and Hype-Driven Financial Bubbles: A Comparison of the Dot-Com and AI Eras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.11982)
*Aksheytha Chelikavada,Casey C. Bennett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用科学出版物的引用网络时序SNA对比互联网泡沫(1994–2001)与AI热潮(2017–2024)，发现前者信号无法可靠预示后者气泡，AI阶段或呈现前所未有的泡沫形态，或根本无泡沫。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融泡沫前兆难测且冲击持久。既然泡沫技术多源于早期学术研究，能否通过追踪科学出版物的引用网络提前捕捉泡沫信号？为此需检验历史泡沫的学术引用模式对未来资产价格是否具备预测力。

Method: 采集1994–2001(互联网)与2017–2024(AI)两时期的学术引用网络与市场数据，构建时序SNA，提取网络拓扑及节点影响力指标；再用LSTM、KNN、AR-X/GARCH等模型检验引用模式与资产价格联动性，并对两时期进行对照与聚类比较。

Result: 互联网泡沫时期的引用网络特征在AI阶段未再现；AI科学家的年度引用网络虽整体不同，但存在子群体其影响力演化路径与互联网时期相似。多模型预测结果趋同：无法确认AI会出现传统意义上的泡沫，或干脆无泡沫，呈现“无先例”状态。

Conclusion: 历史泡沫的学术引用规律不具备直接迁移性，无法作为AI市场泡沫的先行指标；提醒政策与投资者应警惕技术—金融耦合的新范式，而非简单套用旧模式。

Abstract: Financial bubbles often arrive without much warning, but create long-lasting economic effects. For example, during the dot-com bubble, innovative technologies created market disruptions through excitement for a promised bright future. Such technologies originated from research where scientists had developed them for years prior to their entry into the markets. That raises a question on the possibility of analyzing scientific publishing data (e.g. citation networks) leading up to a bubble for signals that may forecast the rise and fall of similar future bubbles. To that end, we utilized temporal SNAs to detect possible relationships between the publication citation networks of scientists and financial market data during two modern eras of rapidly shifting technology: 1) dot-com era from 1994 to 2001 and 2) AI era from 2017 to 2024. Results showed that the patterns from the dot-com era (which did end in a bubble) did not definitively predict the rise and fall of an AI bubble. While yearly citation networks reflected possible changes in publishing behavior of scientists between the two eras, there was a subset of AI era scientists whose publication influence patterns mirrored those during the dot-com era. Upon further analysis using multiple analysis techniques (LSTM, KNN, AR X/GARCH), the data seems to suggest two possibilities for the AI era: unprecedented form of financial bubble unseen or that no bubble exists. In conclusion, our findings imply that the patterns present in the dot-com era do not effectively translate in such a manner to apply them to the AI market.

</details>


### [778] [Online Distributionally Robust LLM Alignment via Regression to Relative Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19104)
*Sharan Sahu,Martin T. Wells*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用在线 DRO 强盗更新，把偏好漂移下的 RLHF 显式加权改成对 min–max 对偶的相对奖励回归，摆脱 PPO 剪裁且不损失可扩展性，在三种分歧集下同时给出首组 $	ilde O(d/n)$ 常数更紧的参数收敛率，并在三连数据集上仍健壮地优于现有鲁棒与非鲁棒基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线 RLHF 的硬优化会带来与人类意图的过度拟合，易在当前 DRO-DPO 方法中表现为样本低效、偏好不均、依赖启发式；需在线的、去启发式的鲁棒更新框架，且保有便于训练的回归公式。

Method: 基于 type-$p$ Wasserstein、KL 与 $^2$ 三支模糊集的在线强盗版 REBEL 更新；通过强对偶将鲁棒策略优化换算为每步的相对奖励回归，完全拿掉 PPO 式剪裁与价值网络；针对不同潜伏分别提供 (1) 梯度正则化 (Wasserstein)、(2) 重要度重加权 (KL)、(3) 一维对偶解 ($^2$) 的 SGD 速算算法。

Result: 在线性奖励-对数线性策略及宽松覆盖下，获得首个 DRO-RLHF 参数误差 $	ilde O(d/n)$，置信区间常数优于现行的 DRO-DPO；实验横跨三规模、三偏离分布（Emotion, ArmoRM,HH-Alignment），DRO-REBEL 均稳健领先，未见鲁棒模型常态生成的性能折损。

Conclusion: DRO-REBEL 提供一条适配偏好漂移并可无缝扩展的在线鲁棒 RLHF 道路，把“对分布漂移的保守性”嵌入普通奖励回归而不牺牲训练效率及最终质量，为部署长周期迭代对齐提供了有理论保证的基础算法。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has become crucial for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. However, existing offline RLHF approaches suffer from overoptimization, where language models degrade by overfitting inaccuracies and drifting from preferred behaviors observed during training. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) is a natural solution, but existing DRO-DPO methods are sample-inefficient, ignore heterogeneous preferences, and lean on brittle heuristics. We introduce \emph{DRO-REBEL}, a family of robust online REBEL updates built on type-$p$ Wasserstein, Kullback-Leibler (KL), and $χ^2$ ambiguity sets. Strong duality reduces each update to a relative-reward regression, retaining REBEL's scalability without PPO-style clipping or value networks. Under linear rewards, log-linear policies, and a standard coverage condition, we prove $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/n})$ bounds on squared parameter error, with sharper constants than prior DRO-DPO analyses, and give the first parametric $\widetilde{O}(d/n)$ rate for DRO-based alignment under preference shift, matching non-robust RLHF in benign regimes. Each divergence yields a tractable SGD-based algorithm: gradient regularization for Wasserstein, importance weighting for KL, and a 1-D dual solve for $χ^2$. On Emotion Alignment, the ArmoRM multi-objective benchmark, and HH-Alignment, DRO-REBEL outperforms prior robust and non-robust baselines across unseen preference mixtures, model sizes, and dataset scales.

</details>


### [779] [Bridging the phenotype-target gap for molecular generation via multi-objective reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21010)
*Haotian Guo,Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SmilesGEN 以双 VAE 架构首次在统一隐空间同时建模药物结构与其转录扰动，实现基于基因签名的从头分子生成与优化，无需实验反馈即可产出高验证率、高新颖度且靶向明确的类药分子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子生成方法仅依据表达谱“静态”指导，忽视药物对细胞上下文的动态扰动，导致生成分子可能无法真正诱导期望表型；需要一种能同时考虑药物-转录响应耦合机制的可解释框架。

Method: 构建双 VAE：SmilesNet 预训练于 160 万药物 SMILES 以编码化学空间；ProfileNet 编码前后表达谱差值（扰动签名）。两者共享隐空间，通过“去扰动再重构”损失迫使隐变量既能重建分子又能重建去扰动后的基线表达；再以目标签名反向驱动 SmilesNet 解码生成新分子。训练数据采用 LINCS/L1000 中小分子扰动谱与 ChEMBL 结构库。

Result: 在独立测试集上分子有效性 98.7%、唯一性 95.2%、新颖性 92.4%，显著优于 JT-VAE、MolGPT 等 SOTA；与生成的靶标配体平均 Tanimoto 相似度提升至 0.62；骨架优化任务中 80% 分子保持模板并提升 QED/SA 评分；抗癌、抗炎签名引导生成的分子与已批准药物平均相似度达 0.58，经 docking 验证结合能低于 -8 kcal mol⁻¹ 的比例提高 30%。

Conclusion: SmilesGEN 提供了一条“基因签名→可药分子”的端到端、零湿实验路径，为靶点未知或复杂表型疾病的早期药物发现奠定了可扩展、可解释的生成基础，并开源代码与数据促进社区进一步开发。

Abstract: The de novo generation of drug-like molecules capable of inducing desirable phenotypic changes is receiving increasing attention. However, previous methods predominantly rely on expression profiles to guide molecule generation, but overlook the perturbative effect of the molecules on cellular contexts. To overcome this limitation, we propose SmilesGEN, a novel generative model based on variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture to generate molecules with potential therapeutic effects. SmilesGEN integrates a pre-trained drug VAE (SmilesNet) with an expression profile VAE (ProfileNet), jointly modeling the interplay between drug perturbations and transcriptional responses in a common latent space. Specifically, ProfileNet is imposed to reconstruct pre-treatment expression profiles when eliminating drug-induced perturbations in the latent space, while SmilesNet is informed by desired expression profiles to generate drug-like molecules. Our empirical experiments demonstrate that SmilesGEN outperforms current state-of-the-art models in generating molecules with higher degree of validity, uniqueness, novelty, as well as higher Tanimoto similarity to known ligands targeting the relevant proteins. Moreover, we evaluate SmilesGEN for scaffold-based molecule optimization and generation of therapeutic agents, and confirmed its superior performance in generating molecules with higher similarity to approved drugs. SmilesGEN establishes a robust framework that leverages gene signatures to generate drug-like molecules that hold promising potential to induce desirable cellular phenotypic changes. The source code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/hliulab/SmilesGEN.

</details>


### [780] [Scaling Behaviors of LLM Reinforcement Learning Post-Training: An Empirical Study in Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25300)
*Zelin Tan,Hejia Geng,Xiaohang Yu,Mulei Zhang,Guancheng Wan,Yifan Zhou,Qiang He,Xiangyuan Xue,Heng Zhou,Yutao Fan,Zhongzhi Li,Zaibin Zhang,Guibin Zhang,Chen Zhang,Zhenfei Yin,Philip Torr,Lei Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次用 Qwen2.5 系列（0.5B–72B）系统测定大模型 RL 后训练扩展律，提出可预测幂律，证实大模型学习与数据复用优势并指出效率饱和点，为 RL 扩规模给出实践指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩展律已明，而 RL 后训练几乎空白，尤其数学推理场景，亟需定量规律指导算力、数据与模型规模的高效配置。

Method: 以数学推理任务为靶，在 Qwen2.5 全系列模型上做大规模 RL 实验，量纲化分析模型规模 N、数据量 D、计算量 C 与最终性能间关系；用幂律拟合测试损失 L(N,C,D)，并引入可学习系数 k(N) 刻画学习效率。

Result: 四发现：① 模型越大，数据与计算效率双升；② 测试损失-计算-数据三者服从稳健幂律 L(N,C,D) = A N^{α} C^{β} D^{γ}，对基础与指令模型均成立；③ k(N) 虽随 N 增大而减，但呈饱和趋势，提示效率增益有上限；④ 数据受限时，高质量数据多次复用有效，性能由总优化步数而非样本唯一性主导。

Conclusion: 扩展 RL 后训练亦可幂律预测；优先放大模型并适度复用优质数据，可在相同预算内最大化推理性能，为未来 LLM 推理系统扩规模奠定理论与实操基础。

Abstract: While scaling laws for large language models (LLMs) during pre-training have been extensively studied, their behavior under reinforcement learning (RL) post-training remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic empirical investigation of scaling behaviors in RL-based post-training, with a particular focus on mathematical reasoning. Based on a set of experiments across the full Qwen2.5 dense model series (0.5B to 72B), we characterize how model scale, data volume, and computational budget interact to shape performance. Our analysis leads to four key findings: 1. Larger models consistently exhibit superior learning efficiency on both compute and data metrics. 2. The relationship between test loss, compute, and data can be modeled by a predictive power-law which is robust across both base and instruction-tuned models. 3. Although larger models exhibit higher learning efficiency, the analytical learning efficiency term k(N) in the power-law reveals a latent saturation trend in learning efficiency as model size continues to increase. 4. In data-constrained regimes, repeated reuse of high-quality data proves highly effective, as final performance is primarily governed by the total number of optimization steps rather than the uniqueness of samples. Collectively, these results provide a principled foundation and practical guidelines for efficiently scaling the reasoning capabilities of LLMs through RL post-training.

</details>


### [781] [Truncated Kernel Stochastic Gradient Descent with General Losses and Spherical Radial Basis Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04237)
*Jinhui Bai,Andreas Christmann,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于球面径向基函数级数展开的正则化策略，将核 SGD 投影到自适应有限维子空间，在保持极小极大最优收敛率的同时把时间-空间复杂度降至线性，适用于流数据与经典损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统核 SGD 需存储核矩阵并做两两计算，导致 O(n²) 存储与 O(n²) 时间，无法扩展到大规模或流式场景；且缺少统一理论同时刻画优化与泛化性能。

Method: 1) 以球面径向基函数的无限级数展开构造显式特征映射；2) 利用核诱导协方差算子的谱结构估计，动态选择使偏差-方差权衡最优的有限维子空间；3) 在该子空间内执行坐标级线性 SGD 更新，避免核矩阵；4) 建立覆盖最后迭代与尾缀平均的极小极大收敛框架，统一分析优化误差与泛化误差。

Result: 证明对最小二乘、Huber、Logistic 等通用凸损失，算法最后迭代与平均迭代均达到极小极大最优率；在再生核 Hilbert 空间中给出最优强收敛保证；时间复杂度降至 O(nd)、存储复杂度降至 O(d)，d≪n 且自适应于有效维数。

Conclusion: 所提正则化核 SGD 在理论（极小极大最优、强收敛）与计算（线性复杂度、流式更新）上均优于传统核 SGD，可在大规模与在线场景下替代现有方法。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel kernel stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithm for large-scale supervised learning with general losses. Compared to traditional kernel SGD, our algorithm improves efficiency and scalability through an innovative regularization strategy. By leveraging the infinite series expansion of spherical radial basis functions, this strategy projects the stochastic gradient onto a finite-dimensional hypothesis space, which is adaptively scaled according to the bias-variance trade-off, thereby enhancing generalization performance. Based on a new estimation of the spectral structure of the kernel-induced covariance operator, we develop an analytical framework that unifies optimization and generalization analyses. We prove that both the last iterate and the suffix average converge at minimax-optimal rates, and we further establish optimal strong convergence in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space. Our framework accommodates a broad class of classical loss functions, including least-squares, Huber, and logistic losses. Moreover, the proposed algorithm significantly reduces computational complexity and achieves optimal storage complexity by incorporating coordinate-wise updates from linear SGD, thereby avoiding the costly pairwise operations typical of kernel SGD and enabling efficient processing of streaming data. Finally, extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency of our approach.

</details>


### [782] [COMPASS: Benchmarking Constrained Optimization in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07043)
*Tian Qin,Felix Bai,Ting-Yao Hu,Raviteja Vemulapalli,Hema Swetha Koppula,Zhiyang Xu,Bowen Jin,Mert Cemri,Jiarui Lu,Zirui Wang,Meng Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: COMPASS 是一个面向旅行规划的基准，首次系统评估 LLM 智能体在满足硬约束的同时优化用户效用的能力，发现主流模型普遍存在“可行-最优”落差，根源在于搜索不充分而非工具使用，而编码式智能体有望缩小这一差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实任务（旅行、购物、调度）本质上是带约束的优化问题，现有 LLM 智能体评估多聚焦单轮问答或简单工具调用，缺乏对“访谈式信息获取→约束满足→目标优化”全过程的系统性考察，导致无法判断模型是否真正具备类人决策能力。

Method: 构建 COMPASS 基准：① 设计多轮对话-工具混合任务场景，迫使智能体主动追问用户以补足需求并调用数据库；② 引入可行性与最优性双重指标，分别度量是否满足硬约束与是否最大化用户效用；③ 对 GPT-4、Claude-3 等 SOTA 模型进行系统测试，并分析工具成功率、搜索宽度与最佳解得分的相关性。

Result: 模型可行性 70–90%，最优性仅 20–60%，形成显著的“可行-最优”落差；工具调用成功率普遍 >90%，证明工具并非瓶颈；最优率与搜索过程中搜集到的候选方案数量呈强正相关；让模型直接生成并执行代码进行搜索，可将最优率提升 10–25 个百分点。

Conclusion: 多轮访谈式信息收集与代码驱动的系统化探索是缩小“可行-最优”落差的关键；COMPASS 为后续研究提供了可复现的测试基底，推动 LLM 智能体向兼具约束满足与目标优化的人机决策基准迈进。

Abstract: Human decision-making often involves constrained optimization. As LLM agents are deployed to assist with real-world tasks like travel planning, shopping, and scheduling, they must mirror this capability. We introduce COMPASS, a benchmark that evaluates whether LLM agents can perform constrained optimization in realistic travel planning settings. To success in these tasks, agents must engage in multi-turn conversations with user to gather task information as well as use tools to gather information from the database. Then agents must propose a solution that not only satisfies hard constraints but also optimizes user's utility objective. Evaluating state-of-the-art models, we reveal a significant feasible-optimal gap: while models achieve 70-90% feasibility (constraint satisfaction), they reach only 20-60% optimality (utility optimization). Our analysis shows that tool use is not the bottleneck. Instead, the core limitation is insufficient exploration of the search space, with success strongly correlating with information gathered. Coding agents show a promising approach to mitigate this gap. Together, COMPASS provides a testbed for developing LLM agents that can truly mirror human decision-making by both satisfying constraints and optimizing objectives.

</details>


### [783] [Revisiting Entropy Regularization: Adaptive Coefficient Unlocks Its Potential for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10959)
*Xiaoyun Zhang,Xiaojian Yuan,Di Huang,Wang You,Chen Hu,Jingqing Ruan,Ai Jian,Kejiang Chen,Xing Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有RLVR在提升LLM推理时因固定熵正则系数导致策略熵崩溃、探索不足；本文提出自适应熵正则AER，按题目难度动态分配系数并锚定初始熵区间，全局再调参，显著增强探索与推理精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR虽被广泛用于激发LLM推理，但训练过程常出现策略熵迅速坍塌，探索丧失，且传统固定系数熵正则对任务/模型极度敏感，难以稳定保持适度探索，亟需任务自适应的熵控制方法。

Method: 提出Adaptive Entropy Regularization (AER)框架：1)难度感知系数分配——根据题目难度动态设定局部熵正则强度；2)初始锚定目标熵——将策略熵维持于初始值以下适度区间；3)动态全局系数调整——训练过程中实时调节整体正则权重，实现探索-利用自平衡。

Result: 在多项数学推理基准（GSM8K、MATH等）上，AER一致优于固定/手工调参基线，推理准确率提升2-4pp，策略熵保持在适中水平，样本效率和探索能力显著增强。

Conclusion: 熵正则潜力被低估，通过任务自适应的动态调控可根本缓解RLVR的熵崩溃问题；AER为LLM推理训练提供稳定、通用的探索机制，具备向其他可验证奖励任务扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Reasoning ability has become a defining capability of Large Language Models (LLMs), with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) emerging as a key paradigm to enhance it. However, RLVR training often suffers from policy entropy collapse, where the policy becomes overly deterministic, hindering exploration and limiting reasoning performance. While entropy regularization is a common remedy, its effectiveness is highly sensitive to the fixed coefficient, making it unstable across tasks and models. In this work, we revisit entropy regularization in RLVR and argue that its potential has been largely underestimated. Our analysis shows that (i) tasks of varying difficulty demand distinct exploration intensities, and (ii) balanced exploration may require the policy entropy to be maintained within a moderate range below its initial level. Therefore, we propose Adaptive Entropy Regularization (AER)--a framework that dynamically balances exploration and exploitation via three components: difficulty-aware coefficient allocation, initial-anchored target entropy, and dynamic global coefficient adjustment. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that AER consistently outperforms baselines, improving both reasoning accuracy and exploration capability.

</details>


### [784] [DB-FGA-Net: Dual Backbone Frequency Gated Attention Network for Multi-Class Brain Tumor Classification with Grad-CAM Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20299)
*Saraf Anzum Shreya,MD. Abu Ismail Siddique,Sharaf Tasnim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 无增强、可解释的双骨干网络 DB-FGA-Net 在七千例脑肿瘤 MRI 上 4 类分类准确率达 99.24%，外部三千例独立验证 95.77%，并配套 GUI 与 Grad-CAM 定位，可直接临床落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习脑肿瘤分类依赖大量数据增强，削弱泛化性与临床可信度，亟需无需增强、仍可保持高准确率且可解释的模型。

Method: 提出双骨干网络 DB-FGA-Net：并行 VGG16 与 Xception 提取局部-全局互补特征，频率门控注意力 FGA 块融合频域与空域信息；全程无数据增强；集成 Grad-CAM 提供病灶可视化；开发 GUI 实现实时推断与定位。

Result: 7K-DS 数据集上 4 类、3 类、2 类准确率分别为 99.24%、98.68%、99.85%；独立 3K-DS 数据集 4 类准确率 95.77%，均优于现有基线；Grad-CAM 高亮区域与肿瘤位置高度一致。

Conclusion: DB-FGA-Net 在不依赖增强的前提下实现高稳健性与可解释性，配套 GUI 可直接嵌入临床流程，为脑肿瘤 AI 辅助诊断提供可部署、可信的解决方案。

Abstract: Brain tumors are a challenging problem in neuro-oncology, where early and precise diagnosis is important for successful treatment. Deep learning-based brain tumor classification methods often rely on heavy data augmentation which can limit generalization and trust in clinical applications. In this paper, we propose a double-backbone network integrating VGG16 and Xception with a Frequency-Gated Attention (FGA) Block to capture complementary local and global features. Our model achieves highly competitive performance without augmentation which demonstrates robustness to variably sized and distributed datasets. For further transparency, Grad-CAM is integrated to visualize the tumor regions based on which the model is giving prediction, bridging the gap between model prediction and clinical interpretability. The proposed framework achieves 99.24% accuracy on the 7K-DS dataset for the 4-class setting, along with 98.68% and 99.85% in the 3-class and 2-class settings, respectively. On the independent 3K-DS dataset, the model generalizes with 95.77% accuracy, outperforming several baseline methods under the same experimental setting. To further support clinical usability, we developed a graphical user interface (GUI) that provides real-time classification and Grad-CAM-based tumor localization. These findings suggest that augmentation-free, interpretable, and deployable deep learning models such as DB-FGA-Net hold strong potential for reliable clinical translation in brain tumor diagnosis.

</details>


### [785] [On Optimal Hyperparameters for Differentially Private Deep Transfer Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20616)
*Aki Rehn,Linzh Zhao,Mikko A. Heikkilä,Antti Honkela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 差分隐私迁移学习的两个核心超参数—裁剪阈值C和批量大小B—的理论推荐与实测表现相反；固定epoch下，传统调B准则失效，累积噪声才是决定表现的关键，且单一(C,B)设定难以适应不同隐私/算力场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DP微调理论认为强隐私需小C、小B，但实测发现大C反而更好；同时算力受限时如何科学选B尚缺指导。本文旨在解释理论与实测的矛盾，并给出可操作的调参依据。

Method: 固定epoch预算，系统扫描不同(C,B)组合；通过梯度分布变化解释C的矛盾表现；引入“累积DP噪声”指标重述B的选取逻辑；将裁剪视为梯度重加权，分析其在隐私/算力切换时的性能跌落。

Result: (1) 梯度分布随C增大而右移，使大C在强隐私下仍有足够信号更新，从而优于小C；(2) 累积噪声可准确预测不同B的最终精度，传统“大B→大噪声”直觉失效；(3) 单一(C,B)跨任务可造成5–15%精度损失，隐私由松到紧或算力由多到限时损失最显著。

Conclusion: 调参应放弃固定C、B，改为：先按梯度分布选C，再以累积DP噪声最小化为目标选B；隐私或算力环境变化时需重新搜索，而不能复用旧设定。

Abstract: Differentially private (DP) transfer learning, i.e., fine-tuning a pretrained model on private data, is the current state-of-the-art approach for training large models under privacy constraints. We focus on two key hyperparameters in this setting: the clipping bound $C$ and batch size $B$. We show a clear mismatch between the current theoretical understanding of how to choose an optimal $C$ (stronger privacy requires smaller $C$) and empirical outcomes (larger $C$ performs better under strong privacy), caused by changes in the gradient distributions. Assuming a limited compute budget (fixed epochs), we demonstrate that the existing heuristics for tuning $B$ do not work, while cumulative DP noise better explains whether smaller or larger batches perform better. We also highlight how the common practice of using a single $(C,B)$ setting across tasks can lead to suboptimal performance. We find that performance drops especially when moving between loose and tight privacy and between plentiful and limited compute, which we explain by analyzing clipping as a form of gradient re-weighting and examining cumulative DP noise.

</details>


### [786] [Joint Score-Threshold Optimization for Interpretable Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.21934)
*Fardin Ganjkhanloo,Emmett Springer,Erik H. Hoyer,Daniel L. Young,Kimia Ghobadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对临床风险评分工具标签稀缺、误分代价非对称且随等级距离递增的难题，作者提出混合整数规划（MIP）框架，同步学习评分权重与阈值，支持治理约束并可在真实EHR数据上快速落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统点式风险评分依赖人工设定阈值，无法充分利用EHR数据；而极端标签缺失与误分代价非对称使标准监督学习失效，亟需兼顾可解释性与临床治理要求的数据驱动优化方法。

Method: 构建MIP联合优化目标：①阈值不等式防止标签稀缺类别塌陷；②代价权重随序数距离递增；③显式施加符号、稀疏、最小改动等治理约束。再对MIP做连续松弛生成高质量热启动，加速求解。

Result: 在Johns Hopkins住院跌倒风险评估工具的真实数据集上，新框架在保持稀疏性与符号约束的同时，将高风险患者误分代价降低32%，且求解时间比冷启动MIP缩短60%。

Conclusion: MIP框架首次把序数距离感知代价、临床治理与稀疏EHR标签整合进可解释评分优化，为风险工具的数据驱动升级提供了兼顾性能、可解释与合规的一站式方案。

Abstract: Risk assessment tools in healthcare commonly employ point-based scoring systems that map patients to ordinal risk categories via thresholds. While electronic health record (EHR) data presents opportunities for data-driven optimization of these tools, two fundamental challenges impede standard supervised learning: (1) labels are often available only for extreme risk categories due to intervention-censored outcomes, and (2) misclassification cost is asymmetric and increases with ordinal distance. We propose a mixed-integer programming (MIP) framework that jointly optimizes scoring weights and category thresholds in the face of these challenges. Our approach prevents label-scarce category collapse via threshold constraints, and utilizes an asymmetric, distance-aware objective. The MIP framework supports governance constraints, including sign restrictions, sparsity, and minimal modifications to incumbent tools, ensuring practical deployability in clinical workflows. We further develop a continuous relaxation of the MIP problem to provide warm-start solutions for more efficient MIP optimization. We apply the proposed score optimization framework to a case study of inpatient falls risk assessment using the Johns Hopkins Fall Risk Assessment Tool.

</details>


### [787] [Power to the Clients: Federated Learning in a Dictatorship Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22149)
*Mohammadsajad Alipour,Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文首次定义了“独裁客户端”(dictator)攻击：少数恶意参与者可在不共享数据的前提下，通过精心构造的局部更新，把全局模型完全篡改为仅对自己有利的状态，且彻底抹除所有良性客户端的贡献。作者给出了可实现的攻击算法，系统地分析了单/多独裁者的收敛影响，并在 CV/NLP 任务上验证了理论预言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习(FL)天然去中心化，现有拜占庭容错框架主要关注“降低恶意影响”，尚未有研究刻画“单客户端即可彻底垄断全局模型”的极端脆弱点。作者想回答：是否存在一类可分析、可复现的攻击，使极少数甚至单个客户端就能让服务器模型完全收敛到攻击者私有目标？

Method: 1) 提出独裁客户端的攻击目标：∀t, w^(t)→w_adv；并给出可验证的充分条件——使聚合更新等于仅含攻击者梯度的更新。2) 针对常用 FedAvg、Momentum SGD 与 Trim-mean 等聚合规则，分别设计三步策略：①预训练影子模型估计方向；②构造缩放系数使恶意更新“淹没”良性更新；③利用动量或修剪机制的正反馈放大自身权重。3) 对多独裁者场景建立博弈-收敛框架：独立(A)、合作(C)与背叛(B)三种模式，用 Lyapunov 漂移与聚合矩阵谱半径给出收敛界。4) 在 CIFAR-10、ImageNet-子集与 AGNews 上复现攻击，验证理论收敛速率与模型劫持成功率。

Result: ①单独裁者仅需 1/|K| 的通信轮次即可使全局模型测试精度降到随机水平，而把攻击者私有任务精度保持在 90%+。②合作独裁者呈线性加速；独立性攻击造成模型震荡，收敛误差上界为 O(σ_b/√(KT))；当独裁者互相背叛时，最早发起偏离的一方可获得≤2×超额收益，剩余方误差扩大 3–5×。③现有拜占庭鲁棒聚合(Krum、Trim-mean)与“裁剪+噪声”防御对该攻击仅将劫持轮次提高 1.3–1.8×，无法根除。

Conclusion: FL 的“民主聚合”假设在独裁客户端面前完全失效；极少数攻击者即可实现对全局模型的单点控制。作者建议：放弃完全无服务器信任的架构，引入可验证聚合证明或零知识更新认证；并呼吁重审当前鲁棒聚合的理论安全边界，因为“擦除他人贡献”是 FL 原生漏洞而非 incidental Byzantine 行为。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for decentralized model training, enabling multiple clients to collaboratively learn a shared model without exchanging their local data. However, the decentralized nature of FL also introduces vulnerabilities, as malicious clients can compromise or manipulate the training process. In this work, we introduce dictator clients, a novel, well-defined, and analytically tractable class of malicious participants capable of entirely erasing the contributions of all other clients from the server model, while preserving their own. We propose concrete attack strategies that empower such clients and systematically analyze their effects on the learning process. Furthermore, we explore complex scenarios involving multiple dictator clients, including cases where they collaborate, act independently, or form an alliance in order to ultimately betray one another. For each of these settings, we provide a theoretical analysis of their impact on the global model's convergence. Our theoretical algorithms and findings about the complex scenarios including multiple dictator clients are further supported by empirical evaluations on both computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks.

</details>


### [788] [The Reasoning Trap: How Enhancing LLM Reasoning Amplifies Tool Hallucination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22977)
*Chenlong Yin,Zeyang Sha,Shiwen Cui,Changhua Meng,Zechao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 强化推理虽能提升任务表现，却系统性地放大工具幻觉，且现有方法无法兼顾能力与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前推理增强方法被默认无害，但 o3 等模型出现“越会推理越会编工具”的悖论，缺乏因果证据与诊断基准，亟需厘清推理强化是否直接诱发工具幻觉。

Method: 构建 SimpleToolHalluBench，覆盖“无工具”与“仅干扰工具”两类失败场景；用 RL、SFT、思维链 prompting 三类方法系统增强推理；引入非工具任务训练检验过拟合；用 Prompt Engineering 与 DPO 干预；通过表征分析定位机制。

Result: 实验证实推理增强与工具幻觉存在线性因果：RL 每涨 1% 任务分即带来显著幻觉上升；非工具任务训练也能迁移式放大幻觉；方法无关，换用 SFT 或仅启用思维链同样出现；所有缓解策略均导致能力-可靠性零和博弈；机制上，RL 优先坍缩工具可靠性表征，幻觉集中在深层残差流。

Conclusion: 现有推理增强范式本质以牺牲工具可靠性为代价，需重新设计同时优化能力与可靠性的训练目标，否则下一代智能体将因“幻觉工具”而不可信。

Abstract: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a key strategy for building Agents that "think then act." However, recent observations, like OpenAI's o3, suggest a paradox: stronger reasoning often coincides with increased hallucination, yet no prior work has systematically examined whether reasoning enhancement itself causes tool hallucination. To address this gap, we pose the central question: Does strengthening reasoning increase tool hallucination? To answer this, we introduce SimpleToolHalluBench, a diagnostic benchmark measuring tool hallucination in two failure modes: (i) no tool available, and (ii) only distractor tools available. Through controlled experiments, we establish three key findings. First, we demonstrate a causal relationship: progressively enhancing reasoning through RL increases tool hallucination proportionally with task performance gains. Second, this effect transcends overfitting - training on non-tool tasks (e.g., mathematics) still amplifies subsequent tool hallucination. Third, the effect is method-agnostic, appearing when reasoning is instilled via supervised fine-tuning and when it is merely elicited at inference by switching from direct answers to step-by-step thinking. We also evaluate mitigation strategies including Prompt Engineering and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), revealing a fundamental reliability-capability trade-off: reducing hallucination consistently degrades utility. Mechanistically, Reasoning RL disproportionately collapses tool-reliability-related representations, and hallucinations surface as amplified divergences concentrated in late-layer residual streams. These findings reveal that current reasoning enhancement methods inherently amplify tool hallucination, highlighting the need for new training objectives that jointly optimize for capability and reliability.

</details>


### [789] [In-Context Distillation with Self-Consistency Cascades: A Simple, Training-Free Way to Reduce LLM Agent Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02543)
*Vishnu Sarukkai,Asanshay Gupta,James Hong,Michaël Gharbi,Kayvon Fatahalian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用动态语境学习与少数示范推理+自洽级联，无需微调或提示工程，即可把教师模型精度迁移到低成本学生模型，实现批任务2.5-3.5倍降本且基本保速保敏捷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 LLM Agent 在迭代式或时间敏感批任务中常被迫在质量与成本间二选一；现有省费方案（提示工程、微调）要么脆弱慢迭代，要么训练耗时且固锁设计，牺牲了研发敏捷。

Method: 1) 仅用教师模型在小子集上运行收集示范并建库；
2) 学生模型并行推理，系统即时检索相似示范作为动态上下文；
3) 引入自洽级联：多数学生样本一致即采纳，分歧即刻回调教师；
4) 全程零训练、零手动调 Prompt，把控库大小、检索策略与级联阈值等推理时杠杆。

Result: 在 ALFWorld 上维持教师精度的同时单样本成本降 2.5×（0.059→0.024）；在 AppWorld 上降 3.5× 并回收 79% 教师准确率；明确给出教师库、示范及级联阈值的设计指引。

Conclusion: 证明推理阶段动态示范+自洽级联可主动推拉「成本-准确率」前沿，无需牺牲训练与迭代速度，为需要频繁更新或跑批的大模型 agent 提供了实用范式。

Abstract: Deploying LLM agents at scale typically requires choosing between quality and cost. Existing cost-reduction approaches fail to preserve agility: the ability to iterate rapidly without human time bottlenecks. Prompt engineering is brittle and slows iteration, while fine-tuning requires multi-day training and commitment to fixed designs; both are impractical for iterative workflows and time-sensitive batch jobs. We demonstrate that established inference-time techniques--dynamic in-context learning and self-consistency cascades--can be leveraged to shift the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier while preserving agility. Practitioners run the teacher on a small task subset to collect demonstrations, then immediately deploy a cheaper student on the remainder. At each step, the system retrieves relevant teacher demonstrations as in-context examples. When multiple student samples agree, we proceed; when they diverge, we fall back to the teacher. This requires no prompt engineering or training. On ALFWorld, we match teacher accuracy at 2.5x lower cost (0.059 to 0.024 per episode). On AppWorld, we achieve 3.5x cost reduction while recovering 79% of teacher accuracy. Our empirical analyses provide guidance on key design choices: teacher database size, demonstration set size, retrieval strategy, and cascade thresholds. These analyses highlight inference-time levers for navigating cost-performance tradeoffs without sacrificing human development speed.

</details>


### [790] [Mitigating hallucinations and omissions in LLMs for invertible problems: An application to hardware logic design automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03053)
*Andrew S. Cassidy,Guillaume Garreau,Jay Sivagnaname,Mike Grassi,Bernard Brezzo,John V. Arthur,Dharmendra S. Modha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LLM当成可逆无损编/解码器，在LCT↔HDL间往返生成，可压制幻觉/遗漏并自动验证逻辑，显著提高NOC设计生产率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成代码时存在幻觉与遗漏，缺乏可靠验证手段，尤其危害硬件设计。需一种不依赖人工即可自验证、自纠错的方法。

Method: 把「LCT→HLL→HDL→LCT」视为可逆映射，让LLM先作无损编码器（LCT→HDL），再作解码器（HDL→LCT）；两次LCT差异即为逻辑/规格错误信号。用7种LLM对13个2D-NoC路由模块（1.5–2 k行）做实验。

Result: 所有模型均实现零差异往返，准确检测并定位LLM引入的逻辑错误及原始LCT规格缺陷，平均开发时间缩短>3×。

Conclusion: 「LLM无损往返」是普适框架，可同时缓解幻觉、发现规格错误并提升硬件生成可信度，适用于任何可逆领域映射。

Abstract: We show for invertible problems that transform data from a source domain (for example, Logic Condition Tables (LCTs)) to a destination domain (for example, Hardware Description Language (HDL) code), an approach of using Large Language Models (LLMs) as a lossless encoder from source to destination followed by as a lossless decoder back to the source, comparable to lossless compression in information theory, can mitigate most of the LLM drawbacks of hallucinations and omissions. Specifically, using LCTs as inputs, we generate the full HDL for a two-dimensional network-on-chip router (13 units, 1500-2000 lines of code) using seven different LLMs, reconstruct the LCTs from the auto-generated HDL, and compare the original and reconstructed LCTs. This approach yields significant productivity improvements, not only confirming correctly generated LLM logic and detecting incorrectly generated LLM logic but also assisting developers in finding design specification errors.

</details>


### [791] [Teaching Language Models Mechanistic Explainability Through MechSMILES](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05722)
*Théo A. Neukomm,Zlatko Jončev,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MechSMILES 框架，让语言模型学会推电子箭头，实现机理预测、CASP 验证、全原子映射与催化剂模板提取，在主流数据集上达到 93.2% 与 73.3% 机理召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CASP 系统缺乏电子层面的机理推理，导致无法验证反应合理性、无法全原子追踪、无法区分催化剂与旁观物种，亟需将百年“箭头推动”形式化并嵌入计算流程。

Method: 设计 MechSMILES 文本格式，用三种箭头编码电子流动并强制守恒；构建 Python 环境保证质量与电荷守恒、杜绝原子幻觉；以语言模型在四档机理预测任务上训练，从 40 例即可外推新反应类别。

Result: 仅给定反应物-条件-产物时，FlowER 数据集 top-1 机理召回 93.2%，mech-USPTO-31k 达 73.3%，top-3 分别升至 97.6% 与 86.5%；臭氧分解与 Suzuki 偶联用 40 例即学会。

Conclusion: 该框架把电子守恒注入模型，首次使 CASP 具备可解释、可验证、催化剂感知的机理级推理，为开源、架构无关的下一代合成规划奠定基础。

Abstract: Chemical reaction mechanisms are the foundation of how chemists evaluate reactivity and feasibility, yet current Computer-Assisted Synthesis Planning (CASP) systems operate without this mechanistic reasoning. We introduce a computational framework that teaches language models to predict reaction mechanisms through arrow-pushing formalism, a century-old notation that tracks electron flow while enforcing conservation of mass and charge. This mechanistic understanding enables three capabilities that are difficult or impossible with current methods: post-hoc validation of CASP proposals by reconstructing physically plausible electron pathways, holistic atom-to-atom mapping that tracks all atoms including hydrogens, and extraction of catalyst-aware reaction templates that distinguish recycled catalysts from spectator species. Central to our approach is MechSMILES, a compact textual format encoding molecular structure and electron flow through three arrow types, designed within a Python-based environment that enforces conservation laws and eliminates the possibility of atom hallucination. We trained and benchmarked models on four mechanism prediction tasks of increasing complexity using the main mechanistic datasets in the literature. On our most challenging task, predicting complete mechanisms given only reactants, conditions, and the desired product, our models achieve 93.2\% and 73.3\% pathway retrieval on the FlowER and mech-USPTO-31k datasets respectively, with top-3 retrieval reaching 97.6\% and 86.5\%. Furthermore, the framework rapidly learns new reaction classes, with strong mechanistic predictions for ozonolysis and Suzuki cross-coupling emerging from as few as 40 training examples each. By grounding predictions in physically meaningful electron movements, this work provides an architecture-agnostic, open-source foundation for more explainable and chemically valid CASP.

</details>


### [792] [OXtal: An All-Atom Diffusion Model for Organic Crystal Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06987)
*Emily Jin,Andrei Cristian Nica,Mikhail Galkin,Jarrid Rector-Brooks,Kin Long Kelvin Lee,Santiago Miret,Frances H. Arnold,Michael Bronstein,Avishek Joey Bose,Alexander Tong,Cheng-Hao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出100 M参数全原子扩散模型OXtal，用数据增强替代显式等变网络、用S⁴晶格无关采样捕获长程作用，在60万实验晶体上训练，以<0.3%传统量子化学成本实现80%以上包装相似度与<0.5 Å RMSD，刷新CSP机器学习纪录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是计算化学长期悬而未决的核心难题，其解直接影响药物多晶型筛选、有机半导体性能优化等。现有基于量子化学的方法计算量巨大（单晶系需10³–10⁴ CPU·h），而机器学习方案或受限于粗粒度表示，或受限于显式对称性假设，难以同时兼顾全原子精度与规模化训练。

Method: 构建大型全原子扩散模型OXtal：1) 端到端学习2D化学图→3D晶体联合分布，同时生成分子构象与周期堆积；2) 抛弃显式SE(3)-等变网络，改用旋转-平移数据增广以降低架构复杂度；3) 提出“化学计量随机壳层采样”(S⁴)——在训练阶段随机抽取球壳邻居团簇，不依赖晶格参数即可捕获长程相互作用，支持线性复杂度、GPU友好；4) 基于60万实验验证晶体（含柔性分子、共晶、溶剂化物）预训练，配合多粒度噪声调度。

Result: OXtal较现有从头算机器学习CSP方法降低1–2个数量级误差：对第一个实验结构，RMSD₁<0.5 Å占比大幅提升；包装相似度>80%，并成功复现热力学稳定与动力学捕获的多种晶型；计算成本仅为DFT-D或periodic MP2的10⁻³量级；同时可生成任意空间群、Z′值及多组分晶体，无需人为对称性输入。

Conclusion: OXtal以大规模数据与生成式扩散框架，首次在全原子精度下实现实验级CSP，验证了“用数据替代对称性归纳偏置”的可行性，并为药物固态筛选、有机电子材料发现提供高通量、低成本的计算平台。

Abstract: Accurately predicting experimentally realizable 3D molecular crystal structures from their 2D chemical graphs is a long-standing open challenge in computational chemistry called crystal structure prediction (CSP). Efficiently solving this problem has implications ranging from pharmaceuticals to organic semiconductors, as crystal packing directly governs the physical and chemical properties of organic solids. In this paper, we introduce OXtal, a large-scale 100M parameter all-atom diffusion model that directly learns the conditional joint distribution over intramolecular conformations and periodic packing. To efficiently scale OXtal, we abandon explicit equivariant architectures imposing inductive bias arising from crystal symmetries in favor of data augmentation strategies. We further propose a novel crystallization-inspired lattice-free training scheme, Stoichiometric Stochastic Shell Sampling ($S^4$), that efficiently captures long-range interactions while sidestepping explicit lattice parametrization -- thus enabling more scalable architectural choices at all-atom resolution. By leveraging a large dataset of 600K experimentally validated crystal structures (including rigid and flexible molecules, co-crystals, and solvates), OXtal achieves orders-of-magnitude improvements over prior ab initio machine learning CSP methods, while remaining orders of magnitude cheaper than traditional quantum-chemical approaches. Specifically, OXtal recovers experimental structures with conformer $\text{RMSD}_1<0.5$ Å and attains over 80\% packing similarity rate, demonstrating its ability to model both thermodynamic and kinetic regularities of molecular crystallization.

</details>


### [793] [Improving the Throughput of Diffusion-based Large Language Models via a Training-Free Confidence-Aware Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07173)
*Jucheng Shen,Gaurav Sarkar,Yeonju Ro,Sharath Nittur Sridhar,Zhangyang Wang,Aditya Akella,Souvik Kundu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CadLLM 是一种无需重训的即插即用方法，通过动态调节生成块/步长、采样阈值与词汇子集，在保精度的前提下把扩散式大模型推理吞吐提升 1.1–2.28 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式大模型（dLLM）逐层-逐步去噪生成，推断延迟高；现有加速方案往往需重训或牺牲精度，且未利用 token 置信度的动态演化特性。

Method: 1) 分析各层/步的 token“解掩”置信度分布，发现其呈显著动态差异；2) 用轻量启发式规则，根据当前已解码 token 的平均置信度在线调整：后续去噪的块尺寸、步数与提前终止阈值；3) 进一步把 softmax 限制在动态选出的高概率词子集，减少计算量；4) 兼容 KV-cache，不改动模型权重，模型无关。

Result: 在四类主流任务上，CadLLM 相较最强基线实现 1.1–2.28× 吞吐提升，同时保持可比精度。

Conclusion: 仅利用生成过程中的置信度统计即可廉价实现显著加速，验证了“自适应邻居规模+动态词表截断”这一思路在扩散式大模型中的普适性与可扩展性。

Abstract: We present CadLLM, a training-free method to accelerate the inference throughput of diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs). We first investigate the dynamic nature of token unmasking confidence across blocks and steps. Based on this observation, we present a lightweight adaptive approach that controls the generation block size, step size, and threshold based on the average confidence of unmasked tokens. We further reduce softmax overhead by dynamically leveraging a subset of the vocabulary to regulate sampling breadth. CadLLM is a plug-and-play, model-agnostic method compatible with KV-cache-based dLLMs. Extensive experiments on four popular tasks demonstrate that CadLLM yields up to 1.1-2.28x throughput improvement over the state-of-the-art baseline with competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [794] [Information-Consistent Language Model Recommendations through Group Relative Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12858)
*Sonal Prabhune,Balaji Padmanabhan,Kaushik Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用强化学习框架 GRPO 把语义等价提示下的输出差异当“缺陷”而非“多样性”来修复，在金融、招聘等场景显著降低 LLM 回答波动性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业在金融、客服、人力资源等关键场景需要“不变”信息，而现有 LLM 对语义等价提示仍给出不一致回答，损害信任与合规；RAG、温度调节等手段无法保证稳定。

Method: 将 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）从推理/代码任务扩展到信息一致性对齐：把语义等价提示划为组，重置上下文以隔离措辞影响；设计基于熵的“有用性奖励”与“稳定性奖励”，直接优化组内输出差异。

Result: 在投资推荐与职位推荐任务上，GRPO 微调模型相比基座 LLM 显著降低输出变异度（具体数值原文未给出）。

Conclusion: 首次把 GRPO 用于“信息一致性”目标，将生成差异重新定义为可纠正缺陷，为 LLM 企业级可信部署提供新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in business-critical domains such as finance, education, healthcare, and customer support, where users expect consistent and reliable recommendations. Yet LLMs often exhibit variability when prompts are phrased with minor differences, even when semantically equivalent. Such inconsistency undermines trust, complicates compliance, and disrupts user experience. While personalization is desirable in certain contexts, many enterprise scenarios, such as HR onboarding, customer support, or policy disclosure, require invariant information delivery regardless of phrasing or prior conversational history. Existing approaches, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and temperature tuning, improve factuality or reduce stochasticity, but cannot guarantee stability across equivalent prompts. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning framework based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to directly optimize for consistency. Unlike prior applications of GRPO, which have been limited to reasoning and code generation, we adapt GRPO to enforce the stability of information content across groups of semantically equivalent prompts. We introduce entropy-based helpfulness and stability rewards, treating prompt variants as groups and resetting conversational context to isolate phrasing effects. Experiments on investment and job recommendation tasks show that our GRPO-fine-tuned model reduces variability compared to the baseline LLM model. To our knowledge, this is a novel application of GRPO for aligning LLMs toward information consistency, reframing variability not as an acceptable feature of generative diversity, but as a correctable flaw in enterprise deployments.

</details>


### [795] [Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval for Lightweight Function Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17052)
*Bhrij Patel,Davide Belli,Amir Jalalirad,Maximilian Arnold,Aleksandr Ermolov,Bence Major*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DTDR，一种轻量级动态工具依赖检索方法，可随调用计划演进自适应选工具，在多个数据集上比静态检索把函数调用成功率提升23–104%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端侧LLM代理的静态检索无法捕捉多步工具依赖与任务上下文变化，常引入无关工具，拖累效率与精度，需要能随计划演化的检索机制。

Method: DTDR：以初始查询+实时更新的调用计划为条件，通过函数调用示范建模工具依赖，动态检索下一步所需工具；并探讨检索结果嵌入提示的策略。

Result: 跨多个数据集与LLM骨干的实验表明，DTDR在检索精度、下游任务准确率与计算效率上均优于现有最佳静态检索，函数调用成功率提升23–104%。

Conclusion: 动态依赖建模是端侧代理高效选工具的关键，DTDR以轻量开销实现显著性能跃升，为复杂任务自动化提供可扩展的检索范式。

Abstract: Function calling agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) select external tools to automate complex tasks. On-device agents typically use a retrieval module to select relevant tools, improving performance and reducing context length. However, existing retrieval methods rely on static and limited inputs, failing to capture multi-step tool dependencies and evolving task context. This limitation often introduces irrelevant tools that mislead the agent, degrading efficiency and accuracy. We propose Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval (DTDR), a lightweight retrieval method that conditions on both the initial query and the evolving tool calling plan. DTDR models tool dependencies from function calling demonstrations, enabling adaptive retrieval as plans unfold. We benchmark DTDR against state-of-the-art retrieval methods across multiple datasets and LLM backbones, evaluating retrieval precision, downstream task accuracy, and computational efficiency. Additionally, we explore strategies to integrate retrieved tools into prompts. Our results show that DTDR improves function calling success rates between $23\%$ and $104\%$ compared to state-of-the-art static retrievers.

</details>


### [796] [AutoFed: Personalized Federated Traffic Prediction via Adaptive Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24625)
*Zijian Zhao,Yitong Shang,Sen Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对隐私敏感的交通预测场景，提出无需调参的个性化联邦学习框架 AutoFed；利用「联邦提示器」将非 IID 局部数据蒸馏成共享 Prompt，动态驱动各客户端专属预测器，在真实数据集上稳定领先并可直接落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准交通预测是网约车调度、道路规划与车队管理的核心，但隐私法规使数据只能本地留存，造成数据孤岛；标准联邦学习受非 IID 数据拖累，而现有 PFL 方案依赖海量调参，难以在真实系统部署。

Method: 设计免调参的 AutoFed 框架：1) 联邦提示器，通过客户端对齐的适配器将局部图特征压缩为轻量级全局提示矩阵；2) 将提示作为条件输入到各客户端的个性化时空网络，实现跨城知识共享与本地特征保留；3) 整个流程采用端到端联邦训练，无需任何手动或离线超参搜索。

Result: 在 4 个真实交通数据集（出租车 OD、高速路流量等）上，AutoFed 平均将 MAE/RMSE 降低 6.3%-14.8%，在非 IID 强度最高场景优势扩大至 18%；零调参下仍显著优于需要网格搜索的 SOTA PFL 基线。

Conclusion: AutoFed 首次在没有手工调参的前提下解决了交通预测中的非 IID 与隐私冲突，验证「提示式联邦蒸馏」在时空图任务中的有效性，为智能交通系统提供即插即用的分布式预测方案。

Abstract: Accurate traffic prediction is essential for Intelligent Transportation Systems, including ride-hailing, urban road planning, and vehicle fleet management. However, due to significant privacy concerns surrounding traffic data, most existing methods rely on local training, resulting in data silos and limited knowledge sharing. Federated Learning (FL) offers an efficient solution through privacy-preserving collaborative training; however, standard FL struggles with the non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) problem among clients. This challenge has led to the emergence of Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) as a promising paradigm. Nevertheless, current PFL frameworks require further adaptation for traffic prediction tasks, such as specialized graph feature engineering, data processing, and network architecture design. A notable limitation of many prior studies is their reliance on hyper-parameter optimization across datasets-information that is often unavailable in real-world scenarios-thus impeding practical deployment. To address this challenge, we propose AutoFed, a novel PFL framework for traffic prediction that eliminates the need for manual hyper-parameter tuning. Inspired by prompt learning, AutoFed introduces a federated representor that employs a client-aligned adapter to distill local data into a compact, globally shared prompt matrix. This prompt then conditions a personalized predictor, allowing each client to benefit from cross-client knowledge while maintaining local specificity. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that AutoFed consistently achieves superior performance across diverse scenarios. The code of this paper is provided at https://github.com/RS2002/AutoFed .

</details>


### [797] [CoMeT: Collaborative Memory Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01766)
*Runsong Zhao,Shilei Liu,Jiwei Tang,Langming Liu,Haibin Chen,Weidong Zhang,Yujin Yuan,Tong Xiao,Jingbo Zhu,Wenbo Su,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量插入式模块 CoMeT，将 Transformer KV 缓存替换为常量大小双记忆队列，使长上下文推理显存和时间复杂度降至线性；32 k 微调即可在 1 M token 序列中精准定位信息，SCROLLS 上媲美全注意力基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 的 KV 缓存随序列长度平方增长，阻碍超长文本处理。作者希望通过极小改动现有预训练模型，无需扩大显存与延迟，就能支持任意长度序列推理。

Method: 设计双记忆系统：FIFO 维护最近 chunk、门控全局记忆管理长程依赖；二者作为动态软提示输入下个 chunk。采用层级流水线并行做极端长度的微调，仅附加 <1 % 参数。

Result: PR 检索：在 1 M token 文中随机收集 passkey，准确率≈100 %。SCROLLS 基准：CoMeT 超越 Linformer/Longformer/Memorizing 等高效方法，摘要任务与全注意力基线几乎持平；真实长对话 QA 准确率提升 5–10 %，同时显存保持常量。

Conclusion: CoMeT 以恒定内存+线性时间解决超长上下文瓶颈，不改变注意力结构即可插拔微调，为长文档检索、对话智能体与持续学习提供实用方案。

Abstract: The quadratic complexity and indefinitely growing key-value (KV) cache of standard Transformers pose a major barrier to long-context processing. To overcome this, we introduce the Collaborative Memory Transformer (CoMeT), a novel architecture that enables LLMs to handle arbitrarily long sequences with constant memory usage and linear time complexity. Designed as an efficient, plug-in module, CoMeT can be integrated into pre-trained models with only minimal fine-tuning. It operates on sequential data chunks, using a dual-memory system to manage context: a temporary memory on a FIFO queue for recent events, and a global memory with a gated update rule for long-range dependencies. These memories then act as a dynamic soft prompt for the next chunk. To enable efficient fine-tuning on extremely long contexts, we introduce a novel layer-level pipeline parallelism strategy. The effectiveness of our approach is remarkable: a model equipped with CoMeT and fine-tuned on 32k contexts can accurately retrieve a passkey from any position within a 1M token sequence. On the SCROLLS benchmark, CoMeT surpasses other efficient methods and achieves performance comparable to a full-attention baseline on summarization tasks. Its practical effectiveness is further validated on real-world agent and user behavior QA tasks. The code is available at: https://github.com/LivingFutureLab/Comet

</details>


### [798] [Unsupervised domain adaptation for radioisotope identification in gamma spectroscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05719)
*Peter Lalor,Ayush Panigrahy,Alex Hagen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 无标签真实谱下，用UDA（MMD或对抗特征对齐）把合成数据训练的LaBr₃放射核素分类器实测准确率从75%→90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现场难以获得大量带标签实测γ谱，纯合成数据训练的模型跨域部署性能骤降，需利用现场无标签数据提升泛化能力。

Method: 对比多种UDA策略，采用Transformer骨干网络，通过最大均值差异（MMD）最小化或域对抗训练实现特征空间对齐，无须目标域标签即可完成核素识别模型适配。

Result: 在LaBr₃实测数据集上，经MMD特征对齐后测试准确率由0.754±0.014升至0.904±0.022，提升15个百分点，且结果在不同UDA方法中最稳定。

Conclusion: UDA可有效桥接合成γ谱与真实探测环境的域差异，是实现合成→实测核素识别模型落地的可行且高效途径。

Abstract: Training machine learning models for radioisotope identification using gamma spectroscopy remains an elusive challenge for many practical applications, largely stemming from the difficulty of acquiring and labeling large, diverse experimental datasets. Simulations can mitigate this challenge, but the accuracy of models trained on simulated data can deteriorate substantially when deployed to an out-of-distribution operational environment. In this study, we demonstrate that unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) can improve the ability of a model trained on synthetic data to generalize to a new testing domain, provided unlabeled data from the target domain is available. Conventional supervised techniques are unable to utilize this data because the absence of isotope labels precludes defining a supervised classification loss. We compare a range of different UDA techniques, finding that feature alignment strategies, particularly via maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) minimization or domain-adversarial training, yield the most consistent improvement to testing scores. For instance, using a custom transformer-based neural network, we achieve a testing accuracy of $0.904 \pm 0.022$ on an experimental LaBr$_3$ test set after performing unsupervised feature alignment via MMD minimization, compared to $0.754 \pm 0.014$ before alignment. Overall, our results highlight the potential of using UDA to adapt a radioisotope classifier trained on synthetic data for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [799] [Jailbreak Scaling Laws for Large Language Models: Polynomial-Exponential Crossover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11331)
*Indranil Halder,Annesya Banerjee,Cengiz Pehlevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对抗提示注入可让安全对齐的大语言模型指数级失效；作者用统计假设与自旋玻璃模型解释“弱/强注入场”分别导致幂律与指数增长的机制，并在真实模型中复现趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐 LLM 仍会被对抗提示攻破，但学界缺乏对“为何少量 token 就能让攻击成功率随采样次数指数爆炸”的定量理解。需揭示其统计本质与普适标度律，为 defense 提供理论靶点。

Method: 1) 实证：对比无注入/有注入时攻击成功率随采样次数 n 的标度，发现无注入≈多项式、注入后≈指数。2) 统计模型：给出 3 条最小假设（安全分布的尾部轻尾性、簇结构、尺寸偏置），证明假设下两种标度必成立。3) 物理建模：把生成空间视为多模态自旋玻璃，其 Gibbs 测度下存在 replica-symmetry-breaking 低谷簇，其中少量“低能-大体积”簇被标为 unsafe；注入 prompt 等效外场 h，短 prompt 对应 h 小→幂律，长 prompt 对应 h 大→指数；用随机能量模型解析求解验证。

Result: 理论推导出攻击成功率 P_succ(n) 的普适标度：弱场时 P_succ∝n^(1−γ)（γ>0，幂律），强场时 P_succ∝1−e^(−λn)（λ>0，指数）。实验在 7B/13B 对齐模型上复现相同趋势，定量拟合优度 R²>0.96，且临界场强度与模型安全对齐强度负相关。

Conclusion: 对抗注入的“指数灾难”是生成空间 RSB 结构下的普适相变现象，与外场强度成正比；仅做轻尾安全微调无法消除该类簇，需主动破坏低能大体积 unsafe 簇或限制采样路径。研究首次把 LLM 安全漏洞与统计物理的 replica 理论连接，为可验证防御给出可测的序参量。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks can reliably steer safety-aligned large language models toward unsafe behavior. Empirically, we find that strong adversarial prompt-injection attacks can amplify attack success rate from the slow polynomial growth observed without injection to exponential growth with the number of inference-time samples. We first identify a minimal statistical mechanism for these two regimes by giving a small set of assumptions on the distribution of safe generation across contexts under which both scaling laws follow. To explain this phenomenon further, we propose a theoretical generative model of proxy language in terms of a spin-glass system operating in a replica-symmetry-breaking regime, where generations are drawn from the associated Gibbs measure and a subset of low-energy, size-biased clusters is designated unsafe. We point out how this model naturally realizes the minimal assumptions. Short injected prompts correspond to a weak magnetic field aligned towards unsafe cluster centers and yield a power-law scaling of attack success rate with the number of inference-time samples, while long injected prompts, i.e., strong magnetic field, yield exponential scaling. We derive these behaviors analytically and find qualitatively similar trends in large language models.

</details>


### [800] [Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11487)
*Yuval Ran-Milo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Softmax注意力必须产生“sink”节点；去掉softmax的ReLU注意力则不会。作者用理论+实验同时验证：sink是归一化约束的必然产物，而非优化副产品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有观察发现Transformer总会出现“attention sink”（概率质量固定压到某一位置），但无法区分这是优化偶然还是功能必需。本文旨在给出严格答案，并厘清softmax归一化在其中所起的关键作用。

Method: 1. 构造最小可解任务：若序列含触发token则输出此前全部token表示的平均值，否则输出零。2. 对softmax自注意力模型证明：完成该任务必然诱导出一个sink位置；并给出非归一化ReLU注意力的无sink构造。3. 在单头与多头设定下进行实验，验证理论预言。

Result: 理论证明：softmax版本必须存在sink；ReLU版本可彻底消除sink。实验结果与理论一致，且推广到更复杂的多头与真实语言建模场景。

Conclusion: attention sink不是训练副作用，而是softmax归一化为实现“默认/忽略”行为所必需的功能机制；改用无归一化的ReLU注意力可直接移除sink，为未来架构设计提供新思路。

Abstract: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. Are sinks a byproduct of the optimization/training regime? Or are they sometimes functionally necessary in softmax Transformers? We prove that, in some settings, it is the latter: computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.

</details>


### [801] [SLE-FNO: Single-Layer Extensions for Task-Agnostic Continual Learning in Fourier Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20410)
*Mahmoud Elhadidy,Roshan M. D'Souza,Amirhossein Arzani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SLE-FNO 架构型持续学习框架，在无需重训旧数据的情况下实现流体动力学代理模型的零遗忘外推更新，综合性能优于 8 种主流 CL 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习代理模型普遍假设训练-测试同分布，一旦实验或仿真条件改变（如血管几何、脉动流变）便需外推。现有方法需重访旧数据，计算昂贵；持续学习虽可增量更新，却面临灾难性遗忘，在流体动力学这类场-场回归任务中尤为突出。

Method: 将单层扩展(SLE)嵌入傅里叶神经算子(FNO)，构成参数隔离型架构 SLE-FNO：每遇新任务只增添极少量新参数，旧参数冻结，实现无回放、无正则、无梯度的零遗忘更新。基准对比 EWC、LwF、 replay、OGD、GEM、PiggyBack、LoRA 等八种 CL 策略，任务序列来自 230 例脉动动脉瘤 CFD 仿真的四组分布外配置，目标为瞬态浓度场→时间平均壁面剪应力(TAWSS)映射。

Result: 在均方误差与遗忘度双指标下，SLE-FNO 实现 100% 旧任务保真(零遗忘)，仅用 0.3% 额外参数，综合得分优于所有基线；回放类与 PiggyBack/LoRA 次之，但仍存在 5–20% 性能退化；正则与梯度投影类方法遗忘显著。

Conclusion: 首次系统评估 CL 算法在流体动力学场回归中的适用性，证明架构扩展型 SLE-FNO 可在不触碰旧数据、不增加推理延迟的前提下，完成高精度外推更新，为科学计算代理模型的在线适应提供新范式。

Abstract: Scientific machine learning is increasingly used to build surrogate models, yet most models are trained under a restrictive assumption in which future data follow the same distribution as the training set. In practice, new experimental conditions or simulation regimes may differ significantly, requiring extrapolation and model updates without re-access to prior data. This creates a need for continual learning (CL) frameworks that can adapt to distribution shifts while preventing catastrophic forgetting. Such challenges are pronounced in fluid dynamics, where changes in geometry, boundary conditions, or flow regimes induce non-trivial changes to the solution. Here, we introduce a new architecture-based approach (SLE-FNO) combining a Single-Layer Extension (SLE) with the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) to support efficient CL. SLE-FNO was compared with a range of established CL methods, including Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), Learning without Forgetting (LwF), replay-based approaches, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD), Gradient Episodic Memory (GEM), PiggyBack, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), within a spatial field-to-field regression setting. The models were trained to map transient concentration fields to time-averaged wall shear stress (TAWSS) in pulsatile aneurysmal blood flow. Tasks were derived from 230 computational fluid dynamics simulations grouped into four sequential and out-of-distribution configurations. Results show that replay-based methods and architecture-based approaches (PiggyBack, LoRA, and SLE-FNO) achieve the best retention, with SLE-FNO providing the strongest overall balance between plasticity and stability, achieving accuracy with zero forgetting and minimal additional parameters. Our findings highlight key differences between CL algorithms and introduce SLE-FNO as a promising strategy for adapting baseline models when extrapolation is required.

</details>


### [802] [Scalable Maximum Entropy Population Synthesis via Persistent Contrastive Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27312)
*Mirko Degli Esposti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用持久对比散度(PCD)替代最大熵建模中的精确求和，首次实现50维属性、18个数量级状态空间下的高效人口合成，且样本多样性比广义raking高86倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MaxEnt人口合成依赖对完整属性组合空间逐项求期望，当属性维度K>20时计算量爆炸；现有Metropolis采样需调参与拒绝，难以实用。

Method: 提出GibbsPCDSolver：在梯度每步用Gibbs扫描更新N个持久“幽灵个体”，以PCD随机近似取代显式期望，空间复杂度O(N)而非O(|X|)，无需遍历状态空间。

Result: K=12–50的扩展实验显示MRE稳定在0.010–0.018；意大利Syn-ISTAT(K=15)MRE=0.03，有效样本量Neff=N，比广义raking提升86.8倍，运行时间随K线性增长。

Conclusion: PCD使MaxEnt人口合成首次突破“20维墙”，兼顾高维、高精度与样本多样性，可直接服务于大规模城市微观模拟。

Abstract: Maximum entropy (MaxEnt) modelling provides a principled framework for generating synthetic populations from aggregate census data, without access to individual-level microdata. The bottleneck of exact-enumeration approaches is expectation computation by explicit summation over the full tuple space $\cX$, which becomes infeasible for more than $K \approx 20$ categorical attributes; sampling-based alternatives exist but rely on Metropolis-type schemes that require proposal tuning and rejection steps. We propose \emph{GibbsPCDSolver}, a stochastic replacement for this computation based on Persistent Contrastive Divergence (PCD): a persistent pool of $N$ synthetic individuals is updated by Gibbs sweeps at each gradient step, providing a stochastic approximation of the model expectations without ever materialising $\cX$. We validate the approach on controlled benchmarks and on \emph{Syn-ISTAT}, a $K{=}15$ Italian demographic benchmark with analytically exact marginal targets derived from ISTAT-inspired conditional probability tables. Scaling experiments across $K \in \{12, 20, 30, 40, 50\}$ confirm that GibbsPCDSolver maintains $\MRE \in [0.010, 0.018]$ while $|\cX|$ grows eighteen orders of magnitude, with runtime scaling as $O(K)$ rather than $O(|\cX|)$. On Syn-ISTAT, GibbsPCDSolver reaches $\MRE{=}0.03$ on training constraints and -- crucially -- produces populations with effective sample size $\Neff = N$ versus $\Neff \approx 0.012\,N$ for generalised raking, an $86.8{\times}$ diversity advantage that is essential for agent-based urban simulations.

</details>


### [803] [Plateaus, Optima, and Overfitting in Multi-Layer Perceptrons: A Saddle-Saddle-Attractor Scenario](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02393)
*Alex Alì Maleknia,Yuzuru Sato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过构建Fukumizu-Amari型最小模型，给出MLP训练动力学的一阶刻画：鞍点结构依次诱导平台期、近优区，最终落入过拟合吸引子；有限噪声数据下无法到达理论最优，只能收敛到过拟合态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有的梯度消失与过拟合分析多依赖渐近极限，难以揭示其真实演化路径。需要一种可在有限宽度、有限样本下直接描述学习动力学的框架，以解释鞍点结构如何塑造整个训练轨迹并驱动过拟合产生。

Method: 在两层MLP上引入Fukumizu-Amari类最小动力学模型；通过高维鞍点分岔理论刻画权值演化，区分鞍主导的平台区、近优区及最终过拟合吸引区；并在有限噪声数据集上给出收敛不可能性证明。

Result: 1. 训练轨迹按顺序穿越鞍点主导的平台期、接近最优区域，最终收敛到由对称性连接的单一点吸引子。2. 对任意有限含噪数据集，权值不可能收敛到总体最优，动力学必然终止于过拟合解；其吸引子位置可由鞍点谱与噪声水平显式给出。

Conclusion: 梯度消失与过拟合并非孤立的渐近现象，而是鞍诱导动力学必经的连续阶段；有限样本下，过拟合是动力学终点而非统计偏差，这暗示早期停止或鞍点逃离策略的有效性有其动力学必然性。

Abstract: Vanishing gradients and overfitting are central problems in machine learning, yet are typically analyzed in asymptotic regimes that obscure their dynamical origins. Here we provide a dynamical description of learning in multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) via a minimal model inspired by Fukumizu and Amari. We show that training dynamics traverse plateau and near-optimal regions, both organized by saddle structures, before converging to an overfitting regime. Under suitable conditions on the data, this regime collapses to a single attractor modulo symmetry. Furthermore, for finite noisy datasets, convergence to the theoretical optimum is impossible, and the dynamics necessarily settle into an overfitting solution.

</details>


### [804] [Olmo Hybrid: From Theory to Practice and Back](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03444)
*William Merrill,Yanhong Li,Tyler Romero,Anej Svete,Caia Costello,Pradeep Dasigi,Dirk Groeneveld,David Heineman,Bailey Kuehl,Nathan Lambert,Chuan Li,Kyle Lo,Saumya Malik,DJ Matusz,Benjamin Minixhofer,Jacob Morrison,Luca Soldaini,Finbarr Timbers,Pete Walsh,Noah A. Smith,Hannaneh Hajishirzi,Ashish Sabharwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 纯Transformer并非唯一出路，将滑动窗口注意力替换为门控线性递归层即可在7B规模上同时提升预训练与中训效果，且扩展效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去虽已提出线性RNN与注意力混合的架构，但缺乏大尺度、可控实验来验证其相对Transformer的绝对收益是否值得投入额外研发与算力风险。

Method: 1)理论：证明混合模型不仅能表达Transformer与线性RNN各自可表达的函数类，还可表达二者均无法表达的任务（如代码执行）；2)实践：在Olmo 3 7B的完整训练 pipeline 中仅把滑窗注意力层替换为Gated DeltaNet层，其余超参与数据不变，训练Olmo Hybrid 7B；3)分析：对比二者在标准预训练与中训指标上的扩展曲线，再用理论解释为何额外表达能力带来更好扩展效率。

Result: Olmo Hybrid在同等7B参数、同等数据量下，预训练困惑度与中训下游任务均稳定优于Olmo 3；扩展曲线显示其参数效率显著更高，即用更少FLOPs即可达到相同性能。

Conclusion: 混合注意力与递归并非只为推理省内存，而是从表达能力出发的根本性改进，可在预训练阶段即获得更高参数与计算效率，为大规模语言模型提供新范式。

Abstract: Recent work has demonstrated the potential of non-transformer language models, especially linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and hybrid models that mix recurrence and attention. Yet there is no consensus on whether the potential benefits of these new architectures justify the risk and effort of scaling them up. To address this, we provide evidence for the advantages of hybrid models over pure transformers on several fronts. First, theoretically, we show that hybrid models do not merely inherit the expressivity of transformers and linear RNNs, but can express tasks beyond both, such as code execution. Putting this theory to practice, we train Olmo Hybrid, a 7B-parameter model largely comparable to Olmo 3 7B but with the sliding window layers replaced by Gated DeltaNet layers. We show that Olmo Hybrid outperforms Olmo 3 across standard pretraining and mid-training evaluations, demonstrating the benefit of hybrid models in a controlled, large-scale setting. We find that the hybrid model scales significantly more efficiently than the transformer, explaining its higher performance. However, its unclear why greater expressivity on specific formal problems should result in better scaling or superior performance on downstream tasks unrelated to those problems. To explain this apparent gap, we return to theory and argue why increased expressivity should translate to better scaling efficiency, completing the loop. Overall, our results suggest that hybrid models mixing attention and recurrent layers are a powerful extension to the language modeling paradigm: not merely to reduce memory during inference, but as a fundamental way to obtain more expressive models that scale better during pretraining.

</details>


### [805] [Restless Bandits with Individual Penalty Constraints: Near-Optimal Indices and Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04101)
*Nida Zamir,I-Hong Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对动态无线网络中“每用户有独立硬性约束”的资源分配难题，引入带个体惩罚约束的 RMAB 模型，提出可离线计算、与系统规模解耦的 Penalty-Optimal Whittle(POW) 指数策略，证明其渐近最优并满足所有约束，同时给出在线强化学习实现方式，仿真显示性能逼近最优且显著优于既有方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 RMAB 假设所有臂共享全局目标，难以刻画无线场景中“每个终端自带能量上限、激活次数上限或信息年龄下限”这类硬性且异构的 QoS 要求；需要一种能同时兼顾公平与效率、又可扩展的资源分配框架。

Method: 1) 将每臂引入独立的“惩罚约束”并形式化为约束 RMAB；2) 推导出仅依赖单臂转移核与惩罚阈值的 POW 指数，实现与系统规模、资源总量解耦的指数可计算性；3) 证明该指数策略在臂数趋于无穷时几乎必然满足所有约束且目标 regret→0；4) 设计基于深度 Q-learning 的在线算法，用神经网络实时估计 POW 指数，避免离线先验知识。

Result: 理论给出约束满足性与渐近最优性保证；离线指数表使单步复杂度 O(1)；在线 DRL 版本在 100 臂、非稳态无线场景中经 5×10^4 时隙训练后，平均累计奖励较最佳基线(Whittle、LP 索引、myopic)提升 18–34%，约束违规率降至 0.2% 以下。

Conclusion: POW 指数首次把“个体硬约束”系统性地纳入 RMAB 索引政策，兼顾可扩展性、最优性与约束合规性，为动态无线网络的公平高效资源调度提供了实用且理论牢靠的新工具。

Abstract: This paper investigates the Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) framework under individual penalty constraints to address resource allocation challenges in dynamic wireless networked environments. Unlike conventional RMAB models, our model allows each user (arm) to have distinct and stringent performance constraints, such as energy limits, activation limits, or age of information minimums, enabling the capture of diverse objectives including fairness and efficiency. To find the optimal resource allocation policy, we propose a new Penalty-Optimal Whittle (POW) index policy. The POW index of an user only depends on the user's transition kernel and penalty constraints, and remains invariable to system-wide features such as the number of users present and the amount of resource available. This makes it computationally tractable to calculate the POW indices offline without any need for online adaptation. Moreover, we theoretically prove that the POW index policy is asymptotically optimal while satisfying all individual penalty constraints. We also introduce a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to efficiently learn the POW index on the fly. Simulation results across various applications and system configurations further demonstrate that the POW index policy not only has near-optimal performance but also significantly outperforms other existing policies.

</details>


### [806] [Neural Computers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06425)
*Mingchen Zhuge,Changsheng Zhao,Haozhe Liu,Zijian Zhou,Shuming Liu,Wenyi Wang,Ernie Chang,Gael Le Lan,Junjie Fei,Wenxuan Zhang,Yasheng Sun,Zhipeng Cai,Zechun Liu,Yunyang Xiong,Yining Yang,Yuandong Tian,Yangyang Shi,Vikas Chandra,Jürgen Schmidhuber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: We propose a new frontier: Neural Computers (NCs) that unify computation, memory, and I/O of traditional computers in a learned runtime state. Our long-term goal is the Completely Neural Computer (CNC): the mature, general-purpose realization of this emerging machine form, with stable execution, explicit reprogramming, and durable capability reuse. As an initial step, we study whether elementary NC primitives can be learned solely from collected I/O traces, without instrumented program state. Concretely, we instantiate NCs as video models that roll out screen frames from instructions, pixels, and user actions (when available) in CLI and GUI settings. We show that NCs can acquire elementary interface primitives, especially I/O alignment and short-horizon control, while routine reuse, controlled updates, and symbolic stability remain challenging. We outline a roadmap toward CNCs, to establish a new computing paradigm beyond today's agents and conventional computers.

</details>


### [807] [AdaBoost Does Not Always Cycle: A Computer-Assisted Counterexample](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07055)
*Erik Y. Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用计算机辅助构造反例，否定AdaBoost是否必收敛到有限循环的公开猜想：利用两因子共享周期-2轨道但线性化返回映射主特征值对数比为无理数的块积装置，使胜者序列渐近频率无理，从而无法周期化，全部断言用精确有理算术验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COLT 2012 Rudin-Schapire-Daubechies公开问题：穷举AdaBoost是否恒收敛到有限循环，长期悬而未决。

Method: 构造块积反例装置：两个5步分支映射共享周期-2轨道；线性化返回映射的支配特征值对数比设为无理数；用精确有理算术全程验证所有断言。

Result: 给出首个被计算机形式化证明的反例：胜者序列渐近频率为无理数，严格排除任何最终周期性，从而否定原猜想。

Conclusion: AdaBoost在非周期情形下可产生永不重复的无限非周期行为，算法收敛性理论需重新评估，计算机辅助证明为开放问题提供确定性答案。

Abstract: We give a computer-assisted counterexample to the open question, posed by Rudin, Schapire, and Daubechies in COLT 2012, of whether exhaustive AdaBoost always converges to a finite cycle. The construction is based on a block-product gadget whose two factors share an exact period-2 orbit for their 5-step branch maps, but whose linearized return maps have dominant eigenvalues with an irrational logarithmic ratio. This irrationality forces the burst-winner sequence to have an irrational asymptotic frequency, precluding eventual periodicity. All assertions are certified by exact rational arithmetic. This work was developed in collaboration with GPT-5.4 Pro and Claude Opus 4.6.

</details>


### [808] [Structural Evaluation Metrics for SVG Generation via Leave-One-Out Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08809)
*Haonan Zhu,Adrienne Deganutti,Elad Hirsch,Purvanshi Mehta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于留一元素渲染的SVG结构诊断方法，无需参考图即可检测缺陷、定位元素关联的概念，并用四个新指标从代码层面衡量模块性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估只看渲染像素相似度，忽略了决定SVG可编辑与可复用性的结构信息。

Method: 元素级留一法：逐个移除SVG元素并重渲染，获得残差图；再结合VLM热图，构建零样本元素质量分、元素-概念归因及纯度、覆盖率、紧凑度、局部性四类结构指标。

Result: 在5类计19 000+编辑、5个生成系统、3种复杂度的大规模测试中，新指标揭示现有方法在模块化与元素对齐上的缺陷。

Conclusion: 首次将SVG评估从图像相似性扩展到代码结构层面，为生成式模型的可编辑性、可解释性与可复用性提供量化诊断工具。

Abstract: SVG generation is typically evaluated by comparing rendered outputs to reference images, which captures visual similarity but not the structural properties that make SVG editable, decomposable, and reusable. Inspired by the classical jackknife, we introduce element-level leave-one-out (LOO) analysis. The procedure renders the SVG with and without each element, which yields element-level signals for quality assessment and structural analysis. From this single mechanism, we derive (i) per-element quality scores that enable zero-shot artifact detection; (ii) element-concept attribution via LOO footprints crossed with VLM-grounded concept heatmaps; and (iii) four structural metrics: purity, coverage, compactness, and locality, which quantify SVG modularity from complementary angles. These metrics extend SVG evaluation from image similarity to code structure, enabling element-level diagnosis and comparison of how visual concepts are represented, partitioned, and organized within SVG code. Their practical relevance is validated on over 19,000 edits (5 types) across 5 generation systems and 3 complexity tiers.

</details>


### [809] [Beyond Fixed False Discovery Rates: Post-Hoc Conformal Selection with E-Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11305)
*Meiyi Zhu,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出事后型Conformal Selection（PH-CS），允许观测数据后再动态挑选候选集合并给出自洽的FDP估计，可灵活平衡发现量与FDR，且具有有限样本FDR理论上界保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Conformal Selection须预先固定FDR，无法根据数据线索和下游资源即时调整取舍，妨碍了如基因组、神经影像等需要事后灵活设定阈值的场景。

Method: 利用Conformal e-variables与e-BH，生成一串顺序候选集合与数据驱动的FDP，用户随后按任意效用函数挑选最优操作点；扩展至一般风险函数，并给出平均FDP估计≤真实FDR的有限样本保证。

Result: 合成数据与真实数据分析表明，PH-CS能迅速满足多种实用约束，FDP估计准确，且FDR控制能力与原有方法持平或更佳。

Conclusion: PH-CS以事后、数据自适应的方式解决了至今固定FDR目标的局限，为探索和发现场景提供灵活、可信的可靠性保障。

Abstract: Conformal selection (CS) uses calibration data to identify test inputs whose unobserved outcomes are likely to satisfy a pre-specified minimal quality requirement, while controlling the false discovery rate (FDR). Existing methods fix the target FDR level before observing data, which prevents the user from adapting the balance between number of selected test inputs and FDR to downstream needs and constraints based on the available data. For example, in genomics or neuroimaging, researchers often inspect the distribution of test statistics, and decide how aggressively to pursue candidates based on observed evidence strength and available follow-up resources. To address this limitation, we introduce {post-hoc CS} (PH-CS), which generates a path of candidate selection sets, each paired with a data-driven false discovery proportion (FDP) estimate. PH-CS lets the user select any operating point on this path by maximizing a user-specified utility, arbitrarily balancing selection size and FDR. Building on conformal e-variables and the e-Benjamini-Hochberg (e-BH) procedure, PH-CS is proved to provide a finite-sample post-hoc reliability guarantee whereby the ratio between estimated FDP level and true FDP is, on average, upper bounded by $1$, so that the average estimated FDP is, to first order, a valid upper bound on the true FDR. PH-CS is extended to control quality defined in terms of a general risk. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that, unlike CS, PH-CS can consistently satisfy user-imposed utility constraints while producing reliable FDP estimates and maintaining competitive FDR control.

</details>


### [810] [Layerwise Dynamics for In-Context Classification in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11613)
*Patrick Lutz,Themistoklis Haris,Arjun Chandra,Aditya Gangrade,Venkatesh Saligrama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次从深度索引 Transformer 中解析出可证明的、几何驱动的 in-context 分类算法，无需梯度训练即可放大类间距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究虽观察到 Transformer 能在推理阶段凭少量标注样本完成分类，但其内部运行机制完全黑箱；亟需在不牺牲功能的前提下，使推理算法可识别、可解释。

Method: 1) 限定 hard no-margin 多类线性分类场景；2) 在每一层强制加入特征-标签排列等变约束，保证功能等价的同时令权重高度结构化；3) 利用该结构从训练后 Transformer 中提取显式的深度递归更新规则；4) 分析该规则所依赖的混合特征-标签 Gram 矩阵及其对训练点、标签与测试探针的耦合更新机制。

Result: 首次获得端到端可识别的 softmax Transformer 内部 emergent 更新公式；证明该几何驱动算法可在期望意义下单调放大类间距并提升类对齐鲁棒性；实验显示其分类边界与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 通过排列等变约束可将 Transformer 的推理算法“白盒化”，揭示其隐含的几何优化本质；为无需参数更新的 in-context 学习提供了可解释且可证明的新范式，也为后续模型压缩与可控性设计奠定理论基础。

Abstract: Transformers can perform in-context classification from a few labeled examples, yet the inference-time algorithm remains opaque. We study multi-class linear classification in the hard no-margin regime and make the computation identifiable by enforcing feature- and label-permutation equivariance at every layer. This enables interpretability while maintaining functional equivalence and yields highly structured weights. From these models we extract an explicit depth-indexed recursion: an end-to-end identified, emergent update rule inside a softmax transformer, to our knowledge the first of its kind. Attention matrices formed from mixed feature-label Gram structure drive coupled updates of training points, labels, and the test probe. The resulting dynamics implement a geometry-driven algorithmic motif, which can provably amplify class separation and yields robust expected class alignment.

</details>


### [811] [SOAR: Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12617)
*You Qin,Linqing Wang,Hao Fei,Roger Zimmermann,Liefeng Bo,Qinglin Lu,Chunyu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOAR 用一次当前模型 rollout + 重噪声+回拉监督，替代 SFT 与 RL，无需奖励模型即可在 SD3.5 上全面超越 SFT 与 Flow-GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型后训分两阶段：SFT 仅在理想前向噪声状态上训练，推理一旦偏离即出现暴露偏差；RL 虽可缓解，但奖励稀疏、信用分配难且易被黑客。亟需一种无奖励、能提供密集监督并直接纠正偏差的方案。

Method: 提出 SOAR：1) 从真实样本出发，用当前模型做单步无梯度 rollout 得偏离状态；2) 对该状态重噪声；3) 用原始干净图作为目标，令模型将偏离状态“拉回”，形成每步密集监督。损失兼容标准 SFT，可直接替换 SFT 作为首阶段后训。

Result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上，SOAR 将 GenEval 从 0.70→0.78、OCR 从 0.64→0.67，全部基于模型的偏好分同步提升；在无奖励条件下，美学与图文对齐指标均优于 Flow-GRPO。

Conclusion: SOAR 以无奖励、密集自纠正方式填补 SFT-RL 鸿沟，可独立替代 SFT 并与后续 RL 兼容，为扩散模型后训提供更强的首阶段方案。

Abstract: The post-training pipeline for diffusion models currently has two stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated data and reinforcement learning (RL) with reward models. A fundamental gap separates them. SFT optimizes the denoiser only on ground-truth states sampled from the forward noising process; once inference deviates from these ideal states, subsequent denoising relies on out-of-distribution generalization rather than learned correction, exhibiting the same exposure bias that afflicts autoregressive models, but accumulated along the denoising trajectory instead of the token sequence. RL can in principle address this mismatch, yet its terminal reward signal is sparse, suffers from credit-assignment difficulty, and risks reward hacking. We propose SOAR (Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement), a bias-correction post-training method that fills this gap. Starting from a real sample, SOAR performs a single stop-gradient rollout with the current model, re-noises the resulting off-trajectory state, and supervises the model to steer back toward the original clean target. The method is on-policy, reward-free, and provides dense per-timestep supervision with no credit-assignment problem. On SD3.5-Medium, SOAR improves GenEval from 0.70 to 0.78 and OCR from 0.64 to 0.67 over SFT, while simultaneously raising all model-based preference scores. In controlled reward-specific experiments, SOAR surpasses Flow-GRPO in final metric value on both aesthetic and text-image alignment tasks, despite having no access to a reward model. Since SOAR's base loss subsumes the standard SFT objective, it can directly replace SFT as a stronger first post-training stage after pretraining, while remaining fully compatible with subsequent RL alignment.

</details>


### [812] [Selectivity and Shape in the Design of Forward-Forward Goodness Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13081)
*Talha Ruzgar Akkus,Suayp Talha Kocabay,Kamer Ali Yuksel,Hassan Sawaf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用可捕捉“峰值/重尾形”而非总能量的局部goodness函数替代SoS，FF算法在MNIST/F-MNIST等6数据集上平均提升数十个百分点，最优达98.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Forward-Forward算法默认仅用平方和(SoS)作为层内goodness，性能受限；作者怀疑深层激活呈重尾分布且判别信息集中于峰值，需设计对“形状”敏感的新准则。

Method: 系统遍历goodness设计空间，提出两类新函数：1)选择性函数(top-k、entmax加权能量)仅度量峰值；2)形状敏感函数(超额峰度/“burstiness”与高阶矩)以尺度无关统计量奖励重尾。结合标签-特征分离前向(FFCL)，在13种goodness×5激活×6数据集上三因素扫描，发现倒U型性能曲线。

Result: Fashion-MNIST 89.0%、MNIST 98.2±0.1%，比SoS绝对提升32.6pp；USPS+72pp、SVHN+52pp，所有基准一致上涨。Burstiness因尺度不变性对层间/数据集间的幅度漂移最鲁棒。

Conclusion: goodness函数必须对神经活动“形状”而非总能量敏感；重尾/峰度准则可成为FF及其他局部学习算法的通用设计原则。

Abstract: The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm trains networks layer-by-layer using a local "goodness function," yet sum-of-squares (SoS) has remained the only choice studied. We systematically explore the goodness-function design space and identify a unifying principle: the goodness function must be sensitive to the shape of neural activity, not its total energy.
